resort_details: Escape to the heart of Cancun at Secrets The Vine Cancun. This adults-only, ultra-chic, contemporary resort offers all the indulgences of Unlimited-Luxury® starting with 497 modern, elegant guest rooms and suites complete with Italian porcelain and teak wood furnishings and sleek, private terraces overlooking the crystal-clear Caribbean Sea and Laguna Nichupte. Enjoy limitless gourmet dining, top-shelf spirits and exciting live entertainment here or spend a night out with the Sip, Savor & See Dining Experience at nearby participating resorts. Relax by one of the sparkling swimming pools, partake in many of the daily activities that are offered, or enjoy a spa treatment at the exquisite Secrets Spa by Pevonia®, boldly inspired by cave-like structures and natural cenotes of the area.

room_details.room_Description: Standard units sleep up to 2 or 3 people and have a full bathroom with a separate shower, water closet and vanity. resort_details: Worldmark Big Bear offers vacationers a wonderful escape from the hustle and bustle of city life. The resort features excellent accommodations with proximity to all of the action and beauty that the area has to offer. On site, there's an outdoor pool with attached spa, outdoor children's pool, children's play area, tennis courts, a game room with pool tables, ping-pong, arcade games, air hockey, a fitness center, and a shared computer area with Internet access.

room_details.room_Description: Worldmark Big Bear consists of 110 studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom units, all with small decks or balconies. Some of the one-bedroom units are equipped with sofa beds. Other amenities include cable TV with VCR/DVD player, telephone, high-speed Internet access (fee applicable), gas fireplace, gas barbecue, washer/dryer, iron and ironing board, hairdryer, and kitchen with microwave and dishwasher. Units are not air-conditioned.

resort_details: Berkshire Mountain Lodge is a family vacation destination for all seasons that will include days filled with countryside beauty, an abundance of historical museums, fine dining to whet your appetite, and scores of shopping opportunities where you’ll find unique treasures to take back home.

room_details.room_Description: Berkshire Mountain Lodge features one-bedroom, newly renovated suites with modern amenities such as full kitchens and cozy living and dining areas. Dogs must be under 35 pounds, and the resort must approve before arrival.

room_details.room_Description: Spacious studios, one, two, and three-bedroom suites featuring fully-equipped kitchens, a TV, DVD player, and complimentary high-speed wireless internet access.

resort_details: Centrally located in the heart of Myrtle Beach and across the street from the beach, the 20-story Carolina Grande offers spectacular views the Grand Strand. Or spend the day by the resort pool outside on the sixth floor. Treat yourself to some quiet time in the hot tub while the view and gentle ocean breezes soothe you. You're also welcome to enjoy the amenities of The Carolinian Beach Resort, including an outdoor pool, hot tub and a lazy river. Carolina Grande is ideally located near a variety of restaurants and entertainment venues, many within walking distance. It's the perfect place to stay.

room_details.room_Description: The Chetola Lodge has 42 large rooms and overlooks the grounds or the lake. They feature two queen-size beds or one king-size bed. The lodge also has five designer-suites and 1-4 bedroom condominiums.

resort_details: Wyndham at the Cottages is just blocks from the Atlantic Ocean, where Charter fishing, sailing, swimming, and barbecues by the pool are a few ways to enjoy your stay. Golfers can choose from 120 golf courses nearby, and be sure to try some of the many nearby restaurants. Guests can spend the day at amusement parks, shopping malls with more than 2,000 shops, and 60 miles of Grand Strand Beach. Pets are not allowed on-site. Check-in is 4pm daily. Check-out is at 10am. Tower 4 check-in is open 8am-9pm Fri-sun. When closed, use Tower 2 check-in, open 24/7. Bike rallies during the month of May each year will cause more noise and traffic. Most amenities require a moderate fee, and call the resort for specifics. The resort enforces maximum occupancy limits. Units are non-smoking.

place_name: Club Wyndham At The Cottages - 3 Nights

Guests can also enjoy access to Wyndham Ocean Boulevard fitness center facilities. Most amenities require a moderate fee, and you can contact the resort in advance to get specific pricing. Motorcycle rallies during the month of May each year will create noise and traffic delays. The resort offers 24-hour secured parking for motorcycles.

room_details.room_Description: All guests checking into the Cottages will check in at the Wyndham Ocean Boulevard Resort, 410 S. Ocean Blvd. North Myrtle Beach. These spacious 3 & 4-bedroom cottages have a mixture of king and queen beds, plus a queen sleeper sofa in the living room. Occupancy limits are strictly enforced, units are non-smoking, and pets are not allowed on the property. Call the resort in advance to discuss special needs. No RVs, boats, trailers, or oversized vehicles can be parked on the property. 5 lots near the resort offer Trailer parking for a fee. Accommodations sleep between 4 to 10 people, and make for an ideal gathering spot for a family vacation. Each air-conditioned unit features a full kitchen, laundry unit and living area. There are gas grills available throughout the property for your convenience. There are elevators available for all Coral Sands Resort North units.

A scenic canal system navigates this community of resort condos and residential properties. The18-hole golf course, tennis courts, hairdresser, lake, and exercise equipment are waiting right outside your door! An indoor pool, outdoor pool, miniature golf course, and playground are perfect for kids. Arriving by boat? The resort includes boat slips up to 60 feet in length. room_details.room_Description: Cozy one and two bedroom condos are nestled between the quaint canals and walkways. The units overlook the lovely Neuse River, golf course, poolside, and lakes. All units come complete with washer/dryer, full kitchen, air conditioning, dishwasher, microwave, carpet, and telephone. The largest unit sleeps six guests comfortably. This is the perfect escape for retired couples or families traveling with small children.

resort_details: FF HARBOUR/WINDJAMMER II is located right on the banks of the Neuse River. A Venice-like canal system laces much of this resort community, providing the perfect setting for those seeking a relaxing vacation near the water. The resort offers an outdoor pool, tennis courts, a recreation center with an indoor swimming pool and hot tub, a miniature golf course, one 18-hole golf course, and boat slips that can handle guest boats up to 60 feet in length. The resort does not offer boat rentals. Boat rentals are available in New Bern and Morehead City during summer months only.

room_details.room_Description: The accomodations are clean, spacious, and charming, with decks overlooking the lake. Many are so close, in fact, you can fish right from your deck. All units are carpeted and equipped with air-conditioning, telephone, and a full kitchen with dishwasher, microwave, and washer and dryer. Other in-room amenties include a coffee maker, cable TV, and alarm clock. If you and your family are looking for a quiet and relaxing getaway, come stay at the Wyndam Resort at Fairfield Harbor. You'll want to return again and again.

resort_details: Grand Palms Resort Villas, formerly Plantation Resort Villas, is three miles south of Myrtle Beach. It is a beautiful place to stay, with the stunning Atlantic Ocean beaches just one mile away. A protected bird sanctuary, home to various wildlife species, surrounds the resort. Guests can enjoy the outdoor swimming pool, sundeck, Lazy River, and water playground. There is also a fitness room and activity center, an indoor pool, certified aerobics, an exercise room, a weight room, saunas and steam rooms, massage therapy, and Wi-Fi internet access. For after-hours check-in information, call 1-888-913-4477 or email reservations@grandpalmsresortmb.com. To learn more about Club Wyndham Grand Palms, visit their website at www.grandpalmsesortmb.com.

room_details.room_Description: Grand Palms Resort Villas is a vacationer's paradise ideal for couples, families and groups looking to get away. Relax in spacious, air-conditioned comfort in hotel units that sleep two, one-bedroom units that sleep four to six, two-bedroom units that sleep six to eight, and three-bedroom units that sleep up to eight. All accommodations come with kitchen facilities that include a microwave, dishwasher and washer/dryers. Please note some 1 bedroom and 2 bedroom units have stairs to get to the Bedrooms.

place_name: Holiday Inn Club Vacations South Beach Resort
resort_details: Set on 16 acres, Holiday Inn Club Vacations South Beach Resort pairs gracious Southern hospitality with an array of essential amenities. Hit the water at Splash Cove with a lazy river and giant waterslides, or relax in a lush, private setting at the Lagoon Pool and Captain Cliff’s Bar. We also have an indoor pool and hot tub open year-round. Our fully equipped fitness center features a sauna with lockers, and kids love the onsite activity center and video game rooms.

room_details.room_Description: Myrtle Beach vacations are best at Holiday Inn Club Vacations® South Beach Resort! The resort is just a two-minute walk across the street from an unspoiled stretch of white-sand Myrtle Beach. Families enjoy our spacious hotel units, studio, or 1 and 2-bedroom villas from 410 to 1,144 square feet. You’ll love the living room, plus prepare delicious meals in your full kitchen with cookware and dining table with tableware included. Wifi, parking, and a beach shuttle are complimentary for our guests.

resort_details: This impressive resort sits on 24 plush acres brimming with freshwater lagoons, swaying palms, and lush tropical foliage. For your recreational pleasure, there are nine tennis courts, a children's pool & playground, a lap pool, and a seasonal hot tub with a tanning shelf. Also available is a workout facility & sauna, basketball, a double-sided hitting wall, a pickle ball court, and on-site bike rental. Guests can fish from the banks of the resort's lagoons, explore the white, sandy beach or just feel the gentle waves roll up to their beach chair. All this awaits you at the Seawatch Island Club Resort.

room_details.room_Description: The resort boasts a choice of elegant and spacious two- and three-bedroom condominiums in a modern mid-rise building. Units can sleep up to eight guests comfortably and invite you with enjoy fully equipped kitchens that include microwave, dishwasher and washer/dryer. The resort cannot honor unit upgrades or moves. All units are air-conditioned, well carpeted, and feature private balconies offering the views and vacation memories of a lifetime.

resort_details: Experience the quiet ambiance of Island Links Resort by Palmera on Hilton Head Island. Enjoy the on-site clubhouse & activities room, shuffleboard court, horseshoe pit, the Fitness Center located on the second floor of the clubhouse, seasonal heated pool, and watch the kids splash around the zero entrance pool. Pool Bar with light snacks, sodas and alcoholic beverages is open from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day Weekend. There is also complimentary beach shuttle from April 1st through September 30.

Our 2 bedroom units are not in elevator buildings

place_name: Margaritaville Vacation Club by Wyndham - Atlanta
resort_details: Find your piece of paradise in Atlanta, Georgia. This metropolis has a heat reminiscent of the islands while bringing its unique vibe to the table - a cool, hip, no-worries feeling that invites you to grab a cold one after a day of exploration. Margaritaville Vacation Club Atlanta is located in the heart of downtown Atlanta, overlooking the beautiful Centennial Olympic Park. It's an easy walk to the SkyView observation wheel, unique museums, delicious restaurants, and the iconic Georgia Aquarium. Back at the resort, unwind and take in the city skyline from the lounge, or chill at the rooftop pool and bar with your favorite cocktail in hand, of course.

Our unique villas offer all the comforts of home, plus use of the facilities at the award-winning Westin Resort Hilton Head Island. The Westin Resort in Port Royal Plantation offers a convenient shuttle service to golf, beach and tennis. Receive discounted rates on one of three championship golf courses at Port Royal Golf Club and one free hour of tennis court time daily. Enjoy dining at the Westin and rejuvenate your body in our new Heavenly Spa by Westin.

Resort is centrally located on the beach at Mile Post 9, with an abundance of restaurants, shopping stores/malls, recreational activities and historical sites nearby. Resort amenities include: on-site parking; clubhouse with recreation activities for both children/adults: free wifi throughout; two swimming pools, one indoor, each with hot tub; child outdoor pool; tennis court; two shuffleboard courts; playground; direct boardwalk access to beach, with gazebo & observation deck; golf privileges for $20; full YMCA privileges with indoor pool.

room_details.room_Description: All the comforts of home, plus a whole lot more – that is what you will find at the Outer Banks Beach Club I. These one- or three-bedroom villas come with fully-equipped kitchens, plenty of living space and enough room to have private time to yourself. Comfortable couches, beds and chairs abound, as do all the modern electronic conveniences and entertainment. All condos are non-smoking and comfortably climate-controlled and include free wifi. Barbeque grills are located on property.

resort_details: Kill Devil Hills not only has great surf, sand, and sun, but it's also the place where the Wright Brothers made the state of North Carolina 'First in Flight.' At the Outer Banks Beach Club, you'll feel like the beach is your own private paradise. Enjoy swimming, surfing, fishing, and other water sports. Tee off at the nearby golf club or enjoy a game of tennis or shuffleboard. Bordered by the Atlantic Ocean, the resort offers two outdoor pools, a children's pool, an indoor pool, and indoor & outdoor spas.

room_details.room_Description: The Outer Banks Beach Club offers beautiful grounds and comfortable accommodations. The resort is perfect for vacationing families or couples enjoying a getaway. Relax in spacious, air-conditioned comfort with one-bedroom units that sleep up to four guests and two-bedroom units that sleep up to six. All accommodations come with full kitchens that include a microwave & dishwasher. Some units have private balconies as well.

resort_details: Embrace Coastal Carolina at Port O’ Call, conveniently located within the Shipyard community. Only moments away from the idyllic Atlantic coastline and surrounded by tall pines, rustic oaks, and tropical palms, the picturesque location is the perfect backdrop for any Hilton Head Island getaway. Guests may enjoy a short walk to the beach, a dip in the outdoor free-form pool, or play a round of golf or tennis game at nearby award-winning facilities. Those who wish to relax can unwind using the resort’s invigorating sauna and hot tubs. Explore the 883-acre Shipyard property by bicycle along the network of walking paths, or the island in its entirety through 117 miles of shared-use pathways. Port O’ Call’s prime location makes it an ideal starting point to partake in Hilton Head Island’s wide assortment of dining, shopping, recreational, and entertainment options. Please note: Resort Fee due upon check-in and pool towels are not provided.

The resort's heated pool area has a children's pool as well as a hot tub. Close by, you'll find great shopping, marinas, and restaurants. Rented bicycles can be delivered to your unit. Enjoy all that Hilton Head Island has to offer from this intimate resort community. Sight-seeing in Savannah, Georgia, and Beaufort is only 45 minutes away.

resort_details: Sheraton Broadway Villas stands in the heart of it all. Championship golf and tennis, Broadway at the Beach, a hot shopping and entertainment district, and the famous sandy shores of Myrtle Beach are just blocks away. The resort offers family activities such as a climate-controlled indoor and outdoor pool, miniature golf, sand volleyball, a lazy river, and a seasonal pool bar. Work up a sweat playing tennis or in the fitness center, complete with aerobic machines and free weights, conveniently open 24 hours a day.

room_details.room_Description: Lovely, fully furnished accommodations welcome you with stylish décor whether you are planning a romantic getaway or an exciting family vacation. Relax in spacious, air-conditioned comfort with one-bedroom units that sleep up to four guests and are furnished with a queen bed, a full-size sofa sleeper, and a mini or full kitchen. Two-bedroom units sleep up to eight and are furnished with one king bed, one queen bed, a queen sofa sleeper, and a full kitchen.

resort_details: Shore Crest Phase I overlooks the Atlantic Ocean. Just a short boardwalk stroll from the beach, guests enjoy the beautiful beach areas. Visitors can also swim in the indoor/outdoor pool or float in the tubes on the Lazy River. Work out in the health club with the exercise equipment, then relax in the whirlpool/hot tub. Family-friendly, take advantage of the barbecue grills. Kids will enjoy the on-site games room. The resort is wheelchair accessible. Guest laundry facilities are available.

room_details.room_Description: One-bedroom units sleep up to four guests, two-bedroom units accommodate from four to six guests and have a king-size bed and a twin-size sleeper sofa bed. Enjoy cable/satellite TV with DVD and VCR players. Additional seating is available throughout the units. Wireless Internet access and CD players are also available. Full kitchens, including microwave ovens, are available for guest convenience, as well as separate dining areas. Private bathrooms come with hair dryers. All units are air-conditioned and have washers and dryers.

resort_details: Shore Crest Vacation Villas II is located across the street from the beach, in the Windy Hill section of North Myrtle Beach. On-site amenities include an outdoor pool, lazy river, and an indoor and outdoor hot tub. Please contact the resort to confirm your unit view.

resort_details: The Carolina Club by Spinnaker is located within a tranquil community. The resort features two- and three-bedroom single and multi-level villas with many amenities. On-site are moss-covered Live Oak trees, manicured golf courses, a fish-stocked interconnected lagoon system, bicycle paths, pool, hot tub, tennis/sport courts, children’s playground, two adult bikes included with each villa, activity center with fitness area and lounge area. Guests can enjoy the Zipline Hilton Head - which boarders Broad Creek, deep-sea fishing to dolphin-watching cruises, water activities, and day trips to historic Beaufort, Savannah, and Charleston. This is a Gated Community.

room_details.room_Description: The resort proudly features luxurious two- and three-bedroom villas in magnificent one- and two-level layouts. Units are designed to sleep six to eight guests comfortably. All are carpeted and air-conditioned. Each lovely villa provides fully equipped kitchens with sit up bars, microwave, dishwasher, washer/dryer, spacious open concept living areas, elegant furnishings, and private bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms. Carolina Club villas have several stairs to entry. If you feel that the steps may prohibit you from accessing villa or enjoying your stay please contact your exchange company for alternative accommodations

resort_details: Located two blocks from the beach and Coligny Plaza, Waterside offers the convenience of a full-scale resort, with the comforts of home. Accommodations are spacious one- , two- and three-bedroom, elevator-accessible villas. On-site amenities include three pools: zero-entry, heated, and children's - as well as a hot tub, free Wi-Fi, and bike trails. Waterside also features resort activities to suit a variety of ages and interests. Golf and tennis are nearby, as well as restaurants and shopping, which are within walking distance of the resort. Try Zipline Hilton Head, an adventurer’s island attraction and enjoy water sports.

room_details.room_Description: Units range from one, two and three bedrooms at Waterside by Spinnaker, providing ample space for groups of four to eight. The experience is enhanced by open concept living and dining areas, private bed and bathroom areas, well-appointed kitchens, and balconies from which you can enjoy the natural beauty of this idyllic setting.

resort_details: In less than 50 years, Dubai has become one of the fastest growing and dynamic cities on the globe. Within that exciting environment, Palm Jumeirah has become one of the most talked about master developments and the so-called "Eighth Wonder of The World". Balqis Residence is located within that wonder, sitting atop the Crescent of Palm Jumeirah and within easy reach of all that the city of Dubai has to offer. The resort is only 30 minutes away from the busiest international airport in the world, the tallest building on the planet and the largest shopping mall ever built. Dubai has become a haven for shoppers, party-goers, golfers and sun worshippers alike and Balqis Residence allows visitors to stay within a tranquil and secure, beach front community, just minutes away from all that Dubai has to offer.

room_details.room_Description: All apartments in Aria Vacation Club, Balqis Residence, are fitted out to a high standard with built-in closets, marble and granite kitchens and bathrooms. All units are air-conditioned and have access to IPTVs as well as containing a fully fitted kitchen with all the appliances and equipment for those that choose to self-cater. All properties are decorated tastefully and elegantly and provide a relaxed environment for families. 24 hour service from the operational team ensures that guests are taken care of extensively and efficiently throughout their stay. Select apartments also offer a full view of the Gulf or a postcard view of Dubai Marina and the city beyond.

resort_details: Set in beautiful grounds on the shores of the Swartviei Lake in Sedgefield, this resort offers fishing, bird watching, boating, and other water sports, all at your doorstep.

Just a lion's roar from Kruger Gate on the Sabie River, this exciting resort offers luxurious, self-contained bush lodges for those who like to enjoy the wilderness in style. The resort has been carefully planned to preserve natural ecology, offering personally supervised game walks into the bushes, allowing for a whole new dimension to game-viewing.

With its personalized service and a palatial experience, guests will be spoiled with choices and exclusive access to facilities and services available throughout Al Habtoor city, Dubai's first integrated urban resort. Guests will enjoy access to three swimming pools, two spas with a combined 32 treatment rooms, a fitness facility, La Perle by Dragone (Dubai's 1st theater production), and a supervised Kids Club with activities & separate swimming pool. In addition, The Dubail Mall, Dubai Creek, the Gold and Spice Souq, Ski Dubai and Dubai Parks are all less than 30 minutes away.

resort_details: Astoria Boracay is a relaxing beachfront hotel on Boracay Island in the Phillippines, and it is consistently rated one of the world's best islands for vacationing. Upon arrival you are greeted by friendly hotel staff and complimentary welcome drinks. Astoria Boracay aims to make every stay a memorable one, and offers room service, laundry service and free clothes drying for swimsuits and towels. Guests can cool off at the white sand beach or in the hotel's private outdoor pool. Additionally, hotel staff can help you book activities such as a golf outing or watersports, and you can rent mountain bikes or motor bikes to get around the island. Located in Boracay's coveted Station 1 region, Astoria Boracay is within walking distance of the island's shopping center, delicious restaurants and popular bars.

room_details.room_Description: Astoria Boracay has several room types that offer studio or one bed and range from 393 to 620 square feet (36 to 57 square meters). All rooms are non-smoking and include modern amenities such as air conditioning, a 32-inch flat screen TV with cable and DVD player, free WiFi, a refrigerator and microwave, an in-room safe, telephone, coffee maker and even slippers to use during your stay. Each room also features a tranquil terrace that allows you to enjoy the beauty of the island from right outside your room. Accommodations are available for disabled guests.

resort_details: Nestled on the coconut grove slopes of Koh Samui, Karma Apsara blends spacious residences with lavish amenities to create a tranquil beachfront getaway. Relax in our infinity pool or sundeck daybeds to enjoy a panoramic view of Koh Samui’s breathtaking north coast, or take a walk through our perfectly tended tropical gardens. Our semi al fresco restaurant, featuring floor to ceiling glass, serves unique cuisine inspired by traditional Thai street fare, while our poolside bar and well-stocked cellar offer a selection of fine wines and a wide variety of cocktails. For those looking for some rest and relaxation, you can indulge in a Thai message from one of Karma Spa’s bodyworkers.

room_details.room_Description: Karma Apsara boasts 32 studios and spacious one and two-bedroom residences, perfect for single adventurers, couples or families. All residences feature comfortable king or queen-sized beds, modern bathrooms with walk-in rain showers, and private terraces overlooking your choice of a garden or ocean view. You can enjoy daily cleaning services, concierge services, and access to Internet and cable television all from the comfort of your room. Accommodations are also equipped with a microwave, refrigerator, in-room safe, mini-bar and work station – everything you need for the all-inclusive vacation experience.

resort_details: Located in the picturesque island village of Kumarakom, Karma Chakra is perched on the coconut palm-fringed banks of Vembanad, the largest lake in Kerala. Boasting 12 wildlife sanctuaries and two national parks, Karma Chakra is strategically positioned to explore the area’s rich culture, eco-tourism attractions and the surrounding cluster of little islets. Offering unmatched, 360-degree views from almost every vantage point amongst its tropically landscaped, sprawling grounds, the boutique resort offers an intimate collection of guest rooms, all with spacious outdoor balconies and sweeping vistas and also organize country boat and house boat cruise through Vembanadu Lake.

room_details.room_Description: Your home throughout your stay at Karma Chakra is in one of 24 luxurious air-conditioned rooms – all with private outdoor balconies. Elegantly furnished with traditional Keralan accents, they feature comfortable beds with plush bedding, stylish en-suite bathrooms, TVs, tea- and coffee-making facilities. These 45-square-metre rooms offer plenty of space in which to spread out and relax. Ideal for couples and solo travellers, these comfortable rooms are cozy and there's plenty of space in which to kick back and reflect on the day's adventures.

resort_details: Located at the Northern end of Jaipur the Ratan Haveli is an authentic old family mansion dating back to the 1700’s and the golden age of the Maharajas. Designed and furnished by local Jaipur designers there is an air of authenticity about this stunning location. Close to the ancient city walls The Ratan Haveli is a mere 10 minutes from the centre of the Pink City. The hotel has spacious bedrooms, the cosy Ambar bar and the Pink Palace restaurant. A fully renovated bawdi (stepped well) forms the centre piece of the gardens. Rooftop terraces provide a great view of the ancient town battlements. Reort Email : ratanhaveli@karmaresorts.com

resort_details: Royal Lighthouse Villa, at Boat Lagoon Resort -- a tranquil resort set in one of Thailand's beautiful marinas, is situated on the east coast of Phuket. It is renowned as a popular holiday destination. Along the boardwalk, there are varied choices of cafes, restaurants, boating trips, car hires, tours, etc. available. Enjoy the on-site facilities of gym, swimming pool, hot tub, sauna and steam room.

resort_details: Experience the best of both worlds at Karma Royal Monterio in northern Goa, which rests on an undulating hillside next to the Baga River. The resort is in a prime location close to Goa's most vibrant beaches, trendy bars, and night markets. The rooms here are luxurious and spacious, with a selection of studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments to choose from. The resort also has two pools, a game room, and a fabulous restaurant if all you want to do is relax on the resort.

resort_details: Karma Royal Palms has been designed in an elegant colonial style, featuring landscaped gardens that give the resort its name. Close to Benaulim Beach, it features a selection of studios, and one and two-bedroom apartments and there is a range of amenities to help you have that well-deserved holiday. The 24-hour reception, gym, spa, and children’s activity program all contribute to making your holiday as comfortable as possible and giving you the chance to discover the joys of Goan culture.

room_details.room_Description: Your luxurious suite at Karma Royal Palms awaits! Choose from studio units, one-bedroom, two-bedroom apartments, and two-bedroom combination units. The largest two-bedroom combination apartments sleep up to eight guests comfortably. Enjoy modern conveniences in a classic setting. Each unit includes a partial kitchen, one or two bathrooms, a telephone, and air conditioning. All units are fully furnished with lovely garden views. Select units have balconies or patios overlooking the palm trees and pools.

resort_details: Set on the banks of the languid Thu Bon River surrounded by tropical verdure, Karma Song Hoai is the perfect luxury enclave from which to discover the romance and allure of UNESCO World Heritage Site Hoi An Town. The resort has a restaurant, bar, gym, spa, outdoor pool, garden, terrace, barbecue facilities, tour arrangements, free WiFi, etc.

room_details.room_Description: The resort offers hotel units and one-bedroom units that are comfortable and warm-styled to bring a feeling of home. The unit has large beds, bathrooms, air conditioning, tea and coffee facilities, and a minibar.

resort_details: In the heart of the scenic Kenting in southern Taiwan, guests enjoy rustic fun on a Western-style ranch and 40 acres of beautiful and lush green valley. The resort is located within National Kenting Park and offers an extensive range of activities for all ages. Take a dip in the outdoor pool, and keep up your health routine at the 26,000-square-foot fitness center. The lake offers plenty of opportunities for fishing, and mountain trails are waiting for you to explore. Later enjoy flavorful cuisine at the on-site restaurant.

room_details.room_Description: The resort's 309 wood cabins are imported from Canada and look out to picturesque expanses of blue sky and lush greenery. Each air-conditioned lodge unit includes one bedroom and sleeps up to either two or four people.

resort_details: Naman Retreat is a secluded, beachfront enclave nestled between two of the finest golf courses in Southeast Asia. This eco-chic, environmentally friendly retreat has impressive bamboo architecture, no-wall spa lifestyle with contemporary designs and is the perfect getaway for those who crave something bold and unique to awaken the senses. With the award-winning Pure spa offering various treatments, guests leave enriched, renewed and rejuvenated. The stunning resort features 242 rooms which are the epitome of elegant sanctuaries of peace and comfort rooms along with the pool villas that boast contemporary interior design, luxurious fittings and high-end amenities. The resort provides an array of facilities including two swimming pools, four food & beverage outlets, complimentary yoga classes and a gymnasium combined with extensive spa facilities.

room_details.room_Description: The Pool Villa is a sophisticated blend of stone and bamboo architecture with fresh minimalist interior design. Each of the Pool Villas are designed to offer absolute privacy and comfort, with floor-to-ceiling sliding doors allowing the room to open to your private plunge pool and intimate courtyard garden. These villas are available in one-bedroom suites with king-bed and two-bedroom suites with one king bed and two twin-beds in the second room. The three-bedroom villas also have a full kitchen, living room and more. The Garden View Pool Villa’s exclusive privacy is just a few steps from the beach plus includes three bedrooms surrounded by a sizable garden. The use of natural light through skylights and floor-to-ceiling glass walls blends the lines between indoor and outdoor spaces. Balance and harmony are created through the integration of natural materials and human souls.

resort_details: Palm Greens resort is located in the beautiful city of Ahmedabad. The nearest airport is Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport. The resort offers luxurious services and cosy rooms to make your stay comfortable. While enjoying a relaxed stay, you can explore the famous tourist places in Ahmedabad like Bhadra Fort, Kankaria Lake, Sidi Saiyad Mosque, Sabarmati Ashram and Jama Masjid. You can also explore the old city and Thol bird sanctuary. The resort comes with a host of amenities such as swimming pool, Water Park, spa, discotheque, indoor movie theatre, gym, laundry and room service. Well-equipped and furnished banquet and conference hall are available for social and formal gatherings.

room_details.room_Description: The Units are equipped with amenities like air condition, television, tea/coffee maker, hair dryer, digital safe and comfortable bed. Attached bathroom comes with facilities like bathtub/shower, hot/cold water and essential bathroom toiletries.

resort_details: Located in Candidasa on Bali's eastern coast, the Rama Holidays At Rama Candidasa is situated on a picturesque, private beach. Candidasa is blessed with almost perfect weather throughout the year, making it a paradise for those who enjoy the outdoors. Here you may enjoy mountain biking and water sports, and swimmers may choose the shimmering ocean waters or relaxing by the swimming pool. You may also indulge in a luxurious Indonesian-style massage and other healing treatments in the resort's spa.

room_details.room_Description: Your well-appointed bungalow or main wing is artistically furnished and decorated with contemporary Balinese décor. Secluded, private balconies offer scenic views of poolside, tropical garden landscape or ocean.

resort_details: The Risata Bali Resort & Spa invites you to completely unwind at the Sukha Spa. A full selection of spa & salon treatments are offered, including massages, skincare, and hair care, making your Bali getaway an unforgettable relaxation experience. Other resort amenities include a spacious swimming pool, gymnasium, children's playground, restaurant, wood-fired brick pizza oven, pool table, praying room (Musholla), and an art shop. Wifi and internet access are available, and the resort's tour desk will help you plan your Bali adventures and offers convenient car rentals. Shopping is just a short distance away in downtown Kuta.

room_details.room_Description: The rooms and suites at Risata Bali Resort & Spa are nestled along a pathway that winds its way through tropical gardens. All units offer numerous amenities, including air conditioning, tub and shower, hairdryer, satellite flat-screen TV, phone, refrigerator, and coffee and tea service. Suites have separate bedrooms and may have two baths. Suites also include living room with sofa bed, kitchenette with large refrigerator, dishes, cutlery, microwave and toaster, and a spacious balcony or terrace. Three-bedroom villas are also available at the resort.

resort_details: The resort's small private pool is breathtakingly beautiful, compliments the lush colorful garden area and is an ideal place to relax in. Royal Bali Beach Club at Jimbaran Bay offers an exclusive and private holiday. The one-bedroom Apartments feature Air-conditioning, each with their own private balconies or courtyards. The pool area is breathtakingly beautiful and is the ideal place to relax in.

room_details.room_Description: This luxury hotel on Bali's upscale Jimbaran Bay combines high quality with highly personal service. This small hotel offers guests an attractive beach- front setting and has 16 rooms for guests. All rooms are equipped with all the conveniences of home including air conditioning, a coffee and tea maker, cable television access, and kitchens. The resort has appointed these luxury accommodations in a traditional Balinese style, set amongst beautiful gardens alongside a pool and hot tub. All units are close to the beach.

resort_details: Resort is Located at Bali's biggest traditional village of Sanur, one of the most established tourist areas. From fine restaurants and modern entertainment, traditional village drama and dance to the Bali Safari Marine Park or the Bali Zoo Park all within a half hour drive. Great starting point to enjoy the Island Tour Area. This resort offers delights of staying on a tropical island but also to gain a real appreciation of Balinese culture and local life.

room_details.room_Description: All units have telephone, cable TV, DVD Player, a partial kitchen, central A/C, Hair Dryer, Iron and Board and have private balconies.

resort_details: Shangshanqi offers modern accommodations near many of Chengdu’s popular sites and attractions. With simple Chinese design elements, the resort embraces the area’s culture while providing four-star hotel service. During their stays, guests can enjoy access to many on-site amenities like a fitness center, restaurant, night club and bar. For families, the resort offers kid-friendly activities, helping to complement local attractions. As an added convenience, the resort also offers professional room service and public parking for guests.

room_details.room_Description: Shangshanqi provides one- and two-bedroom accommodations that blend Chinese style with modern convenience. Each unit features a balcony or patio as well as a kitchen that includes a stove, toaster oven, refrigerator, coffee maker and cookware for preparing simple meals. Resort will charge RMB150/per day for cleaning fee. The bathrooms feature an oversized bath tub or shower as well as a courtesy kit with toiletries. Additional conveniences include cable TV and WiFi as well as an alarm clock, hairdryer, iron and ironing board.

resort_details: Sterling La Vida Varca is situated in Southern Goa. Varca proudly stands apart from the other beaches with its fine white sand and pristine water. Peppered with palm trees and shrubs along its 10km coastline, the Varca beach paints a pretty picture of the typical, sun-kissed vacation destination. Its shallow and warm waters, along with its very own Rescue Tower, provide for a safe swim during any time of the day. Located at a distance of about 40km from Panaji, Varca Beach is an ideal retreat for those seeking respite from their busy world.

resort_details: Located at the base of Devikulam Mountain in the charming village of Chinnakanal, Sterling Munnar offers guests a host of on-site activities, as well as easy local travel arrangements for sightseeing. A wonderful base for families, the property has a playground and club house, as well as a selection of video games and a library. At the club house, families can challenge each another with table tennis, badminton and other games. On weekends, bonfires, party games and music keep the atmosphere lively. Whatever your lifestyle & preferences are, Tathastu has something distinctive for everyone.

resort_details: Elegantly perched on the banks of Beas, White Meadows, Manali offers breathtaking vistas of the mountains and the river, delectable food and plenty of options for adventure sports. White Meadows has excellent road and rail connectivity with easy accessibility from major cities like from Chandigarh (350 Km) and Delhi (585 Km). The Manali airport in Bhuntar is a short 50 km away from the property.

room_details.room_Description: White Meadows Manali is draped in lush greenery offering you the comfort of the hills. Enjoy the pine-scented air and the peaceful scenery of the hills while you stay in the resort. Take a trip to the serene Buddhist monasteries in the vicinity to witness how the monks live. If an adrenaline surging adventure is what you are on the lookout for, there are opportunities for rafting, trekking and rock climbing as well.

resort_details: Yilu Gangtou Village is a unique hotel that embodies the design concept of Southeast Asian overseas Chinese culture. It offers 20 distinct styled rooms situated within the sacred precinct of Empress Zeng, a 660-year-old Confucian site at the heart of Gangtou Ancient Village. Developed by Renkaiji, the village features the characteristic comb-style layout of Guangfu residential buildings, adorned with wok-ear walls, grey sculptures, and stone carvings, effectively transforming Gangtou Village into an open-air Lingnan architectural museum. The hotel is surrounded by 1,200 acres of natural beauty, comprising mountains, water bodies, forests, and fields. It offers amenities such as rice fields, swimming pools, various dining and banquet facilities, scenic greenways, wooden pathways of varying lengths, earth kitchens, and hands-on field activities such as fruit picking and rural markets.

room_details.room_Description: The hotel adopts an overseas Chinese-style villa design, providing an opportunity to experience the comforts of a private residence within each villa. Comprising five independent villas and a Lingnan-style ancestral hall serving as a public area, the establishment spans a total construction area of 1,200 square meters. In total, the hotel offers 20 rooms, complete with amenities like restaurants, KTV, bars, chess and card facilities, independent courtyards, and swimming pools for guests to enjoy.

place_name: Anantara Vacation Club Oaks Shore Queenstown
resort_details: Set along the shores of Lake Wakatipu in the heart of New Zealand’s most popular ski town, this elegant, yet rustic resort offers access to an amazing variety of vacation activities – everything from tranquil vineyard tours to thrilling jet-boat rides. On-site amenities include a sauna and fitness center, and a complimentary shuttle is available for transporting guests to and from area attractions.

room_details.room_Description: 120 guestrooms available in studio- and two-bedroom suite configurations. Enjoy all the comforts of home with furnished kitchens, LCD televisions in all bedrooms and wireless Internet availability. Two-bedroom suites provide stunning views of Lake Wakatipu, and private bathrooms offer complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The resort’s courtyard houses barbeque facilities for outdoor cooking, and private lockers can be arranged for ski and golf club storage.

resort_details: Beach House Seaside Resort is in the most idyllic location overlooking the magnificent Coolangatta Beach, known for its spectacular surfing conditions and stunning scenery. Your day can be as relaxing or action-packed as you'd like when you choose to stroll the resort's landscaped gardens, unwind by the sparkling pool, or treat yourself to some spa time. When you're ready, the on-site activity staff can offer some ideas for enjoying all that Queensland's Gold Coast has to offer.

room_details.room_Description: Located on Marine Parade directly across from Coolangatta Beach, the resort has 132 two-bedroom apartments, which sleep from 4 to 6 people. After a long day of surfing, theme parks, or sightseeing, relax in your air-conditioned home-away-from home with a full kitchen (including dishwasher and microwave) and full laundry. Relax with family and friends over a home-cooked meal, or explore the area's dining options.

resort_details: Set back one block from Coolangatta Beach, Beachcomber International Resort is a high rise building located in the heart of Coolangatta for access to restaurants, bars, and shops in Queensland's most southernly coastal town. The resort has two pools and hot tub and a barbecue area, plus tennis and small gym for guests to enjoy.

room_details.room_Description: The rooms at Beachcomber International Resort are spacious and have balconies from which you can enjoy the city skyline view. The Resort has one and two bedroom units for visitors to enjoy. The units sleep four to six respectively and include kitchen, living and dining areas, and washer and dryer.

resort_details: At the resort, experience the huge swimming pool with spa and bridge, tennis, squash, lawn bowls, gym, sauna, playground, hair salon, games room, lounge, and mini golf.

Only 10 minutes from the centre of Coffs Harbour, Boambee Bay Resort offers one of the the most attractive holiday destinations on the northern coast of New South Wales. Bordered by Boambee Creek, fishing, canoeing, and hiking are all nearby. Swim in the magnificent lagoon-like swimming pool or relax in the indoor and outdoor hot tubs. Take the children to play mini-golf or enjoy the games room with all the family. The resort also features tennis, squash and basketball courts.

room_details.room_Description: Guestrooms at Boambee Bay Resort are sprinkled throughout the lushly landscaped gardens. The rooms are well equipped and are perfect for vacationing families enjoying a getaway. Each spacious and tastefully decorated, 2-bedroom unit sleeps six and has a screened in patio, a queen bed, two single beds and a sofa bed. All accommodations come with full kitchen facilities that include a microwave, dishwasher and washer/dryer.

location: Paihia, Bay of Islands, New Zealand
resort_details: In addition to the breathtaking views and vistas, Club Paihia has every amenity and service to pamper and please. Enjoy multiple swimming pools, spa pools, sauna, a gymnasium, tennis courts, super-sized outdoor chess set, barbecue grills and a bushwalking track that includes a magnificent orchid house. Relax in the library, play a game of pool or table tennis. And be sure to take advantage of the resort's in-house tour desk to handle any and all bookings for whatever local attractions you desire.

room_details.room_Description: Enjoy the luxury and comforts of Club Paihia's finely appointed and roomy studio, one-bedroom or two-bedroom accommodations. Studio units feature a mini kitchen with microwave and two-burner stove. All one- and two-bedroom units are well equipped with full kitchens that include microwave, dishwasher, and waste disposal. Room features also include full bathrooms with overhead showers, TV, DVD player, CD/stereo, shared laundry, and comfortable queen-size beds.

resort_details: Ramada Resort by Wyndham Dunsborough is a luxurious resort with extensive facilities and amenities on the property, including a beauty and day spa, a fireside wine bar, a tour desk and even a wedding chapel. Gourmet dining is available at Toby's Restaurant & Bar, which offers premier wines of the region. Laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site for guest use.

room_details.room_Description: Accommodations at Ramada Resort by Wyndham Dunsborough include studio rooms and one- or two-bedroom apartments. The one and two bedroom units have partial or full kitchens with microwave, tea/coffee service, telephone, air conditioning, cable TV and DVD player. Some units have carpeting, washer/dryer and dishwasher.

resort_details: Located in the uptown West Perth Business District, Wyndham Perth offers you inner-city chic. It's also just a short stroll away from Kings Park, the city center, and Swan River. Have a delicious gourmet breakfast at the hotel restaurant before the day's activities. The Club Room & Bar is an ideal place to relax with a fine drink after a tiring day. If you are staying in for a quiet evening, the hotel's in-house DVD library is sure to have something that interests you.

room_details.room_Description: Ramada by Wyndham Perth The Outram features beautifully decorated rooms that have been elegantly furnished with an array of contemporary amenities to satisfy the needs of discerning travelers. Relax in spacious, air conditioned comfort with studio units that sleep up to two guests.

resort_details: Ramada Resort by Wyndham Wanaka is set on a quiet, tree-lined avenue and offers a comfortable yet refined base to enjoy the many delights of New Zealand's South Island. The Resort boasts superb facilities including a heated pool with water slide (seasonal), hot tub, sauna and barbeque area, as well as a cafe and and bar. Only a short stroll from the lakeshore and only a two minute drive from the heart of the village, the local area can provide you with all the relaxation or adventure you desire with something to suit everyone.

room_details.room_Description: The resort's interior is complemented by warm timber rooms, reflecting the natural beauty of the exterior surroundings.

resort_details: Ramada Resort by Wyndham Wanaka is set on a quiet, tree-lined avenue and offers a comfortable yet refined base to enjoy the many delights of New Zealand's South Island. The Resort boasts superb facilities including a heated pool with water slide (seasonal), hot tub, sauna and barbeque area, as well as a cafe and and bar. Only a short stroll from the lakeshore and only a two minute drive from the heart of the village, the local area can provide you with all the relaxation or adventure you desire with something to suit everyone.

room_details.room_Description: The resort's interior is complemented by warm timber rooms, reflecting the natural beauty of the exterior surroundings.

resort_details: You will love the magnificent alpine vistas.as you relax in the spacious open gardens of the Edgewater Resort. Go boating or fishing or simply go for a leisurely stroll around the lake. There's also tennis, a spa, a sauna, whirlpool/hot tub, and a playground for the kids. Dining options include Sargoods Restaurant, a long time Wanaka favorite. At the heart of the Wineglass CafÃ© is a cozy fire providing a warm welcome, and alfresco dining can be enjoyed on the surrounding terrace area.

room_details.room_Description: The hub of the apartment is a full kitchen, dining, and living area where you can share time together and relive the memories you have just created. Choose from a one- or two-bedroom. Whether the occasion is a special anniversary or simply a chance to rejuvenate, the accomodations have been designed with space in mind, giving you room to spread out and escape to the heart of welcoming nature. As a fully enclosed retreat, there are in-room laundry facilities if you need them. All units have either a balcony or a patio with uninterrupted vistas right to the edge of Lake Wanaka.

resort_details: At the resort, there are tennis courts, swimming pool and private spas outside every unit. The sauna and pool room round out your holiday needs.
At the resort, there are tennis courts, swimming pool and private spas outside every unit. The sauna and pool room round out your holiday needs.

Island Palms Resort on Magnetic Island prides itself on hospitality. In fact, it has won the RCI Hospitality Award 12 times. It's the perfect spot to enjoy the unique and wonderful recreation activities of this barrier-reef locale. Enjoy the large outdoor swimming pool that is heated in the winter for your comfort. Play half-court tennis or table tennis, stroll along Nelly Bay Beach just yards from your apartment and barbecue right at poolside. There is a spa to pamper you, and the friendly staff will help plan and facilitate your activities.

room_details.room_Description: For over 20 years, Island Palms Resort has been providing quality Magnetic Island accommodations. Self-contained apartments are built around 2 large bedrooms with spacious bathrooms for your convenience. The rooms are fully air-conditioned for your comfort, and can accommodate 6 people, making it perfect for families, couples or small groups. The rooms have been upgraded to include flat screen TV's for your entertainment. Living areas are large and there are separate dining areas and full kitchens.

resort_details: Situated on one of the deep-water inland canals with its own boat moorings, Jadon Place is in an ideal location. Laze by the pool or relax in the spa, or for those active days, experience every watersport imaginable nearby.

Situated on one of the deep-water inland canals with its own boat moorings, Jadon Place is in an ideal location. Laze by the pool or relax in the spa, or for those active days, experience every watersport imaginable nearby.

Kyneton Bushland Resort is set within over 125 acres of bushland on the outskirts of Kyneton. Each two- and three-bedroom villa is nestled in a unique bush setting, ensuring your complete privacy and all come with fully-equipped kitchens. Rest, relax and enjoy the wonders of the Australian wildlife, swim in the resort's pool and unwind in the sauna and spa. Guests can also canoe, fish or swim in the five-acre lake. Enjoy bike riding or play tennis, volleyball, mini-golf or table tennis.

room_details.room_Description: Each private villa is separated by natural bushland. An abundance of animal life surrounds the resort, and if you look closely at dusk, you might see kangaroos and wallabies. The resort is perfect for vacationing couples or families enjoying a getaway. Relax in air-conditioned comfort with 2-bedroom units that sleep up to four, or 3-bedroom units that sleep up to six. All accommodations come with full kitchens that include a microwave, dishwasher, and washer/dryer.

resort_details: Take in the picturesque view looking south down the lake, where the Tongariro National Park Mountain ranges lie.

room_details.room_Description: Stunning location right on the lake's edge. Step onto the walkway for a stroll or dip in the lake. Fully self-contained apartments with kitchen, laundry, and stunning decks to relax on. Cafes and bars within 100m walking distance along the beautiful walk 3 kilometers to town.

resort_details: The resort has an indoor heated pool, spa and sauna, two outdoor pools, including a spa and children's pool, exercise room, and tennis, squash, and racquetball courts. Guests can enjoy a miniature golf course, and board games. Children can entertain themselves in the children's game room or playground, and adults can enjoy a lounge with darts, snooker, pool table and library. Fishing rods and mountain bikes are available for a fee.

room_details.room_Description: Murray Valley Resort two-bedroom units sleep up to 6 guests. The 2-floor design of the units allows for flexible living. Units include fully equipped kitchens that have a microwave, hot plate and dishwasher, spacious living rooms, telephone, television, and air conditioning.

resort_details: The vast waterways, interesting wildlife, and crystal-clear blue water keep people coming back again and again. A family-friendly environment, Pacific Palms resort offers an extensive activities program along with facilities, including a swimming pool, spa, sauna, gymnasium, barbecue and playground. For excursions farther afield, a car is necessary to fully enjoy the area, as public transportation is not available. Nearby Smith's Lake provides boat rentals and Wallis Lake has picnic spots. Four-wheel-drive tours can be arranged with pick up at the resort. Paddle boats and windsurfers are only 3 miles (5 km) away.

room_details.room_Description: Each unit is a self-contained Polynesian-style villa offering ceiling fans, cable television with DVD, and partial kitchen in the 2 bedroom and full kitchen in the 3 bedroom. Shared laundry facilities are available on-site. 2-bedroom units sleep up to six guests in a queen bed, 2 single beds, and 1 double sleep sofa. 3-bedroom units for up to 8 guests provide a queen bed, 2 singles, 2 bunk beds, a double sleep sofa, and 2 bathrooms.

resort_details: Pacific View Resort has complete facilities that allow our guests to enjoy a tropical holiday within the grounds of the resort. Enjoy the superb Queensland climate as you sun yourself by the swimming pool. Or take a long and relaxing soak in the outdoor heated spa, or steam in the resort's saunas. Barbecues provided are perfect for grilling meals, and a large recreation lounge provide table tennis, television, and a stimulating environment for entertainment.

room_details.room_Description: Each resort unit has a balcony or private courtyard for guests to enjoy sea breezes and private outdoor space. The units contain two-bedrooms and all units feature a queen-size bed and two single beds for a comfortable night's sleep. Each unit accommodates up to six people when the lounge's double sofa bed is used, and all linens are supplied. There's also a fully equipped kitchen with a full stove, a dishwasher, and a microwave oven, laundry facilities, LCD television with a DVD player, a direct-dial phone, and air conditioning.

resort_details: Port Pacific Resort is located in the heart of Port Macquarie and is the perfect base for exploring the beaches, wineries, wildlife and art galleries of the mid north coast of New South Wales. Port Pacific Resort offers a heated swimming pool, children's wading pool, gymnasium, sauna, indoors and outdoor spas, half tennis court, billiards room, adult lounge, comprehensive DVD library, table tennis and pool tables, video/ pinball games, book/ board game library, laundries, free use of kayaks, sail boards and free undercover parking.

room_details.room_Description: Our apartments include a fully equipped kitchen with hot plates, microwave, dishwasher, full-size refrigerator, all crockery/ glassware, two color televisions, DVD player, a range of FOXTEL channels, free WIFI and at least two bathrooms.

resort_details: Sun Pacific Villas is a world-class resort complex, on the sun-drenched north face of the Bay of Plenty and basks in all-day sun, while sheltered from the southwest winds. It's close to majestic Mt. Maunganui and is nestled in the heart of the Kiwi fruit coast. The resort is beautifully located to make the most of the area's blend of natural beauty and history. Sun Pacific Villas is also attractively situated on one of New Zealand's most popular surf beaches. High standards mandate wonderful service for all the guests at Sun Pacific Villas.

room_details.room_Description: Each of the resort's 22 2-bedroom units is approximately 1,050 square feet and includes a full kitchen, a laundry, 2 bedrooms, one queen-size bed, 2 single beds, a tilt-away double bed in the lounge, and 2 bathrooms with a bath. The 8 1-bedroom units of around 800 sq ft have 1 bathroom with shower over bath, separate toilet, laundry, and a tilt-away double bed in the lounge. In each unit there is a full supply of linen, crockery, and cooking equipment, as well as a washing machine, a dryer, a dishwasher, a microwave, 2 TVs, a DVD player, and a CD stereo system. The furnishings are luxurious and feature a lounge suite and a full dining table. There is parking on-site for one car per unit.

resort_details: With a sunny and pleasant climate, Sunraysia Resort is a perfect place to take the family for a relaxing and memorable holiday. Keep up your workouts on holiday at the on-site gym. Take in a round of tennis, or plunge into the swimming pool. Both the young and the young-at-heart are sure to have fun testing their skill and agility at the miniature golf course, and kids in particular will love the on-site games arcade and table tennis. Whether you're relaxing or active, the Resort Bar and Bistro provides great food and entertainment. Your family is sure to enjoy their stay!

room_details.room_Description: Each fully self-contained apartment features two bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen with a microwave and dishwasher, a dining area, ceiling fans, DVD players, and air conditioning. Carparks are provided close to each apartment and the outdoor amenities are all within walking distance. The main bedroom contains a queen size bed and two single beds in the second bedroom. The convertible double bed/settee in the spacious living room allows each apartment to accommodate up to six people. Most apartments also house two bathrooms and selected apartments contain full laundry facilities.

resort_details: Retreat to a quiet haven perfect for a family getaway or just the two of you. Whether you're playing a round or two of tennis, sunning and splashing by the pool, or strolling through the beautiful garden areas, Tamarind Sands is an ideal escape to relax and rejuvenate. Children will enjoy the playground area; the games room with ping pong, pool and more; and they can test their putting skills at the 9-hole mini-golf course.

room_details.room_Description: Spacious, well-appointed rooms offer peace and quiet after a day of sightseeing. Meal preparation is convenient with full kitchens in all units, featuring dishwasher, microwave and washing machine. One-bedroom units sleep 4 and also include a sleeper sofa, two-bedroom units sleep 6 and feature two fold out sofas, and three-bedroom units sleep 8 and feature two single sofa beds.

resort_details: Situated on the Tomago River in New South Wales, The Moorings resort is perfect for both families and couples alike. On-site facilities include a restaurant, pools, flood-lit tennis courts, barbecue facilities, a games lounge, a children's play area, a golf course, mini golf, driving range, and a shop. The larger towns of Bateman's Bay and Moruya are close, offering plenty of restaurants, shopping and a zoo.

room_details.room_Description: After a day of boating or swimming at one of the nearby beaches, or after a vigorous tennis match, or a round of golf, you can retire to a spacious two bedroom suite and just relax. Large sliding glass doors invite you onto a balcony or patio to view the splendid natural beauty of the Tomago River or its lush environs.

resort_details: The modern apartments at ULTIQA @ Village Resort are situated in Port Macquarie, in New South Wales, Australia. Here you will discover a private lagoon set within a cluster of lush gardens close to the Hastings River. Swimming and water sports can be enjoyed year-round, and in between activities, guests can enjoy the spa, sauna and stylish cabanas which are perfect for relaxing. The resort offers three-bedroom apartments which sleep up to eight people, featuring a fully-equipped kitchen.

room_details.room_Description: The stylish accommodations at ULTIQA at Village Resort have three bedrooms to sleep up to eight adults and children. All units have a full kitchen, washer/dryer, microwave, dishwasher and telephone service.

resort_details: The modern apartments at ULTIQA @ Village Resort are situated in Port Macquarie, in New South Wales, Australia. Here you will discover a private lagoon set within a cluster of lush gardens close to the Hastings River. Swimming and water sports can be enjoyed year-round, and in between activities, guests can enjoy the spa, sauna and stylish cabanas which are perfect for relaxing. The resort offers three-bedroom apartments which sleep up to eight people, featuring a fully-equipped kitchen.

room_details.room_Description: The stylish accommodations at ULTIQA at Village Resort have three bedrooms to sleep up to eight adults and children. All units have a full kitchen, washer/dryer, microwave, dishwasher and telephone service.

resort_details: Here's your opportunity to enjoy the Rocky Mountain lifestyle, complete with abundant sunshine and magnificent scenery. Hiking, biking, river rafting, paragliding, horseback riding, bird watching, natural hot spring pools and spa treatments are all right outside your door.

room_details.room_Description: 5-Bedroom units sleep up to 13; 4-Bedroom units sleep up to 11, 12 or 14; 3-Bedroom units sleep up to 8, 10 or 12; 2-Bedroom units sleep up to 6, and all units feature a full kitchen.

resort_details: Northstar

room_details.room_Description: Chalet-style one and two bedroom condominiums welcome guests at Northstar Whistler resort. All accommodations are filled with modern conveniences and luxurious amenities. All units include air conditioning, lush carpeting, a gas fireplace, a fully-equipped kitchen and spacious living areas. Itâ€™s the perfect place to relax after an active day. Best of all, each unit has its own balcony where guests can take in the incredible vistas of the surrounding mountains.

resort_details: Comox Valley's Old House Hotel & Spa is a 79 room, West Coast inspired boutique hotel committed to offering its guests great value. Located only blocks from downtown Courtenay, its riverfront location is just a 3 hour drive from Victoria and 15 minutes from the Comox International Airport. The hotel features spacious Studio, One and Two Bedroom Suites designed with comfort in mind. Guests can also enjoy the hotel's BBQ terrace, lush grounds, year-round outdoor heated pool, fitness room, indoor & outdoor hot tubs, and walks along the Riverway Trails. The 4500 square foot Oh Spa is the perfect way to escape the stress of everyday life.

room_details.room_Description: Studios with 2 Double beds have kitchenettes, that have microwave oven, under-counter refrigerator, sink, coffee maker, kettle, toaster, and table setting for 4. A flat screen TV and fireplace along with table and chairs for 2 makes the Studios very popular. One Bedroom Suites come complete with a full modern fully equipped kitchen, a King bed and flat sceen TV in the bedroom, and a Queen sofa pull-out, fireplace and flat screen TV in the living room. We are located in the heart of the Comox Valley, minutes to shopping, dining and Comox airport. Ideal for a family getaway, our Two Bedroom Suite has a King bed in both bedrooms, and a pull out sofa in living room with flat screen TV's in all 3 rooms. The fully equipped gourmet kitchen has an island for entertaining and preparing those special meals.

resort_details: The resort is located in the heart of BC's most dramatic and diverse recreational areas. This four season area offers vacation activities year around. Winter season offers downhill, and cross country skiing all within 10 minutes to 1.5 hours drive from your front door. Spring, summer and fall bring golfers from all over the world to the many championship golf courses. Fishing, hiking, biking, river rafting, paragliding, horseback riding, bird watching, natural hot spring pools and spa treatments are minutes away. Fairmont Hot Springs offers fine dining and shopping.

room_details.room_Description: The resort is located in the heart of BC's most dramatic and diverse recreational areas. This four season area offers vacation activities year around. Winter season offers downhill, and cross country skiing all within 10 minutes to 1.5 hours drive from your front door. Spring, summer and fall bring golfers from all over the world to the many championship golf courses. Fishing, hiking, biking, river rafting, paragliding, horseback riding, bird watching, natural hot spring pools and spa treatments are minutes away. Fairmont Hot Springs offers fine dining and shopping.

resort_details: Vancouver boasts a multicultural population and an enchanting mix of nature and civlization. It also offers a diverse selection of things to do: browsing historic Gastown or shopping in a sleek new mall; enjoying popular Stanley Park or the lesser-known Lighthouse Park; savoring ethnic food or fresh seafood caught each day; seeing a ballet, opera or play; wandering through 100 plus contemporary galleries or visiting the impressive Vancouver Art Gallery to see masterpieces of old; golfing or skiing, scuba diving or spectator sports.

room_details.room_Description: Worldmark Vancouver units have a full kitchen w/microwave & dishwasher, a washer & dryer, a gas fireplace, cable TV/VCR, stereo system and phone. Units are not air conditioned. Units are small/compact. 1BR units for 2 have 1 bath & a queen bed. 2BR units for 4 have 1.75 baths, a queen bed and a sleeper sofa. Guests will have access to a pool, spa and exercise facility across the street. These facilities are part of the Sheraton hotel. Check-in is located in the townhouse to the right of the main lobby. If arriving after 6PM, call resort for late check-in instructions; without them, you will not be able to enter the secured building. No pets allowed on the property. All public buildings in Vancouver are non- smoking. Call 877/484-3258 to check special needs.

resort_details: The city of Victoria reigns supreme on Vancouver Island, a year-round treasure with a temperate climate and British Heritage. Sights include the world-famous Butchart Gardens, Royal British Columbia Museum, and the amazing Victoria Butterfly Gardens. Stroll through Goldstream park, where salmon spawn and eagles fly, or the Beacon Hill Park area. After a full day, return to the resort to linger over tea. The rooms are angled to maximize water views, and the fireplace will keep you cozy as you look out over the moonlet bay.

room_details.room_Description: Your vacation home at WorldMark Victoria has a full kitchen with a BBQ, microwave, dishwasher, fireplace, TV/DVD and telephone. Your 2 bedroom unit has either 1 queen bed, 2 twin beds and a murphy bed or 2 queen beds and a murphy bed. Units have 2 bathrooms. Check-in is located in the resort lobby. Pets are not allowed. Smoking is not allowed inside the units.

resort_details: Whistler is the ultimate year-round resort destination. Winter features an abundance of downhill skiing at both Whistler and Blackcomb ski areas. In the summer there is even more to do, including alpine hiking, fishing, swimming, windsurfing, horseback riding, canoeing, and white-water rafting. The Village at Whistler has boutiques, sidewalk cafes, numerous bistros, and fine restaurants. Music and art festivals are intertwined with daily street entertainment.

room_details.room_Description: The units at Worldmark Whistler Cascade Lodge feature a TV/VCR, a full kitchen, a gas fireplace, A/C and a washer & dryer. 1BR units OCC: Max 4/Pri 2 have 1 bath, 1 queen bed and a sleep sofa. The resort does not offer housekeeping services. A credit card deposit is required at check-in. You must be at least 21 to check-in. Pets are not allowed. All units are non-smoking.

location: St. John's, Antigua, Antigua and Barbuda
resort_details: There is a place where life is different. The balmy breeze equals the warmth of the welcome. Antigua Village is a very special place to stay, with a real community and a relaxed resort atmosphere. Nestling on one of the world's most breathtaking beaches, this dream destination offers a unique combination of comfort, character and culture that encapsulates the spirit of the Caribbean. Antigua Village – where a warm welcome awaits!

room_details.room_Description: There are studios, suites and villas, and they either are located on the beachfront of Dickenson Bay, around the Village pool or in the resort tropical gardens. Studios comprise a spacious sleeping and living area with full kitchen facilities and separate bathroom. Studios are available on ground floor level or on the first or second floors and are ideal for two people but can accommodate additional guests. Suites are also spacious, have separate bedroom and living areas with kitchens and separate bathrooms. Villas are supremely spacious and are almost all two level duplexes either split between ground and first, or first and second floors. All units have at least one large private terrace or balcony, all boasting beautiful aspects.

resort_details: There is something for every member of your family at the Aruba Beach Club. Located on one of the most scenic beaches on Aruba, this resort boasts all the fun-in-the-sun activities you could want. There is an Olympic-size swimming pool, as well as one for the kids, a poolside bar, tennis courts, playground and shops right on site. Enjoy the live entertainment, and the full range of activities nearby, from water sports to horseback riding to casino gambling. There is even a championship golf course close by. Do it all, or enjoy doing nothing at all – it’s always your choice.

room_details.room_Description: The rooms at the Aruba Beach Club are designed for the perfect family experience. Spacious and laid out for both privacy and family gatherings, the bedrooms are comfortable and the living space is neat and roomy. Take advantage of the relaxing private balconies that boast lovely views of the ocean or perfectly manicured grounds. The kitchen and bathrooms have everything you need to enjoy your stay, and the attentive housekeeping staff is always ready to serve your needs

location: Simpson Bay, St Maarten Dutch Caribbean
resort_details: At this wonderful resort, discover the best of Sint Maarten. The Atrium Beach Resort offers a half-mile of beach, breathtaking views of the Caribbean Sea, a blue lagoon, and lush, rolling hills. Amenities include a small swimming pool, a gymnasium, a hair salon, a beach bar, and a restaurant that’s one of the island’s mainstays. Within walking distance are a shopping center, more bars, more restaurants, a movie house, and a water sports/scuba diving center. Plus, you’re just minutes from the glamorous nightlife and duty-free shopping of both the Dutch and French sides of the island.

room_details.room_Description: If tranquility, luxury, and a pampering, full-service staff are what you want, the Atrium Beach Resort is the place you’ve been looking for. Stylish and comfortable accommodations invite relaxation, while the views reinvigorate the spirit. Select from a studio, or a one, two, or three bedroom unit. All are air conditioned and have either a full or mini kitchen. All units are equipped with microwaves and dishwasher.

resort_details: Located in the center of Palm Beach, the Barceló Aruba faces stunning aquamarine water with the beach studded by numerous palm trees for shade. A rock garden island sits in the middle of a lagoon style pool that includes a swim up bar. The rock waterfall island features two spa tubs. Play tennis on one of the lighted courts. The on site casino opens at noon with a variety of games to enjoy. End the day by taking in a nightly music and dance show, or dance to karaoke, disco music or the live DJ. Parents with children under age 10 will make good use of the Kids Club, with age appropriate supervised activities. Five restaurants offer an assortment of atmosphere and menu choices.

room_details.room_Description: The Barceló Aruba offers a variety of accommodations. Smaller units sleep from two to four guests. One-bedroom units accommodate four visitors; two-bedroom units sleep six to eight guests. Three-bedroom units sleep six to ten visitors, making this a wonderful choice for larger families or a 'friends'vacation. Air conditioning is supplemented by ceiling fans. Bathrooms include shower/tub combination, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryer. Some units include kitchen facilities with microwave ovens.

resort_details: As with all Divi resorts, the Beach Villas at Divi Phoenix puts vacationers in the lap of luxury amid a paradise-like setting. This particular gem is ideally situated on the powdery white sands of Palm Beach. The resort offers 140 luxury beachfront suites, with a swimming pool. It is ideal for family vacations. Children's poolside activities are offered during the week, and the Divi staff is available to help arrange childcare.

room_details.room_Description: Guests can choose from a studio suite, one-bedroom suite or two-bedroom suite. The studio has a spacious room featuring queen-size bed, queen sleeper sofa, and one private bath. The one-bedroom suite features a king-size bed in the bedroom, queen sleeper sofa in the separate living room, and one private bath. While the two-bedroom suite features two-bedrooms with king-size beds each, queen sleeper sofa in a separate living area, and two private bathrooms.

resort_details: As with all Divi resorts, the Beach Villas at Divi Phoenix puts vacationers in the lap of luxury amid a paradise-like setting. This particular gem is ideally situated on the powdery white sands of Palm Beach. The resort offers 140 luxury beachfront suites, with a swimming pool. It is ideal for family vacations. Children's poolside activities are offered during the week, and the Divi staff is available to help arrange childcare.
