resort_details: Warmth radiates like the sun's rays on and around Bougainvillea Beach Resort. Something special awaits couples and families of all ages where you can opt to do as much or as little as you like. Delight in spa treatments, work out in the fitness center, or sip cocktails at the swim-up pool bar.

room_details.room_Description: The units are spacious and beautifully furnished with ocean, pool, and garden views. They include all the amenities needed for your contentment and ease, including kitchen facilities.

place_name: BPPC @ Luxury Bahia Principe Runaway Bay
resort_details: An adult’s only escape in a privileged area of Jamaica! Enjoy luxurious amenities engulfed in the natural wonderland of Runaway Bay. Access the highest level of service of the Don Pablo Collection and relax under the sun as you enjoy your favorite cocktail made just for you at the nearest pool bar. Onsite restaurants and buffets cater to all palates and will indeed satisfy yours.

room_details.room_Description: Stay in suites with a chic style and high-end touches. Each room features opulent amenities including hydromassage bathtubs and evening turndown service that will deliver a comfortable space every day. Rooms are available with one (1) King size bed or two (2) double beds, air conditioning, hairdryer, coffee maker, safety deposit box and satellite TV. Enjoy the tropical climate all year long with wonderful views of the sorroundings areas.

resort_details: Breathless Montego Bay Resort & Spa, surrounded by Montego Bay Marine Park, is a modern 5-story adults-only, 150-suite resort boasting chic design and state-of-the-art technology. Breathless Montego Bay takes Unlimited-Luxury® - where everything is included – to the next level. Indulge in delectable gourmet cuisine at six specialty dining venues and mix & mingle at five trendsetting bars and lounges serving unlimited curated cocktails and premium spirits. This stunning resort offers the only rooftop bar in Montego Bay, fire pits, relaxing cabana beds, a world class spa by Pevonia®, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and spectacular bay views - all providing the perfect balance of Live Big and Breathe Deep. From lively entertainment to endless lounging opportunities, whatever you’re looking for is right here. Guests also have full access to all the amenities at Secrets Wild Orchid and Secrets St. James next door with 20 additional dining & bar options and more.

room_details.room_Description: Breathless Montego Bay offers 150 ultra-chic suites with state-of-the-art technology, carefully designed to exceed expectations with stunning mountain and bay views. Furnishings include a private balcony or terrace with a hot tub, floor-to-ceiling glass doors, marble bathrooms with double vanities, and more. Both Standard and Xhale Club suites have a king-size bed or 2 double beds with a maximum occupancy of 3 adults. Xhale Club units offer personalized check-in and check-out, upgraded bath amenities, a mini-bar, and welcome gifts. Allure Jr. Suite King Tropical View are Hotel units for 2, and Xhale Club Junior Suite Ocean View King are studio units for 2.

resort_details: Located on the most pristine beach in Aruba, Casa del Mar offers couples and families unforgettable memories. Relax on the beach and enjoy unforgettable sunsets and cooling trade winds or partake in the many resort activities. Play tennis, work out in the gym or enjoy pool aerobics or seated yoga with our instructors. Arrange watersports, golf, scuba, snorkeling, windsurfing or island tours through our Activities Desk. Play a game of bingo or relax with a book or game from our library. We have two large swimming pools, poolside hot tub’s and BBQ’s for your use. Our staffed Activities Center with kiddie pool, playground, shuffleboard and giant chess or checkers sets will keep the youngsters occupied. The pool bar offers cocktails throughout the day and 3 daily Happy Hours. Enjoy fine dining at Matthew's Beachside Restaurant or enjoy your own BBQ with friends. Directly across the street is the exciting nightlife of the Alhambra Casino and Shopping Plaza with dining and shopping options.

room_details.room_Description: Casa del Mar Beach Resort, located on one of the finest beaches in Aruba, offers deluxe and comfortable vacations in air-conditioned two-bedroom suites [sleep up to 6]and one-bedroom suites [sleep up to 4]. The 1 bedroom units are poolside and a short walk to the beach. All suites feature a fully-equipped kitchen with full size refrigerator, stove, and appliances, and a balcony or patio. Just steps away from the pool and other resort activities, guests will also enjoy using the barbecue grills to try out new recipes or enjoy old favorites. Whether you choose to spend most of your time at the resort or exploring the island, this property welcomes you with comfort and convenience.

location: Cowpet Bay, St. Thomas, VI, USA
resort_details: Cowpet Bay, home of the St. Thomas Yacht Club, is the site of the Elysian Beach Resort. Enclosed by palm-shaded hills, the resort rises from its secluded beach to offer a magnificent setting. Besides the beach, enjoy water sports, including sunfish sailing, kayaking, windsurfing, swimming, and introductory scuba lessons. Enjoy lunch at one of the restaurants; dine in elegance each evening.

room_details.room_Description: Whether you arrive with family, friends, or just you and your partner, you will appreciate the privacy of the resort's separate bedrooms and the private kitchen. The studio suites contain two double beds, or one king-size bed, or one queen-size Murphy bed, as well as a partial kitchen with a microwave oven, refrigerator, toaster, and coffee maker. The maximum occupancy for each unit is four people, and there is a balcony & desk in each suite. Note that bed structures vary, and a specific request cannot be guaranteed. Some units offer Wi-Fi access for an additional fee.

resort_details: Coral Sands Resort is a small resort located close to downtown Georgetown and within walking distance of shopping, restaurants, and nightlife. Enjoy a day at Seven Mile Beach just a short drive away, or relax at the resort's private beach. The resort also has a small pool.

room_details.room_Description: Coral Sands Resort is a small resort located close to downtown Georgetown and within walking distance of shopping, restaurants, and nightlife. Enjoy a day at Seven Mile Beach just a short drive away, or relax at the resort's private beach. The resort also has a small pool.

resort_details: Situated on Aruba's famed Palm Beach, and backed by a private wildlife sanctuary, guests of the Divi Aruba Phoenix Beach Resort will find themselves in a vacation paradise courtesy of the resort’s prime waterfront location, vibrant tropical landscaping, and first-rate amenities. On top of a powdery-fine, white beach dotted with thatch cabanas and inviting hammocks, the property boasts a freshwater free-form swimming pool surrounded by palm trees, spacious accommodations with sweeping views, a hot tub, a lively beachside bar and bistro, and an excellent on-site restaurant. The property also conveniently has a French market and deli, squash court, fitness center, spa services, and a full-service concierge. Resort guests enjoy preferred tee times at the Divi Aruba 9 hole Golf Course nearby. Given all the luxuries that Divi Aruba Phoenix Beach Resort offers its guests, your Aruba vacation can only be as enjoyable as you want it to be.

room_details.room_Description: The Divi Aruba Phoenix Beach Resort features spacious, air-conditioned beachfront studios, one-, and two-bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchens, picture windows, and large private balconies with sweeping views. Studio units sleep 2 to 4 people; one-bedrooms house 4 persons and two-bedroom units accommodate 6 guests.

place_name: Divi Beach Villas at Southwinds, Ltd.
resort_details: A spectacular half-mile stretch of a talc-white, sandy beach is the location of The Beach Club at Southwinds, Ltd.

Divi Flamingo Beach Resort gives the diving enthusiast the best of all possible worlds. It is the home of Divi Dive Bonaire, which offers complete certifications at all levels. In addition, Capture Photo Bonaire provides underwater still and video camera instruction, developing, and equipment rental. Then, after a day of beach play, try your luck at the resort's casino or relax in the day spa.

There’s no end to the activities available at Divi Little Bay Beach Resort, from lounging on a beautiful private beach to exciting water sports like diving, snorkeling, and more. Three freshwater swimming pools offer even more water options, fitness room, and activities coordinator mean even more options. In addition to three on-site restaurants, a lively beach bar and grocery store are available. A full-service Indulgence by the Sea spa provides deluxe spa treatments to the relaxing sounds of the Caribbean Sea.

room_details.room_Description: The resort wraps around a soft, wide arc of white sand washed by the gentle blue waves of St. Maarten's Little Bay, the perfect complement to the pastel exteriors and striking terra cotta rooflines. Divi Little Bay offers a range of spacious suites and features a host of amenities and a full-service staff. Units boast contemporary style with a Caribbean flare with flat screen televisions, clock radio with iPod docking station, DVD player, granite kitchen countertops, wood cabinets, and porcelain tile. Some units may have a convection oven in lieu of traditional oven.

place_name: Divi Southwinds Beach And Racquet Club
resort_details: Guests are in paradise at the Divi Southwinds Beach Resort in Barbados located on a half mile of amazing beach amidst twenty acres of lush tropical gardens. St. Lawrence Gap, a lively collection of shops, restaurants, and nightlife runs right through the Divi Southwinds, offering guests a full range of activities at the beach or off. Enjoy the dazzling white-sand beach at the resort that also features three swimming pools, two tennis courts, a fine restaurant, a beach bar, and access to a variety of bracing water sports.

room_details.room_Description: Suites come with a bedroom and offer one king-size bed with a queen-size sleeper sofa in the living area. There are also 2-bedroom suites with one king-size bed in the bedroom, with a queen-size sleeper sofa in the separate living area. 2-bedroom suites also feature one king-size bed, 2 twin beds, and a queen-size sleeper sofa in the separate living area. 2- bedroom suites offer 1 full bath and 1 half bath. Suite amenities may include a fully-equipped kitchen, a TV, air-conditioning, and an in-room safe. The beach villas offer private patios or balconies with ocean views.

resort_details: Enjoy relaxing comfort plus Caribbean adventure and leisure at Divi Village. This magnificent property is located across the street from the white sands of Aruba’s Druif Beach. Guests enjoy well-appointed accommodations, a deluxe 9-hole golf course, driving range, putting greens, lighted tennis courts, a 400-foot long Infinity-edge swimming pool, free-form children’s pool and hot tub, plus full access to the combined facilities and services of five Divi Aruba Resorts nearby. These include a modern fitness center, a full-service spa, and a 30-foot artificial rock climbing wall located on the beach, among others. Divi Village guests also enjoy the convenience of on-site dining at the Sea Breeze Café and a full-service bar overlooking the Caribbean. Divi Village’s location is also convenient in proximity to various kinds of water activities, shops, restaurants, a casino and live entertainment.

room_details.room_Description: Divi Village features spacious, tastefully appointed studio, one- and two-bedroom accommodations. With limitless gourmet à la carte dining and unlimited top-shelf beverages at nine restaurants and ten bars, plus 18 additional options at Breathless Punta Cana next door, guests will find everything they are looking for. resort_details: Nestled on the sparkling golden beaches of Puerto Plata, the newly-renovated Emotions by Hodelpa Playa Dorada offers modern and luxurious accommodations in a lush tropical setting. The sleek new resort offers exclusive accommodations such as convenient and extravagant swim out rooms, spacious rooms for families of five, and an exclusive adults only section featuring a private pool and hot tub. Adventurers may try their hand at the on-site climbing wall or play a round of golf at the nearby Playa Dorada Golf Course, while kids will have a blast at the kids and teens club. Guests looking for rest and relaxation can soak up the sun on a beachside lounger, take a dip in the warm waters of the Caribbean, or enjoy a refreshing cocktail by one of the resort’s various pools. We offer 5 restaurants and 2 bars/lounges, Full-service spa, 3 outdoor pools, Nightclub, Outdoor tennis court, Beach umbrellas, Children's club and many more ameneties and services.

room_details.room_Description: EMOTIONS BY HODELPA PLAYA DORADA offers our guests 423 elegant decor rooms, with various services and facilities, that will assure your family, couple or friends the dream vacations you all deserve. 1 Bedroom Suite for family or couples Private room King size bed and Sofa bed in the living room. Contemporary decorative, hot tub, TV, Partial Kitchen with Fridge, microwave, coffeemaker. For more informations, you can visit our website www.emotionsbyhodelpa.com

location: Magens Bay, St. Thomas, VI, USA
place_name: Flamboyan on the Bay Resort & Villa
resort_details: Magens Point Resort is on the cool, scenic, north side of St. Thomas. It is a small, simple, quiet family run resort situated on a tropical hillside overlooking beautiful Magens Bay and Fazio designed Mahogany Run Golf Course. The location is ideal because its secluded setting is far enough from town for a quiet, tropical vacation, but only minutes from the major attractions of St. Thomas; including a 10 minute walk down a hill to Magans Bay Beach. Amenities include a pool, bar, poolside restaurant, small convenience store, massage, fitness center,tennis and more.

room_details.room_Description: The one-bedroom unit is 525 Sq. Ft., and it sleeps 4. It's perfect for a small family or 2 adults. There is a queen-size bed in the bedroom and a queen size sleeper sofa in the living room. The two-bedroom unit is 700 Sq. Ft., and it sleeps 6. There is a queen-size bed in most bedrooms (some units have a loft for the bedroom) and a sleeper sofa in the living room. Most units are accessible via stairs and have stairs in the unit (resort does not have elevators) and feature conveniences like a kitchenette with a microwave, coffee maker, stove, breakfast bar, cable or satellite TV. Internet is available for a fee.

resort_details: The Flamingo Beach Resort is located on the pearly white sand beach of Simpson Bay, on the island’s friendly Dutch side. The resort features a beautiful, negative-edge pool that seems to go on to infinity. There is a restaurant and snack bar on site, as well as barbeque areas. The resort offers tennis, volleyball, massage services, live entertainment, housekeeping services, front desk, security, and laundry facilities. A spa and casino are nearby. The resort is close to restaurants, shopping, and nightspots. The activities department will be happy to help you arrange for nearby boating, fishing, scuba diving, water sports, horseback riding, golf, and sightseeing. The resort offers a relaxing, intimate atmosphere just a few minutes away from all the island’s exciting action.

room_details.room_Description: The Flamingo Beach Resort features modern, comfortable accommodations – all decorated in a chic, understated style designed to make you feel pampered and relaxed. Choose a spacious studio that accommodates 2 people: or a one- or two-bedroom unit that can accommodate up to 8 people. The suites feature terraces or balconies with fantastic views. All units have a fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher, toaster, coffee maker, blender, and all cookware, dishes and utensils. Depending on the size, there are multiple bathrooms. The suites also feature telephone with voicemail service, satellite and cable television, DVD player, climate control, hairdryer, ceiling fans, in-room safe, iron and ironing board. Some units also feature a washer and dryer.

resort_details: The relaxing ambience of this adult-only hotel is ideal for a romantic getaway. Access the highest level of service of the Grand Bahia Principe and relax under the sun as you enjoy your favorite cocktail made just for you at the nearest pool bar. location: Pelican Key, St Maarten Dutch Caribbean
resort_details: Being one of the only family-owned and operated resorts on the island of St. Maarten, La Vista Resort has been a favorite to many for over 28 years. The staff is friendly and accommodating and will do their best to ensure that your vacation is comfortable and relaxing. La Vista Resort offers 7 different unit-types varying from deluxe suites to cottages. The resort offers various but equally breathtaking views from all unit-types and features a gorgeous infinity pool alongside the fantastic on-site restaurant, The Hideaway. The gardens of local flowers surrounding the resort along with the Caribbean-bungalow style rooms add to the Caribbean feel of this quaint, relaxing resort. Enjoy St. Maarten’s beautiful sunsets and watch as the cruise ships come and go right from the comfort of your own private balcony or from the pool deck. La Vista Resort prides itself on its reputation for ensuring that their guests are happy, so come visit us and enjoy your vacation at your home away from home.

room_details.room_Description: There are seven different unit types at La Vista Resort; Junior Suites, Deluxe Suites, Penthouse Suites, Cottages, 1-Bedroom Deluxe Suites, 1-Bedroom Penthouse Suites, and Sleep-4 Deluxe Suites. All rooms at La Vista Resort have a full or partial view of the crystal-clear turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea, and have their own private balconies. All rooms also feature a kitchenette with a two burner stove and basic appliances, a living room, a safe, and a dining area. Most rooms offer a pullout couch, and all rooms sleep between 2 to 4 persons. Each suite features similar décor sticking to a blue and green color scheme along with Caribbean inspired prints and fabrics that add to the Caribbean feel of the resort. No matter which unit-type you chose to enjoy, you will be getting the authentic La Vista Resort experience. Come on down and see for yourself why this resort has been a favorite to many for over 28 years!

location: Pelican Key, St Maarten Dutch Caribbean
resort_details: La Vista Beach Resort is located right on the beach in Pelican Key on the Caribbean island of St. Maarten. This 3-story building is surrounded by picturesque palm trees, a tropical garden of local bougainvillea and hibiscus flowers, and overlooks the crystal-clear turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea. Watch St. Maarten’s gorgeous sunsets while you enjoy the sound of the calm ocean waves crashing against the reef, all from your private balcony at this quiet and relaxing resort. Make sure you have your cameras out to capture the amazing orange, pink and purple colors that our sunsets offer, as well as passing cruise ships! With the resort being mere steps from the beach, you have the option to lounge on your own private balcony, by the pool, or on the beach! The beach is also a nice area for snorkeling as it is right off of one of the many reefs along the coast of St. Maarten. You can see various colorful Caribbean fish, and sometimes even octopuses and eels! Come and see for yourself!

room_details.room_Description: There are two unit types at La Vista Beach; Studios and Two Bedrooms. All rooms face the crystal-clear waters of the Caribbean Sea, and have their own private or semi-private balconies. All rooms at La Vista Beach feature a full kitchen with all appliances, a living room with a pull-out couch, a safe, and a dining area both inside and outside. The studio units offer a sectioned off master suite, complete with a privacy curtain to accommodate friends or family, and a bathroom with two doors. These units have 2 TV’s, can sleep up to 4 people, and are quite cozy. The two bedroom units offer a master suite, two bathrooms, a second bedroom with twin beds, closet space, and 3 flat screen TV’s. The rooms are accessible via the front of the building as well as the back, and can sleep up to 6 people. All units overlook the beach and pool deck, and offer unique, breathtaking views. The room décor as well as the gardens outside add to the Caribbean-feel of this resort. Come and see for yourself!

Our two-bedroom suites have been decorated with dark, rich wood, and are equipped with kitchens and stainless-steel appliances, separate dining and living areas, a private balcony, designer furnishings, and spectacular views!

room_details.room_Description: Enjoy upscale accommodations in an unparalleled setting by booking one of our exceptionally appointed two bedroom suites. All suites have one king bed in the master bedroom, two queen beds in the second bedroom, and a queen murphy bed in the living area, as well as three private bathrooms. Equipped with air conditioning, cable television, phones, ceiling fans, modern decor, and unrivaled views of tropical gardens or the Caribbean Sea, you will embrace the laid-back charm and elegance of The Presidential Suites Puerto Plata. Ideal for couples or any family, our on-property amenities features a large, centralized pool with waterfall, Jazz, a French Fusion Restaurant, Bourbon Street Bar, three tennis courts, and a full-press lighted basketball court. Wherever you go, you’re in paradise!

resort_details: This beachfront resort features lush gardens, swimming pools, hot tub, and evening entertainment. Located in the heart of Maho Village, La Plage offers a serene escape. Visitors have convenient access to the beach, spa, salon and an on-site restaurant. A range of studios with partial kitchens, and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with kitchens are available. There's a small grocery store, fitness centre, a babysitting service and an activities desk to plan your island adventures.

room_details.room_Description: La Plage is a private resort featuring 128 air-conditioned suites, each with balconies, some with fully furnished kitchens and modern amenities including dishwashers and microwaves. Large and bright, all the rooms face the pool and beach, and offer an amazing spot for watching the planes landing and taking-off at the airport during the day, yet a quiet respite at night.

Standard units sleep up to 2 or 3 people and have a full bathroom with two rain showers, water closet and double vanities. resort_details: From indigenous art to chic design, Secrets Wild Orchid Montego Bay, a AAA Four Diamond resort, takes its inspiration from the island’s radiant surroundings, steeped in the Ethiopian roots of Jamaica’s African ancestors. There are 350 luxurious suites with classic décor, 24-hour room service and more. The Unlimited-Luxury® experience continues with gourmet dining and unlimited top-shelf spirits served at ten dining options and eight bars & lounges. Resort facilities are shared with Secrets St. James Montego Bay, located just next-door. During the day, relax on an expansive white sand beach, take a ride on the resort’s catamaran or rejuvenate at the Secrets Spa by Pevonia®. At night, exciting entertainment awaits. The Unlimited-Luxury® experience continues with Unlimited Connectivity, offering free Wi-Fi and international calling to the U.S., Canada and Mexico. This adults-only, stylish resort is perfect for youthful souls and is located near all of the excitement in Montego Bay.

room_details.room_Description: Hotel and Studio Units sleep 2 and include a 3/4 bath. Suites feature all of the essentials for fun time and downtime with your companion and 24-hour room service. Several suites also offer direct swim-out access to pools that flow up to each private patio. Preferred Rooms are available and include lounge bar, in-room internet access and pillow menu. (H/02/02)Junior Suite Ocean View King (S/02/02)Preferred Club Junior Suite Ocean View King

location: Cole Bay, St Maarten Dutch Caribbean
resort_details: Simpson Bay Resort, Marina & SPA, on the pearly white shores of Simpson Bay Beach, lies midway between the beach and the island's most popular nightspots, restaurants, and shopping. The resort features a casino, 2 restaurants, 1 sports pub, 4 lighted tennis courts, 5 pools, swim-up bar, water sports, a full-service spa, shopping arcade, children's pool and playground, and more. For your convenience, the resort also features a grocery mart and laundry facilities. Simpson Bay Resort & Marina has plenty of things for the whole family to enjoy, including island tours, shopping trips, aqua aerobics, and Bingo. Nearby, Aqua Mania Adventures can arrange for scuba diving, snorkeling, excursions, dinner cruises, and ferries and sail boats to neighboring islands.

room_details.room_Description: Simpson Bay Resort, Marina & SPA has the right size unit for every guest: studios sleep 2; studio sleep 4; 1- and 2-bedroom units sleep 4 to 6 respectively; and 3-bedroom units accommodate up to 8 people. The spacious and fully-equipped suites feature modern amenities. Most units feature a terrace or balcony. All units have fully equipped kitchens, ceiling fans, air conditioning in the bedrooms, direct-dial telephone, satellite TV, in-room safe, iron and ironing board, hairdryer, free wireless internet access, and weekly maid service.

resort_details: While on this stunning island, spend a day lounging on the beach, soaking up the sun and enjoying the blue Caribbean water. The Sea Palace Resort has beach loungers available, and the staff is available to arrange day trips to other parts of this Dutch/French island. Take a day-long fishing excursion, and upon return, partake of fine cuisine in the on-site restaurant. US dollars, traveler’s checks, and major credit cards are widely accepted. Smoking is not allowed in the units but allowed on the balconies. The resort charges a USD$35 weekly utility surcharge. There is also a government-required timeshare tax of USD$50 per week. Complimentary wifi is provided.

A warm welcome awaits you at South Beach Resort I where the warmth of Barbados' beautiful climate is echoed by the warmth of the hospitality you will receive. The South Beach Resort I is situated across a picturesque bay on Barbados' vibrant south coast, a location that provides the perfect blend of tranquility and entertainment. After a day of water sports, or simply relaxing in the warm Caribbean waters, an interesting choice of evening entertainment awaits you.

place_name: The Crown Villas at LHVC Resort
resort_details: The Crown Villas are just as impressive on the inside. The Villas are beautifully appointed and impeccably decorated with a distinctly Caribbean flair, furnished with natural wicker, rattan, and exotic elephant bamboo. Each Villa comes with a fully equipped kitchen, dining room, and living room with cable television. The air-conditioned bedrooms are designed with your comfort in mind and feature a private bathroom. Every Villa has a private pool, shaded terrace, patio, and encompasses the relaxed ambiance of the Caribbean in an elegant setting! Enjoy a luxurious tropical getaway in your private paradise!

place_name: The Residence Suites at LHVC Resort
resort_details: The Residence Suites are situated within twelve three-story Spanish-Mediterranean hillside buildings just inland from Cofresi Beach. Here couples and families are provided the ultimate in comforts and convenience to complement their stay in the Caribbean. Enjoy the gentle sea breeze as it rolls in while watching the sunset on your private terrace. If you are feeling adventurous, Cofresi Beach offers water sports, sailing, deep-sea fishing, and the aquatic wonders of Ocean World. No detail has been overlooked as these one or two-bedroom luxurious suites offer spacious living and dining areas, private baths, and fully equipped kitchenettes to assure you and your guests are provided a home-away-from-home vacation experience!

room_details.room_Description: The Residence Suites feature elegant design touches and deliver guests a wide range of amenities to complement their stay in the Caribbean. Highlights include several swimming pools, a beach club, and various restaurants. The one- and two-bedroom suites are air-conditioned, and include a living room, dining room, and a spacious balcony or patio, all decorated in the typical Caribbean style with wicker and bamboo accents.

resort_details: The St. George's Club is comprised of cozy cottages nestled amongst 18 acres of flourishing tropical landscape. The Club offers three outdoor swimming pools (one heated) and three tennis courts. Enjoy the resort's private beach and beach club which are about a mile away. The beach club and conveinience store is opened seasonally (May thru October) and offers a restaurant, bar, beach chairs and water sports equipment rental. St. George's Club also offers on-site moped rentals, and fitness center. We offer a commentary Shuttle bus service from the resort to the town & beach that runs from April to October. Prices in Caribbean tend to be more expensive.

room_details.room_Description: Overlooking the World Heritage town of St. George and its pristine harbour, these lovely, fully furnished accommodations welcome you with stylish decor. Relax in air conditioned comfort with hotel units that sleep two, one-bedroom units that sleep up to four, and two-bedroom units that sleep up to six. All accommodations come with kitchen facilities that include a microwave, and for added comfort and convenience, some units also feature full kitchens as well as dishwashers.

resort_details: The Tropical features three-story buildings that combine an eclectic Mediterranean style along with the Caribbean-influenced roofs and cobblestone walkways making it a true tropical beachfront resort. The surrounding mountain ranges and the sparkling ocean are prominent views from every spacious guest rooms or Studios. The Tropical strives to create an elegant atmosphere paired with world-class personalized services to be enjoyed by your friends and family for a one-of-a-kind getaway experience!

room_details.room_Description: Each of the bright Tropical Rooms is filled with effortlessly chic décor, well-equipped, top-notch entertainment systems, and two queen-sized beds or one king-size bed. Studio units include a king-size bed and an additional sitting area amongst other amenities. Each unit is equipped with cable TV, air conditioning, clock radio, coffee maker, hairdryer, iron and ironing board, and safety deposit box, and all units feature a private balcony that overlooks either the pool or the beach. Imagine enjoying your morning coffee without having to leave your room, or late afternoon drink, while relaxing on your balcony and enjoying the scenery. You may never want to leave! Room occupancies include: Tropical Rooms 4 people * Estudios 4 people No pets are allowed at the resort.

The Tropical strives to create an elegant atmosphere paired with world-class personalized services to be enjoyed by your friends and family for a one-of-a-kind getaway experience!

room_details.room_Description: Each of the bright Tropical Rooms is filled with effortlessly chic décor, well-equipped, top-notch entertainment systems, and two queen-sized beds or one king-size bed. Studio units include a king-size bed and an additional sitting area amongst other amenities. Each unit is equipped with cable TV, air conditioning, clock radio, coffee maker, hairdryer, iron and ironing board, and safety deposit box, and all units feature a private balcony that overlooks either the pool or the beach. Imagine enjoying your morning coffee without having to leave your room, or late afternoon drink, while relaxing on your balcony and enjoying the scenery. You may never want to leave! Room occupancies include: Tropical Rooms 4 people * Estudios 4 people No pets are allowed at the resort.

location: St. Mary's, Antigua, Antigua and Barbuda
resort_details: Embark on a weeklong cruise aboard a luxury catamaran. A crew runs the yacht, including food and beverage service, while guests swim, kayak, snorkel and scuba dive, or simply relax. Each day after breakfast, sail for an hour or two and again after lunch, visiting different small islands. Most days end with cocktails and a wonderful dinner in quiet bays, where the yacht will moor overnight.

room_details.room_Description: Yachts feature four guest cabins, each a spacious double stateroom designed for complete comfort and enjoyment.

resort_details: Cowpet Bay, home of the St. Thomas Yacht Club, is the site of the Elysian Beach Resort. Enclosed by palm-shaded hills, the resort rises from its secluded beach to offer a most magnificent setting. Besides the beach, enjoy water sports, including sunfish sailing, kayaking, windsurfing, swimming, and introductory scuba lessons. Enjoy a great breakfast and lunch at one of the restaurants; dine in elegance each evening. Enjoy the swim-up bar. Both on-site restaurants offer scheduled live entertainment.

room_details.room_Description: Whether you arrive with family, friends, or just you and your partner, you will appreciate the privacy of the resort's separate bedrooms and the private kitchen. The studio suite contains two double beds or one king-size bed or one queen-size Murphy bed, a partial but fully-equipped kitchen with a microwave oven, a refrigerator, a toaster, and a coffee maker. The maximum occupancy for each unit is four people, and there is a balcony and desk in each suite. Note that bedding may vary, and specific requests cannot be assured. resort_details: Perfectly located along a 200 yard stretch of pristine beach on the easternmost coast of the Dominican Republic, Zoëtry Agua Punta Cana is an intimate sanctuary of supreme relaxation integrated with nature. This resort offers Endless Privileges®, which provide guests with limitless access to the majority of all services and amenities that include 96 ultra-luxurious suites situated throughout the beautifully-manicured gardens, gourmet à la carte restaurants, bars and lounges, complimentary horseback riding and in-suite private dining. The resort also features a luxurious spa complete with elite products and an extensive menu of unique and indigenous body treatments. A full-service fitness center, salon and meeting facilities are also available.

Resort Details
Nestled minutes from the UNESCO-protected jewel of the Pitons, a luxurious and serene tropical paradise in St. Lucia. This 124 all-suite, boutique oasis is perched on a scenic hillside overlooking Marigot Bay, LaBas beach and just one hour away from the Hewanorra International Airport. Complete with swaying palm trees, anchored yachts and a nearby volcanic, white-sand beach, Marigot Bay Resort, Spa & Marina immerses guests in a haven of luxury, service, and serenity for the ultimate in blissful relaxation. The resort boasts a myriad of accommodations all complemented by gracious St. Lucian hospitality and Caribbean-chic architecture. Four restaurants and bars treat guests to rich culinary traditions, a palette of Caribbean flavors and herb-infused cocktails that are sure to inspire. Lounge poolside or savor a therapeutic massage at our spa sanctuary.

Sport fishing, sailing, diving, kayaking, and hiking are all great activities and adventures in this area!

The sofa bed is recommended for children under 12 years old.

The full-service Secrets Spa by Pevonia® is a sanctuary for the senses, offering rejuvenating treatments and packages.

location: San Pedro Town, San Pedro Island, Belize
resort_details: Experience the ultimate in luxury, privacy and oceanfront, island living at the Villas at Banyan Bay with commanding panoramic views of the Caribbean Sea and the Great Belize Barrier Reef. Our resort features a full-service restaurant, Rico's Bar & Grill, Dive Shop and Gift Shop - all just a mile and a half south of San Pedro.

room_details.room_Description: A family oriented resort, located on Ambergris Caye in Belize, our villas feature two bedroom accommodations.

resort_details: Escape to one of Orlando's hidden gems, Barefoot Suites, located in Kissimmee, Florida, just 1 mile from Walt Disney World® Maingate. Within walking distance of Barefoot Suites is the Old Town Entertainment Complex®, home of the Pepsi-Cola Friday Nite Cruise® and the Saturday Nite Cruise®. Every weekend beautiful hot rods, antiques, and muscle cars from throughout the United States are parked for display on the famous Trophy Row. The highlight of both nights is when the cars line up and cruise down Old Town's brick streets to the classic rock 'n roll music of the '50s, '60s, and '70s. Old Town hosts 75 specialty shops, 8 restaurants, and multiple amusement rides. Fun Spot USA® amusement park is also within walking distance of the resort.

room_details.room_Description: Barefoot Suites has fully furnished apartment-style condo units that are sure to meet all your needs. Our condo resort offers vacationers roomy accommodations of deluxe queen bed and deluxe king bed units. Each unit has a kitchen or kitchenette, TVs, and an in-unit washer and dryer.

place_name: Holiday Inn Club Vacations At Orange Lake Resort - East Village
resort_details: Holiday Inn Vacations at Orange Lake Resort is located on 1,450 beautiful acres of lush greenery. A myriad of amenities and activities are available at this resort and the facilities of all four resort villages are available to all guests. The resort features seven pools, a lazy river, an 80-acre lake with a beach and water sports, four golf courses, seven restaurants, two mini golf courses, and more. The East Village has two relaxing pool areas and villas that overlook the 18-hole championship golf course.

room_details.room_Description: The spacious air-conditioned villas at the Orange Lake Resort are comfortably furnished and make for relaxing accommodations. These colorful and airy villas feature a full or partial kitchen, a dining room and living room area, and a satellite TV with a DVD player. Villas are also furnished with a patio or balcony and range in size from studios to three-bedroom units that sleep 2 to 12 guests.

place_name: Holiday Inn Club Vacations At Orange Lake Resort - North Village
resort_details: Even with so much to do nearby, guests find it difficult to tear themselves away from Orange Lake Resort with its 80-acre lake, 365m lazy river, golf courses, and restaurants. Also, enjoy the beach, and abundant water sports & activities including waterskiing, boating, fishing, tennis, racquetball, basketball, and more. The North Village offers access to all the amenities of the resort but in a more intimate setting that families love. A spectacular swimming pool and a nine-hole golf course are guest favorites.

room_details.room_Description: A variety of units are available at the Holiday Inn Orange Lake North Village, ranging from one to three bedrooms. They offer ample room for 4 to 12 guests to relax after action-packed days. Each is attractively furnished and offers amenities, comforts, and conveniences such as full kitchens, air conditioning, a washer & dryer, telephones, and more.

place_name: Holiday Inn Club Vacations at Orange Lake Resort - River Island
resort_details: Holiday Inn Club Vacations at Orange Lake Resort - River Island is the ultimate location for a family getaway. River Island features a tropical water park with a 12-acre pool complex, a lazy river, a waterfall, waterslides, bars, eateries, and shops. Guests have access to all four resort sections, featuring seven pools, a 1,200-foot-long lazy river, and an 80-acre lake with a beach and watersports. Enjoy four golf courses, seven restaurants, two mini golf courses, three fitness centers, basketball, tennis, racquetball courts, and more.

room_details.room_Description: Spacious floor plans and inviting décor create the perfect home away from home. Orange Lake Resort is perfect for vacationing couples or families enjoying a getaway. Relax in air-conditioned comfort with one-bedroom units that sleep up to four, two-bedroom units that sleep up to eight, three-bedroom units that sleep up to 12, and four-bedroom units that sleep up to 14. All accommodations have pull-out sofa sleepers and come with full kitchens that include a microwave, dishwasher, and washer/dryer.

place_name: Holiday Inn Club Vacations at Orange Lake Resort - West Village
resort_details: Holiday Inn Vacations at Orange Lake Resort is situated on 1,450 acres of lush greenery. A myriad of amenities and activities are available, and the facilities at all four resort villages are available to all guests. These resorts feature seven pools, a lazy river, an 80-acre lake with a beach & water sports, four golf courses, seven restaurants, two mini golf courses, and more. The West Village features a clubhouse overlooking the lake, a themed restaurant & patio bar, cabanas, and retail shops.

room_details.room_Description: The spacious, air-conditioned villas at the Orange Lake Resort are comfortably furnished and help you relax during your stay. These colorful and airy villas feature amenities such as full or partial kitchens, a dining room and a living room with satellite TV and a DVD player. The villas range in size from studios to three-bedroom units and can sleep from 2 to 12 guests.

place_name: Holiday Inn Club Vacations Orlando Breeze Resort
resort_details: Holiday Inn Club Vacations Orlando Breeze Resort is the perfect resort for a family-friendly getaway. Enjoy spacious condo-style one, two, and three-bedroom villas complete with a living, dining room, and fully-equipped kitchen. At the resort, guests can enjoy outdoor pools, an arcade room, a fitness center, a movie theater, a snack bar, an activity center, tennis & basketball courts, volleyball, and an 18-hole mini golf course. Located just minutes from Walt Disney World®, you can enjoy Disney Springs shopping and the dining district including Planet Hollywood and House of Blues. Universal Studios Florida™, Universal’s Islands of Adventure™, and the new Universal’s Volcano Bay™ water theme park are also some of our guests’ favorites located nearby.

room_details.room_Description: Holiday Inn Club Vacations Orlando Breeze Resort offers beautifully decorated and spacious one, two, and three-bedroom villas. Enjoy a spacious living room with a queen sleeper sofa, a dining room, and a fully-equipped kitchen complete with cookware & tableware. A washer & dryer are included in some villas, and free laundry facilities are available onsite. Wifi and parking are also free.

place_name: Las Palmeras, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club
resort_details: Ideally located in the heart of Orlando's thriving tourist and convention corridor, Las Palmeras, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club offers the luxuries and comforts of a private residence in the ultimate getaway setting. Conveniently set near Orlando's thrilling attractions, celebrated theme parks, and the popular shopping, dining and entertainment venues of International Drive, this exceptional high-rise tower features modern suites, resort dining, lobby and pool bars, a fitness center, and a heated outdoor pool.

room_details.room_Description: The resort is comprised of spacious studio, one, and two-bedroom guest suites, with either a partial or mini kitchen.

resort_details: Magic Tree Resort is the "best kept secret in Florida" according to our owners & guests, and we are a FAMILY resort that makes you feel right at home! Located less than 2 miles from Disney World, and a short drive from Universal Studios, Sea World, Legoland, Kennedy Space Center, and Gatorland, Magic Tree Resort is an ideal location for fun and entertainment. We offer full-size shuffleboard, giant checkers, life-size connect four, and cornhole. Enjoy free DVDs available for check-out.

room_details.room_Description: The renovated first-class accommodations may tempt guests to stay in their rooms just a bit longer than planned. But don’t let this keep you from enjoying the spectacular city surrounding the resort. One-bedroom units accommodate up to four (1BR/4/4), while two-bedroom units accommodate up to six (2BR/6/4).

resort_details: The Fountains resort boasts a range of attractions including the impressive 75,000 square-foot Wakoola Springs tropical water oasis with two water slides, a zero-entry pool, interactive water fountains, hot tubs, bridges, and fire circles. Guests can also enjoy fishing, paddle boating, walking along the boardwalk and pier on Lake Eve, a 6,000 square-foot indoor/outdoor pool, a pool bar, a playground, and a 20,000 square-foot clubhouse with a gift shop, activity center, bar, and casual yet refined restaurant.

room_details.room_Description: Experience privacy and comfort in our modern, spacious two and three-bedroom villas. Each villa features a screened balcony with a lake view, a fully equipped kitchen, a garden tub, and a surround sound system. The two-bedroom units can sleep up to six or eight people, while the three-bedroom units can accommodate up to ten.

place_name: Parc Soleil, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club
resort_details: Parc Soleil, a Hilton Grand Vacations resort has an unsurpassed setting in the vacation capital of Orlando. This exquisite new property is the most expansive Hilton Grand Vacations Club resort in Florida. The resort is centrally located to the most celebrated attractions in the region. This grand resort features extensive on-site recreational facilities and amenities, tranquil waterfront walking paths, and ideal proximity to Orlando’s most popular theme parks, golf courses, dining, and shopping.

room_details.room_Description: Our resort features luxurious accommodations, including studios, and one, two, and three-bedroom suites with private balconies. Each guest suite features a fully-equipped kitchen, a washer & dryer, and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi.

resort_details: Luxury and style are hallmarks of Sheraton Vistana Resort, the ideal base for any Orlando holiday. We offer many amenities and activities including thirteen tennis courts, seven swimming pools, seven hot tubs, an 18-hole miniature golf course, an activity center, two snack bars, and one full-service restaurant. Guests can enjoy a massage, and there is also basketball, volleyball, a children's splash pad, and a children's playground. Tickets for attractions can be purchased at the resort.

room_details.room_Description: Luxury and style are hallmarks of Sheraton Vistana Resort, the ideal base for any Orlando holiday. We offer many amenities and activities including thirteen tennis courts, seven swimming pools, seven hot tubs, an 18-hole miniature golf course, an activity center, two snack bars, and one full-service restaurant. Guests can enjoy a massage, and there is also basketball, volleyball, a children's splash pad, and a children's playground. Tickets for attractions can be purchased at the resort.

resort_details: Set within 54 acres surrounding Lake Eve, and right in the heart of the action along International Drive, The Fountains offers everything you would expect from a world-class resort. With a over 500 square metres indoor/outdoor pool, a hot tub spa, children's pool and a clubhouse, there's plenty to do. Rooms range from one-bedroom apartments for six people to three-bedroom apartments that will sleep ten guests - perfect for a family break, plus the resort is close to Orlando's top theme parks.

place_name: Tuscany Village, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club
resort_details: Inspired by the beauty and ambiance of Tuscany, this distinguished resort in the heart of Orlando provides easy access to the region’s top attractions. Here, a grand piazza opens up to a clubhouse, a lakefront walking path, and dazzling swimming pools and water features. Within minutes of the theme parks and adjacent to the Orlando Premium Outlet, Tuscany Village, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club, treats guests to extraordinary amenities and is the ideal setting for fun and relaxation.

room_details.room_Description: Your vacation home is equipped with air conditioning, a telephone, a television, and a DVD player. Studio units are designed for two people with a king-sized bed, one bathroom, and a mini kitchen. One-bedroom units accommodate up to four people and include a king-sized bed, a queen-sized sofa bed, one bathroom, and a full kitchen. Two-bedroom units are ideal for six people, with one king-sized bed in one bedroom, a varied bedding arrangement in the second bedroom, one queen-sized sofa bed, two bathrooms, and a full kitchen. Three-bedroom units can accommodate up to eight people, including two king-sized beds, two double beds, one queen-sized sofa bed, 2.7 bathrooms, and a full kitchen.

resort_details: Come to 24 North Hotel and soak in Key West. Our concierge can curate personalized experiences such as yoga, pilates, spa services, bicycle and scooter rentals, snorkeling and diving, seaplane tours, catamaran sailing, parasailing, deep-sea fishing, and more.

room_details.room_Description: Rooms are equipped with a 48" LCD TV, microwave, refrigerator, laptop safes, oversized lounge chair and ottoman, bath with granite counter tops, and exceptionally comfortable and clean beds.

resort_details: Come to 24 North Hotel and soak in Key West. Our concierge can curate personalized experiences such as yoga, pilates, spa services, bicycle and scooter rentals, snorkeling and diving, seaplane tours, catamaran sailing, parasailing, deep-sea fishing, and more.

room_details.room_Description: Rooms are equipped with a 48" LCD TV, microwave, refrigerator, laptop safes, oversized lounge chair and ottoman, bath with granite counter tops, and exceptionally comfortable and clean beds.

place_name: AC Hotel Fort Lauderdale Sawgrass Mills / Sunrise - 3 Nights
resort_details: Step into modern design with a European vibe at the brand new AC Hotel Fort Lauderdale Sawgrass Mills/Sunrise, ideally located directly adjacent to Sawgrass Mills, one of the largest outlet shopping centers in the US. Catch a game at nearby BB&T Center, home of the Panthers (0.9 mi). Our location provides easy access to Fort Lauderdale attractions and beaches 20 minutes away. A refined design with an emphasis on technology brings flat-screen Smart HDTV’s to each room and complimentary high-speed WiFi throughout. Our daily breakfasts at AC Kitchen will kick-start your morning with freshly baked croissants, artisan cured meats and assorted quiches. We offer a Spanish twist with our breakfast and serve up tapas and expert local knowledge at our AC Lounge, featuring handcrafted cocktails and craft brews. Head to Horizon rooftop bar and lounge for cocktails and small bites with great views and even better atmosphere. Host your next successful meeting in our 1,675 sq ft of space.

room_details.room_Description: At the hotel, the rooms have a desk, a flat-screen TV, a private bathroom, bed linen and towels. At AC Hotel By Marriott Fort, every room comes with air conditioning and a safety deposit box. Guests at the accommodation can enjoy a continental breakfast.

resort_details: AC Hotel by Marriott Gainesville Downtown has a restaurant, outdoor swimming pool, a fitness center and bar in Gainesville. The property is located a 15-minute walk from Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, 1.3 miles from University of Florida and 2.5 miles from Regal Cinemas Royal Park Stadium 16. Free WiFi is available and private parking can be arranged at an extra charge.

room_details.room_Description: A refined design with an emphasis on technology brings flat-screen Smart HDTV’s to each room and complimentary high-speed WiFi throughout. We offer a Spanish twist with our breakfast and serve up tapas and expert local knowledge at our AC Lounge, featuring handcrafted cocktails and craft brews. Our well-appointed fitness center and rooftop pool will keep your fitness routine intact while enjoying the Florida sun. AC Hotels - a new way to hotel.

resort_details: Spearheading Tampa’s transformation, The Aloft Midtown Tampa Hotel is located in the city’s hottest new destination district - combing Westshore and Downtown with a central neighborhood undeniably energetic and contemporary. Tampa International airport, Raymond James Stadium, International Plaza and Bay Street are minutes away.

room_details.room_Description: Relax in comfort in a modern King guest room with comfy bedding and conveniences such as a mini-fridge and free Wi-Fi. Loft rooms offer two queen-size beds and feature airy 9-foot-high ceilings, plush platform beds, fast & free Wi-Fi, 55-inch LCD TVs and an eclectic, yet minimalist style.

resort_details: Looking over the Florida Bay from each unit's screened balcony at Anchorage Resort & Yacht Club it is easy to let troubles melt away. Guests will want to take part in the abundant water sports activities. Right outside the door is boating, fishing, and tennis. Between outdoor activities or local water sports, relax on the resort's sun deck and take a few dips in the pool with deck. Then back to more fun above and under the beautiful azure waters of Key Largo. Also on site are many court games, tennis, pickle ball, badminton, shuffleboard, and basketball.

room_details.room_Description: Anchorage Resort and Yacht Club features all one-bedroom suites with beautiful sunset views. The rooms are spacious and have great furnishings. All units have a full kitchen, a dishwasher, and a microwave plus all the kitchen amenities for your cooking pleasure. Units have screened private balconies. Gas grills are located by the pool.

Your unit at Avalon Resort has a full kitchen with microwave, air-conditioning and a television. Laundry facilities are located on-site for your convenience. Towel exchange service is provided once at mid-week. Studio Units OCC: Max 2/Pri 2 have 1 bath, 1 sofa (not a sleeper sofa) and 1 queen bed. 1BR units OCC: Max 4/Pri 4 have 1 or 2 baths, a king bed & a queen sleep sofa. The resort cannot accommodate requests for larger units. Cots and cribs are available for a fee, but please notify the resort in-advance to reserve them. There is a $35 charge for any room keys not returned. ** YOU MAY NOT EXCEED THE MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY OF THE UNIT AS STATED ON YOUR CONFIRMATION INCLUDING INFANTS! Guests of RCI members must have an RCI Guest Certificate in order to check-in. NO PETS ARE ALLOWED.

resort_details: Welcome to Bahama House Right here on the ocean in Daytona Beach, you will find a bright, airy, affordable and best of all, warm and personalized, alternative to the usual corporate, chain-style hotels. The family built, family operated and family-friendly Bahama House is a chic, inviting gem of a hotel for families, couples and groups who seek out unique and authentic places to stay when traveling. While you’re with us, you’ll enjoy free perks like Wi-Fi, onsite parking, an upscale continental breakfast in the morning and a cocktail hour each evening. What you won’t get are surprise “resort fees” and hidden charges. At Bahama House, complimentary means complimentary. If you want to soak up Daytona Beach’s famous sun, sand and surf, the beach is mere steps from the hotel. Sunseekers who can do without the sand can lounge in a comfy chaise on the deck by our seasonally heated oceanfront pool. Experience the Daytona Beach lifestyle at its most vibrant at the Bahama House hotel.

room_details.room_Description: Each of our air-conditioned guest rooms and suites is downright stunning, boasting a chic, modern décor, extra-spacious 400+-square-foot living areas and private balconies with ocean views. In addition to the previously mentioned free Wi-Fi, in-room comforts include coffeemakers, microwaves and refrigerators, plush bedding and flat-screen televisions with cable

resort_details: The property is just minutes from Clearwater Beach and St. Pete Beach. An area trolley stops right at the front door.

Easily reached from the Fort Lauderdale Airport as well as by car, the Wyndham Santa Barbara Resort welcomes families and couples seeking the best of Florida's renowned Gold Coast. Located across from Pompano Beach, this 10-story resort provides breathtaking views of the intercoastal waterway. With an on-site heated pool, luxury marina, barbeque area, hot tub, proximity to the beach, and resort activities, this is the perfect family-friendly, handicapped-accessible resort.

room_details.room_Description: The Wyndham Santa Barbara Resort offers stylish, clean, and comfortable accommodations that sleep up to six people. Studio, one, and two-bedroom units are air-conditioned with a well-equipped kitchen, including a microwave, dishwasher, and even a Margarita blender. Additional unit amenities are a TV, DVD Player, telephone, whirlpool tub, balcony, hair dryer, and an iron & ironing board. Laundry facilities are onsite.

resort_details: Costa Del Sol Resort, a luxury oceanfront resort hotel located directly on the beach in the charmingly tropical town of Lauderdale-By-The-Sea, Florida. Our resort is just across the bridge from world-famous Fort Lauderdale, yet quietly tucked away in a quaint seaside community close to fine restaurants, charming cafes and world class shopping.

room_details.room_Description: The resort's pleasant suites are extremely clean and comfortable. Every one-bedroom unit is tastefully decorated and includes a living room with a sofa-bed, a dining room, a king or queen size bed in the bedroom, a full kitchen with a microwave and a dishwasher, a spacious luxurious bath, two color televisions with cable, free WiFi, a safe, and a private balcony.

resort_details: With the beach at your door, you can explore miles of soft golden sands and luxuriate in the Florida sun. Play the day away in the surf swimming, snorkeling and jet skiing, kick back at the pool with friends & family, or relax in the hot tub. Enjoy the salty air and sea breezes from your oceanfront balcony, where you can watch the sun rise and survey the beach scene below. Daytona has one of the few remaining drive-on beaches in the world, so go crusing with the kids or catch all the action at the world famous Daytona International Speedway and DAYTONA USA.

room_details.room_Description: With the beach at your door, you can explore miles of soft golden sands and luxuriate in the Florida sun. Play the day away in the surf swimming, snorkeling and jet skiing, kick back at the pool with friends & family, or relax in the hot tub. Enjoy the salty air and sea breezes from your oceanfront balcony, where you can watch the sun rise and survey the beach scene below. Daytona has one of the few remaining drive-on beaches in the world, so go crusing with the kids or catch all the action at the world famous Daytona International Speedway and DAYTONA USA.

resort_details: Eagle's Nest Beach Resort indulges guests in a Marco Island experience that blends exhilarating outdoor adventures with the art of relaxation. Visitors enjoy tennis, watersports and other on-property recreation as well as the convenience of nearby shopping, dining and entertainment. With its clay-tiled roofs, lush tropical grounds and stunning gulf views, this welcoming beachfront retreat provides the distinctive ambience of a Mediterranean village. A spectacular courtyard garden and fountain add to the resort's romantic appeal. Delight in all the wonders of Marco Island, from its gentle breezes and natural splendor to the local flavor of its specialty shops and boutiques.

room_details.room_Description: Eagle's Nest's tower units and villas offer contemporary, beautifully appointed 1- and 2-bedroom condos, each with 2 baths, a sleeper-sofa, a screened balcony, a fully equipped kitchen, and washer/dryer.

resort_details: The Georgian Inn Beach Club has everything you'll ever need in one fantastic place. Join others in the Welcome Aboard Room for free coffee and donuts. Meet your fellow vacationers while discussing this week's activities. Only three miles away, visit Daytona Lagoon where you can choose from rock climbing, go-karts, mini golf, and laser tag. If you want to stay in shape while you're on vacation, please visit the gym. Bikes, beach chairs, and boogie boards are also available. And when you're done breaking a sweat relax in the hot tub.

room_details.room_Description: The Georgian Inn Beach Club is all about making your experience enjoyable. Toward that effort, the entire building underwent major restoration. This project included replacement of all balconies, new hallway and balcony deck coatings, white railings, new windows, and balcony doors. The large pool and deck overlooks the beach. Queen units (ocean front view) are: 206, 306, 207, 307, 208 and 308. Additional amenities include outdoor BBQ grills, soft drink and snack machines, indoor hot tub, gym, large social room, on-site laundry facilities, and much more.

place_name: Grande Villas at World Golf Village
resort_details: Adjacent to The World Golf Hall of Fame, Grand Villas at World Golf Village is a year-round paradise for anyone who longs for the ultimate Florida getaway. Overlooking the 17th and 18th fairways of The Slammer and The Squire championship golf course are the one- and two-bedroom villas. Just minutes away, you'll find some of Florida's best beaches and historic St. Augustine.

Surrounded by more than six lush, tropical acres, Sanibel Beach Club I enjoys a setting right on the beautiful Gulf of Mexico. The resort offers amenities, such as a heated outdoor pool, hot tub, sauna, two tennis courts, basketball and volleyball court, shuffleboard, and bicycles.

room_details.room_Description: Spacious two-bedroom accommodations provide two full baths, a fully-equipped kitchen, washer/dryer and screened porch. The Master Bedroom contains a king-size bed, the 2nd bedroom offers two full beds, and there's a queen-size sleep sofa in the Living Room. Please note that accommodations are located in two-story buildings and there are 14-steps leading to the 2nd-floor units; there are no elevators on property.

place_name: Sea Villas At New Smyrna Waves By Exploria Resorts
resort_details: Check in for Sea Villas at New Smyrna Waves by Exploria Resorts is conveniently located at 3208 Hill Street Unit 111 New Smyrna Beach, FL 32169. Sea Villas at New Smyrna Waves by Exploria Resorts is an ideal resort for family fun in the summer, with organized activities for the young and young-at-heart every day of the week. The resort consists of three two-story buildings, with oceanfront, ocean-view and ocean-side units. Each second-floor unit is accessed via its private staircase. Sea Villas has a heated pool, barbecue area and gazebo. The beach is just a few steps to the north of the resort.

room_details.room_Description: The accommodations at Sea Villas at New Smyrna Waves by Exploria Resorts have two bedrooms and two bathrooms with a six-person sleeping capacity. The rooms are delightful and the kitchen is well-equipped with a full-size range, refrigerator and microwave. There is a dining area and private porch or balcony adjacent to the living room. Cable television is provided in both bedrooms. Daily housekeeping is not available at this time.

resort_details: From its historic origins as a quaint settlement of fishing villages, Fort Myers Beach on Estero Island now treats visitors to sparkling white sands, stunning sunsets, abundant recreational activities and superb shopping and dining. Simply cross a bridge to this relaxing community and feel the weight of the world lift from your shoulders. An ideal headquarters for your South Florida escape, Seawatch On-the-Beach provides tastefully appointed accommodations with all the comforts of home, as well as magnificent views of the Gulf of Mexico and close proximity to the plentiful amenities of laid-back Fort Myers Beach

room_details.room_Description: Spacious 1 and 2 bedroom suites with screened balconies, each suite features a fully equipped kitchen, washer and dryer.

resort_details: From its premier vantage point at the southern tip of Sanibel Island, Shell Island Beach Club overlooks the tranquil waters of the Gulf of Mexico, just steps away from spectacular shelling and water sports along the sparkling coast. This relaxing getaway is close to the historic Sanibel Lighthouse and provides easy access to the island's vibrant collection of recreation activities, shopping, dining and entertainment. From meandering bike trails and nature walks to snorkeling, scuba diving and fishing excursions, Sanibel Island and its surroundings treat visitors to a memorable island vacation.

room_details.room_Description: 2 bedroom suites with screened balconies, featuring fully equipped kitchen, washer and dryer.

resort_details: Attend one of the welcome activities, sip Florida Dreamsicles, attend a hot dog or chicken roast, and play trivia games. Amenities include a heated pool, hot tub, horseshoes, bicycles, and fishing pier. Just behind the resort, visit the tropical gardens; in front, is the pool and spa. There's a large dock on the bay with lounge chairs, tables, and chairs as well as picnic areas with barbeque grills. Don't worry about beach chairs or beach towels because the resort provides them along with wireless Internet service, bicycles, games, and a book exchange, all free of charge.

room_details.room_Description: Smuggler’s Cove has well-appointed studio- and 1-bedroom units available. Each studio is equipped with a queen-size bed. The 1-bedroom units have a king-size bed in the bedroom and a queen-size sleeper-sofa in the living room. Both types of units have large, fully-equipped kitchens with refrigerator-freezers, dishwashers, standard and microwave ovens, as well as cookware and appliances. Each unit also has a large TV with a DVD player and stereo CD-players. Just ask if you need something…we’ll get it for you!

resort_details: From the moment you arrive at Solara Surfside, you can relax in comfort with convenience. The staff will pamper and spoil you with attention and service. We can arrange a variety of tours for you, from water taxis to the Everglades to viewing celebrity homes. Solara Surfside blends local Art Deco architecture. Once you step inside the lobby with its oak walls, marble counters and decorative tile floor, you'll know you're someplace special. With miles of golden beaches and the inviting Atlantic Ocean, there is a year-round heated pool, hot tub, shuffleboard and beach volleyball, there's plenty to do at this resort. But you won't want to miss all the activities nearby either: water sports, fishing charters, upscale shopping, fine dining and sightseeing. Valet Parking is also available for a nightly fee.

room_details.room_Description: Solara Surfside offers 58 guestrooms. Televisions come with all premium cable channels, DVD players, and VCRs. In-room safes are provided along with direct-dial phones, free local calls, and voice mail. Accommodations at this three-star property have kitchens with refrigerators, microwaves, cookware/dishes/utensils, and coffee/tea makers. Bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Sofa beds, air conditioning, and welcome amenities are also included.

resort_details: Sunrise Bay Resort and Club overlooks its private boat dock and a beautiful sheltered bay, while Gulf of Mexico beaches are only two miles away. Resort offers 1 boat rental on-site, and nearby marinas offer everything else you might need for a day on the water. Enjoy the resort's outdoor pool or relax in the hot tub. If you want an unforgettable adventure, take a trip to Everglades National Park, about an hour away. After a full day of sun, sport, and sight-seeing, explore the many tempting restaurants of Marco Island.

room_details.room_Description: Sunrise Bay Resort has 20 centrally air-conditioned, 1-bedroom and 2-bath condominiums. All units at Sunrise Bay Resort directly face the beautiful bay, providing guests a spectacular view of the sunrise. All units have screened balconies and are fully furnished and fully equipped to meet your vacation needs with a king-size bed, queen-size sleeper sofa in the living area, and fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher and microwave.

resort_details: An outdoor Olympic-size swimming pool, a hot tub, two shuffleboard courts, and a tennis court all await guests of Surf Rider Resort Condominium. This resort is located across the street from the Atlantic Ocean. The resort requires a US$ 100 credit card deposit upon check-in.

room_details.room_Description: All units have A/C, microwave, dishwasher, T.V, and a coin operated washer/dryer. 1BR units OCC: Max 4/Pri 4 have 1 or 1.5 baths, 1 queen bed, and a full murphy bed. 2BR units OCC: Max 6/Pri 4 have 1.5 or 2 baths, 1 king bed, 2 twin beds, and a full murphy bed. Units are across the street from the beach and do not have ocean views. Pets are not allowed. You are charged for all long distance phone calls placed from the units. Local calls are free.

place_name: The Charter Club of Marco Beach
resort_details: Marco Island, the largest of the Ten Thousand Islands leading to the Florida Everglades, is a tropical paradise nestled between the Gulf of Mexico and pristine natural wetlands. From its ideal beachfront setting, The Charter Club of Marco Beach delivers a vacation experience that's sure to delight all ages and interests. An extensive selection of activities awaits visitors, from sailboat rentals, tennis instruction and nearby golf courses to poolside recreation and peaceful strolls on the beach. Within walking distance are charming shops and restaurants. Marco Island's secluded environment provides the perfect backdrop for both relaxation and adventure.

room_details.room_Description: Your stay at Marco Island includes a spacious 2-bedroom condo with a balcony, fully-equipped kitchen, cable TV-DVD-MP3-CD player, a washer/dryer, Internet access, and air conditioning. Your stay grants you access to a heated pool and hot tub spa and a children's swimming pool, 2 lighted tennis courts, shuffleboard, a poolside barbecue grill, the supervised recreation program and fitness room, onsite water sports equipment rentals, the clubhouse Internet café, and faxing, printing, and copying services.

resort_details: Your sun-drenched escape awaits at the Galleon Resort where a private beach sits on the Gulf of Mexico, seducing you to experience the outdoors. Mingle with friends at the Tiki Bar while watching the sunset on the harbor or swim laps in the waterfront pool. Head to the observation deck for a romantic evening where you can view a stunning panorama of the island. Rent a boat for a private viewing of the Keys or take a Jet Ski for a spin. Work up a sweat at the on-site exercise room and relax your body and mind in the sauna.

room_details.room_Description: Your unit at The Galleon Resort will be relaxing and accommodating. Hotel suites are 290 Sq. Ft. which house two people and are equipped with a small refrigerator, coffee maker and microwave oven. One-bedroom condominiums sleep up to four while most two-bedroom condos sleep up to six. All are thoughtfully decorated to emphasize the tropical ambiance.

resort_details: When you vacation in a part of the world where it is always summer, naturally you want to fill those days with outdoor activities. Besides just being steps away from the beautiful Gulf waters, the Penthouses at Gulf Stream offers an outdoor pool, hot tub, picnic and playground area, as well as bicycles for guest use. For golf enthusiasts, there are more than 15 exciting and challenging championship golf courses in Manatee County. Tennis courts also are available in the area. At the end of a busy day, there is no finer place than The Penthouses at Gulf Stream to enjoy a spectacular West Coast Florida sunset.

room_details.room_Description: Your air-conditioned unit at The Penthouses at Gulf Stream Resort features cable TV in each bedroom, a telephone and a full kitchen. The resort is located across the street from the beach.

resort_details: Located directly on beautiful Cocoa Beach, yet, close enough to Orlando to truly have "the best of both worlds”. The Resort on Cocoa Beach is a premier destination on the Space Coast. We are located just minutes away from Port Canaveral, with all major cruise ships. We offer modern and spacious two bedroom, fully equipped accommodations with an endless array of fun activities both at the Resort or just minutes away. Enjoy surfing, golfing, kayaking, parasailing, wave runners, deep sea fishing, and Kennedy Space Center just to name a few.

room_details.room_Description: 2 Bedroom Sleeps: 6 Full kitchen 2 Full Baths

resort_details: From its prominent perch at the center of Marco Island's pristine beach, The Surf Club of Marco delivers an unforgettable vacation experience, blending peace and tranquility with the exhilaration of swimming, sailing, windsurfing and other seaside activities. Guests at this charming resort follow winding walkways through beautifully landscaped grounds to the beach and shimmering waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Abundant restaurants and evening entertainment are within walking distance, and vacationers enjoy easy access to the nearby Everglades National Park and the mangrove-lined estuaries and breathtaking beauty of the Ten Thousand Islands.

room_details.room_Description: The Surf Club of Marco features two-bedroom units with balconies overlooking the beautiful island. Accommodations sleep up to six guests and include a king-size bed, two twin beds, and a queen-size sleep sofa. Two bathrooms are included with tub and shower. All units come with fully equipped kitchens, including dishwashers and microwave ovens. A separate dining area is available for guest convenience. Enjoy cable TV with video players. Additional seating is throughout. All rooms are air conditioned.

resort_details: Following serene walkways bordered by colorful tropical landscaping, vacationers at Tortuga Beach Club Resort are just a stroll away from Sanibel Island's magnificent white-sand beaches. Guests enjoy a poolside gazebo, a private clubhouse and superb resort amenities, as well as complimentary greens fees and other select offerings at The Dunes Golf & Tennis Club. Marvelous shopping and dining are just minutes away, including delightfully inventive cuisine at the area's signature bistros and cafes. Chefs from around the world have brought their creative influence to Sanibel and Captiva, providing an ideal complement to every vacation in this island paradise.

room_details.room_Description: The spacious 2 bedroom townhouses offer screened balconies, a fully-equipped kitchen and washer/dryer.

resort_details: Go to the beach for a swim, or enjoy the resort’s on-site swimming and hot tub. Our recreational coordinator will keep you busy with activities such as tie dye t-shirts, sand art creations, karaoke night, various crafts, family game night, and weekly BBQ, just to mention a few. This is where you’ll check in as guests and check out as family. Also available are bikes, boogie boards, beach chairs, and beach umbrellas for a fee. Weather permitting and of course non-refundable.

room_details.room_Description: All rooms have their own private ocean front balconies. Prepare gourmet dinners in your fully equipped kitchens or you can cook at the on-site barbecue grills. Light housekeeping services are provided Monday through Friday. The rooms are supplied with coffee, shampoo, bath soaps, paper products, safes, pool towels, free Wi-Fi, and extra sheets, blankets and pillows.

resort_details: Tropical Sands Resort is located on a captivating seven-mile island beach town. Our resort offers you a comfortable, serene and friendly atmosphere on a picturesque tropical island. For your pleasure you have access to our bike barn, exercise room and library on the property. When you stay at Tropical Sands Resort, you will enjoy our activities around our refreshing pool. Whether it is playing bingo, indulging in a delicious root beer float, joining us for our weekly hot dog meal or listening to Jimmy Buffet music while sipping on a margarita, you are going to experience a fun-filled vacation full of enjoyable memories. Our welcoming staff is here to accommodate your needs and make your stay a pleasant one.

room_details.room_Description: You will enjoy all the comforts of home in our spacious 1,200 square foot two bedroom condo which accommodates a full size washer and dryer for your convenience. All of our kitchens have been remodeled and we are in the process of replacing the flooring in all the units which will be completed by 2017. These attractive air-conditioned condos are clean, efficient and cheerful. They sleep six comfortably with a king size bed in the master bedroom, twin beds in the guest bedroom and queen size sofa bed in the living room.

resort_details: Vacation Village at Weston is approximately twenty minutes from Fort Lauderdale Beach and one hour from Miami Beach. At the resort, you can relax by the swimming pool’s waterfall feature, soak in the hot tub, or work out in one of the two fitness centers. Play a game of tennis or go horseback riding nearby. The resort has a wide range of activities for the whole family to enjoy, including poolside Bingo, Latin dance, and movie night.

room_details.room_Description: Lovely, fully furnished, and stylish accommodations welcome you, whether you are planning a romantic getaway or an exciting family vacation. Relax in spacious, air-conditioned comfort with one-bedroom units that sleep up to four guests or two-bedroom units that sleep up to eight. All accommodations come with kitchen facilities that include a microwave, and for added comfort and convenience, some units also feature full kitchens with dishwashers.

resort_details: Vanderbilt Beach and Harbour Club offers a swimming pool and water activities and is near fabulous Naples area restaurants and boutique shops. The Vanderbilt Beach and Harbour Club offers 44 two-bedroom condominiums. Amenities at the resort, in addition to the gorgeous beach, include a 17-slip boat dock and bayside fish cleaning station, pool and hot tub, a health club with sauna, complimentary wireless Internet, bicycles and shuffleboard, and kayaks and pontoon boats for rent. Nearby amenities include car rental, groceries, and hairdresser services.

room_details.room_Description: The two-bedroom condominiums at Vanderbilt Beach and Harbor Club sleep six people. Every unit includes a full kitchen with dishwasher and microwave, balcony with a view, cable TV with HBO, air conditioning, washer/dryer, carpeting and telephone. Local phone calls are complimentary and DVD players are available upon request.

resort_details: Located directly on the beach of Hutchinson Island, only 45 miles North of West Palm Beach, Vistana Beach Club is ideal for relaxing and enjoying the tranquil beauty of Florida's Treasure Coast. Enjoy the magnificent swimming pool and the outdoor spa. Practice your backhand at the tennis courts or go for a bike ride. The hotel also features a boardwalk with a gazebo, picnic area, and video arcade.

room_details.room_Description: Guestrooms at Vistana Beach Club have private balconies with ocean views. The condos are well-equipped and perfect for vacationing families or couples.
