Stroll the white beaches in the morning and see the most amazing views available in this part of Florida. Camelot is perfect for swimming, fishing, sailing, parasailing, and other water sports. The resort has its own beach as well as a swimming pool, air-conditioning, computer facilities, internet access, TVs, and laundry. Units are non-smoking. The resort has limited parking, so only one parking space per unit is allowed.

room_details.room_Description: Camelot-by-the-Sea has classic Florida décor in the studios, one, and two-bedroom units, with full kitchens and unique amenities. This resort offers its guests fully-equipped and well-decorated suites. Our amenities include a heated pool, a sauna, cable television, a hot tub, barbecue grills, an exercise room, bikes, a shuffleboard area, a safe deposit box, and a solarium.

resort_details: Experience it all at the beautiful Club Wyndham Clearwater Beach Resort, and see what everyone is talking about. Whether you're here for a beach getaway, a family vacation, or a business meeting, this resort offers a blend of warm Southern hospitality, high-tech capabilities, and an inviting ambiance for relaxing, working, meeting, playing, dining, and exploring the natural beauty of Clearwater Beach.

room_details.room_Description: These spacious deluxe and presidential suites are fitted with all the necessities to make this your home away from home, including private bedrooms, separate living areas, a full kitchen, and spa amenities.

resort_details: Commodore Beach Club offers miles of beaches for walking, swimming, shell hunting and simply relaxing. The soothing Gulf breezes and beautiful sunsets can be enjoyed from the privacy of your balcony or while lazing by the heated swimming pool, or while relaxing in a whirlpool/hot tub. Commodore Beach Club is just minutes from excellent golf courses and a variety of excellent restaurants. Shopping centers and theaters are abundant and major attractions like Busch Gardens, Adventure Island, MOSI, Greyhound racing and the Hard Rock Hotel & Casino are all within an hour driving distance.

room_details.room_Description: Commodore Beach Club provides clean, comfortably furnished and well-equipped apartments to to fit your needs. Choose from one-bedroom, two-bedroom or studio layouts. All have telephones, air conditioning, televisions, and either full kitchens or kitchenettes with dishwashers and microwaves. Some units are carpeted. Laundry facilities are available. The friendly staff will help make sure that you and your family will want to return.

resort_details: Each neatly decorated and well-maintained unit at the Coral Reef Beach Resort features a full kitchen, and a living room in both one- and two-bedroom accommodations. One-bedroom units sleep four and two-bedroom units sleep up to six adults and children.

room_details.room_Description: Coral Reef Beach Resort offers a vacation getaway as active or as relaxing as you choose to make it. The resort overlooks the Gulf of Mexico at St. Petersburg Beach and features a 360,000 gallon freeform, outdoor swimming pool. There are actually two outdoor pools on the property, three hot tubs, shuffleboard and laundry service.

resort_details: Relax on the white sand facing the Gulf of Mexico at the Coral Shores Resort and splash in the gentle Gulf surf. Enjoy the beautiful beachfront swimming pool and soak up the sun in the chaise lounges. Stay on the beach and witness the spectacular sunsets. Play shuffleboard, then unwind in the hot tub. Laundry facilities are available for guest use, and current-release videos are provided at no additional charge.

room_details.room_Description: Studio units sleep two guests and include a full-size Murphy bed and a full-size sleeper sofa. One-bedroom units sleep up to four visitors with a queen-size bed and a queen-size sleeper sofa. Two-bedroom units accommodate up to six guests and have two bathrooms, one queen-size bed, two twin beds, and a queen-size sleeper sofa. All units include air conditioning, cable TV with DVD. Full kitchens feature microwave ovens and dishwashers. Some accommodations overlook the Gulf of Mexico.

resort_details: This hotel is conveniently located just 12 miles from Tampa International Airport and 15 miles from the Clearwater Beaches. It offers an outdoor pool, hot tub and a fitness center.

room_details.room_Description: Our Courtyard Tampa Oldsmar hotel offers stylish guest rooms with Marriott's luxury bedding, LCD flat-screen TV's, mini-fridge and FREE High-Speed Internet. Connect and enjoy a social experience in our new lobby, featuring The Bistro, serving breakfast, dinner & Starbucks. Get invigorated in our 24-hour fitness center and unwind in the courtyard, soak up the sun by the pool or relax by the waterfall and koi pond. Conveniently located to the Westshore Business district, the friendly team at this hotel in Tampa Bay eagerly awaits your arrival.

resort_details: Located on the Gulf of Mexico with beautiful sandy beaches, The Dolphin Beach Resort is the perfect destination for your next getaway. Once the sun sets, get ready for a great night out, and only a short walk away, you'll find fabulous restaurants, unique boutiques and shops. Leave your car in our parking lot and hop on the trolley right in front of our St. Pete Beach hotel for all your local travels.

room_details.room_Description: Each of the 173 non-smoking, spacious accommodations includes individual climate control air conditioning/heating, microwave, mini-refrigerator, coffee maker, iron/ironing board, hair dryer, large flat screen TV’s with free movie channels, free in room safes and complimentary Wi-Fi.

resort_details: Located in North Redington Beach, Grand Shores West is bordered by the Gulf of Mexico and Boca Ciega Bay. Here you can swim along the resort's beach or in the outdoor pool, or try the water sports available on site. The resort has one boat, volleyball, free sailing lessons; for just outside your door are the white sandy beaches and the warm waters of the Gulf. Amentities and special services include a sixteen foot hot tub and free beach cabanas.

room_details.room_Description: At Grand Shores West you will live in a spacious contemporary home away from home, filled with more features and fun things to do than time will allow you to enjoy. Children's games, cooking equipment for indoor and outdoor experimentation, and weekly maid service head the list of amenities. Studios can accommodate up to four, and two bedrooms sleep six.

resort_details: Spend your days lounging on the beach or pampering yourself in the warmth of the hot tub. The resort overlooks the Gulf of Mexico on a portion of the beach that comprises the Pinellas Suncoast, where swimming, sailing, deep-sea fishing and windsurfing are the order of the day. For your convenience the resort provides beach cabanas, and the on-site gas grills let you serve up your favorite catch of the day.

room_details.room_Description: One-Bedroom units and One-Bedroom Loft units sleep 4, and Two-Bedroom units sleep 6. All units are air-conditioned, and ocean view units are available. Each unit includes a fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher and microwave, as well as a washer and dryer.

resort_details: Nautical Watch in Belleair Beach located directly on the Gulf of Mexico, is close to everything you come to Florida to enjoy. When not sightseeing, spend your days at the resort sunbathing and swimming in the outdoor heated pool. Enjoy beautiful views and Florida foliage while relaxing on the beach or soaking in the hot tub. Shuffleboard and surf fishing are on-site as well. A barbeque and picnic area are also available for guests to enjoy.

room_details.room_Description: Spacious, air-conditioned studio, one, and two-bedroom accommodations are perfect for families or couples enjoying a getaway. The studios sleep two and have a full-size bed, one-bedroom units sleep up to four with a queen-size bed and queen sleeper sofa, and two-bedroom units sleep six with a queen-size bed, two twin beds, and a queen sleeper sofa. All accommodations come with a kitchenette that includes a microwave and dishwasher. Laundry facilities are available on-site.

place_name: Residence Inn by Marriott Tampa Suncoast Parkway - 3 Nights
resort_details: The Residence Inn Tampa Suncoast Parkway at NorthPointe Village hotel is a contemporary all-suite hotel situated in the Lutz suburb of the Tampa Bay area. This all-suite, extended stay hotel allows quick access to Tampa International Airport. Specializing in extended-stays, our Tampa Bay hotel features spacious suites with fully equipped kitchens, living and work areas, luxury bedding and FREE Wi-Fi.

room_details.room_Description: Our Studio Suites feature a king bed, queen pull-out sofa and a fully swiveled 32-inch flat-panel LCD TV to enjoy your favorite show in the living area or while in bed. Our One-Bedroom Suite has a king bed and warm, comfortable atmosphere to make you feel like you are at home. Enjoy your favorite show on our 32-inch flat panel LCD TV, relax in the living room with a pull-out sofa, or in the privacy of your bedroom.

place_name: Safety Harbor Resort and Spa - 3 Nights
resort_details: The perfect location right in the heart of Tampa Bay, close to two international airports -Tampa-St. Petersburg and Clearwater -and the famous white sands of Clearwater Beach. Our centrally-located resort offers the quaint town of Safety Harbor with retail shops, a variety of restaurants, and plenty of events right outside our front door. Of course, you may not ever want to leave our resort, as we offer every amenity you would expect -and more -all under one roof. Stunning views of Tampa Bay, spacious guestrooms, historic ballrooms and award winning spa facilities await your visit with us whether for a business meeting, special occasion or the need to just get away.

room_details.room_Description: Standard King with spacious guestroom featuring granite countertops and marble flooring in the full bath. These rooms comfortably accommodate up to 2 adults. Standard room accommodations have limited views of Tampa Bay while overlooking the pool area or our Tranquility Garden.

resort_details: Dramatically perched atop wind-swept dunes with expansive views of the sparkling Gulf of Mexico and St. Pete Beach in every direction, the fully renovated Don CeSar is the crown jewel of Florida's Gulf Coast and the epitome of classic American glamour and sophistication. Having completed luxurious property enhancement in 2021, including all 277 guestrooms and suites, dining outlets, and common spaces, the Don continues to beckon new and old generations with its unique architecture, modern art-deco interior design and subtle winks to its storied roots. Whether you’re looking to relax poolside, indulge in a spa treatment, explore luxurious retail boutiques, or find your refuge on the beach, the iconic Pink Palace® has it all. Bask in nonstop sunshine and luxury in a place where seven miles of sugar-white shoreline is equally breathtaking from a lounge chair or your private guestroom balcony.

room_details.room_Description: Dramatically perched atop wind-swept dunes with expansive views of the sparkling Gulf of Mexico and St. Pete Beach in every direction, the fully renovated Don CeSar is the crown jewel of Florida's Gulf Coast and the epitome of classic American glamour and sophistication. Having completed luxurious property enhancement in 2021, including all 277 guestrooms and suites, dining outlets, and common spaces, the Don continues to beckon new and old generations with its unique architecture, modern art-deco interior design and subtle winks to its storied roots. Whether you’re looking to relax poolside, indulge in a spa treatment, explore luxurious retail boutiques, or find your refuge on the beach, the iconic Pink Palace® has it all. Bask in nonstop sunshine and luxury in a place where seven miles of sugar-white shoreline is equally breathtaking from a lounge chair or your private guestroom balcony.

resort_details: Quenching your travel cravings in the city or at the shoreline is easy from AC Hotel San Juan Condado, which is conveniently situated in the heart of San Juan. Inside, indulge in the elegant details that we are known for. From our contemporary eateries to our rooftop pool overlooking the ocean, you'll get lost in the elegance.

room_details.room_Description: When it's time to call it a night, savor sweet dreams in our spacious rooms and suites, complete with sleek furnishings, mini-refrigerators and private balconies overlooking the city. In addition to your trip goals, you will find serenity, sunshine and splendor at AC Hotel San Juan Condado

resort_details: Bahia Blanca, known for 20 years of exceptional hospitality, makes your getaway under the sun a truly memorable experience. Awaken to friendly smiles and blue skies, and take a dip in the purified and heated pool any time of the day. The restaurant serves up savoury Spanish or International cuisine and whether you need an extra towel or help setting up an excursion, the resort's reception is open 24 hours a day. Choose from one- or two-bedroom units which will sleep four to six guests.

room_details.room_Description: The clean, uncluttered and modern design of your apartment creates a soothing environment that promotes complete relaxation. Take full advantage of the spectacular and endless views of the sun and ocean from your terrace or garden, includes sun loungers, parasols and a dining table. Cook a romantic dinner for two in the kitchen. Accommodations feature a comfy sofa, armchair and ceiling fans for warmer months. One-bedroom apartments can sleep up to four guests using the sofa bed in the sitting room. Two-bedroom units sleep four with privacy for four.

place_name: Best Western Plus Condado Palm - 3 Nights
resort_details: Escape to the Best Western Plus Condado Palm Inn & Suites – a modern hotel nestled in the most exclusive area of San Juan, Puerto Rico. Peaceful, affordable and just steps away from a powdery-white beach, we pride ourselves on providing the best value and outstanding service at the best location.

room_details.room_Description: Your Two Queen Bed room features a Microwave, Refrigerator, Pillow Top Mattress and 37 Inch Television.

location: Charlotte Amalie, St. Thomas, VI, USA
Rio Grande, Puerto Rico, PR, USA

room_details.room_Description: All units feature spacious and luxurious accommodations that showcase a fusion of sophistication and charisma. The One bedroom Suites for 6 ( HN-1BFR, HN-1BSA, HN-1BSU) are ocean view units with 691 sqft and have 2 double beds, a full sofa bed, 1 full bath and a hot tub in the bedroom. One bedroom Master Suites for 4 (HN-1MSA and HN-1MSU) are ocean view master units with 1076 sqft and have 1 king bed and 1 full sofa bed, 1 full bath and a hot tub in the bedroom. All units have air conditioning, 2 plasma TVs, DVD player, stereo system with CD player, safety deposit box, and hair dryer.

place_name: Divi Carina Bay Beach Resort & Casino Adults Only
resort_details: Carina Bay has a plethora a relaxing and exhilarating activities awaiting your arrival. Explore the sea with water activities, including paddle boards, snorkeling gear, kayaks or soaking in the rays while sunning in a lounge chair or swimming in one of the 2 freshwater pools. Tennis, shuffleboard, weekly activities and pickleball will keep you energized.

room_details.room_Description: You'll always get a good night's sleep at Carina Bay. Retreat to the comfort of your air-conditioned room or suite after a day of fun in the sun on St. Croix. All of our completely redesigned hotel rooms and hillside suites feature a fresh Caribbean chic look, luxury bedding, modern bathrooms, and sleek balconies or patios.

place_name: Embassy Suites by Hilton San Juan Hotel and Casino - 3 Nights
resort_details: Embassy Suites San Juan Hotel & Casino is two blocks away from Isla Verde Beach offering made-to-order breakfast daily, an outdoor pool with a waterfall, a kid's playground area, and an on-site casino. Guests can enjoy daily complimentary drinks every evening from 17:30 until 19:30. El Patio Latin Bar Cafe serves Latin and international cuisine, while Coqui Pool Bar offers poolside sandwiches and drinks. Eateries is a casual dining outlet with a variety of grab-and-go items. Guests can use the 24-hour gym or the business center at the hotel. The hotel's tour concierge desk offers information about things to see and do around the island.

room_details.room_Description: Every two-room suite features two TVs, a wet-bar-style kitchenette with a fridge, microwave, and coffee maker. All suites feature a minimalist design and have a separate bedroom and living-dining area, each with a TV and telephone.

place_name: Fairmont El San Juan Hotel - 3 Nights
resort_details: **As a special offer, RCI members will receive a $75 resort credit when confirming a 3-night stay or a $100 resort credit when confirming a 5- or 7-night stay if traveling by December 31, 2024. Where lively urban vibes and peaceful ocean views meet, you will find the Fairmont El San Juan Hotel. Venture inside and find an ode to traditions, old and new. If these walls could talk, they would share stories of 1960s society headliners crooning in the nightclub and generations of locals celebrating life's greatest milestones in the ballrooms. A timeless Puerto Rican icon and one of the Caribbean's most desired destinations, Fairmont El San Juan Hotel offers guests genuine Puerto Rican hospitality and a luxury lifestyle experience complete with a luxe full-service spa, four signature pools, private cabanas, a world-class fitness center with sky deck, retail shops, lively entertainment and non-stop gaming action at Foxwoods El San Juan Casino.

room_details.room_Description: The resort fee includes unlimited basic Wi-Fi, nightly live entertainment, kids activities and outdoor games, use of paddleboard equipment, and bicycles for adults and children. There are refillable water bottles and filtered water stations around the hotel, pool amenities with sunscreen, one Fitness class per guest per stay, and daily tropical cocktail class at Caña from 5pm to 6pm. Guest get special discounts at the shops at Fairmont El San Juan Hotel, 10% off hotel ticketed entertainment events, 10% off on the Well & Being Spa treatment of the day, 10% off Well & Being Spa and Fitness retail products, and one $25 Match Bet Coupon to use at the gaming table of your choice at Foxwoods El San Juan Casino. Additionally, waived rental fee on Seaside cabanas upon availability (food and beverage minimum consumption apply), waived cover fee for admission to Brava nightclub, and discounted Green Fees at Wyndham Grand Rio Mar Golf Course.

place_name: Margaritaville Vacation Club by Wyndham - Rio Mar
resort_details: At Wyndham Rio Mar Resort you will find 10 restaurants, a 1-mile stretch of beach, 13 tennis courts, and a fitness center. Other facilities offered at the resort include 2 golf courses, a shared lounge, and laundry facilities. Guests can enjoy a variety of water sports, dance lessons, and seasonal activities.

room_details.room_Description: The spacious air-conditioned units at Wyndham Rio Mar are comfortably furnished, ensuring a stay will be a pleasant one. For convenience, each unit is equipped with a full or mini-kitchen. With the relaxing decor, these bright and airy rooms make a perfect home base. Guest rooms range in size, from studios to three-bedroom units, and can accommodate two to ten guests.

place_name: Park Royal Homestay Club Cala Puerto Rico
resort_details: This European Plan hotel is perfect for long-term stays in Palmas del Mar Humacao, a colonial city on Puerto Rico's East coast. It has 104 villa-style rooms that are well-appointed with a living & dining room, fully-equipped kitchen, washer and dryer, all surrounded by beautiful gardens. Enjoy fresh tropical cocktails at the pool bar and find everything you need in the Royal Mart, from convenience items, to light breakfasts, wine, and fresh local coffee. An oasis in the middle of two famous golf courses, the hotel is the ideal starting point for discovering Puerto Rico’s natural treasures, such as El Yunque National Forest, Humacao Nature Reserve, and Fajardo Bioluminescent Bay. The hotel has two pool. A fitness center, spa, beach club, tennis court, golf course, and fishing are available at additional cost. Our hotels have international health and safety certifications through our Safe Guest Program®, ensuring a safe stay.

room_details.room_Description: 104 spacious suites are designed for longer stays and extended vacations. Spacious one, two and three bedroom units can include a king size bed and separate living room area with queen-sized sleeper sofas. All units are furnished with complete laundry facilities, fully equipped kitchens and offer views over the gardens, the marina or the swimming pools.

location: Puerto Rico, Gran Canaria, Canary Islands
resort_details: The Tindaya apartments are situated on the western side of Puerto Rico between the beach and the commercial shopping center. It boasts a breathtaking view of the bay and the valley. Within the apartment complex is a swimming pool, and a Mexican restaurant; there is another excellent restaurant nearby.

room_details.room_Description: The Tindaya apartments are situated on the western side of Puerto Rico between the beach and the commercial shopping center. It boasts a breathtaking view of the bay and the valley. Within the apartment complex is a swimming pool, and a Mexican restaurant; there is another excellent restaurant nearby.

resort_details: The resort is about a 5 minute walk to the renowned Eagle Beach. The resort has 362 rooms and each is a private haven of comfort and tranquility, with air conditioning, a complete kitchen, a spacious living room, and a private balcony or patio surrounding the oasis swimming pools. Step outside and take a refreshing dip while sipping your favorite beverages at the swim-up bar. Take the kiddies down the 150-foot waterslide or enjoy the plunge by yourself (you know you want to!). Drop by the Bikini’s Bar & Grill for tropical cocktails and live music or try your luck on the slots and table games at the Eagle Aruba Casino. Enjoy a variety of restaurants, snack bars, coffee shop and convenience store all on-site. This resort hosts the largest beach tennis facility in the world. There are sixteen courts at Eagle Aruba Resort & Casino, we offer league play, group & private lessons, kid’s clinics and tournaments. Tropicana customers have free usage of the courts with their stay!

room_details.room_Description: Either a 1 bedroom Standard King (KP-1) or Queen Room (DP1) offers Grand Pool and/or Garden views complement each of these large fully equipped guest suites that provides privacy with comfort. All rooms offer Flat Screen TV (2 TV’s in each suite), Wi-Fi (for a fee), complete kitchenette, with a full size fridge, microwave, built in stove, coffeemaker, roomy private balcony, commodious private bedroom, spacious living room with queen sofa bed, dining area and cozy furnishing with couples and families comfort in mind. Maximum occupancy per room is 4.

resort_details: Gold Coast Residences by Aruba Villa Rentals, located in the prestigious Malmok area on the north side of Aruba is a mix of stylish residential Town Homes, condominiums and villas with access to the Gold Coast Clubhouse, two pools and a BBQ area, providing you with the comforts of home without the crowds of a hotel.

room_details.room_Description: All of the spacious condos and town homes that we manage come fully furnished and equipped with the comfort and conveniences of home, making your time with us enjoyable whether you’re here for days, weeks or even months.

resort_details: Set on a magnificent white-sand beach and surrounded by lush landscaping, the Playa Linda Beach Resort features a number of on-site amenities for guests to enjoy. Pools, spa, tennis court, exercise and games rooms, snack bar and restaurant are all of the highest quality. The Playa Linda Beach Resort has been the recipient of several international hotel awards. The staff is committed to providing the highest level of service to all guests.

room_details.room_Description: Featuring studio, one- two- and three-bedroom units, all accommodations at the Playa Linda Beach Resort are well-appointed and designed to meet guests’ every need. All units are air conditioned and sparkling, each with phone, kitchen facilities, and microwave. For guests’ ultimate convenience, many units also include a dishwasher and washer and dryer.

place_name: Limetree Beach Resort by Club Wyndham
resort_details: Limetree Beach Resort by Club Wyndham is nestled on a secluded beach on the southern end of the island. While at this resort guests can enjoy the outdoor pool, a swim-up bar, and the beach. The resort is within driving distance of the delightful shops and restaurants at Charlotte Amalie and Havensight malls.

room_details.room_Description: All air-conditioned units offer an ocean view, a TV, phone, and internet access, and a kitchenette with a coffee maker, refrigerator, microwave, toaster oven, and 2-burner stove top, but no conventional oven. Studio Max 4/Priv 2 has a king bed and sleep sofa, all in the same room. 1BR Max 4/Priv 2 has a king bed and a sleep sofa. Must have a photo ID, credit card, and a reservation in your name to check-in. A $250 US security deposit is charged at check-in and a mandatory $22 energy fee. Contact the resort if arriving after 6pm. No charge for parking. Pets are not allowed. A restaurant and market are on-site, with more options within a 15-minute drive. A car is suggested. There is a fee for some amenities. For special needs, call in advance at 340-776-4770 or www.wyndhamvacationresorts.com.

place_name: Margaritaville Vacation Club by Wyndham - St. Thomas
resort_details: Located on Water Bay at the eastern end of St. Thomas, this beachside location is nestled in a cove with waving palm trees. It’s the perfect escape for anyone with a sense of adventure looking for music and fun or for those wanting a more laid-back experience. Grab a beach chair, kick off their flip-flops, and sip a margarita while looking out onto the white sand beach, crystal-clear waters, and the island of St. John in the distance. Live the JImmy Buffet-inspired beachside Margaritaville life. Check out the tiki-style 5 O’Clock Somewhere Bar, a cheeseburger in paradise!

room_details.room_Description: The studio suites offer one king-size bed, a partial kitchen with a microwave oven, a refrigerator, a toaster, and a coffee maker. The maximum occupancy for each unit is two people, and there is a balcony or deck in each suite. Wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected.

location: Magens Bay, St. Thomas, VI, USA
place_name: Tropic Leisure Club at Magens Point Resort
resort_details: Enjoy a quiet tropical vacation at this small, family run, secluded resort, that is situated on a on a tropical hillside overlooking the world-famous Magens Bay just a short 10 minute walk down a hill. Discover a friendly family atmosphere whether you lounge by the pool or play tennis on your choice of two courts. Amenities include a pool, bar, poolside restaurant, small convenience store, massage, fitness center, ,tennis and more. After a day of fun, relax and enjoy a glass of wine or an ice-cold rum creation at the pool bar while watching the sun set over Magens Bay.

room_details.room_Description: Air-conditioned studio units sleep up to 2 adults comfortably and 1 small child and features 1 queen bed, twin pull-out/ roll-away bed available and 1 bathroom. In addition, all units include a balcony, as well as a mini-kitchen with small fridge, 2-burner stovetop and microwave oven. Units also include a television, DVD player, telephone and safe. Internet is available for a fee. Because the units are quite small they are best suited for 2 adults.

resort_details: Our team at Club Quarters, Houston is always available to answer any questions you may have. Our fitness center is open 24 hours and includes treadmills, an elliptical trainer, an upright row station, free weights, and a Peloton® bike. Table 7 Bistro serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily artistically presented American cuisine in an upscale yet casual atmosphere with floor-to-ceiling windows and a colorful array of art.

room_details.room_Description: Our studio units are spacious and inviting with comfortable bedding, a small kitchenette, and a multipurpose work station. Our largest room type, our One bedroom Suite will feel more like your home-away-from-home with a kitchenette and a separate seating area.

resort_details: The 24-hour front desk staff greets you with a smile as you step into Club Wyndham Riverside suites. With the amenities of a condo-style resort, you'll discover an array of comforts that make you feel right at home. The 3rd-floor patio area overlooks the beautiful River Walk. Also, our professional concierge staff can assist with vacation planning needs. Discover the perfect family vacation or romantic getaway at this downtown San Antonio resort.

room_details.room_Description: Our air-conditioned studios sleep 2, one-bedrooms sleep 4, and two-bedrooms sleep 6. All units feature a mini kitchenette with a coffee maker, microwave, and refrigerator. One and two-bedroom units have a sleeper sofa, and all units have a queen bed(s), an iron & ironing board, a sitting area, a TV, a telephone, and a hairdryer.

place_name: Embassy Suites by Hilton Dallas Market Center - 3 Nights
resort_details: The Embassy Suites by Hilton Dallas Market Center is a 9-story all-suite hotel consisting of 248 suites. Hotel guests can enjoy complimentary made-to-order breakfast and complimentary light snacks and beverages at the nightly evening reception. The hotel also features an indoor temperature-controlled pool, spa, and exercise room.

room_details.room_Description: Every suite is equipped with a refrigerator, a microwave, a coffee maker, Wi-Fi, a sleeper sofa, and an additional vanity in the bedroom. Enjoy a spacious seating area.

resort_details: Within walking distance of many restaurants and shops and just a drive to a day's worth of activities, the Four Seasons is a small, boutique-style resort across from the beach on Seawall Boulevard. The Four Seasons offers a quiet respite from the day's activities. Enjoy the views from your home away from home at the Four Seasons. Spectacular Gulf sunrises are only the beginning to your day in Galveston. On-site, enjoy the resort's pool and children's playground.

room_details.room_Description: The FOUR SEASONS ON THE GULF is a boutique-style resort with 2-bedroom villas that sleep up to 6 people. All villas are their own central air and heat controller and are carpeted throughout. The villas have full kitchens which include a dishwasher and microwave. The City of Galveston enforces paid parking along the Seawall Blvd. and has other parking restrictions on adjacent streets of the resort. All resort guests must have assigned parking tags visible and on display for up to two vehicles. Additional vehicles are subject to availability on a space basis and require additional fees. The resort does not have a guest laundry room but does offer valet laundry service for a fee. The occupancy limit is strictly enforced for 6 total, violations will be charged $100 per night.

place_name: Holiday Inn Club Vacations Holly Lake Resort
resort_details: Holiday Inn Club Vacations Holly Lake Resort offers the perfect outdoor vacation. Situated amid the famed Piney Woods of East Texas, the resort has its own lake and offers a variety of water activities, such as boating, swimming, and fishing. Enjoy one of three pools, a playground for the kids, golf, tennis, or hiking. There is a snack bar and game room, and some of the most beautiful land to take a walk in East Texas. There is always plenty to do or the option to just relax.

room_details.room_Description: Holiday Inn Club Vacations Holly Lake Resort offers spacious and comfortable condos, great for families with kids or couples. The bedrooms are roomy and all units have a full kitchen and plenty of living space. The couches and chairs are soft & inviting, and you can kick back and relax after a fun day vacationing. The exterior design is rustic to blend with the area and the interior is pleasant and well-kept. Window views are lovely year-round, and the resort is kept secure for your peace of mind.

place_name: Holiday Inn Club Vacations Piney Shores Resort
resort_details: Holiday Inn Club Vacations Piney Shores Resort features rustic log cabins with a backdrop of wooded serenity, offering peaceful relaxation. Lake Conroe boasts a wide variety of water sports, including fishing (native game fish are black bass, catfish, and crappie), skiing, sailing, swimming, and boating. Covered boat slips & a launch ramp are on-site. When you're not on the water, enjoy the game room, movie theatre, video rentals, tennis, miniature golf, shuffleboard, volleyball, basketball, or horseback riding. The lake, outdoor pool, and other resort amenities are about five blocks from the units.

room_details.room_Description: Spacious and comfortable units at Holiday Inn Club Vacations Piney Shores Resort include studios, and one and two-bedroom suites that accommodate up to 6 guests. All units feature kitchen facilities with dishwasher and microwave, air-conditioning, telephone, and all the comforts and conveniences you'd expect. Some units have a fireplace and a washer & dryer.

place_name: Holiday Inn Club Vacations Villages Resort
resort_details: Imagine a fun-filled, family resort that offers everything from a peaceful pontoon boat excursion to an all-season indoor water park. Holiday Inn Club Vacations Villages Resort, on the shores of Lake Palestine, offers visitors an abundance of fun activities and indulgent pleasures. The marina offers watercraft rentals, boat slips, and launch ramps. The resort features 4 swimming pools, 2 hot tubs, a sauna, a snack bar, lighted tennis courts, volleyball, mini golf, basketball, horseback riding (additional fees apply), and more. The activity center has pool tables, a video arcade, a movie theater, and exercise equipment. At the Villages Resort, you will always find something to do, whether it's renting a movie, or for a fee, enjoying the on-site 19,000 square-foot indoor water park. The resort offers laundry facilities, barbecue & picnic areas, a country store, and limited wifi access.

room_details.room_Description: Relax in a comfortable studio or villa surrounded by country charm at Holiday Inn Club Vacations Villages. Choose a studio for 2 people, or a one, two, or three-bedroom villa that can accommodate 4 to 8 guests. You’ll love the spacious living room, fully equipped kitchen, and dining table. A washer & dryer is included in some villas and free laundry facilities are available onsite. Wifi and parking are also complimentary.

place_name: Holiday Inn Riverwalk San Antonio - 3 Nights
resort_details: The Holiday Inn Riverwalk is a contemporary 313-room, 23-story high-rise hotel located in downtown San Antonio directly on the romantic Riverwalk. This full-service hotel features Windows on the River Restaurant and Lounge overlooking the Riverwalk. The hotel is complete with an outdoor pool and spa, fitness center, laundry service, and Muggs Cafe. The hotel offers complimentary WiFi and a business office. The hotel has a parking garage to accommodate valet and self-parking. Located directly on the banks of the Riverwalk which is lined with colorful shops and the best cuisine.

room_details.room_Description: Dream better in one king, two queens, or two double plush beds (depending on unit confirmed) with soothing triple sheet bedding. Our guest rooms offer comfort along with stylish amenities. From perks like free high-speed Internet access and a 49-inch, flat panel HDTV to a large, well-lit work area with a comfortable chair, you'll have everything you need for a comfortable stay.

place_name: Hotel Trinity Innsuites Fort Worth - DFW Hotel & Suites
resort_details: Hotel Trinity Innsuites Fort Worth - DFW Hotel & Suites

room_details.room_Description: The vibrant downtown area, including Sundance Square with shopping and many popular restaurants, are just 1.5 miles from the hotel.

resort_details: Set in the "antique capital of Texas," Inverness at New Braunfels provides first class accommodations for your vacation. Water sports can be enjoyed at any of several lakes in the area, with fishing as near as the spring-fed river bordering the resort. Back on land, golf and tennis can be enjoyed within a mile of the resort. The rich German heritage of New Braunfels makes it a most interesting town to explore, but its close proximity to San Antonio and Austin provides a great sightseeing base. The resort has no onsite office.You must call the resort one week prior to check-in to get your key code at 830/609-8196.

Inverness at South Padre is a 11-story high-rise resort featuring an outdoor pool and a hot tub on the third level. Other on-site amenities include a beautiful beach and excellent fishing. Laundry facilities are also on site. Water sports and miles of beach make Inverness at South Padre a year-round destination. Only five miles away is a marina that provides boat rentals, ramps, and slips. The fishing is excellent year-round, with daily deep-sea charters. Golf, tennis, horseback riding, and shuffleboard are also popular. Nearby Water Slide Park is fun for the entire family.

room_details.room_Description: Air-conditioned 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments are available. All units are light, airy, and comfortably furnished. All have fully equipped kitchens with microwaves and dishwashers. Living areas feature cable TV and phones. Each has a large private balcony with a panoramic view of the Gulf.

resort_details: LUXURY IN THE HEART OF THE TEXAS HILL COUNTRY! Situated atop one of the highest points in all of San Antonio, you’ll find La Cantera Resort & Spa. It’s a place where you can Relax, Revel and Radiate. Where emerald fairways and sparkling pools are the only things interrupting the scenic vistas overlooking the Texas Hill Country. La Cantera Resort & Spa is a Hill Country oasis featuring two world-class golf courses, five sparkling new pools, luxurious cabañas, a state of the art fitness center, a destination spa, and more. Additionally, the resort is centrally located – only 20 minutes from the San Antonio International Airport

place_name: Moody Gardens Hotel, Spa & Convention Center
resort_details: **As a special offer, RCI members receive a 20% off discount on all spa services if traveling by December 31, 2024. Nestled amongst the lush palm trees and tropical gardens, this unique island resort hotel offers the iconic Moody Gardens pyramids with a variety of world-class attractions and the Moody Gardens Golf Course to make your island getaway one to be remembered. Moody Gardens Hotel is nestled steps away from local attractions including the beautiful Moody Gardens and the fun-filled Galveston Schlitterbahn Waterpark. Leisure amenities at the Moody Gardens Convention Center include a full-service spa, a water park and indoor and outdoor swimming pools. Guests of the Moody Gardens Hotel and Spa can indulge in delicious dishes in 4 wonderfully-decorated restaurants.

room_details.room_Description: A spacious 500 square foot guestroom with a view overlooking the resident of Galveston and Schlitterbahn, Indulgent amenities like plush bathrobes, lighted vanities, full length mirrors, extra pillows and sheets, mini refrigerators, Hamilton Beach Single Serve K-Cup Coffeemaker, two, two-line telephones, complimentary WIFI and in-room safes. Handicap Accessible Available in this view.

resort_details: Fishermen's Village Waterfront Mall Resort & Marina in Punta Gorda is the most pleasant waterside vacation complex in Southwest Florida. It's dfficult to find a better vacation value. It features wonderful shopping, fine dining, a day spa, relaxing harbor cruises, exciting live entertainment, adventurous fishing charters, and boat rentals. Units have stunning views of inviting Charlotte Harbor. There are also tennis courts, a heated pool, bicycles, cable TV, and laundry facilities available on-site. Fisherman's Village is located only 24 miles and a short drive north of Fort Myers.

room_details.room_Description: All the 2-bedroom units at Fishermen's Village Waterfront Mall Resort & Marina in Punta sleep up to 6 people. They feature a telephone a kitchen, air conditioning, carpet, a dishwasher, and a microwave. Other general amenities for all the units include boating, fishing, pool, tennis, a games room, live entertainment, an elevator, a hairdresser, a laundry, a restaurant, a snack bar, shopping, and conference facilities.

resort_details: Enjoy the view of the pools or the docks from your terrace. When not exploring Corpus Christi, combing the beach, or heading to Padre Island, relax at your vacation home at Puente Vista. The resort has an on-site outdoor pool for when you prefer to lounge poolside instead of on the beach. The on-site boat dock also provides fishing opportunities. A grocery store is just a five minute drive away and there is a convenience store nearby. On-site laundry facilities are also provided.

room_details.room_Description: Puente Vista has two- and three-bedroom units that sleep 6 to 8 guests accordingly. The simply appointed, air-conditioned units are carpeted and include a full kitchen with dishwasher and microwave, and telephone service.

resort_details: The best location Peninsula Island Resort & Spa is at the end of the Queen Isabella Bridge and in the most secluded section of the island and the beach. Each furnished condo has a 24-hour concierge service to meet all your needs. Well-equipped kitchens in each condo, patio, and amenities such as: * Restaurant, oceanfront meals at Las Olas Restaurant Grill and Bar * SPA, Aveda Exclusive Spa * GYM fitness center, Beachfront development, with private and secure access.

room_details.room_Description: STUDIO: Two full sized beds or one king-sized bed, comfortable Leather Sofa Bed (full*), fully furnished, kitchenette(dining for four), 25" TV, Bathroom, bath tub,safety box, balcony. LUXURY:Two Bedroom Condo, Master bedroom w/King-sized bed, 25" TV, private bathroom with hot tub bathtub, hair dryer, safe box. Second Bedroom w/Two full sized beds, 25" TV, Bathroom. THREE Bedroom Condo: Master bedroom W/King-sized bed, 25" LCD TV ,Private bathroom with oversized hot tub bathtub, hair dryer, safe box. Two Bedrooms w/two full sized beds, 25" LCD TV. place_name: Peregrine Townhomes at San Luis Pass
resort_details: Enjoy the beachside pool, volleyball, horseshoes, and surf and bay fishing with bait shops nearby.

Galveston, a city steeped in Texas history is home to San Luis Condominiums. The resort's free-form pool, the perfect setting for sunning and swimming, boasts a Polynesian-style, swim-up bar. On the beach, the resort offers everything from sailing to horseback riding, or enjoy the use of the on-site tennis court.

From game fishing in the Laguna Madre and sport fishing in the deep waters of the Gulf to shopping in Mexico's mercados and island specialty shops, Seascape Condominiums offers family-style entertainment day and night. After an action-packed day that might include exciting water sports and tasty restaurants, relax in the resort's hot tub and chat with locals about what you'll want to do tomorrow.

room_details.room_Description: All units are two-bedroom, two baths with fully equipped kitchens and a washer/dryer. Linens, bedding and utensils are provided. Maximum occupnacy is 4 to 6 guests and there are no pets allowed. The complex consists of two 3-story buildings separated by a courtyard. The courtyard includes a large pool, hot tub and children's pool.

place_name: Sonesta Suites Dallas Park Central - 3 Nights
resort_details: Conveniently situated in the heart of the North Dallas Park Central Business District—and only minutes from Restaurant Row—the Sonesta Suites Dallas Park Central is the ideal location for business travelers, shoppers, vacationers, and families. We pride ourselves on pampering you with amenities that calm the body and soothe the soul. Take a dip in our sparkling indoor-outdoor pool, enjoy a relaxing soak in our therapeutic hot tub and stay fit in our fully equipped fitness center. Plan to spend the day exploring the area’s world-renowned museums, art galleries, and retail shops. You'll appreciate countless roads to comfort, convenience, and productivity—it’s your haven when staying in Dallas.

place_name: Bluegreen Wilderness Club at Big Cedar
resort_details: Bluegreen Wilderness Club at Big CedarÂ captures the essence of Table Rock Lake's tranquil setting and the natural beauty of the Ozarks. Overlooking the lake, the resort's architecture was inspired by the grand wilderness lodges of the Adirondacks. Guests can indulge in a luxurious spa, four fabulous restaurants, and amenities as spectacular as the great outdoors. The resort's most unique attribute is its Lazy River water feature, complete with caves, rock grottos, waterfall, and giant water slide. Kids will also enjoy the playground, rock climbing wall, and game room. Guests can enjoy all the amenities at the adjacent Big Cedar Lodge, including the riding stables, marina, fitness center, heated pools, spa, a Jack Nicklaus signature golf course, water sports, fishing, and hiking trails. For your convenience, the resort provides a concierge, laundry facilities, barbeque grills, internet access, grocery store, and business center.

room_details.room_Description: Mountain retreat meets modern amenities in Bluegreen Wilderness Club's comfortable log cabins and lodge units, all with a view of the lake or woods. Each unit has been thoughtfully decorated to reflect the homespun style of the Ozarks. Choose a studio that sleeps 4 people, or a one-, two-, or three-bedroom unit that can accommodate 4 to 8 people. Each spacious cabin has vaulted ceilings, a fireplace, hot tub bath, area rugs,Â and a 350-square-foot deck with gas grill. Lodge units feature wood-plankÂ floors,Â spa-sized tubs (except in studios), patios, hickory sapling furniture, and mountings of trophy bucks and game birds. Some also include aÂ cozy fireplace with a split log mantle. All units feature telephone, television, full kitchen or kitchenette, air conditioning, and dishwasher. Some also feature a washer and dryer.

place_name: Holiday Inn Club Vacations Smoky Mountain Resort
resort_details: Enjoy the amazing scenery and plush accommodations at the Holiday Inn® Club Vacations-Smoky Mountain Resort. Located in Gatlinburg, Tennessee, and nestled in the foothills of the breathtaking Great Smoky National Park, the resort is the perfect setting for an outdoor family vacation or romantic getaway. The property offers guests spacious, lodge-inspired accommodations equipped with all the comforts of home, and the amenities help to make every stay an enjoyable & memorable one. Upon entering the lobby, guests will be impressed by the resort's rustic, mountain charm and the splendid landscape blends perfectly with the surrounding nature. Enjoy the indoor and outdoor pools, a hot tub, and a state-of-the-art fitness center.

room_details.room_Description: Holiday Inn® Club Vacations-Smoky Mountain Resort features spacious one, two, and three-bedroom accommodations. All units are air-conditioned, have a fireplace, washer & dryer, and are equipped with a full kitchen, including a dishwasher. One-bedroom units sleep up to 4 people, two-bedroom units sleep up to 6 people, and three-bedroom units accommodate up to 10 guests.

resort_details: Warm, friendly Southern spirit combined with plenty of entertainment at Wyndham Smoky Mountains, makes it a great location for all occasions. Guests enjoy year-round swimming in the resort's indoor and outdoor swimming pools and hot tubs. There's also an outdoor children's pool and "spray ground" with fountains, water buckets, and cannons. We also provide a fitness center, sauna, miniature golf, playground, and picnic & BBQ areas. Daily activities are scheduled for kids and adults, and there's live entertainment in the evening. A credit card security deposit is required at check-in. The resort is cashless and only accepts payment using a debit or credit card.

room_details.room_Description: At Club Wyndham Smoky Mountains, our air-conditioned one, two, and three-bedroom condos comfortably sleep four to eight guests and range from 558 to 1,532 square feet. Our condos feature private rooms with one king bed in the main bedroom, two double beds or a king bed if you have an additional bedroom and a queen sleeper sofa in the living area. You will appreciate the economy of a mini or full kitchen and the convenience of a washer & dryer in each suite. Most units have a balcony & Whirlpool tub, and each has a separate living/dining area and TVs throughout. Enjoy panoramic views of the Great Smoky Mountains. Pets are not allowed, and units are non-smoking.

resort_details: At a 2200-foot elevation, Mountainloft Resort II affords you sweeping views of the Smoky Mountains. Here outdoor adventures abound, whether you spend your days skiing, rafting or hiking mountain trails. You can find plenty of indoor fun too, whether it's keeping up your fitness routine at the fitness center, or having fun with your kids at the Kids' Club and game room. After a full day of fun and adventure, treat yourself to a soak in the outdoor hot tubs, a dip in the heated pools, or a relaxing sauna or massage. Attractions include: Dollywood, Splash Country, Ripley's Museum, Ripley's Aquarium and Great Smoky Mountains National Park.

room_details.room_Description: The rich, earthy colors and traditional American furnishings within each villa or chalet will make you feel right at home. Catch a glimpse of deer or a black bear from your balcony or patio. Warm up after a day on the slopes in front of the fireplace or in your hot tub. All two bedroom villas have a balcony, fully-equipped kitchen, washer/dryer and hot tub bath. Some one bedroom units have a balcony, full kitchen, washer/dryer and hot tub bath. Please contact the property 7 days or less prior to arrival with special requests.

place_name: Hilton Grand Vacations Club at Trump International Hotel Las Vegas
resort_details: Find yourself in the lap of luxury with a decadent array of indulgent amenities to satisfy even the most discerning taste. Treat yourself to an air-conditioned cabana on the sky-high pool deck, fine dining at the Michelin Star DJT restaurant, cocktails at the H2 (EAU) poolside bar, and a range of soothing treatments at the spa.

room_details.room_Description: Our accommodations include studios, plus one and two-bedroom suites. All units feature a hot tub. Studios feature kitchenettes, and the larger units offer fully equipped kitchens. All suites offer internet access.

place_name: Elara, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club
resort_details: We are connected to shopping, dining, and entertainment at Miracle Mile Mall, with access to Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino. The Eiffel Tower Experience and Madame Tussauds Las Vegas are within a mile. Enjoy our fitness center and seasonal outdoor pool.

room_details.room_Description: At Elara, we offer luxurious studios, plus one, two, three, and four-bedroom suites. Studios and one-bedroom suites feature kitchenettes, and larger suites include full kitchens. All units feature complimentary high-speed, wireless internet access.

resort_details: Less than two km. from the Las Vegas Strip, Wyndham Grand Desert Resort offers outstanding accommodations to enjoy in between casino hopping. Pamper yourself in the hot tub, followed by a quick stop in the sauna. Spend the afternoon lounging by the outdoor pool while the younger ones will have a blast playing in the children's pool, or getting competitive in the games room. The resort provides shuttle transportation from the resort to Harrah's Casino on The Strip.

room_details.room_Description: Wyndham Grand Desert units are air-conditioned, with a partial or full kitchen, a TV & DVD, a stereo with a CD player, and a washer and dryer. Units are non-smoking. Call in advance to discuss special needs, however, handicap-accessible units may not be an option. Pool towels are provided, and wireless internet is available. Pets are not allowed. There is no daily or mid-week cleaning offered.

resort_details: A Premier Playground for All Ages. Combine the convenience and stature of an urban luxury hotel with all the space and amenities of an elite resort, and then set it down in the heart of one of the world’s most dynamic destinations. The end result would be Wyndham Desert Blue, a striking resort with comfort and fun built right in. With an ideal location just off the world-famous strip, it’s the perfect place to stay while you create your own brand of fun in the glitz and glamour that is Las Vegas.

room_details.room_Description: Wyndham Desert Blue offers spacious air-conditioned units with a large-screen TV in the living room. Studio units sleep up to four and feature a partial kitchen with a mini refrigerator and microwave, one bath, and various bed structures. The one-bedroom units that sleep up to four have a full kitchen, a bath, a king-size bed, and a sleep sofa. Units also offer wireless internet.

resort_details: Back in 1985 it was decided by the owners to allocate their ancestral (old winery) to the visitors of Santorini island. The building dates from 1547 (labelled traditional) and is consisted of fully equipped houses. The traditional styled houses are carved into the rocks allowing the quest to feel the vibes and the energy of Santorini island. The owners’ aim is not to offer luxury but in a rural environment, giving the opportunity to the guests to live for a few days at the places, where their ancestors lived. All houses have a view of the vineyards and the sea. The complex is located in the village of Vourvoulos 1,5 km from the beach and 2,5 km from Fira. In Vourvoulos guests may enjoy the Greek hospitality in the traditional tavernas and taste the delicious local dishes and selected wines. Spending your holidays in Santorini Villas will give you the opportunity to experience the exceptional services and chance to explore the mystique island

This chic Portifino hotel features a range of stylish room options that will accommodate two to five people, while beyond the fully furnished, modern accommodation there are beautifully manicured gardens, a restaurant and bar, sun terrace and even a babysitting service. Meanwhile the upmarket centre of Portofino is just a ten-minute walk from the resort and you're just a four-minute stroll from the beach. You'll also find golfing and a myriad of watersports close by.

room_details.room_Description: One of only three hotels actually in Portofino, the Piccolo has a limited number of suites for three or four persons with no kitchen facilities.

place_name: Club Wyndham Kauai Coast Resort at the Beachboy - 3 Nights
resort_details: Surrounded by swaying coconut palms and fragrant plumeria blossoms, Kauai Coast Resort at the Beachboy is ideal for family vacations, romantic escapes, and relaxing getaways. This Kauai resort is situated on eight beautiful acres and features a swimming pool with natural rock formation waterscapes, a children's pool, an oceanside hot tub plus extensive landscaping, and a cascading water feature at the main entrance.

room_details.room_Description: Choose from studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom accommodations, all decorated with red, gold, and green fabrics, carpeted floors, and island-style accents. The buildings are three stories with NO elevators. If you have special needs please call the resort 2-4 weeks prior to arrival to request a first-floor unit (not guaranteed). Studio units have a compact refrigerator, microwave, and coffeemaker. One-bedroom and two-bedroom units have a fully-equipped kitchen with a refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave.

resort_details: Wyndham Shearwater is perched on a bluff overlooking pristine Anini Bay with spectacular views, meticulous garden pleasures, and an impeccable standard of service. The cliffside pool and spa are sensory delights, and the resort's elegant clubhouse inspires shared fun with friends old and new. The beach is close by, or you can swim in the on-site outdoor pool. Area activities are abundant and include horseback riding, fishing, surfing, snorkeling, and sailing. Golfers will find a golf course just blocks away.

room_details.room_Description: All units have a fully-equipped gourmet kitchen, including high-end appliances such as a microwave oven, blender, dishwasher, toaster, and coffee maker. Every unit has 3 TVs, a stereo system, a DVD player, a washer and dryer, a phone, and a therapeutic jetted tub. The units are not air-conditioned. The resort has two or three floors and NO elevators. As per the law, the resort must charge a State Transient Occupancy Tax, which may be subject to change without notice. The resort cannot guarantee specific unit views or locations, even if they are listed on your reservation. Please contact the resort at (808) 826-6549 for any questions. RCI has on-site staff at the Ka'Eo Kai main office, and walk-ins are welcome.

place_name: Club Wyndham Waikiki Marina Resort at the Ilikai - 3 Nights
resort_details: This resort in Waikiki has hosted United States Presidents, celebrities, and international guests, offering studio units with private lanais. It provides various amenities, such as a sparkling swimming pool, an on-site restaurant with international cuisine, and complimentary internet access. Valet parking is available for a fee. During your stay, there are several activities to enjoy, such as live Hawaiian music in the courtyard, fireworks on the beach every Friday night, and daily torch-lighting ceremonies. Bell service is available through a third-party company for a fee.

room_details.room_Description: Each air-conditioned unit accommodates up to four guests and is equipped with a fully functional kitchen. The accommodations feature either a king-sized bed or two full-sized beds, with a queen-sized sleeper sofa. Your kitchen has a refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave, and coffeemaker. You can relax on the lanai or balcony with city views. If you're arriving after 10pm, please contact the resort in advance to make arrangements to get your keys. All units are non-smoking, and pets are not allowed.

place_name: Grand Waikikian, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club
resort_details: Towering over the world-famous Hilton Hawaiian Village Beach Resort & Spa, the Grand Waikikian offers the very best Oahu vacations. Spectacular views abound, and the ambiance and service rival a grand hotel. Guests enjoy all the comforts & convenience of a luxury condominium home. This 39-story tower heralds a new era of elegance in the oceanfront paradise of Waikiki, a destination of romance, dreams, cultures, and cuisines. The extraordinary Grand Waikikian is further enhanced by the surrounding grandeur of Hilton Hawaiian Village, renowned for its signature luau celebrations, Catamaran sailing trips, spectacular shopping, and an array of dining experiences.

room_details.room_Description: The Grand Waikikian offers beautiful grounds and luxurious accommodations. All units feature a private balcony with fantastic views. The resort is perfect for vacationing families or couples enjoying a getaway. Relax in spacious, air-conditioned comfort with one-bedroom units that sleep up to 4 guests and 2-bedroom units that sleep up to 6. All accommodations come with full kitchens that include a microwave, dishwasher, and washer & dryer.

resort_details: Hanalei Bay Resort is a tropical Shangri-La with lush gardens, lava rock waterfalls, and an award-winning pool. A scenic path leads to the resort’s private beach for guests to enjoy the breathtaking bay view. Guests have full access to all amenities including 2 swimming pools, 8 tennis courts, bell & shuttle service, a front desk, and more. The Happy Talk lounge has a tropical atmosphere for guests to enjoy food, and live music on-site.

room_details.room_Description: We feature one and two-bedroom condo suites, each with spectacular views. All units are beautifully decorated in a variety of styles and designs. Unit features include a fully-equipped kitchen, and some have a washer & dryer. Come join us for a fun family vacation, a relaxing get-a-way escape, or a romantic Kauai honeymoon retreat. We'll help make your Hawaii vacations worth remembering! Units are non-smoking and pets are not allowed.

resort_details: The Ka’anapali Beach Club is located on the north shore of Maui's world-famous Ka'anapali Beach in Hawaii. Guests will find themselves in a vacation paradise courtesy of the resort's prime waterfront location, vibrant tropical landscaping, first-rate amenities, posh accommodations, and exclusive array of leisure activities. The property boasts a one-acre swimming pool with separate kids pool, as well as calming outdoor hot tubs. Guests can also make use of the amenities in the games room and spa, as well as participate in daily resort activities such as yoga, fishing, snorkeling and scuba diving, just to name a few. The property also conveniently has massage services, a modern fitness center, shops, poolside bar, barbecue grills, snack bars and even a hair salon on site. The Ka’anapali Beach Club likewise has a variety of on-site dining choices and within minutes are five championship golf courses, tennis facilities, and famous retail shops.

room_details.room_Description: Ka'anapali Beach Club features spacious one-, and two- bedroom accommodations. These tastefully-appointed units are all air-conditioned and are equipped with limited kitchens. One-bedroom units sleep 4 people; and two-bedrooms accommodate 6 guests.

place_name: Hokulani Waikiki, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club
resort_details: Anchoring the southmost stretch of Waikiki Beach Walk® entertainment district, Hokulani Waikiki, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club offers ideal access to Waikiki's most vibrant showcase for dining, shopping, and entertainment. Just a brief walk from the famed beaches of Waikiki and the nearby Hilton Hawaiian Village Waikiki Beach Resort®, this unique property also features Na Lani Sky Lounge – an exclusive rooftop deck with pool lounge, bar, private cabanas, and dynamic views of Waikiki.

room_details.room_Description: Anchoring the southmost stretch of Waikiki Beach Walk® entertainment district, Hokulani Waikiki, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club offers ideal access to Waikiki's most vibrant showcase for dining, shopping, and entertainment. Just a brief walk from the famed beaches of Waikiki and the nearby Hilton Hawaiian Village Waikiki Beach Resort®, this unique property also features Na Lani Sky Lounge – an exclusive rooftop deck with pool lounge, bar, private cabanas, and dynamic views of Waikiki.

place_name: Kings’ Land, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club
resort_details: Kings’ Land, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club, on the famed Kohala coast, offers fairway views and stunning big island panoramas. Carved from an ancient lava field, this 112-acre oasis has a superb location between two of Hawaii's finest golf courses, the King's Course and the Beach Course. While at the resort guests can also enjoy access to the restaurants, boutiques, beaches, and water recreation at the nearby Hilton Waikoloa Village Resort. In this spectacular region of Hawaii, perpetually sunny skies, dramatic vistas, and world-class amenities combine to create one of the most desirable vacation destinations.

room_details.room_Description: Kings' Land, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club, offers spacious suites with private lanais. Each suite features a washer & dryer and complimentary high-speed, wireless internet access. The two-bedroom suites offer fully equipped kitchens, and some one-bedroom suites offer partial kitchens with a two-burner stove top, a dishwasher, a full-size refrigerator, and a microwave.

place_name: Kohala Suites, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club
resort_details: Kohala Suites, a Hilton Grand Vacations property, have an elegant tropical style with distinctive amenities and furnishings. With our free shuttle, Hilton Waikoloa Village is only a mile away, and you have access to its amenities and restaurants. The Waikoloa Kings' and Waikoloa Beach golf courses are within one mile. On-site a putting course, an outdoor pool & bar, barbeque grills, and a grocery delivery service are provided.

room_details.room_Description: Our spacious two-bedroom suites have two baths and a private lanais. Each guest suite features a fully-equipped kitchen, a washer & dryer, complimentary high-speed internet access, and air-conditioning. Parking is free on-site. Units are non-smoking.

resort_details: Come to the Big Island of Hawaii, home to beautiful, sun-drenched beaches, verdant hills and the Kona Coast Resort Phase II. You will have access to all the island has to offer, including deep-sea fishing, scuba diving, cruises and excellent shopping. Cool off in one of two swimming pools or relax in one of the resort's three hot tubs. Enjoy breakfast, lunch, dinner or just relax with a cocktail at the onsite poolside restaurant, Aloha Fridays at the Pointe.

room_details.room_Description: All villas have a fully equipped kitchen, TV with Blue Ray Player, safe, washer and dryer, and microwave. Air conditioning is optional and available for an extra fee.

place_name: Lagoon Tower, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club
resort_details: Hilton Hawaiian Village® Waikiki Beach Resort in Honolulu provides visitors with spectacular amenities and an unrivaled position in the heart of paradise. Lagoon Tower, a Hilton Grand Vacations Club, gives guests ideal access to Waikiki’s famous white-sand beach and the extensive entertainment, shopping, and dining options within the renowned Hilton Hawaiian Village. A 5,000-square-foot family activity pool features the longest slide in Waikiki and overlooks the landmark Duke Kahanamoku Lagoon. Just beyond the Village, a variety of adventures awaits your discovery, including scuba diving, snorkeling, golf, hiking trails and abundant cultural riches.

room_details.room_Description: Spacious studios, one, two, and three-bedroom suites offer the convenience of a kitchenette or fully equipped kitchen. Most have a balcony so you can enjoy the beautiful island views.

resort_details: Boasting a fantastic location on Poipu, Lawai Beach Resort is just steps from one of Kauai's best beaches for snorkeling, surfing, and whale-watching. The property features roomy, well-equipped accommodations, three swimming pools, hot tubs, various picnic areas with barbecue grills and elevator access. If not enjoying themselves on the beach or engaging in water recreational activities, guests can use on-site facilities like tennis courts, 18-hole miniature golf course and a recreation room with pool tables, arcade games and a modern fitness center. The resort also offers thoughtful amenities like a convenience store, snack bar, library and an activity desk to help plan and book activities inside the property and Kauai's south shore. A variety of dining options, shops and live entertainment can be found nearby. On top of its location and beautiful scenery, Lawai Beach Resort prides itself on the friendliness of its staff and topnotch guest satisfaction.

Getting around is easy thanks to local and airport shuttles, a hotel vehicle, and on-site car rental. Off-site paid parking. After a busy day of business or sightseeing, relax in a non-smoking guest room featuring a balcony, flat-screen HDTV with cable

room_details.room_Description: Super 8 by Wyndham Dubai Deira Explore this magnificent Middle Eastern metropolis while enjoying the dependable comforts of Super 8 by Wyndham Deira, close to metro and bus stops, and just six miles from Dubai International Airport (DXB). Located in the buzzing Deira business district, our contemporary hotel is minutes from the Dubai Cruise Terminal, Dubai Gold and Spice Souks, and Heritage Village. Take a dhow boat cruise in Deira Creek, hit the links at Dubai Creek Golf Club, or unwind at our contemporary hotel with free WiFi, a restaurant, and well-appointed guest rooms.

resort_details: Spacious & luxurious accommodations await guests who visit The Mirage at Al Habtoor Polo. Outstanding views of the manicured emerald lawns, along with flat-screen TVs, lavish furnishings and beautifully appointed bathrooms truly inspire serenity & relaxation for everyone. room_details.room_Description: Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. Other recreations include a children's play area and board games, horse riding, tennis courts, squash courts and a stunning outdoor swimming pool. All guests will enjoy the beautiful world-class horses that populate the resort's polo fields and stables.

You'll also find a bar, a café and a restaurant onsite, but the bars, restaurants, and nightspots of the town are all within walking distance. The year-round sunshine and well-situated resort make this an ideal holiday destination whether you like to relax or prefer a little more action.

The village itself is known for its unforgettable sunsets, and the resort offers prime viewing complemented with modern comforts. Comprised of 17 private villas built in the traditional Santorinian style, the resort also features amenities like a swimming pool with a pool bar, along with a spa that includes a sauna and hot tub. Guests can also enjoy a bite to eat at the onsite restaurant, which serves up a creative menu with twists on traditional Greek cuisine.

room_details.room_Description: Modernly appointed and traditionally designed, each of Laokasti Villas’ private villas offers an unforgettable holiday. resort_details: The resort offers five large swimming pools, one indoor pool, saunas, barbecue facilities, and beautiful gardens. The resort also has a leisure center with tennis courts, pool tables, a gymnasium, squash courts, and watersports.

It’s all about high energy happenings, hip and luxurious accommodations in our 169 suites, relaxing moments, fabulous food, curated cocktails served at our 4 chic lounges, and making new friends. Breathless Cabo San Lucas offers the best of both relaxation and entertainment that will captivate every guest’s senses.

All Inclusive Mexican hacienda style, with beautiful gardens, pools and 390 rooms, strategically designed horseshoe to provide easy and quick access to all areas and services of the hotel. It is located at the southern tip of the Baja California Sur peninsula at only 20 minutes from International airport, 5 minutes from historical downtown, the art district, dolphinariums and Convention Center. The property features the best in entertainment activities for all families to enjoy, including a unique mini water park and kids club for the little ones, a deluxe spa with top of the line treatments, Fine dining, spectacular nightly shows, and the best for a unique vacation a breathtaking view of the sea. Come to live a WOW experience at this Ocean Front All Inclusive Resort! location: Cabo San Lucas, Baja California Sur, Mexico
resort_details: This resort is located inside Cabo del Sol, a complex with a full range of recreational and cultural amenities including two championship golf courses, a private beach and over 28 acres of beautiful landscaped gardens. The resort features eight restaurants, four snack bars, five swimming pools, a snorkeling pool, gym and Cactus Spa. The resort offers a shuttle bus into Cabo San Lucas or its exclusive TEN Car Rental service. The resort has launched an incredible Meal Plan program that offers 12 different restaurant options a la carte, or buffet breakfast, lunch & three course a la carte or buffet dinner, snacks in the pool area, alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages.

room_details.room_Description: All accommodations at Hacienda del Mar Resort offer exclusive and stunning Mexican decor. Some rooms have a living room featuring a sofa bed, a kitchen and dining area for four to six people, and a spacious private terrace with outdoor furniture.

resort_details: Set within some 670 acres of lushly landscaped gardens, WorldMark Denarau Island Resort offers luxury and comfort with tropical flair. On site amenities at this fabulous resort include one of the largest swimming pools in the South Pacific, with a swim-up bar with wet and dry seating, restaurant, and wide variety of water sports and fun family activities. There's also an 18-hole international standard golf course, port and marina, gym, outdoor spa, children's pool, kid's club, massage center, and barbecue areas.

room_details.room_Description: Relax in lovely, spacious, air-conditioned apartments with wifi access, a private balcony, ceiling fans, satellite TV with DVD, stereo with CD player, hairdryer, and fully equipped kitchen, including microwave and dishwasher, as well as washer and dryer. Even expect extra's like a blender and mixer. Choose from one-, two-, or three-bedroom apartments. The one-bedroom units sleep 4; the two-bedrooms sleep 6, and the three-bedrooms accommodate 8.

resort_details: Fiji Palms' excellent location on the beach and in Pacific Harbor is a great advantage to vacationing here if you're visiting the Fiji Islands. The resort is also just 50 km (32 miles) from Suva, Fiji's capital where you can explore the picturesque waterways, enjoy the native markets and dine at delicious, but inexpensive restaurants. Just sit on the gorgeous beach and you'll know you're in paradise. Go for a dip in the pool with incredible scenery of Fiji as your backdrop.

room_details.room_Description: All units at the Fiji Palms are two-bedroom and sleep 6. The resort exudes old world charm. The units have air conditioning in the bedrooms only and a washer/dryer and a dishwasher in every unit. There's even a microwave so you can warm up local delicacies you couldn't finish earlier. If you've brave enough, and you should be since you're in Fiji, why not try cooking a meal Fiji-style in your kitchen? Having all the comforts at home will make you feel at home in this comfortable tropical paradise.

resort_details: TradeWinds offers you the unique experience of exploring the beautiful sailing areas of this exotic destination. Live onboard a catamaran for a week, and visit different islands, with your days ending with cocktails and dinner in quiet secluded bays where the yacht will moor overnight. Fijian waters are rich with sea life, and with over thirty five islands to choose from we will literally “go with the flow”. You and your shipmates will have this magical environment virtually to yourselves! Our cruise in this fantastic destination takes you through parts of the beautiful and timeless Mamanuca and Yasawa island chains.

room_details.room_Description: The resort will send incoming guests a welcome letter, asking essential questions about dietary requirements and requesting exact flight arrival details. This is a sailing vacation on a wonderful yacht, hence a certain degree of agility is necessary to be able to move around the yacht as well as into the rubber dinghy. Five guest cabins, each with an ensuite private bathroom and shower. Ten guests in total with two professional crew members. Snorkel gear is provided free of charge. Scuba diving is available to certified divers, at USD $100 per person per dive including all gears. Bath and beach towels are provided. Food served on board is healthy, fresh, and fresh fruit is available between meals. This resort requires a mandatory all-inclusive fee that covers meals, drinks (including open bar), resort amenities, services, and facilities and is required to be prepaid before arrival or at check-in. Fees are determined by the resort and are subject to change at any time.

place_name: Waldorf Astoria Orlando - An Official Walt Disney World Hotel
resort_details:
This Official Walt Disney World® Hotel is located on a 482-acre nature preserve, adjacent to the theme parks. Guests staying at Waldorf Astoria Orlando - An Official Walt Disney World Hotel can take advantage of 30-minute early entry, and free transportation to and from Disney parks. The resort boasts an 18-hole golf course, and full-service spa.

A 55 -inch flat-screen TV comes standard in each bedroom at the Waldorf Astoria Orlando - An Official Walt Disney World Hotel. Other amenities include a marble soaking tub, separate shower, and luxury Aesop toiletries. A mini-bar and an electronic safe suitable for laptops are included.

Waldorf Astoria Orlando - An Official Walt Disney World Hotel features a kids' club, 2 swimming pools, a jacuzzi, and private cabanas. The Waldorf Astoria Spa offers massages, facials, Himalayan Salt therapies and salon services. The on-site golf club features 18 custom-designed holes.

Dining is available at 11 on-site restaurants, and the hotel offers in-room dining. Options include an elegant lobby bar and an award-winning steakhouse.

Universal Studios and SeaWorld theme parks are within 20 minutes' drive of the Waldorf Astoria in Orlando. Orlando Premium Outlets are 11.9 km away, and the Orange County Convention Center is 17 km away.

Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.2 for a two-person trip.

resort_details: Imagine a hotel that not only delivers the magic of Disney, but enhances it, and without breaking the bank. A place where, every morning, a free, hot breakfast prepares you for an unforgettable Disney day. A place where hot, dinnertime snacks and cold beverages await your return to comfortably refresh and ready you for what tomorrow may bring. In addition to everyday free meals, this stunning new hotel offers exciting amenities for both the young and young-at-heart. Free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel keeps you connected. An on-site arcade, oversized resort-style pool and playful splashpad keep you entertained. Numerous indoor and outdoor dining options satisfy any appetite. Unmatched views of Lake Buena Vista and nightly views of fireworks from Walt Disney World® Resort keep you enchanted. And best of all, you’re conveniently located within the Disney Springs® Resort Area, just moments away from the sights, the sounds, and the sheer magical delight of Walt Disney World® Resort!

The destination pool deck with private cabanas offers a saltwater infinity pool, and a pool bar that seamlessly transitions from day to night. With a location steps from Waikiki Beach, it is where Hawaii vacations turn moments into memories.

room_details.room_Description: Our contemporary guest room design concepts were created by Rockwell Group and include stylish custom furnishings with local elements and spa-like bathrooms.
