resort_details: Wyndham Waikiki Beach Walk is part of the exciting Beach Walk Project, the resort offers the ultimate in comfort and relaxation. All units are well maintained by our helpful staff at one of the world's great vacation destinations. You and the whole family can relax by the pool, spend quiet time in the spa, exercise in the fitness center, savor a delicious meal, and enjoy shopping in the shops nearby.

room_details.room_Description: Our air-conditioned units have cable TVs, a VCR/DVD combo, a CD player, a washer and dryer, a full kitchen, and a patio or balcony. One-bedroom units for four people include a king bed, a queen sleep sofa, and a full bath. Two-bedroom units for eight guests feature a king bed, two double beds, a queen sleep sofa, and two full baths. Three-bedroom units, also for eight guests, offer two king beds, two double beds, and two baths with no sleep sofa. Four-bedroom units for ten guests come with three king beds, two double beds, a queen sleep sofa, and three full baths. Pets are not allowed. Guests with special needs are encouraged to contact the resort in advance. Smoking is not permitted at the resort.

resort_details: Wyndham Kona Hawaiian Resort in Kailua-Kona on the Big Island's West Coast, lets you step back in time to a simpler era. Units are designed with charming island ambiance found back in the '30s while providing guests with amenities and activities you expect in a modern-day tropical resort. Guests experience the best of Hawaiian local hospitality from the resort staff. The town of Kona and the beautiful beach is a short walk from our rustic but comfortable accommodations. This tropical vacation paradise features two outdoor pools, hot tubs, and a children's pool. Guests can also use the workout room, and the beautiful picnic areas and barbecue grills around the property. A credit card security deposit is charged upon arrival.

room_details.room_Description: The units at Wyndham Kona Hawaiian Resort are two-bedroom units that can accommodate up to six people. Each unit features a full kitchen with a dishwasher and microwave, a washer and dryer, internet access, cable TV, and two bathrooms. Some units are townhouse style and require stairs to access the bedrooms. The upper (A side) units have approximately 13 steps.

place_name: Club Wyndham Royal Garden at Waikiki
resort_details: Royal Garden at Waikiki offers beautiful studio units, with a variety of city views. The resort is away from Waikiki's busy streets but within walking distance of shops, dining, and other attractions. Wyndham Vacation Resort at Royal Garden at Waikiki offers a wonderful atmosphere for a romantic getaway.

room_details.room_Description: Your well-appointed air-conditioned room at Royal Garden at Waikiki has a private patio or balcony, LED TVs, and internet access. For guest convenience, our rooms have a hair dryer and an iron & ironing board. Your partial kitchen offers an under-counter refrigerator, microwave oven, sink, coffee maker, blender (upon request), and toaster. All rooms are studio units sleeping 2 people.

place_name: Hilton Garden Inn Kauai Wailua Bay
resort_details: Kauai is beloved for its warm spirit and untamed beauty. These traditions come alive at our casual beachfront hotel, the Hilton Garden Inn Kauai Wailua Bay. We invite you to our island and hotel, with our beautiful open-air lobby, comfortable guest rooms, suites, cottages, refreshing pools, and The Garden Grille.

room_details.room_Description: Our accommodations are warm, inviting, and equipped with the latest technology and ergonomic comfort for maximum convenience. Enjoy a restful night's sleep in a luxurious Suite Dreams® by Serta bed, which perfectly balances comfort and support. Work comfortably at the desk with an ergonomic Mirra chair by Herman Miller. Watch a program on the 50-inch LCD TV or surf the web with complimentary Wi-Fi access. Your room also features a mini-fridge, microwave, adjustable air-conditioning, an iron and ironing board, and a Keurig coffee system to make you feel at home. Stay connected to the office with our 24-hour business center, which provides complimentary printing, fax, and copy machines.

resort_details: This 27 floor high-rise has a pool deck and owners' lounge with panoramic views. The resort staff strives to fulfill the resort motto, "What can I do for you today?" by offering a wide array of services and amenities: an activity center in the lobby, golf club & tennis racquet rentals, beach amenities, fitness center, pool, ATM access, bellman service, check cashing, fax service, flower arrangement fulfillment, an on-site jewelry store and convenience store, self-service laundry, masseuse and valet parking.

room_details.room_Description: All units at the Imperial Hawaii Vacation Club feature air conditioning, a 37" flat panel television and DVD player, hairdryer, iron/Ironing board, in-room safe, telephone and alarm clock, mini refrigerator, coffeemaker, toaster, and convection oven. Soak up the sun on one of the nearby sandy beaches or enjoy a dip in our beautiful outdoor pool. Experience the best of the island and visit Pier 60 for stunning sunsets, the dolphin experience, the pirate cruise, or fishing on the Gulf of Mexico. AC Hotel by Marriott Clearwater Beach has a restaurant, an outdoor swimming pool, a fitness center, and a bar in Clearwater Beach. The property is close to Clearwater Marine Company, Clearwater Beach Jet Ski Rentals Guided Tours, and Captain Memo s Pirate Cruise.

room_details.room_Description: Fully equipped rooms featuring elegant design and comfort for both leisure and business travelers. Complimentary high-speed internet access in all guest rooms and throughout the hotel. Rooms are equipped with a full bathroom suite, telephone, hairdryer, air-conditioning, adjustable reading lamps, comfortable beds, plush pillows, 55" smart TVs, and a mini refrigerator for your convenience at this Clearwater Beach Hotel.

resort_details: Experience it all at the beautiful Club Wyndham Clearwater Beach Resort, and see what everyone is talking about. Whether you're here for a beach getaway, a family vacation, or a business meeting, this resort offers a blend of warm Southern hospitality, high-tech capabilities, and an inviting ambiance for relaxing, working, meeting, playing, dining, and exploring the natural beauty of Clearwater Beach.

room_details.room_Description: These spacious deluxe and presidential suites are fitted with all the necessities to make this your home away from home, including private bedrooms, separate living areas, a full kitchen, and spa amenities.

resort_details: This cozy and quiet getaway offers ideal access to the best of Marco Island. Fabulous restaurants, specialty shops and boutiques are just minutes away, as are world-class golfing, fishing and excursions to the area’s historic and archeological sites. Here, a dozen key historical markers chart the rich legacy of Marco Island, where archeologists have unearthed artifacts found to be more than 3,000 years old. Club Regency treats visitors to the signature delights of this island wonderland, from peaceful strolls along one of the world’s most beautiful beaches to sailing, kayaking and an endless array of memorable vacation adventures.

room_details.room_Description: Spacious 2 bedroom suites with screened lanais, each suite features a fully equipped kitchen.

resort_details: This unique resort offers its own inimitable charm with cosy rooms and a stunning location within Venice. On the island of Giudecca, guests can enjoy total relaxation, while not being too far from the buzz of the city. Hotel rooms are spacious and sleep two to three people, while the extensive breakfast buffet and onsite café help you get your day off to the right start. Near Venice is the island of Lido, which provides a range of sports including golf, tennis, beach, swimming, as well as a casino.

Eagle's Nest's tower units and villas offer contemporary, beautifully appointed 1- and 2-bedroom condos, each with 2 baths, a sleeper-sofa, a screened balcony, a fully equipped kitchen, and washer/dryer.

While relaxing by the heated pool, you may catch a glimpse of a dolphin or manatee swimming by. High-speed internet access and proximity to downtown make the Best Western Fort Myers Waterfront perfect for business travelers. Whether coming to Fort Myers area for busines or just for a weekend getaway, let the Best Western Fort Myers Waterfront make a trip to Florida special, unique, and comfortable. We have 2 restaurants on site. IHOP is openfor breakfast, lunch and dinner and the 3 Fisherman Seafood restaurant is open for lunch and dinner. Enjoy your stay.

place_name: The Lodge at Blue Sky Auberge Resorts
resort_details: Listen to the sound of fresh snow crunching underfoot. Spy hundreds of elk that come down from higher elevations during winter months to graze in our open fields. Just 35 minutes from Salt Lake City airport but a world away, our 3,500-acre private retreat in the Wasatch Mountain Range is where you will leave the cares of the modern world behind and powerfully reconnect with nature, from snowshoeing through forested trails to horse-drawn sleigh rides to heli-skiing for intermediate and advanced skiers alike. You'll feel right at home with our relaxed mountain lifestyle - and with the Blue Sky family.

room_details.room_Description: The Lodge at Blue Sky offers 46 rooms and suites, each designed to seamlessly blend contemporary design with the surrounding natural beauty. Rooms feature natural color palettes, sleek lines, and locally sourced materials like wood, stone, and marble. They also include private terraces with views and amenities like outdoor fireplaces, porch swings, and fly-fishing rods, depending on the accommodation type.

location: 9100 Marsac Avenue, Deer Valley, Park City, UT 84060, United States
resort_details:
Offering 7 restaurants and a full spa on site, this resort features ski in/ski out accommodations. A year round indoor and outdoor pool and hot tub are offered. All rooms are equipped with free WiFi.

Rooms at Montage Deer Valley provide a patio or balcony, a seating area with a fireplace, a flat-screen cable TV with pay-per-view channels. Each private bathroom also comes with a hairdryer. Select rooms have mountain or garden views.

Daly’s Pub & Rec offers pub fare and cocktails for lunch and dinner and guests can enjoy an espresso bar at Buzz Coffee Shop. Asian cuisine is served at Yama Sushi and Vista Lounge offers alpine cuisine and live entertainment. Burgers and Bourbon serves American cuisine and cocktails.

Guests can take advantage of the spa treatments offered at Spa Montage, including massages, manicures and pedicures. A transfer service within Park City is also available at Park City Montage Deer Valley.

Ruby Express ski elevator is 656 ft and Empire Express ski elevator is 656 ft from the resort. Salt Lake City International Airport is 27 mi from Montage Deer Valley.

room_details.room_Description: Montage Deer Valley offers a variety of luxurious rooms and suites, including King and Queen/Queen options with views of the resort or mountains. Room features typically include estate-quality furnishings, sitting areas with gas fireplaces, marble bathrooms with soaking tubs and showers, and heated floors. Some rooms also offer balconies or terraces.

resort_details:

Exceptional Facilities: Guests can enjoy spa facilities, a fitness center, terrace, restaurant, bar, and a year-round outdoor swimming pool. Additional amenities include a hot tub, fitness room, and ski equipment hire.

location: 7520 Royal Street Deer Valley, Park City, UT 84060
resort_details: Goldener Hirsch, Auberge Resorts Collection seamlessly blends an iconic historic inn with new contemporary residences designed by award-winning architect Tom Kundig. Nestled at the foot of Deer Valley's Silver Lake Express lift, the freshly renovated family-owned property has been an iconic fixture in Silver Lake Village for more than 30 years. Now complementing the inn's beloved old-world architecture and know-you-by-your-name hospitality are one to three-bedroom alpine chic residences. Ski-in, ski-out access stretches just steps from Goldener Hirsch's doorstep to endless picture-perfect pistes where 103 runs wind through the region's majestic aspen groves and evergreen glades.

room_details.room_Description: Goldener Hirsch Auberge Resort offers a variety of room types, including Balcony Rooms and Studio Suites, with amenities like fireplaces, microwaves, refrigerators, and coffee makers, according to Kayak. The resort also includes Residences, which are modern condo-style rooms with a different ambiance, notes Kayak.

location: 6501 Railroad Avenue Southeast, Snoqualmie, WA 98065, United States
resort_details:
Venture into the world of one of America’s favorite mystery drama television series at Salish Lodge & Spa. Nestled in the foothills of the Cascade Mountains, overlooking the 268-foot Snoqualmie Falls, Salish Lodge served as inspiration for the iconic Great Northern Hotel, and offers guests a Great Northern Escape package.

This one-of-a-kind experience allows you to explore the show’s locations around the Lodge, cozy up in one of the 85 guest rooms while binge-watching the first season, relax with Damn Good Coffee and Cherry Pie, in The Attic, or join your fellow Peakies for a Dale Cooper cocktail.

With an award-winning spa, locally-sourced, seasonal cuisine in both The Dining Room and The Attic, a fantastic wine list featuring over 50 Washington wines, and an on-site apiary, Salish Lodge & Spa is known for providing an iconic, Pacific Northwest experience. With such a stunning natural setting in Snqoualmie Washington, just 30 minutes from Seattle, you can also enjoy skiing, hiking, mountain biking, river rafting and fishing.

Indulge in the luxury and excitement of Tulalip where you will experience impeccable service, unrivaled rewards and the most cash back of any Washington casino. The AAA Four Diamond Tulalip Resort Casino is Washington’s premier destination for luxurious accommodations, award-winning dining, a rejuvenating spa, and casino excitement with over 2,400 slots and 37 gaming tables for gaming. Guests will fall in love with the stunning guest room renovations completed in 2020. The updated styling pays homage to the rich history and culture of the Tulalip Tribes, while taking a leap forward in design, technology, and luxury.

room_details.room_Description: The Tulalip Resort Casino offers a range of guest rooms, from Deluxe King to Deluxe Queen rooms, each with amenities like ensuite bathrooms, air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, and free WiFi. Many rooms also include refrigerators, tea/coffee makers, and irons. The resort is known for its clean and spacious rooms, making for a comfortable stay. Some rooms have jacuzzis or jetted tubs, but specific details about which rooms have these amenities are best confirmed directly with the hotel staff.

location: 1000 First Avenue, Seattle Central Business District, Seattle, WA 98104, United States
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Hotel 1000, LXR Hotels & Resorts
Located in downtown Seattle on the corner of First and Madison Street, this 4-star hotel features a full-service spa which offers a number of services such as massages, body treatments, manicures, pedicures, and facials. The Seattle Art Museum is 3 minutes' walk away.

Every room at the 1000 Hotel includes an in-room safe and a mini-bar. The rooms also offer a cable 42-inch flat-screen TV with 52 HD channels, and free Wi-Fi access.

Hotel 1000 provides All Water Seafood & Oyster Bar, an on-site seafood restaurant featuring boat-to-table cuisine sourced from the Pacific Northwest. Rosebay is also located on-site, offering craft cocktails and light fare. Virtual golf with over 50 golf courses, a fitness center are available. A business center, meeting facilities, and 24-hour room services can also be found onsite.

The Seattle Center is a 5 minutes' drive away, Pike Place Market is a 7 minutes' walk, and Pioneer Square is a 6 minutes' walk from the hotel.

The Port of Seattle is 2 minutes' drive from Hotel 1000 and it welcomes popular cruise ships. SeaTac International Airport is 14 mi away and the Washington State Convention Center is 17 minutes' walk from the property.

Walking hand in hand, you see an eagle soar overhead. You stop to skip stones across the water. Four, five, six skips. A perfect moment suspended in time. A story for dinner. This is the place where memories are made, where families come back year after year. Like having your own waterfront cottage, only better. Cartwheels on the grass. A game of badminton at sunset. Leather couches and a glass of Washington state Syrah. The sweet succulent bite of fresh oysters. Rooms that make you say “wow” when you open the door. Can this hotel be only two hours from Seattle? It can. Welcome to Alderbrook Resort & Spa.

Some rooms also have deep soaking tubs and Molton Brown bath products,

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Westin Bayshore, Vancouver
The Westin Bayshore, Vancouver is in perfect balance with its breathtaking urban and natural surroundings. An elegant base to explore Vancouver, this waterfront resort-style property is a hub of well-being. Direct access to the Vancouver Seawall and iconic Stanley Park, a variety of signature wellness programs, outdoor (heated) and indoor pool, and an on-site spa promote a feeling of excellence, amid food and beverage offerings that recharge body and mind.

The Westin Bayshore features newly renovated guestrooms and suites featuring floor-to-ceiling windows to reveal magnificent views of the harbor, mountains, and city skyline. Dine in the comfort of our newly revitalized restaurant venues, H2 Kitchen & Bar, H Tasting Lounge, and T & Co Cafe. Handcrafted cocktails, local delicacies, and picturesque outdoor dining options provide unparalleled experiences.

At Westin, everything we do is designed to leave you feeling better than when you arrived. Stay active by making use of our WestinWORKOUT fitness center, Just Add Water Yoga Studio, Liquid Yoga classes, and our 2-hour complimentary BikeWESTIN rentals.

Rooms at Poet's Cove Resort & Spa include a mini fridge and harbor view. With large windows and whitewashed walls, cottages and villas feature a full kitchen and patio.

Showcasing regional West Coast cuisine, the on-site Aurora Restaurant serves up a variety of seafood dishes. Poet’s Cove Resort also features a full service on-site spa.

For on-site activity, guests can participate in yoga classes or make use of the basketball court. Fishing is another on-site recreational option.

location: Bedwell River Valley, British Columbia V0R 2Z0 Canada
resort_details: Set on the edge of the Pacific Ocean, Vancouver Island’s remote luxury outpost Clayoquot Wilderness Lodge is stationed on 600-acres of pristine wilderness where abundant wildlife roams freely. Twenty-five luxurious Canadian safari tents styled for the modern-day traveler offer a rare privilege of place with ocean, forest, and mountains right on the doorstep for just a fortunate few. Get set for a choose-your-own adventure style escape where the vast landscape and thriving wildlife combine in a backdrop to exhilarating, unforgettable experiences. Take a hike on the wild side, try horseback riding, or canyoning in the glacier-fed river and cruise the sound to spot the west coast’s wildlife superstars. After all the action, dine in The Cookhouse restaurant, relax sound-side in The Ivanhoe bar and recharge in the Healing Grounds Spa. It’s a grown-up summer camp, a step away from time where you're treated to exclusive, privileged access to nature’s playground.

room_details.room_Description: Clayoquot Wilderness Lodge offers 25 canvas tents, not traditional rooms, which provide a luxurious glamping experience. These tents are furnished with amenities like comfortable beds, couches, tables, and a freestanding gas stove. Rooms are categorized as "rainforest deluxe" (private bathrooms a few steps away), rainforest ensuite (bathroom attached), waterfront ensuite, and a family suite. Communal facilities like hot tubs, bars, and social tents are also available for all guests.

room_details.room_Description: Tigh-Na-Mara Lodge offers various room types, including Spa Bungalows, Oceanview Rooms, and Rustic Cottages. Spa Bungalows offer features like a queen Murphy bed, private balcony or patio, gas fireplace, kitchen, and dining area. Oceanview Rooms provide beautiful views, while Rustic Cottages are pet-friendly and offer a more basic, yet cozy, experience.

resort_details: Eagle Nook is an remote luxury wilderness resort offering world class salmon and halibut fishing charters, whale watching and kayaking tours. You'll find a cozy atmosphere with double room accommodations, all with bathrooms en suite. With 23 guest rooms, all with ocean-views, a dining room with vaulted ceilings overlooking Vernon Bay, media room and patios overlooking both Vernon and Jane Bays, Eagle Nook Resort is one of the most impressive resorts on the West Coast. After a day of adventure, unwind in the Jacuzzi, or just relax and watch the sun go down while sitting on one of our patios. The ocean view dining room and lounge are the gathering points where adventure stories can be shared at the end of a great day in the outdoors. With its splendid wilderness location, luxurious feeling, and numerous indoor and outdoor activities, a room at Eagle Nook Resort is the perfect home base for an unforgettable vacation.

Guests enjoy sweeping ocean views, refined accommodations, and world-class amenities—from Canada’s Top 20 oceanside golf course to a premier sport shooting centre. Outdoor adventures include kayaking, fishing, cruises, sport shooting, archery and axe throwing. The award-winning Spa & Wellness features a junior Olympic pool and fitness centre. Culinary experiences range from casual fare at The Willard to elevated coastal cuisine at Cape Cliff Dining Room, recipient of Wine Spectator’s Two Goblet Award. With a private 5,000-ft runway, deep-sea marina, and unmatched service, Fox Harb’r offers an exclusive retreat that blends elegance, recreation, and authentic East Coast charm.

This is why so many travellers make ke Oak Island Resort & Conference Centre their resort of choice when visiting Nova Scotia's South Shore! Providing an ideal mix of value, comfort and convenience, it offers a family-friendly setting with an array of amenities designed for travelers like you, enjoy our newly renovated guest rooms, bar and lobby. Staying connected during your stay is easy with free wifi for guests. The resort features a 24 hour front desk and room service (room service hours may vary based on occupancy levels). Guests can enjoy 2 pools, new hot tub and an on-site restaurant as well as free parking. At Oak Island Resort & Conference Centre, your comfort and satisfaction come first, we look forward to welcoming you to the Western Shore.

Cabot Cape Breton features 46 holes of exhilarating golf (Cabot Cliffs, Cabot Links and The Nest) and one of the best resort experiences in Canada. Cabot Cape Breton | Destination Cape Breton

Many rooms include fireplaces, four-poster beds, jetted tubs, and private sitting areas. The hotel also features a 13,000-foot spa with a saltwater pool, hot springs, and a fitness center.

location: 18 Saint Thomas Street, M5S 3E7 Toronto, Canada
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Windsor Arms Hotel
A European-inspired spa, 2 restaurants and free WiFi are all featured the 5-star Windsor Arms Hotel is centrally located in the city of Toronto. The Royal Ontario Museum and Yorkville Avenue shopping district are both within a 5-minute walk.

A flat-screen cable TV, mini-bar and sofa bed are standard in every modern room at the Windsor Arms Hotel. All the suites include a musical instrument and a large, limestone bathroom with a spa bath.

A buffet breakfast is available in the restaurant with surcharge. There is also a menu to choose from. High Tea can be enjoyed in one of the Windsor Arms individually themed tea rooms. The Living Room Restaurant is open all day, specializing in comfort foods and offering a wide variety of craft beers. A self-pour draft table is available upon request.

Windsor Arms Spa offers guests a selection of massage and body treatments. An indoor salt water pool, steam room, sauna and gym are also available.

The University of Toronto and the Bay Subway Station are both within 3 minutes’ walk from the hotel. Toronto Pearson International Airport is 19 mi away.

room_details.room_Description: The Windsor Arms Hotel offers 28 suites, each individually furnished and ranging in size from 500 to over 2,000 square feet. These suites feature amenities like personal butler service, private butler pantries, and amenities like a minibar, complimentary Nespresso, and daily amenities. All rooms include comforts like air conditioning, bathrobes, free WiFi, and safes.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Le Mount Stephen
Le Mount Stephen is located in Montreal's Golden Square Mile, 1476 feet from the Museum of Fine Arts, 1804 feet from Bell Center and 2953 feet from McGill University. This hotel is housed in a historic mansion dating from 1880, coupled with a sleek contemporary tower of 90 rooms and suites.

Guest rooms offer complimentary WIFI, a Nespresso machine, mini-bar and flat-screen IPTV, as well as touch panel automated climate, lighting and curtains controls. Marble bathrooms feature heated floors and a rain forest shower head with Chroma lighting therapy.

Bar George, restaurant and bar is located on site. Guests can also dine on the outside terrace during the summer months.

Shopping along Ste-Catherine Street is only 427 feet from the hotel. Montreal-Pierre Elliott Trudeau International Airport is 11 mi away.

room_details.room_Description: Le Mount Stephen offers a range of room options, from Deluxe rooms with king beds and terraces to suites with floor-to-ceiling windows and exclusive amenities. All rooms feature modern comforts like air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, and soundproofing, with some offering extras like in-room sitting areas, Nespresso machines, and chromotherapy lighting in the bathroom.

location: 1 Rue des Carrieres, G1R 4P5 Quebec City, Canada
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Fairmont Le Chateau Frontenac
Ideally located in Old Quebec, this heritage property features views of the St. Lawrence River. The on-site restaurants provide a variety of dining options, from classic to regional dishes. Montmorency National Park is a 2-minute drive away.

The elegant, European-style rooms of the Fairmont Le Chateau Frontenac have large windows, cable TV and a coffee maker. Ironing facilities and air conditioning are also included.

Guests of the Fairmont are welcome to enjoy the indoor pool, a hot tub and the steam rooms. A fitness room, business center and concierge services are also available. Guests can enjoy a variety of treatments at the Spa du Château, the on-site spa.

The Notre Dame Cathedral is a 3-minute walk from Le Chateau Frontenac. The Citadel of Quebec is just over a quarter mile away.

room_details.room_Description: The Fairmont Le Château Frontenac offers 610 rooms and suites, a blend of historic charm and contemporary elegance. Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Ritz-Carlton, Montreal
This luxury hotel in Montreal city center features contemporary French cuisine at the on-site Maison Boulud. All rooms feature a flat-screen TV. A variety of galleries and boutiques are within 5 minutes’ walk and a saltwater pool is located on site.

The spacious rooms at The Ritz-Carlton, Montreal feature a marble bathroom with heated floors and 19-inch flat-screen TV. Asprey bath products are provided. Rooms include a digital control of lights and curtains, as well as automatic toilets. Free WiFi, a mini-bar and flat-screen TV in the bedroom are also included.

A fitness center is available at The Ritz-Carlton, along with in-room massages. A business center, 24-hour concierge service and client accompaniment service are also offered.

Guests can dine in the garden of Le Jardin during summer months. Cocktails and snacks are available in The Ritz Bar.

Casino de Montreal is 15 minutes’ drive from Montreal Ritz-Carlton. Old Montreal is 10 minutes’ drive away.

room_details.room_Description: The Ritz-Carlton Montreal offers a range of guest rooms and suites, all with a palette of warm neutrals, including deluxe rooms, premium rooms, and various suites. Suites include the Junior Suite (600 sq ft), Executive Suite (1000 sq ft), and the Royal Suite, the largest at 4,700 sq ft, boasting 12 rooms

resort_details:

Located between the sea and mountains in La Malbaie, Quebec, this luxurious castle hotel features a 27-hole golf course, on-site dining and a spa. It has cable TV with video games in every room.

Guests at Fairmont Le Manoir Richelieu can enjoy the 2 outdoor pools, indoor pool and sauna. The on-site gym features free weights, bicycles and treadmills.

A work desk and an arm chair are included in the warm-colored rooms. The bathrooms have bathrobes and a hairdryer. Rooms with views of St. Lawrence River are available.

The full-service, hotel spa provides massages and body treatments. It also has manicures, pedicures and facials.

Charlevoix Casino is next to Fairmont Le Manoir. The hotel is 10 miles from Mont Grand-Fonds ski area and 40 miles from Le Massif ski area.

room_details.room_Description: The Fairmont Le Manoir Richelieu offers a variety of rooms and suites, including Fairmont King, Fairmont Queen, and Deluxe rooms, all with a St. Lawrence River view. Some rooms, like the Deluxe Double Double, are larger and can accommodate up to six people. All rooms feature amenities like a 42" HDTV, Nespresso coffee maker, kettle, mini-bar, and snacks.

location: 1440 RUE DE LA MONTAGNE, H3G 1Z5 Montreal, Canada
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Four Seasons Hotel Montreal
Elegant Accommodations: Four Seasons Hotel Montreal in Montreal offers a 5-star experience with a luxurious indoor swimming pool, bar, and free WiFi. Guests enjoy air-conditioned rooms with private bathrooms, baths, TVs, and electric kettles.

Comfortable Amenities: The hotel features a hot tub, 24-hour front desk, electric vehicle charging station, family rooms, and room service. Additional facilities include a fitness center, spa, and paid on-site parking.

Exceptional Service: Highly rated for its attentive staff and excellent service support, the hotel provides a convenient location with a variety of nearby attractions.

room_details.room_Description: The Four Seasons Hotel Montreal offers a range of guest rooms and suites, from the spacious Deluxe Rooms to the elegant Executive Suites, all featuring luxury amenities and stylish design. The hotel also boasts a Guerlain Spa, a 24-hour fitness center, and a skylit indoor pool, further enhancing the guest experience.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Hôtel Birks Montréal
Located in Downtown Montreal, Hôtel Birks offers a street level terrace for the Restaurant Henri Brasserie Française. The property is set 984 feet from Eaton Center Montreal and 1312 feet from Museum of Contemporary Art.

At Hôtel Birks, rooms are fitted with a desk, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom. Each room has air conditioning, and some rooms at the Hôtel Birks Montreal offer a private terrace overlooking the city. Some rooms feature a claw-foot bath and a gas fireplace.

A continental, express or à la carte breakfast can be enjoyed at the property. At Hôtel Birks you will you will find the Restaurant Henri Brasserie Française, offering French comfort food made with seasonal Canadian products.

Hôtel Birks Montréal is also home to Spa Valmont, the perfect place to be treated with Valmont skin care.

Staff at the 24-hour front desk speak English and French.

Convention Center Montreal is 1640 feet from Hôtel Birks. The nearest airport is Montreal-Pierre Elliott Trudeau International Airport, 9.3 mi from the property.

Housekeeping service
Our rooms are cleaned according to the most demanding cleaning protocol in compliance with government regulations. If you require additional items (towels, shower gel, comb etc.), simply request them from the hotel reception and they will be delivered to you. Some items have been removed from the rooms and are available on request to facilitate the sanitation process.

Restaurant Henri Brasserie Francaise
Our restaurant Henri Brasserie Française is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner services from Tuesday to Saturday and for brunch service on Sunday. We offer our guests the opportunity to order Room service through our menu available 24 hours per day 7 days a week.

Valet service:
It will be our pleasure to park your vehicle while making sure to follow the cleaning guidelines every time you need your vehicle. The drop off for our valet service with underground parking is located at 1240 Square Phillips. The service is offered with in and out privileges at a daily fee of $40. Please note that due to height restrictions 'pick-up' trucks and vehicles with sportrack cargo box may be refused based on their height. Our valets will direct you to the closest parking available

Just 2 minutes’ walk from Mont-Tremblant Resort & Village, this luxury, all-suite hotel in Mont-Tremblant features an on-site restaurant, wine bar and spa. All suites offer a view of Lake Tremblant.

A wood-burning fireplace (ecological logs) and private balcony or terrace are standard in each suite at Hotel Quintessence. Each spacious bathroom is appointed with heated marble floors, a spa bath and a separate rain shower.

Restaurant La Quintessence features fine cuisine and an extensive wine list. Guests can dine on the terrace during warmer months.

Massages and body treatments are among services offered at Hotel Quintessence’s Spa Sans Sabots. Overlooking Lake Tremblant, a seasonal outdoor pool and hot tub provide additional relaxation options.

Le Géant and Le Diable golf courses are 0.6 mi from this hotel. Casino Mont-Tremblant is 1.9 mi away.

room_details.room_Description: Hotel Quintessence in Mont-Tremblant, Canada, offers 30 luxurious suites with lake or garden views. Each suite features a private balcony or terrace, a king-size bed, a wood-burning fireplace, and en-suite bathrooms with therapeutic spa tubs, rain showers, and AVEDA amenities. Amenities include complimentary internet access, a minibar, and a safe. Some suites also offer a sofa bed and a dining area with a table and chairs.

location: 700 rue Ripplecove, J0B 1C0 Ayer's Cliff, Canada
resort_details:
Experience World-class Service at Ripplecove Hotel & Spa
Located 75 minutes from Montreal and 15 minutes from Vermont, Ripplecove Hotel offers an ideal location with its 12-acre land directly on Lake Massawippi, Quebec. This  hotel features a full-service spa and a gourmet restaurant.

Each unique room features views of the lake or the hotel’s landscaped gardens. An iPod docking station, cable TV and a seating area are all provided. Rooms come with free WiFi.

Ripplecove’s on-site restaurant "Le Riverain" features innovative regional and international cuisine, an extensive wine list and live piano music.

Ripplecove's Arboressence Spa provides various therapies and beauty treatments. Guests can also use the tennis courts and heated outdoor swimming pool.

This luxury hotel offers various activities on site, including tennis, boating, swimming, cycling, snow-shoeing, skating and ice fishing.

location: 8 Rue Saint-Antoine, G1K 4C9 Quebec City, Canada
resort_details:

Guests at the Saint-Antoine Auberge can take advantage of the fitness center, then relax with a massage. After a busy day, guests can browse the display of archaeological artifacts in the hotel.

Chez Muffy restaurant at the Auberge Saint-Antoine serves French-Canadian cuisine for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Guests can also enjoy a light meal in the hotel's Cafe Artifact.

location: 8 Balderton Street, Brown Hart Gardens, Westminster Borough, London, W1K 6TF, United Kingdom
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Beaumont Mayfair
Offering a popular restaurant, spa and fitness center, The Beaumont Mayfair is set in the prestigious London district of Mayfair. The original building dates back to 1926 and features an iconic, 3-story high sculpture by the award-winning Sir Antony Gormley.

The hotel offers free WiFi and easy access to London's shopping.

Accommodations ranges from standard guest rooms with large king-size beds, to spacious suites, all elegantly designed in Art Deco style with original artwork and antiques. Luxury bathrooms have black and white marble, heated floors.

The hotel features Le Magritte Bar and The Colony Grill, which are popular with locals, while The Gatsby Room provides the ideal setting for afternoon tea or evening drinks.

The hammam and spa offer relaxation treatments, and use of the gym, sauna and steam room is free for all guests.

The hotel is in a quiet position overlooking a landscaped garden square. Selfridges is within a short walk, while Hyde Park can be reached in 10 minutes by foot. Theaters, art galleries and luxury shopping can be reached easily by Tube or car.

room_details.room_Description: The Beaumont Mayfair in London offers a variety of room types, all decorated in a soft Art Deco style and featuring en-suite bathrooms with rain showers and DR Harris toiletries. The hotel also provides amenities like LCD TVs, tea-and-coffee-making facilities, and complimentary soft drinks and snacks.

location: 51 Buckingham Gate, Westminster Borough, London, SW1E 6AF, United Kingdom
place_name: 51 Buckingham Gate, Taj Suites and Residences
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Taj 51 Buckingham Gate Suites and Residences
Located in the heart of Westminster, just a short walk away from Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park and Mayfair, this 5-star luxury suites and residences with 3 restaurants, a full-serve spa and a 24-hour fitness center. Free WiFi is available for guests throughout.

All suites come with air-conditioning, fully equipped kitchenettes with a separate living areas, a flat-screen TV, and a modern bathroom with fluffy bathrobes, slippers and designer toiletries.

Butler and Golden Key Concierge service is available 24-hours a day.

Chef Sriram Aylur’s Michelin starred Quilon serves South-West coastal Indian cuisine, while Kona offers award-winning themed afternoon teas.

The newly opened House Of Ming, brings with it history, culture and authentic cuisine from China, taking your palate on a journey of flavors.

At the heart of the hotel is the Victorian Courtyard, a relaxing escape from the busy city and the ideal setting for cocktails and alfresco dining.

J Wellness Circle features a range of spa treatments inspired by Indian wellness philosophies and using natural ingredients and products. Pre booking of treatments is essential.

The property is centrally located in the heart of London's Royal Quarter, with St. James’ Court being a short 10-minute walk from Victoria Coach and Rail Stations, and easily accessible from both Gatwick, via the Gatwick Express, and Heathrow International airports.

location: 45 Park Lane, Westminster Borough, London, W1K 1PN, United Kingdom
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at 45 Park Lane - Dorchester Collection
Overlooking Hyde Park, 45 Park Lane features a spa and gym and a modern American steak restaurant. A striking central staircase leads to a mezzanine featuring a bar, library and a private media room.
Impressive views of Hyde Park are featured in each room at 45 Park Lane, which also include Bang & Olufsen TVs, en suite marble bathrooms and free Wi-Fi. All rooms include Aromatherapy Associates toiletries.
Prime dry and wet aged beef, pan-roasted lobster and fine wines are on offer in the on-site restaurant. Full English and continental breakfasts can also be provided.
The shopping district of Oxford Street is just a 15-minute walk from the hotel. Tennis, horseback riding and boating can all be enjoyed within Hyde Park, as well as leisurely walks. Hyde Park Corner tube station is a 5-minute walk.

room_details.room_Description: 45 Park Lane offers a range of room types, including studios, suites, and the Penthouse Terrace Suite, all with varying square footage and amenities. location: Wilton Place, London SW1X 7RL, London, United Kingdom
resort_details: The fashion-forward set has long been calling The Berkeley their home away from home, and not just because of the Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star hotel’s proximity to Harvey Nichols, Harrods and Sloane Street designer shops.

resort_details:

Located in the affluent area of London’s West End, The Biltmore Mayfair is steps away from the finest shopping, dining and royal parks. Located on Grosvenor Square, the hotel is just a few minutes’ walk from New Bond Street, Oxford Street and Regent Street, while the leafy surroundings of Hyde Park are 7 minutes’ walk away.

The spacious rooms and suites reflect the building’s origin as an elegant London private residence. All feature Italian marble bathrooms, a Ruark sound system, smart TV, mini-bar, espresso machine and complimentary WiFi.

Guests can dine at Café Biltmore, Mayfair,overseen by Executive Chef Luis Campos. Café Biltmore is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner, and features a seasonally driven menu with dishes of wood-fired fish and meats, fresh seafood, signature salads and plant-based plates. In addition, guests can enjoy afternoon tea at The Tea Lounge,  and an array of the finest wines and premium spirits prepared by expert mixologists at The Pine Bar.

It's located at 44 Grosvenor Square in the heart of Mayfair, known for its shopping and dining options, and is close to attractions like Royal Parks and New Bond Street.

location: 16-22 Great Russell Street, London WC1B 3NN, United Kingdom
resort_details:
The Bloomsbury is a colorful gem housed in a grand neo-Georgian building in the heart of London’s leafy literary district. Neatly tucked on a peaceful side street, the hotel offers a tranquil urban escape while offering easy access to must-visit landmarks like the British Museum, Covent Garden, the Sir John Soane’s Museum and West End theaters.

You’ll want to save time to take in the picturesque hotel, too. The flamboyant, character-filled décor exudes British charm. With botanical wallpaper, rich fabrics and art deco lighting, every detail enhances the inviting, stylish atmosphere.

There are plenty of chic spaces to enjoy, from the blossom-covered Dalloway Terrace, a destination for a picture-perfect lunch, to the moody Bloomsbury Club Bar for a nightcap. A blend of historic charm and contemporary design, The Bloomsbury is an ideal choice for travelers seeking an immersive London experience.

room_details.room_Description: The Bloomsbury Hotel in London offers various room types with stylish interiors, including Classic, Deluxe, and Luxury Studio Suites. Rooms feature contemporary decor blending with original Georgian features, and amenities like pod coffee machines, duck-down duvets, and heated marble bathroom floors. The hotel also provides access to a 24-hour business and fitness center, and a car service.

resort_details:

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Brown's Hotel, a Rocco Forte Hotel
Between Piccadilly and Regent Street, this elegant 5-star hotel has award-winning fine dining, a gym and a peaceful spa. In exclusive Mayfair, guests are just yards from galleries and designer shops.

Guests can choose from a range of massages and beauty treatments in the on-site spa. Green Park Tube Station is 5 minutes’ walk away.

location: 171 Knightsbridge, Westminster Borough, London, SW7 1DW, United Kingdom

Located in the heart of Knightsbridge, Bvlgari Hotel London - Michelin guide highest 3 keys rating property features 85 beautifully appointed spacious rooms and suites, an elegant bar, restaurant, a 25-yard swimming pool, private cinema, and a stunning ballroom. An award-winning spa and fitness center are also provided.

Harrods, Hyde Park, and Knightsbridge Underground Station are just a 5-minute walk from the hotel, and Oxford Street can be reached in 20 minutes by tube. The museum district of South Kensington and Royal Albert Hall are only a 15-minute walk away.

A 42-inch plasma TV, Nespresso coffee machine and free WiFi are featured in all Bvlgari rooms, and many feature views over Hyde Park and Knightsbridge. Rooms and suites combine English style with Italian heritage, and feature a luxurious variety of marbles, fine woods and unique detailing with many furnishings made exclusively for Bvlgari.

Sette restaurant is the first London location of New York City’s Scarpetta Restaurants. Housed on the ground floor of Bvlgari Hotel London, but operated independently with its own entrance at 4 Knightsbridge Green, Sette restaurant brings authentic Italian food from the heart of Manhattan. Nolita Social will be the new after-hours hangout bar, bringing the energy of ‘the New York night’ to London with a heady mix of crafted cocktails, live music and DJs, creating a space perfect for lighthearted revelry in Knightsbridge.

Rooms feature premium bedding, down comforters, minibars, and in-room safes. Bathrooms include separate tubs and showers, often with deep soaking tubs and rainfall showerheads. Amenities like Nespresso machines and complimentary wireless internet are standard.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Cadogan, A Belmond Hotel, London
In exclusive Knightsbridge, this 5-star boutique hotel once played host to Oscar Wilde. Guests can dine or have a light lunch in the elegant and comfortable bar and drawing room and enjoy luxurious rooms with iPod docks.

Guests can also exercise in the hotel’s fitness studio.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Coworth Park - Dorchester Collection
A luxurious spa with a roof of fragrant herbs, an excellent gourmet restaurant, and an equestrian center are offered at this stunning, 5-star country house. Its sumptuous rooms boast Bang and Olufsen TVs.

Spacious and elegantly furnished, each room features spacious bathrooms with under-floor heating and copper baths. Guests can relax with high-end technology, including a Blu-Ray DVD player, an iPod/USB dock, and a Nespresso coffee machine. All rooms enjoy scenic views of the gardens.

Just 50 miles from the center of London, this elegant Georgian manor house offers luxurious accommodations in Hampshire. There is an on-site spa, swimming pool, a bar and restaurant, a 24-hour front desk and free WiFi in public areas. Free parking is also available on-site.

Guests at Four Seasons Hotel Hampshire can enjoy outdoor activities like horse riding and clay pigeon shooting. There are 2 floodlit tennis courts, a highwire adventure and you can even go canal boating on the river that passes through the grounds.

Rooms are spacious and stylishly furnished, and all benefit from an private bathroom with free toiletries and a hairdryer. Rooms all have a satellite TV and air conditioning, and some also have picturesque views.

South Downs National Park is about a 30-minute drive from Four Seasons Hotel Hampshire. Portsmouth can be reached in an hour by car, and Winchester is a 35-minute drive away.

room_details.room_Description: The Four Seasons Hotel Hampshire offers 133 guest rooms and suites, including 22 suites, all designed for comfort and varying in size and layout. Rooms start at 485 square feet and feature amenities like marble bathrooms in some rooms, views of the countryside or courtyard, and a range of themes in décor and colors. Some suites offer upgraded amenities like private bars and spacious living areas.

location: Chandler's Cross, Hertfordshire, WD3 4TG, Hertfordshire, United Kingdom
resort_details: The Grove is just 20 miles from the center of London but so rich is the offer at this historic manor that you might be tempted to eschew the British capital altogether and stay put for the duration of your visit. The Grove is set within 300 acres of charming countryside that encloses a wetland area, two lakes, woodland criss-crossed with walking and bicycling trails (bicycle hire is complimentary, including helmets for children), and a championship golf course.

room_details.room_Description: The Grove Hotel in Chandler's Cross, Hertfordshire, offers a variety of room types, from standard to luxury suites, with a total of 215 bedrooms. The hotel features a range of amenities including a championship golf course, a spa, and multiple dining options. It also boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, with options for various group sizes.

location: Oxford Rd, Aylesbury HP17 8NR, Aylesbury, United Kingdom
resort_details:
Take a sumptuous step back in time at Hartwell House & Spa, a 16th-century mansion estate in Buckinghamshire, 40 miles outside of London.

Hartwell House has a remarkable history unmatched by most luxury hotels, as it was once the family residence of exiled French King Louis XVIII of France for five years; the seat of John, Earl of Mortaigne (later known as King John); and the home of General Robert E. Lee’s 18th-century ancestors.

No two stays are alike, as each of the 46 rooms and suites are individually decorated, but all maintain a cohesive, classic country-house style.

The delight is in the details: Among the bountiful collection of antiques, oil paintings and intricate plaster and paneling throughout the mansion, the 400-year-old staircase “guarded” by a beguiling lineup of Jacobean statues is a marvel not to be missed.

Also unmissable are the picturesque, manicured parkland surrounding the hotel, as well as Hartwell Spa’s impressive indoor pool and café, where you can unwind after a beauty treatment or massage.

location: Heckfield Place, Hampshire, RG27 0LD Great Britian, Hampshire , United Kingdom
resort_details:
Heckfield Place was reportedly a decade in the making, but this grand Georgian retreat was worth the wait. Renowned British designer Ben Thompson artfully married the impressive framework of an 18th-century manor with light, contemporary interiors that make the hotel feel spacious and unfussy.

The 430-acre Hampshire estate is an hour from London’s Waterloo district but feels joyously secluded and calm. While away the hours spotting wildlife, reconnecting with nature and engaging in nostalgic activities that encourage a sense of mindfulness.

The countryside experience begins the moment you are collected from Winchfield train station in one of the hotel’s Land Rovers and driven through the verdant grounds, home to some of the U.K.’s largest and oldest trees, many of which predate the legendary Kew Gardens.

What’s truly impressive is how self-sustaining Heckfield Place is. The bountiful estate (which is certified organic) produces all manner of fruits and vegetables as well as all of the flowers used to adorn the hotel.

room_details.room_Description: Heckfield Place offers six distinct room types: Chamber, Master, Signature, Long Room, Lake Room, and other rooms. Chamber rooms are spacious and airy with garden views, while Master rooms feature generous living areas and also have garden views. Signature rooms offer a connection to Heckfield's history, and the Long Room is a magnificent living space overlooking the lakes and grounds.

location: Church Road, Great Milton, Oxford, OX44 7PD, Oxford, United Kingdom
place_name: Le Manoir aux Quat'Saisons, A Belmond Hotel, Oxfordshire
resort_details:
From the outside, Le Manoir aux Quat'Saisons, A Belmond Hotel, Oxfordshire looks like any other refined English country house hotel. But beyond the stone gateway, painstakingly landscaped gardens and historic architecture hides one of the U.K.’s most extraordinary culinary experiences.

Renowned chef Raymond Blanc opened Le Manoir in 1984 as a triumphant follow-up to his first restaurant, Les Quat’ Saisons, which he founded in Oxford in 1977. Just a 25-minute drive outside the historic university city where Blanc had his first professional successes, the hotel is also home to The Raymond Blanc Cookery School and The Raymond Blanc Gardening School. Professionals are trained here but courses on everything from desserts and nutrition to bread-making and dinner parties are available to guests, too. It’s hard to imagine a more gourmet place to stay.

location: London Road, Bagshot GU19 5EU, Bagshot, United Kingdom

room_details.room_Description:
Located just an hour’s drive southwest of London, Pennyhill Park beckons travelers who need a quick escape and have a taste of the British countryside. Despite its proximity to London, the overall atmosphere here is one of quiet indulgence and you’ll revel in the decadence of the 123 individually themed bedrooms (think vast four poster beds and velvet drapes).

The building itself is an unusual muddle of old and new architecture, and initially you may be left wondering where the original 19th-century manor house is hiding.

Yet, while you shouldn’t come here expecting Downton Abbey, the seemingly endless expanse of stunning grounds and woodlands, the impressive onsite restaurants and extensive spa facilities more than make up for any loss of character the hotel has experienced over the years.

location: Ridge Lane, Rotherwick, Hook RG27 9AZ, Hampshire, United Kingdom
resort_details:
Tylney Hall Hotel, Hampshire is an elegant 112-room mansion hotel with an expanse of gardens, lakes and forest, and is one of England’s quintessential luxury country retreats. Based in Hampshire, about 50 miles from London, the existing mansion was built during the Victorian era and first functioned as a palatial estate for the Tylney family in the 1700s.

The property became a hotel in 1985 and maintains a classic ethos — oak-paneled walls, gilded ceilings and period paintings — and is best suited for traditionalists who prefer the opulent living of yesteryear.

Tylney Hall is renowned for its acres of glorious garden space and woodlands, where 250,000 trees and shrubs surround the stately mansion. Feed the pond ducks in the bucolic Water Garden or lose yourself in a forest of redwoods alongside a picturesque lake. Horticultural even takes over the mansion itself, with Virginia creepers and rose trees elegantly caressing the red brick exterior.

location: Ripon, North Yorkshire, HG4 3ET, England, Ripon, United Kingdom
resort_details:
Since opening in 2019, Grantley Hall has become one of the U.K.’s most celebrated hotels. On the eastern edge of the Yorkshire Dales National Park, this stately 17th-century mansion was originally built as a private residence and has seen many incarnations since. 

With fewer than 50 rooms, Grantley Hall ensures an intimate, indulgent stay where luxury, history, nature and gourmet delights collide. Surrounded by 30 acres of landscaped grounds, the country estate is an ideal base for exploring the Dales while offering tranquil spaces to relax, including the opulent Three Graces Spa. 

Food lovers will savor the culinary experiences, including hyper-local fine dining at the heralded Shaun Rankin at Grantley Hall, contemporary Asian cuisine at Bar & Restaurant EightyEight, and casual yet polished British and European fare at Fletchers. Meanwhile, the sophisticated Norton Bar & Courtyard and garden-inspired Valeria’s Champagne and cocktail bar add tantalizing tipples to the mix.

location: 100 Princes Street, Edinburgh, Scotland EH2 3AB, Edinburgh, United Kingdom
resort_details:
Stepping over the threshold of The Red Carnation Hotel Collection’s 100 Princes Street, you wouldn’t be off base for thinking you’ve just walked into a centuries-old members club. Set along Edinburgh’s coveted Princes Street, this 2024-debuted boutique hotel draws design inspiration from its former life as the headquarters for the Royal Over-Seas League, a members club founded in 1910. Oil paintings depict gigantic ships at sea, while gilded 18th- and 19th-century lookalike furnishings dot tartan-clad rooms outfitted with intricately carved fireplaces.

This meticulous attention to detail helps ensure the property maintains its Old World gentlemen’s club atmosphere while continuing to cater to discerning travelers of the modern era. Whiskey tastings, afternoon tea and Scottish comfort classics are all on the menu at 100 Princes Street, as are stunning views of Edinburgh Castle from just about every room.

room_details.room_Description: 100 Princes Street in Edinburgh offers luxurious and comfortable rooms, some with castle views, designed with a blend of traditional and modern styles. The hotel emphasizes personal, "anything, anytime" service and a cozy atmosphere.

location: 1 Princes Street, Edinburgh, EH2 2EQ, Edinburgh, United Kingdom
place_name: The Balmoral, a Rocco Forte Hotel
resort_details:
One of Edinburgh’s most instantly recognizable landmarks, The Balmoral, a Rocco Forte Hotel was first conceived as a railway hotel — it sits adjacent to Edinburgh Waverley train station. Today, the Victorian-era baronial-style property remains one of the Scottish capital’s most luxurious stays.

The agelessly elegant, castle-like exterior of turrets, bows and balconies draws the eye from all directions, yet this grand façade gives way to an even more impressive interior. Classic yet contemporary, it’s an environment where soaring ceilings, sweeping staircases and shimmering chandeliers meet floral-print furnishings, soft pastel shades and stunning landscape photographs. All are arranged around the central dome-topped Palm Court — Scotland’s afternoon tea mecca. Kilted doormen and tartan-trousered reception staff provides a hearty Scottish welcome.

With an array of extraordinary fine-dining options, sumptuous spa facilities and an unbeatable location in the heart of Edinburgh — which also means remarkable panoramic views of the iconic castle — this luxe Rocco Forte hotel is the ideal base from which to explore the city.

room_details.room_Description: The Balmoral, a Rocco Forte Hotel, offers 168 rooms and 20 suites, blending traditional elegance with contemporary luxury. Rooms boast king-sized beds, marble bathrooms, and some offer castle views. Suites are spacious and grand, with luxurious amenities. The hotel is known for its cleanliness, luxurious amenities, standout dining, and attentive service, according to Tripadvisor.

location: Princes Street, Edinburgh, United Kingdom, EH1 2AB, Edinburgh, United Kingdom
place_name: The Caledonian Edinburgh, Curio Collection by Hilton
resort_details:
Opened in 1903 as a grand railway hotel in the heart of the city, The Caledonian Edinburgh, Curio Collection by Hilton maintains its magnificent rose-tinted sandstone façade, intricately sculpted stone arches and unmistakable whiff of Victorian grandeur. Visit today and you’ll find it also incorporates a level of luxury, comfort, service and sophistication that is distinctly 21st century.

Still affectionately known by locals as “The Caley,” the property boasts 235 sumptuously appointed rooms and suites, which form a “V” shape around the hotel’s beating heart, the lobby lounge. It also has a roomy gym and pool, a luxurious spa and a lavish whisky bar.

But the real highlight here is the food. This Edinburgh stay is home to two of the city’s top restaurants: Newly reimagined food and drink destination The Court, and acclaimed fine-dining venue Dean Banks at The Pompadour. What’s more, The Court also serves seasonal and indulgent afternoon tea, while The Caley Bar is home to a selection of bespoke cocktails, premium spirits and some of Scotland’s finest whiskies. One thing’s for sure, you won’t leave this hotel hungry.

location: 2 Greenside Place, Edinburgh, EH1 3AA, Edinburgh, United Kingdom
resort_details:
There is nowhere quite like The Glasshouse Hotel in the Scottish capital. A swath of sleek glass architecture weaves around a more than 170-year-old stone church in a breathtaking fashion guaranteed to excite design enthusiasts.

Lady Glenorchy Church had seen better days before it was resurrected in 2003 as a boutique hotel. Push beyond the grand Gothic façade of this central bolthole to find a modern marvel. The 77 bedrooms and suites have a fresh vibe, and the windows make the most of the light and help conjure up a feeling of airiness.

That sense of space is echoed throughout, not least on the expansive rooftop garden, which is a major draw. Other reasons to linger at The Glasshouse: it offers superb room service and a welcoming whisky lounge.

room_details.room_Description: The Glasshouse, Autograph Collection offers 5-star luxury accommodations in Edinburgh's city center, known for its blend of traditional and modern design. The hotel features gorgeously appointed rooms and suites, many with views of either Calton Hill or Edinburgh's New Town. Guests can enjoy amenities like a Snug Bar with over 160 exclusive Scotch whiskies and a Snug Lounge offering locally sourced Scottish cuisine.

location: Auchterarder, Perthshire, PH3 1NF, Perthshire, United Kingdom
resort_details:
The Gleneagles Hotel, a palatial escape deep in the Scottish glens, has seen it all since opening back in 1924. This grande dame has welcomed kings and queens, countless movie stars and also hosted the G8 summit of world leaders in 2005 and golf’s Ryder Cup in 2014.

You’ll find it all tucked into the resort’s sprawling 850 acres, from myriad eating and drinking venues to a trio of championship golf courses, tennis courts and facilities for country sports. And don’t forget the spa, complete with a bubbling outdoor hydrotherapy pool where you can watch the stars twinkle over the glens.

Unlike many of the country’s rural hotels, which are hidden deep in the remote Highlands, Gleneagles is very accessible from Scotland’s two largest cities, Edinburgh and Glasgow, and their international airports, though you can also still arrive romantically by train.

room_details.room_Description: The Gleneagles Hotel offers eight types of bedrooms and suites, each meticulously designed and equipped with modern amenities, inspired by the Perthshire countryside. These include the Estate Room, Manor Room, Country Room, and Double Rooms, along with various suites.

location: 19-21 George Street, Edinburgh, EH2 2PB GB, Edinburgh, United Kingdom
resort_details:
A recent multimillion-dollar refurbishment brought InterContinental Edinburgh The George, a dramatic historic Scottish grande dame, back to her striking best. Sprawled across a quintet of Georgian townhouses (dating back as far as 1775), this luxury hotel is the place for those who appreciate Old World style, grandeur and a touch of glamour.

The refresh has replenished and enhanced the solid oak, marble and leather interior with a classic color palette inspired by Scotland’s 19th-century landscape painters. The Printing Press Restaurant — once the abode of celebrated novelist Susan Ferrier — has been reborn into a steakhouse with a speakeasy vibe that doubles as a sophisticated breakfast venue. The popular Printing Press Bar and welcoming Burr & Co café complete the impressive ground-floor mix.

But what hasn’t changed is the property’s prime location on stately George Street, which hosts some of Edinburgh’s finest boutique shopping, and a stylish string of cafés, bars and restaurants.

location: Old Station Road, St. Andrews KY16 9SP, United Kingdom
resort_details:
Stepping into the Old Course Hotel, you feel an immediate connection to the history and charm of St. Andrews, the birthplace of golf. Situated along the iconic 17th hole of the Old Course, the hotel combines timeless elegance with modern luxury. Whether you're a golfer or not, the views of the course and West Sands Beach are breathtaking, especially at sunrise when the mist rolls in over the fairways.

Inside, the décor blends classic Scottish touches — think sparsely placed tartan fabrics and rich wood — with contemporary design. Rooms and suites are spacious, many offering private balconies and views of the course or the town’s medieval skyline. Kohler Waters Spa is a standout, with hydrotherapy pools and signature treatments designed to rejuvenate.

Dining here is an experience in itself, from the esteemed Road Hole Restaurant (editor’s note: the establishment and its bar are closed for renovations), featuring locally sourced ingredients and an impressive whisky collection, to the laid-back Jigger Inn, steeped in character and history.

room_details.room_Description: The Old Course Hotel features 175 rooms, including a penthouse suite, offering classically elegant and contemporary interiors designed by French designer Jacques Garcia. Rooms are situated alongside the 17th hole of the Old Course and boast views of the Scottish coastline and West Sands Beach. The hotel also includes a variety of amenities, such as a Kohler Waters Spa, six restaurants/bars, and access to The Duke's golf course.

location: Priestfield Road, Edinburgh, EH16 5UT Great Britian
resort_details:
Tuck into the Prestonfield House Edinburgh, a boutique property that looks as if it could have served as a setting in a Jane Austen novel. Each room boosts beautiful antiques, rich brocade fabrics, textured wall paper, soft lighting and bespoke furniture. Even the 20 acres of surrounding land offer surprises at every turn, be it with a beautiful statue, an 18-hole golf course or the elegant topiary.

The grand house was built in 1687, designed for Sir James Dick by the king's personal architect, Sir William Bruce. That's when the property garnered the name Prestonfield, a take on the original moniker, Priestfield.

A lot of the original furnishings deck the hotel’s historic public areas, including the Leather Room, Yellow Room, Tapestry Room and Whisky Room, an aptly named space where you can indeed indulge in a fine glass of scotch.

From these unique rooms and the exquisite suites to the well-stocked dining room to the luscious gardens, you could wander the luxury hotel and natural spaces for days, taking it all in without ever leaving the grounds.

room_details.room_Description: Prestonfield House, a luxury hotel in Edinburgh, offers a variety of room types, including Estate, Luxury, and Classic rooms, each with unique features and amenities. Rooms boast rich decor, like velvet textures and antique furnishings, with some featuring parkland views. All rooms have modern conveniences like free Wi-Fi, 24-hour room service, safes, air conditioning, and bathrobes

location: Heiton by Kelso, Roxburghshire, TD5 8JZ Scotland, Kelso, United Kingdom
resort_details:
Nestled in the heart of the Scottish Borders an hour outside of Edinburgh, luxury meets the rugged romance of the countryside at SCHLOSS Roxburghe Hotel & Golf Course. A stay at this 300-acre estate, formerly owned by the Duke of Roxburghe, feels like stepping back in time. Upon arrival, the sweeping driveway, lined with centuries-old trees, opens to a magnificent 12th-century manor, steeped in history yet impeccably restored. The grandeur of its stone façade contrasts beautifully with its warm, modern interiors — think crackling fireplaces, tartan accents and other nods to its Scottish heritage.

Rooms and suites blend stately elegance with contemporary comfort, offering views of rolling countryside or the estate’s championship golf course. Outdoor pursuits abound, from salmon fishing to clay pigeon shooting to brisk walks through the estate’s picturesque grounds. For relaxation, the spa is a sanctuary of serenity, featuring treatments inspired by local botanicals. 

Dining showcases the country’s rich bounty, with menus at Scottish bistro Charlie’s and fine dining Sunlaws drawing from the estate’s gardens, while the and whisky-forward Bar 1745 and the relaxed State Room Lounge round out the offerings.

A journey to The Torridon is like taking a step back in time. Nestled into the rolling green hills of the Scottish Highlands, the historic manor house stands sentinel over an enchanting landscape filled with towering pines, imposing mountains and a sprawling loch that is fittingly emblematic of this wild corner of the British Isles.

From the first glimpse, the 19th-century retreat oozes historic grandeur with classic Victorian architecture with turrets and a dramatic brick façade. Inside, impressive original features remain but are brought into the modern era with sleek contemporary furnishings and soothing natural tones. Creature comforts like an upscale whisky bar and indulgent deep-soaking tubs add to the extravagant ambiance, while a host of outdoor pursuits like hiking, fishing and kayaking ensure you can make the most of your spectacular surroundings.

room_details.room_Description: The Torridon in the Scottish Highlands offers a variety of rooms and suites, each designed to blend Scottish heritage with modern comforts. Rooms boast amenities like premium bedding, bathrobes, free WiFi, and safes. Many rooms offer stunning views of Loch Torridon and the surrounding mountains. The hotel also provides facilities like a terrace, a garden, and laundry services.

location: Parque Nacional Iguazú S/N, 3370 Puerto Iguazú, Argentina
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Gran Meliá Iguazú
Strategically located inside Iguazu National Park, Gran Meliá Iguazú features an infinity pool and spa facilities. Has 3 restaurant, and 4 Bars.

Soberly decorated, rooms at Gran Meliá Iguazú feature large private balconies. Some of them overlook the waterfalls, and some others enjoy a jungle view.

A buffet breakfast is served daily. International dishes can be enjoyed at Merkado Restaurant, Amaro Restaurant or at Restaurant and Pool Bar Gala, all with overlooking the falls. Fine drinks can be ordered at the 4 bars.

Spa facilities include a hot tub, a hammam, and a sauna. Guests can request massage sessions for an extra cost, unwind on the sun loungers by the pool or hike through the lush garden surrounding the property. The fitness center is available without charge.

Free parking is available upon request. Gran Meliá Iguazú is 6.2 mi from Puerto Iguazu airport. Shuttles can be arranged

room_details.room_Description: Gran Meliá Iguazú offers various room types, including Deluxe Rooms with king or two single beds, and suites like the Junior Suite Red Level with waterfall views. Some rooms offer Red Level access, a VIP service with extra amenities and personalized attention. All rooms feature modern amenities, private balconies, and views of the jungle or Iguazu Falls

location: Posadas, 1232, Retiro, C1011ABF Buenos Aires, Argentina
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Sofitel Buenos Aires Recoleta
Featuring polished marble floors and stylish rooms, Sofitel Buenos Aires Recoleta offers impeccable 5-star style and services.

Air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screens with satellite TV and mini-bars. Rooms are styled in cream-colored hues, have stylish mahogany furniture, and floor-to-ceiling curtains. Bathrooms have marble fittings and include separate bath and shower.

A full buffet breakfast is offered. The on-site restaurant serves contemporary Argentinean cuisine. There is 24-hour front desk assistance and airport shuttles are available for an extra charge.

Sofitel Buenos Aires Recoleta is 13 blocks from Colon Theater and historic Recoleta Cemetery is 8 blocks away. Jorge Newbery Airport is 4.3 mi from the property.

room_details.room_Description: The Sofitel Buenos Aires Recoleta offers a range of stylish and comfortable rooms, including Superior and Deluxe rooms. These rooms feature amenities like air conditioning, flat-screen TVs with satellite, minibars, and bathrooms with separate tubs and showers, as well as marble fittings. The hotel also provides suites with panoramic views and other luxurious options.
