The hotel also provides suites with panoramic views and other luxurious options.

location: Selva Yriapú S/N, Puerto Iguazu 3370 Argentina
resort_details: "A rainforest treehouse beside the biggest waterfalls in the world" - Conde Nast Traveller. Our 14-Villa lodge is located in a secluded part of the jungle and 20 minutes from the Falls, Awasi is the only all-inclusive, carbon neutral luxury lodge in the area that provides a truly tailor-made experience. Each villa is given a private guide and 4WD to experience the entire region as it has never been seen before. As a part of Relais & Chateaux, Awasi’s chefs showcase the best local flavors, making for an unforgettable gastronomic journey

room_details.room_Description: Awasi Iguazu's rooms, or villas, offer a luxurious jungle experience. The hotel features 13 villas, each with a living area, coffee corner, private terrace, and plunge pool. They also have a bathroom with a bathtub and walk-in shower. One of the villas, the Master Villa, is larger and includes two bedrooms and two bathrooms.

location: Av. Siete Lagos 4505, 8407 Villa La Angostura, Argentina
resort_details:
Located in Villa la Angostura, Correntoso Lake & River Hotel offers peaceful accommodations at the mouth of the Correntoso River. It features stylish rooms. Wi-Fi and parking are free.

The rooms at Correntoso River Hotel enjoy contemporary decor.  Each is equipped with a modern private en suite. Many rooms boast views of Nahuel Huapi Lake, while some have a private terrace.

Correntoso Lake Hotel has an in-house restaurant and bar, where light snacks and refreshing drinks are served. For those feeling more indulgent, room service is available for private in-room dining.

location: Av. Bustillo Km 25, R8401ALN San Carlos de Bariloche, Argentina
resort_details:
Prime Location: Llao Llao Resort, Golf-Spa in San Carlos De Bariloche offers a private beach area and beachfront access. Guests enjoy stunning views of the surrounding mountains and lakes.

Exceptional Facilities: The resort features a spa, sauna, fitness center, sun terrace, water sports, and a year-round outdoor and indoor swimming pool. Additional amenities include a tennis court, hot tub, and games room.

Comfortable Accommodations: Rooms offer air-conditioning, balconies, and private bathrooms with free toiletries. Guests can relax in the hot tub or enjoy the view from the terrace.

Dining Experience: The family-friendly restaurant serves American and Argentinian cuisine with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. Breakfast includes local specialties, fresh pastries, and a variety of beverages.

Nearby Attractions: Located 24 mi from San Carlos De Bariloche Airport, the resort is close to Capilla de San Eduardo (9-minute walk) and Cerro Catedral Ski Resort (14 mi).

room_details.room_Description: Llao Llao Hotel & Resort offers a variety of room types, including standard rooms, junior suites, and deluxe studios with lake views. The resort is undergoing renovations, so some rooms may be more modern than others, and the historic Bustillo Wing has undergone a recent renovation, according to a Tripadvisor review. Rooms typically feature amenities like Egyptian cotton sheets, premium bedding, down comforters, and minibars.

location: Avda. Corrientes 280, C1043AAP Buenos Aires, Argentina
resort_details:
The NH Jousten is a 4-star hotel in the core of downtown Buenos Aires, only one block from the traditional Florida Street and the Galerías Pacífico Mall. Wi-Fi is free.

In a traditional building with baroque décor, the NH Jousten invites its guests to rest in its quiet rooms and to enjoy panoramic city views from the top-floor suites.

The elegant Aralar Restaurant specializes in Spanish cuisine, serving exquisite dishes and a select list of Argentinean wines in an elegant atmosphere with dark wood tables and comfortable armchairs.

A café Bar is also available on site. Room service is provided 24 hours a day.

location: Calle Arroyo 841 Retiro, Buenos Aires C1007AAB Argentina

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Alvear Art Hotel
Alvear Art Hotel is a modern 17-floor building located in the financial, commercial and cultural heart of the city, next to the historic Plaza San Martin. It is only a few steps away from Santa Fe Avenue and Florida Street, with their countless stores, art galleries and the theater district. It is a nonsmoking hotel where free Wi-Fi is provided.

This urban designed hotel has elegant and contemporary style rooms, with neutral colored silk curtains, luxurious marble bathrooms, jacuzzi, and Egyptian cotton bed linen.

At Alvear Art Hotel you can enjoy the panoramic city views at the Spa and Fitness Center that features a vitality pool, solarium, sauna, steam bath, and high- tech fitness equipment. Not to be missed is the contemporary cuisine served at Contraluz Restaurant, as well as the signature drinks at Artesano Bar.

Alvear Art Hotel is 1640 feet the Colon Theater, from the Obelisk, and from Galerias Pacifico shopping mall. San Martin square is 984 feet away and Ezeiza international airport is 12 mi from the property.

We'd like to inform our guests that our pool located on the 17th floor will be closed from Feb 3 to Feb 9 due to upgrades.

room_details.room_Description: The Alvear Art Hotel in Buenos Aires offers luxurious accommodations with a contemporary design. Its rooms feature amenities like iPod docking stations, minibars, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and 42-inch LCD televisions with premium channels. Bathrooms include separate bathtubs and showers with jetted tubs, rainfall showerheads, bathrobes, slippers, and bidets.

location: Av. Alvear 1891, Recoleta, C1129AAA Buenos Aires, Argentina
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Alvear Palace Hotel - Leading Hotels of the World
The Alvear Palace is a 5-star hotel located in the stylish neighborhood of La Recoleta, surrounded by restaurants, shops and only five minutes away from the financial district. It is a smoking free property with free WiFi.

The Hotel has grand French-inspired public areas and gracious 192 guestrooms and suites decorated in modern French style. The recently renewed top floors unveil 15 spacious, contemporary designed suites. Exclusive service for rooms on 10th and 11th floor, Alvear Suite and higher categories, where a team of butlers assists guests, making their stay a unique and memorable experience.

A buffet breakfast is available each morning at the property. Dine at the recently open Alvear Grill, offering a renewed interpretation of major identity local cuisine. The restaurants and bars are traditional meeting points in Buenos Aires, with a warm ambiance and exquisite international cuisine. New areas on the uppermost levels, with great city views include an indoor heated pool with pool bar and solariums. It also has a luxurious Spa and Fitness Center that features a vitality pool, sauna, steam bath, body and face treatments, kinesis and high- tech fitness equipment.

Colon Theater is a 19-minute walk from Alvear Palace Hotel, while Museum of Latin American Art of Buenos Aires MALBA is 1.1 mi away.

room_details.room_Description: The Alvear Palace Hotel in Buenos Aires offers a variety of room types, including Standard rooms, Suites, and Palace Premier rooms. Standard rooms are around 35 sq m and start at $363-$403 daily. Suites range from around $420-$3,366 daily and can be up to 150 sq m. Palace Premier rooms offer features like a private indoor hot tub, air conditioning, and connecting rooms, and are 398 sq ft.

The 1828 Smart Hotel unites contemporary elegance and sophisticated design with Argentine warmth.  Located in a vibrant neighborhood, you'll be steps from major tourist attractions, restaurants, and shopping.
 This award-winning hotel with a mention of Michelin offers a heated outdoor pool with sun loungers, sun terrace, gym facilities, spa and room service at no extra charge.

The breakfast buffet is offered until 12pm and then a snack bar will be available to enjoy during the afternoon. There is a 24-hour reception.

All rooms at 1828 Smart Hotel have a mini-bar, soundproofed windows and smart TVs.  They are equipped with air conditioning, adjustable lights and electronic curtains. The bathrooms include anti-steam mirrors, hair dryers and toiletries.

1828 Smart Hotel is 1640 feet from Plaza Armenia, 4 mi from Plaza de Mayo and 4.7 mi from Puerto Madero. Ezeiza international airport 19 mi and 3.7 mi from Aeroparque Jorge Newbery.

When Staying at 1828 Smart Hotel you can enjoy the following special amenities: Welcome drink,Complimentary snacks and tea service every afternoon at the bar, Wine dispenser that charges straight to the room bill, Nespresso machine in every room with 2 complimentary pods, Bar & light menu available 24hs .

room_details.room_Description: The 1828 Smart Hotel offers a variety of rooms, including Luxury Suites and Deluxe Rooms, each designed with a focus on luxury, comfort, and modern amenities. The rooms feature avant-garde designs, calming colors, and elegant bathrooms, including Italian-marble bathrooms in some cases. Additionally, the hotel boasts a Spa Boutique, a Piano Lounge, and a water cascade.

location: 2352 Coles Bay Rd, Coles Bay, Freycinet, Tasmania 7215 Australia
resort_details: Saffire Freycinet is Australia’s luxury lodge on Tasmania’s East Coast adjacent to Coles Bay and overlooking the Freycinet Peninsula, famed for the iconic Wineglass Bay. Delivering sophisticated and intimate style and an inspirational experience, our Tasmanian accommodation blends mankind and nature with breathtaking beauty. Featuring 20 luxurious suites, exclusive day spa, restaurant, guest lounge and bar, this five-star plus luxury lodge experience is a celebration of the art of service, internal and external wellbeing, local culinary delights, ancient landscapes and abundant wildlife.

location: 1 Lagoon Road, Lord Howe Island 2898 Australia
resort_details: Pinetrees Lodge is the perfect place to relax and escape the stress of everyday life. We provide exceptional meals, personalised service, elegant accommodation and a beautiful waterfront location on Lagoon Beach. Our boatshed is a great place for a shower after your swim in the lagoon, or for a cold beer or champagne while watching the sunset. Enjoy world-class snorkelling, diving, surfing, walking, kayaking and gold, or just relax on Australia's most beautiful island. Stay with us once and you'll understand why so many guests come back to visit every year.

location: Lot 11, East Bedarra Bedarra Island, 4852 Bedarra Island, Australia
resort_details:
Experience World-class Service at Bedarra Beach House
Prime Beachfront Location: Bedarra Beach House in Dunk offers a private beach area and direct beachfront access. Guests enjoy sea views and a spacious terrace with a balcony. The property features a lush garden and an outdoor seating area.

Comfortable Accommodations: The holiday home includes one bedroom and two bathrooms. The living room offers a sofa bed and parquet floors. Amenities include a fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, and free WiFi.

Outdoor Activities: Guests can engage in fishing, canoeing, hiking, and diving. The surrounding area provides opportunities for relaxation and exploration.

Highly Rated by Guests: Bedarra Beach House is highly rated for its location, ensuring a memorable stay.

location: Lagoon Road, Lord Howe Island 2898 Australia
resort_details: Refreshingly off the radar, Capella is Lord Howe’s premium luxury retreat. Combining contemporary design with glorious natural surroundings, Capella’s relaxed aesthetic lets the true stars shine: views of the ocean and Mounts Gower and Lidgbird. Nine suites welcome the outside in and feature custom furnishings, island-themed artworks and private decks, many with plunge spas to create a sense of barefoot luxury. Fine dining is a highlight and menus champion a bounty of local seafood and fresh regional produce. A short flight from Australia’s east coast transports visitors to a real ‘treasure island’. The World Heritage-listed site is a paradise of rainforests and beaches and recreations span mountain walks and exploration of the world’s southernmost coral reef. Nestled among swaying Kentia palms, the petite Capella Spa encourages dreamy surrender to island-inspired treatments.

room_details.room_Description: Capella Lodge offers nine contemporary, island-styled suites designed to blend seamlessly with Lord Howe Island's natural environment. These suites feature spacious, light-filled interiors with king beds, custom furnishings, artworks, and private decks, creating a sense of relaxed luxury. Some suites also include private plunge spas.

resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Orpheus Island Lodge
Offering luxurious accommodation with free Wi-Fi at the lodge, free meals and a private patio boasting stunning Coral Sea views, Orpheus Island Lodge is surrounded by serene, white sand beaches and 1,368 hectares of National Park.

Guests can take a dip in an infinity pool or relax with a unique, indigenous-inspired treatment at the Gwandalan Day Spa. The resort has a bar and restaurant with an alfresco-style dining area. Accommodation rates include all gourmet meals prepared by the head chef, using local produce and fresh seafood.

Located just 80 km north of Townsville, Orpheus Island offers a secluded paradise escape set on the waters of the Great Barrier Reef. It is a 30-minute scenic helicopter ride from Townsville Airport or a 1.5 hour ride from Cairns. The surrounding World Heritage-listed Marine Park boasts snorkelling and diving with over a thousand species of tropical reef fish.

Each of the refurbished beachfront rooms offer bright and modern décor, a 32-inch LED flat-screen TV and an iPod docking station. Crisp white bed linens and Li’tya guest amenities are provided.

Your inclusions feature activities such as a daily Orpheus experience, which includes snorkelling, fishing, and island cruises.

location: Hanson Bay Road, Karatta, Kangaroo Island, South Australia 5223 Australia
resort_details: Celebrated around the world as the pioneer of experiential luxury in Australia, the new iteration of Southern Ocean Lodge has returned to crown the wildly beautiful clifftops on Kangaroo Island. The new-look luxury lodge bears a similar footprint to its award-winning original, complete with breathtaking views of the Southern Ocean, magnificent Great Room and string of luxurious guest suites easing along the coastline. Combining contemporary design, world-class dining and a personal connection with nature, Southern Ocean Lodge celebrates the resilient spirit of Kangaroo Island, its wildlife and its community.

room_details.room_Description: Southern Ocean Lodge offers 25 suites with panoramic ocean views, including the Flinders Suite, which features a bar, sunken lounge, and fireplace. The suites also include walk-in wardrobes and spacious bathrooms with sea views. Larger options include the Remarkable Suite, Osprey Suite, and Baillie Pavilions, some with plunge pools, fireplaces, and horizon-edge pools.

location: Yulara Drive, Yulara, 0872 Ayers Rock, Australia
resort_details:
Set in the secluded surroundings of Uluru-Kata Tjuta National Park, Longitude 131 offers luxury tents with panoramic views of Ayers Rock (Uluru). It features an outdoor swimming pool with a terrace.

The accommodation at Longitude is air-conditioned and has a CD player, minibar and tea and coffee making facilities. Each of these 5-star tents is eco-friendly and offers guests stunning views over the park.

The property offers an exclusive touring program designed for guests. Guests can also enjoy complimentary meals and selected beverages during their stay, served at the Dune House Restaurant or under the desert stars at Table 131.

Longitude 131 is situated just over 2 km from Yulara. A free return airport transfer service is available from Ayers Rock Airport (Uluru, Connellan Airport) only.

room_details.room_Description: Longitude 131°, a luxury camp in Uluru-Kata Tjuta National Park in Australia, offers 16 tented pavilions, each with views of Uluru. These pavilions range in size, with the Dune Pavilion being the most expansive, offering a total of 153 square meters, according to a review on smh.com.au. The tents feature king beds, modern amenities, and artworks by local indigenous artists, and are designed with the landscape in mind.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at RACV Torquay Resort
Boasting a tennis court, indoor pool and a fitness centre, RACV Torquay Resort offers accommodation in Torquay, just 1 km from the beachfront. The resort offers guests total relaxation with a spa and wellness centre as well as a sauna. Free WiFi, a 24-hour front desk and a business centre are also available. The property is located adjacent to the Torquay golf course.

All rooms at RACV Torquay Resort come with air conditioning, a seating area, a flat-screen TV, a safety deposit box and a private bathroom with a bath. Also included is a coffee machine (not in all rooms), while selected rooms have a balcony and others also feature sea views. Guest rooms will provide guests with a fridge.

A range of dining options is available for guests on-site. Number One restaurant offers meals using quality local ingredients and breakfast is available daily here and includes Buffet and Gluten-free options. White's Paddock is a relaxed venue offering salads, sandwiches, seafood and more and features views across the golf course and coastline. You can also relax in Harding's Lounge and enjoy a drink or light meal.

A games room is also available at the property where you can play table tennis and billiards.

Lorne is a 45-minute drive from RACV Torquay Resort. The nearest airport is Avalon Airport, 45 km from the property.

location: 7 Hickson Road, Sydney CBD, 2000 Sydney, Australia
resort_details:
Park Hyatt Sydney perfectly personifies contemporary luxury with its coveted location between the Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge. Reminiscent of an exclusive harbourside residence, the 155-room hotel offers intimate surroundings with architecture, art and design that reflect the Australian landscape.

Each of the 155 rooms offers a sense of residential elegance, offering a harmonious blend of modern luxury and the allure of waterside living. The interiors are thoughtfully curated to evoke a natural aesthetic, boasting rich layers of chocolate, cream and beige hues. Luxurious furnishings and fittings, adorned with naturally-textured fabrics, grace the space, while designer lighting illuminates the surroundings.

At Park Hyatt Sydney, personalised service reaches unparalleled heights. Dedicated butlers anticipate and cater to esteemed guests with round-the-clock service. Around every corner within the rooms, suites and hotel’s public areas, guests are able to admire the hallmarks of the Australian art scene with specially commissioned masterpieces by local artists.

An iconic precinct of historical significance, The Rocks is 6 minutes away on foot. Circular Quay, a host to ferry quays, bus stops and railway station is a 10-minute stroll. For those arriving from afar, the Sydney International Airport is a mere 25-minute drive away.

room_details.room_Description: Park Hyatt Sydney offers a variety of guest rooms and suites, all known for their luxury and stunning views of Sydney Harbour and the Opera House. Rooms feature contemporary interiors, ambient lighting, and polished furnishings, with upgrades including private balconies, living areas, and kitchens. The hotel also boasts 24-hour butler service, a rooftop pool, and a spa with various treatments.

location: 11 Hickson Road, Sydney CBD, 2000 Sydney, Australia
resort_details:
Nestled alongside the Sydney Harbour Bridge, Pier One Sydney Harbour is built on the water with its own private pontoon and panoramic Sydney Harbour views. This unique federation style accommodation is within 15 minutes' walk of a range of shopping and dining options.

All rooms and suites feature contemporary décor with a nautical theme. Each room or suite includes a flat-screen TV and a minibar. Some accommodation offers a spa bath and a sofa bed.

Located in the heart of Sydney's historic Rocks precinct, Pier One Sydney Harbour is 5 minutes' walk from the Sydney Theatre Company and the Rocks' cafes and nightlife.It is 20 minutes' walk from the Sydney Opera House and the Royal Botanic Gardens.

PIER dining offers a relaxed ambience and captivating connection to the harbour with a fresh seafood lead menu.

location: Corner of Phillip and Bridge Streets, Sydney CBD, 2000 Sydney, Australia
resort_details:
Located in a historic 19th-Century building in Circular Quay, near The Rocks, the 5-star InterContinental Hotel overlooks the iconic Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge.

All air-conditioned rooms at the InterContinental have views of the city or the harbour. Each room includes satellite TV and a mini-bar. The Botanic Gardens of Sydney are less than 5 minutes' walk away via Macquarie Street. Circular Quay Ferries are just a 2-minute walk away, convenient for those who need to travel across Sydney Harbour, or enjoy one of Sydney's famous whale-watching tours.

Complete with a $120 million refurbishment in 2022, elevated guest rooms, public spaces, and a new era of luxury awaits at InterContinental Sydney.

location: 176 Cumberland Street, The Rocks, Sydney CBD, 2000 Sydney, Australia
resort_details:
Wake up to breathtaking views of the iconic Sydney Opera House, the Harbour Bridge or Darling Harbour each morning. You will be spoiled for choice at the Shangri-La Hotel, with a day spa, fitness centre and indoor pool at your disposal.

The Shangri-la Sydney is located in the historic Rocks area, where Europeans first settled in Australia in 1788. This enviable location is just 5 minutes’ walk from both the Sydney Opera House and the MCA (Museum of Contemporary Art).

After a day of sightseeing, you can relax in the bathtub of your lavish marble bathroom. All rooms include free Wi-Fi and an iPod dock, as well as fluffy bathrobes and slippers.

CHI, The Spa offers a luxurious escape in its private spa suites, with a range of body treatments and massages on offer. The hotel also offers a hot tub, sauna and sun deck so you can make the most of your stay.

The award-winning Altitude Restaurant boasts magnificent views of the harbour and the New York-inspired Blu Bar on 36 is the perfect spot for a creative cocktail.

place_name: Hotel Amigo, A Rocco Forte Hotel
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Rocco Forte Hotel Amigo
The 5-star Hotel Amigo boasts elegant rooms with designer features, on the corner of Grand Place. It combines modern facilities, a gym and an award-winning restaurant with a picturesque historic setting.

Flat-screen interactive cable TV, a work desk and a minibar stocked with drinks and Galler chocolates are provided in the rooms at Rocco Forte Hotel Amigo. Each air-conditioned room has a seating area and a luxurious bathroom with mosaic details.

The Manneken Pis Statue is only 200 metres away. Le Sablon antiques area and the Magritte Museum are both less than a 15-minute walk from Rocco Forte Hotel. Bourse Metro Station is only a 5-minute walk away.

The award-winning Ristorante Bocconi serves Italian dishes and Mediterranean cuisine in an elegant yet relaxed setting.

Amigo offers a range of extra services including concierges, 24-hour room services and a valet parking service.

Elegant Accommodation: Juliana Hotel Brussels in Brussels offers a 5-star experience with spa facilities, a wellness centre, sauna, fitness centre, terrace, restaurant, bar, indoor swimming pool, and free WiFi.

Comfortable Amenities: Guests enjoy air-conditioning, private bathrooms, bathrobes, tea and coffee makers, minibars, and work desks. Additional features include baths, dining areas, and sofas.

Dining Options: The family-friendly restaurant serves French and Belgian cuisine for lunch. Breakfast includes continental, buffet, à la carte, and vegetarian options with champagne, local specialities, warm dishes, and fresh pastries.

Prime Location: Located 20 km from Brussels Airport, the hotel is near attractions such as the Belgian Comics Strip Centre (5-minute walk), Grand Place (800 metres), and Manneken Pis (11-minute walk). Highly rated for staff and service support.

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Steigenberger Icon Wiltcher's
Elegant Accommodation: Steigenberger Icon Wiltcher's in Brussels offers a 5-star experience with spa facilities, a fitness centre, terrace, restaurant, bar, and free WiFi throughout the property.

Comfortable Amenities: Guests enjoy air-conditioning, private bathrooms, bathrobes, minibars, and city views. Additional features include yoga and fitness classes, beauty services, and electric vehicle charging.

Dining Options: The traditional restaurant serves European cuisine for lunch and dinner, offering continental, buffet, vegetarian, vegan, halal, gluten-free, and Asian breakfasts with champagne, juice, fresh pastries, and more.

Prime Location: Located 16 km from Brussels Airport, the hotel is near attractions such as the Horta Museum (13-minute walk) and Palais de Justice (less than 1 km). Guests appreciate the attentive staff and convenient location.

location: 69 1/4 Miles, Benque Viejo Rd, Western Highway, 00000 San Ignacio, Belize
resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Ka'ana Resort & Spa
Set in beautiful gardens, Ka'ana Resort & Spa features a spa, an infinity pool and charming rooms with terraces. Located outside San Ignacio, it offers excursions to nearby national parks, caves and the rainforest.

The spacious rooms at Ka'ana Resort & Spa are set in small houses overlooking the tropical gardens. All rooms have a small seating area with an iPod dock, flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi.

La Ceiba Restaurant serves gourmet Belize cuisine using organic produce from the Ka’ana’s gardens. Private dining is available next to the pool, on the terrace or in the wine cellar.

Ka'ana Resort & Spa spa offers treatments using sugar, cocoa and coffee. Holistic therapies and massage are also available.

The property is within 50 km of 4 forest reserves and a 10-minute drive from the border with Guatemala.

room_details.room_Description: Ka'ana Resort, a luxury eco-resort in Belize, offers a variety of accommodations, including Master Suites and villas, all with private outdoor spaces and modern amenities like air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and flat-screen TVs. Many rooms feature garden or pool views and are located in small, hacienda-style buildings or open-concept villas. Some rooms also offer a private outdoor shower and enclosed garden.

resort_details: Luxury and unspoiled beauty on the Caribbean Sea. Turtle Inn is a true labor of love. Less than a year after Francis and Eleanor Coppola acquired this beachside refuge in 2001, it was swept out to sea by the forces of Hurricane Iris. Turning disaster into triumph, the Coppola's led a two-year reclamation project, creating a magnificent resort that is consistently ranked among the best in Central and South America.This 28-room seafront hideaway combines natural wonders with luxury style. Accommodations are in individual thatched cottages, decorated with handcrafted Balinese furnishings and naturally cooled by the ever-present sea breezes. Just steps beyond your private deck, the beach dissolves into the Caribbean Sea. In addition, the resort has two infinity swimming pools, a spa, dive shop and three restaurants.

room_details.room_Description: Turtle Inn in Belize offers 25 individually designed, thatched-roof cottages, each with Balinese furnishings and private balconies or patios overlooking the ocean. The rooms are naturally cooled by sea breezes and include amenities like minibars, refrigerators, and hair dryers. They also feature outdoor showers and are decorated with Balinese furnishings, enhancing the resort's luxurious and relaxing atmosphere.

location: Mile 20 Placenica Road, Placencia Village, Belize
resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Itz'ana Resort & Residences
Facing the beachfront in Placencia Village, Itz'ana Resort & Residences has a bar and a garden. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, a 24-hour front desk and room service, along with free WiFi throughout the property. The resort features family rooms.

Guests at the resort can enjoy a continental breakfast.

Itz'ana Resort & Residences offers a terrace. Guests at the accommodation will be able to enjoy activities in and around Seine Bight Village, like cycling.

Placencia Village is 6 km from Itz'ana Resort & Residences.

room_details.room_Description: Itz'ana Resort in Placencia, Belize offers a range of contemporary luxury rooms and suites, including villas, with features like private plunge pools, wraparound terraces, and sea or pool views. They have luxurious amenities, modern furnishings, and stylish interiors, ensuring a comfortable and relaxing stay.

location: Mountain Pine Ridge Reserve Cayo District, San Ignacio, Belize
resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Blancaneaux Lodge by Francis Ford Coppola
Set within the Mountain Pine Ridge Forest Reserve, Blancaneaux Lodge by Francis Ford Coppola offers an outdoor pool, organic gardens and 2 restaurants. Each charming bungalow and villa has a balcony with wonderful river views.

The luxurious bungalows and villas feature a spacious seating area, a mini-fridge, free WiFi and an iPod dock. Villas also have a kitchenette. The en suite bathrooms include a bath or shower and a hairdryer.

Blancaneaux Lodge by Francis Ford Coppola is surrounded by pine trees and has its own orchid trail. The property can arrange hiking to a nearby waterfall and caves. Free bikes are also available to explore the surroundings.

Free parking is provided at Blancaneaux Lodge by Francis Ford Coppola. San Ignacio town is around 30 km away, while the Guatemalan border is within 50 km. Belize City can be reached in 2.5 hours by car.

location: Sea Grape Drive, PO Box 266, San Pedro, Belize
resort_details:
Beachfront Location: Alaia Belize, Autograph Collection in San Pedro offers direct beachfront access and stunning sea views. Guests can relax on the sun terrace or take a dip in the rooftop swimming pool.

Comfortable Accommodations: Rooms feature air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and modern amenities. Additional comforts include balconies, terraces, and free WiFi throughout the property.

Dining Experience: The family-friendly restaurant serves American, Caribbean, and international cuisines. Dining options include a buffet, à la carte, and live music.

Leisure Facilities: The hotel provides a fitness centre, spa facilities, and an outdoor play area. Guests can also enjoy scuba diving in the surrounding waters.

Guest Services: Highly rated for its attentive staff and excellent service support. Free airport shuttle service is available from San Pedro Airport, 1000 metres away.

room_details.room_Description: Alaia Belize offers a variety of luxurious accommodations, including Vista Studios, Reef House suites, and Oceanfront Villas. The resort features a range of amenities and services, including a spa, multiple restaurants and bars, and a dive shop, according to the Marriott website.

location: L.G. Smith Boulevard #55B, Palm-Eagle Beach, Aruba
resort_details:
Set on the white sands of the award-winning Eagle Beach, this adults-only (18+) boutique resort features an ocean-front restaurant with spectacular views and healthy dining options. Complimentary breakfast and free WiFi are provided.

The rooms and suites at Bucuti & Tara Beach Resort Aruba offer style and comfort, with cable TV, air purifiers, dehumidifiers, a microwave, and a fridge.

The oceanfront, SandBar is open exclusively to their guests. The resort offers various complimentary wellness programs for their guest to experience.

Romantic dining on the beach in a private palapa can be reserved.

An air-conditioned fitness center has a beautiful view of the courtyard garden and nearby beach. An outdoor pool and concierge services are also available.

Guests can relax with a massage or treatment in the Purun Spa. Twice per week guest can enjoy a free movie night on the beach.

The resort is designed for people seeking serenity and romance, and proactively cultivates an atmosphere that lets peace and relaxation come naturally. The resort minimizes distractions by focusing on individual guests and, therefore, does not reserve groups. To maximize comfort the resort does not accept a reservation for more than two rooms, with two people per room.

The Bucuti & Tara Beach Resort is near the Alhambra Casino and shopping center. Reina Beatrix International Airport is 8 km away.

location: L. G. Smith Boulevard 107, 0000 Palm-Eagle Beach, Aruba
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Ritz-Carlton, Aruba
The beachfront Ritz-Carlton, Aruba tempts guests with free WiFi, 2 outdoor pools and spa in Noord. It lies 8.9 km from the Archaeological Museum of Aruba.

The rooms are bright and modern. They have splashes of bright colour and elegant furniture. Each comes with a private bathroom with free toiletries, a minibar and flat-screen TV. There is air conditioning, a balcony, an iPod docking station and a DVD player. Towels and linens are included.

Guests can enjoy the children’s activities and 3 onsite restaurants. The Ritz-Carlton, Aruba offers 24-hour front desk assistance. The hotel also offers onsite water sports facilities and a casino. There is a business centre, retail shop and concierge service.

Queen Beatrix International Airport lies 11.7 km from The Ritz-Carlton, Aruba.

room_details.room_Description: The Ritz-Carlton, Aruba offers 320 rooms and suites, including 55 suites with private balconies, all featuring colorful, island-inspired décor and ocean views. The resort also has a Club Level with personalized service, a spacious 2-bedroom suite option, and classic amenities in the Club Lounge.

location: J.E. Irausquin Blvd 55, Palm-Eagle Beach, Aruba
resort_details:
Located on Aruba’s widest beach this intimate luxury boutique resort features 72 deluxe rooms for romantic, culinary and rejuvenating getaways,  a Caribbean-Balinese spa and premium all-inclusive option.

The elegant rooms at Manchebo Beach Resort and Spa are styled with Caribbean colors. Each is equipped with a microwave (on request) and refrigerator. A 40-inch LCDTV, iPod docking station and free WiFi are also included.

Spa del Sol has a steam room and massages are offered in the tropical outdoor gazebos. Guests can also relax by the outdoor pool or workout in the gym. Daily complimentary Yoga & Pilates are offered for guests.

Manchebo Beach Resort offers concierge services as well as on-site car rental. Multiple beach cabanas including lounge chairs and towels are available. This property is a yoga retreat destination.

Beach Resort Manchebo’s Pega-Pega Café and Beach Bar features sandwiches, poke-bowls and Caribbean cocktails.  Live music is performed on theme-nights at Ike's Bistro - Mediterranean & Caribbean where breakfast a-la carte is served and offers fine dining in a tropical poolside setting. The Chophouse is open daily for the best chops in the neighborhood and Sushi is served from Tuesday - Saturday in The Omakase Sushi bar located inside the Chophouse.

location: J.E. Irausquin Boulevard 85, Palm-Eagle Beach, Aruba
resort_details:
Offering an unrivaled oceanfront location, direct beach access, a full-service spa, exciting casino action and gourmet dining, this Palm Beach, Aruba resort provides everything needed for an unforgettable stay.

The newly enhanced rooms at Hyatt Regency Aruba Resort Spa and Casino feature designs inspired by the teal blues of Aruba and welcoming furnishings that include 65” flat-screen TV, Hyatt Grand Beds and roomy bathrooms that feature stone and quartz.

An endless variety of recreational activities can be found moments from the Hyatt Regency Aruba Resort and Casino, including deep-sea fishing, sailing and snorkeling. The resort also has two pools, the outdoor pool complex which is 8,000 sq. ft. with two story waterslide and a 4,951 sq. ft. adults-only pool.

Guests at the Aruba Hyatt Regency can also relax with a massage or facial from the newly enhanced on-site ZoiA Spa, enjoy a yoga class or browse for gifts in the on-site shops. The resort's casino features popular slot machines and card games.

room_details.room_Description: The Hyatt Regency Aruba Resort & Casino offers a range of room types with varying views and amenities. Standard rooms include two queen beds, resort views, and a furnished balcony. Some rooms feature oceanfront views or sunset views with a balcony.

location: L.G. Smith Boulevard # 101, Palm Beach Palm-Eagle Beach, Aruba
resort_details:
The Tradewinds Club offers an exclusive experience at the Aruba Marriott Resort, with elite adult-only privileges & impeccable service throughout stay.

This beachfront resort faces Palm Beach and is a short walk from Tierra Del Sol Golf and Country Club. It offers the 24-hour Stellaris Casino, 7 dining options, an outdoor swimming pool and spa. WiFi access is free in the common areas but paid in the rooms. This Resort holds a Four Diamond Award.

The rooms at the Aruba Marriott Resort and Stellaris Casino have a balcony, a flat-screen TV with in-room movies and a coffee maker. The en suite bathroom offers a double vanity sink, a hairdryer and bathrobes.

Guests can enjoy steaks and classic desserts at Ruth’s Chris Steak House. The Aruba Marriott also features international cuisine at La Vista, which offers panoramic ocean views. You can also enjoy a romantic dinner at "Atardi" perfectly set to enjoy sunsets.

This Aruba Marriott also features an outdoor swimming pool and hot tub.  A car rental desk and a gift shop are located on site.

room_details.room_Description: The Aruba Marriott Resort & Stellaris Casino offers individually furnished rooms with amenities like premium bedding, wet bars, and laptop-friendly workspaces. Each room includes a flat-screen TV, coffee maker, double vanity sink, hairdryer, and bathrobes, along with views of the ocean or lush gardens, and a private balcony. Additional features include down duvets, free cots, and spacious closets.

location: PO Box 288  St. John’s, Antigua, W.I., 00000 Old Road, Antigua & Barbuda
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Curtain Bluff - All Inclusive
Beachfront and Leisure: Curtain Bluff - All Inclusive in St. John’s offers beachfront access, a swimming pool with stunning views, a fitness centre, sun terrace, and water sports facilities. Guests can enjoy a tennis court, garden, and free WiFi throughout the property.

Comfortable Accommodations: Rooms feature sea views, air-conditioning, balconies, and private bathrooms. Additional amenities include minibars, work desks, and free on-site parking. The hotel provides free WiFi, a 24-hour front desk, and a concierge service.

Dining and Entertainment: The family-friendly restaurant serves Caribbean cuisine with local specialities, fresh pastries, and a variety of breakfast options. Evening entertainment includes live music and a games room.

Activities and Location: Located 19 km from V. C. Bird International Airport, the hotel offers fishing, yoga, fitness classes, and water sports. Guests can enjoy activities such as canoeing, diving, and snorkelling.

room_details.room_Description: Curtain Bluff Resort's room details include a variety of options, such as Cliff Pool Suites with infinity pools and ocean views, as well as Ocean View Junior Suites with verandas. All rooms offer comforts like 24-hour room service and air conditioning, along with free WiFi and safes. The resort also provides amenities like bathrobes, slippers, and Molton Brown bath products.

location: Devil's Bridge National Park, Willikies, Antigua and Barbuda
resort_details:
Experience the celebrities' experience with top-notch service at Hammock Cove Antigua - All Inclusive - Adults Only
Hammock Cove Antigua - All Inclusive - Adults Only features 3 restaurants, 3 pickleball courts, a spa and fitness center, 3 bars, and a garden in Willikies. This 5-star hotel offers water sports facilities, a concierge service, and free WiFi. The hotel offers a 24-hour front desk, room service, and currency exchange. All rooms at the hotel are air-conditioned and feature a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a Blu-ray player, and a private bathroom with a shower, a hairdryer, and free toiletries. At the hotel, every room comes with a desk and a kettle. Hammock Cove Antigua - All Inclusive - Adults Only offers a continental or buffet breakfast. The accommodation offers a terrace. The area is popular for snorkeling. Hammock Cove Antigua - All Inclusive - Adults Only can provide car hire. All units have a personal Ambassador. All units have a private plunge pool.

location: Freeman's Bay,187 st. John's, 00000 English Harbor Town, Antigua and Barbuda
resort_details:
Experience the star experience with top-notch service at The Inn at English Harbour.
Facing the beach, The Inn at English Harbour offers 5-star accommodation in English Harbour Town and features a garden, a shared lounge, and a terrace. It offers a restaurant, a bar, and water sports facilities. The accommodation offers a 24-hour front desk, airport transfers, room service, and free WiFi throughout the property. Breakfast is available and includes à la carte, English/Irish, or American options. The hotel offers an outdoor pool. You can play tennis at The Inn at English Harbour, and the area is popular for snorkeling. Galleon Beach is just steps from the accommodation. The airport (VC Bird International Airport) is 20 km away.

Each tropical room boasts a patio or balcony. Colorful island artwork is displayed in every room. Cedar Valley Golf Course is 4.5 km from the resort. Antigua rainforest canopy tour is 17.3 km away. Free snorkeling equipment, sailing and Hobie-Cats, Kayaking, Paddle-Boarding and Sunfish Boats. Guests can exercise in the air-conditioned gym. The resort also offers features like His and Hers showers and separate soaking tubs in Premium Beachfront Suites.

resort_details:
Experience the celebrities' experience with top-notch service at the Fairmont Royal Pavilion Barbados Resort.
Located in Saint James, 2 km from Holetown and next to Glitter Bay Beach, this resort features a spacious garden, massage services, a swimming pool, and free Wi-Fi throughout. Featuring plantation-style décor, the rooms and suites are equipped with air conditioning, a ceiling fan, a seating area, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, and a DVD player. Each accommodation also has a balcony or terrace with sea views and a private bathroom with a bathtub and separate shower. The lobby, rooms, and suites were renovated in November 2017. The Fairmont Royal Pavilion Barbados Resort features 2 restaurants serving Caribbean and international dishes. Private dining options can be arranged, and room service is available. Guests can enjoy activities such as canoeing, diving, fishing, and snorkeling. A gym, tennis courts, laundry facilities, and a gift shop are available. Professional babysitting services can be arranged for an additional fee. Requests must be made at least 24 hours in advance. This resort is a 5-minute drive from Royal Westmoreland Golf Course and a 15-minute drive from Bosque de Flores Botanical Park. Grantley Adams International Airport is 19 km away.

room_details.room_Description: The Fairmont Royal Pavilion in Barbados offers 72 luxurious rooms and suites, all with ocean views and private balconies or terraces. Room amenities include comfortable Fairmont beds, flat-screen TVs, refreshment centers, and WiFi. Suites on the ground floor provide direct beachfront access, while upper-floor rooms feature large glass-fronted balconies.

resort_details: Sandy Lane's legendary style makes it one of the most prestigious resorts in the world.

location: Crane, St. Philip, Barbados, BB18079 Saint Philip, Barbados
resort_details:
Experience World-class Service at The Crane Resort
Located on famous Crane Beach and overlooking the ocean, this Caribbean resort hotel offers 5 restaurants and lighted swimming pools. It is a 15-minute drive from Grantley Adams International Airport.

Each 19th-century-style room at The Crane Residential Resort includes vaulted ceilings and a 4 poster king sized bed. They are equipped with cable TV and free Wi-Fi. The marble bathroom is furnished with a whirlpool tub.

A shopping complex with clothing and jewelry stores are part of this Barbados resort. Guests can work out on the cardio machines in the gym which features views of the beautiful cascading pool.

L’Azure Restaurant, located on-site, specializes in seafood and provides seating on its outdoor balcony. Zen Restaurant offers traditional Japanese and Thai cuisine, while The Carriage House is a poolside restaurant that serves light meals and cocktails in a casual atmosphere.

Bushy Park Racing Circuit is a 10-minute drive from The Bridgetown Crane Resort. Ocean City is 3.1 mi away.

room_details.room_Description: The Crane Resort offers a variety of room options, including suites, ocean view rooms, and rooms with garden views. Many rooms feature balconies, comfortable furniture, and private hot tubs. Some rooms also include full kitchens with appliances, while others offer kitchenettes with basic amenities. The resort boasts immaculately maintained rooms and grounds.

resort_details: Waves caters to those seeking a mind and body holiday; for those wishing for a serene, adults-only escape or a high energy communal oceanfront lounge location on a stunning West Coast beachfront setting

room_details.room_Description: Waves Resort & Spa offers 70 guest rooms and suites with a mix of layouts, amenities, and views, including standard guest rooms, ocean front rooms, and junior suites. All rooms are equipped with modern conveniences like flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and in-room safes. Standard guest rooms on the second and third floors feature a king bed, sofa bed, and island views, while ocean front rooms offer additional amenities like a double sofa bed. Guest rooms also include bathrobes, and in some cases, rainfall showerheads and ceiling fans. Additionally, all guests staying for 5 or more nights receive two spa treatments per adult.

location: 34 Coot Pond Road, St Catherine's Beach, GE 03 Saint George, Bermuda
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The St. Regis Bermuda Resort
Elegant Accommodations: The St. Regis Bermuda Resort in St George offers luxurious rooms with sea views, balconies, and private bathrooms. Each room includes a work desk, free toiletries, and a tea and coffee maker.

Exceptional Facilities: Guests can enjoy spa facilities, a wellness centre, and an outdoor swimming pool. Additional amenities include a terrace, open-air bath, fitness room, and hot tub.

Dining Experience: The resort features a steakhouse restaurant serving lunch and dinner, alongside a bar. A buffet breakfast is available each morning.

Prime Location: Located a few steps from St Catherine's Beach and 5 km from L.F. Wade International Airport, the resort is also close to Horseshoe Bay, 34 km away. Highly rated for its attentive staff and excellent service.

room_details.room_Description: The St. Regis Bermuda Resort offers a range of elegantly appointed guest rooms and suites, many with ocean views. The resort features a variety of room types, including Grand Rooms and various suite options, such as the St. Regis Fort Oceanfront Suite and Caroline Astor Suite. Some rooms offer connecting rooms, while others are specifically designed for larger groups or families.

location: 76 Pitts Bay Road, Hamilton City, HM08 Hamilton, Bermuda
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Hamilton Princess & Beach Club A Fairmont Managed Hotel
Overlooking Hamilton Harbour, this luxury waterfront hotel boasts an infinity pool with Hamilton Harbour views and floating sun loungers; multiple on-site restaurants, Crown & Anchor, 1609 Bar & Restaurant, The Duchess Café & Gelateria, Intrepid Steak, Seafood & Raw Bar and our Beach Club Kitchen.

Offering hardwood tables and a full-service bar, Crown & Anchor Bar, Restaurant, & Terrace is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. While 1609 Bar & Restaurant is open seasonally with our open-air dining experience for lunch and dinner. Our new fine dining restaurant, Intrepid, is open Monday - Saturday for dinner service only, offering a contemporary twist on the classic American grill cuisine.

location: 30 Kings Point Road, Sandys Parish, MA02 Somerset, Bermuda
resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Cambridge Beaches Resort and Spa
This luxury Bermuda resort features 4 private beaches and rooms with tropical views. The resort offers a full service spa, tennis court, putting green, croquet lawn, 2 pools, watersports centre, restaurant, bar, and room service.

Balconies and patios are standard in the Cambridge Beaches Resort and Spa rooms. The rooms include a large marble bathroom with slippers and robe and tropical décor in the rooms. Free Wi-Fi is available to guests.

Guests can swim in the outdoor pool or get a tennis lesson from a professional. The resort concierge helps guests arrange plans both on-site and off.

The resort features 3 seasonal restaurants including Breezes, a seafood restaurant and Shutters, which features casual dining for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

The Cambridge Beach is within a 5-minute drive of the Royal Navel Dockyard and shopping. The Horseshoe Bay Beach is 8 miles from the resort.

location: 60 Tucker's Point Dr, Hamilton Parish, HS02 Tuckerʼs Town, Bermuda
resort_details:

The air-conditioned rooms at the Rosewood tucker’s Point offer balcony or terrace and have flat-screen TVs and iPod docking stations. They are equipped with safety boxes, closets and minibars. The bathroom features bathroom amenities, a marble bath and shower and bathrobes and slippers.

Rosewood tucker’s point has a restaurant on site and offers in-room dining. It offers shops and gift shops and there is 24-hour concierge service and a business centre. Guests can rent scooters and bicycles on site.

St. George’s Town is 15 minutes’ drive, while Bermuda International Airport is 20 minutes by car. Horseshoe Beach can be reached within 30 minutes by car and Hamilton Town is a 30 minutes’ drive.

room_details.room_Description: Rosewood Bermuda offers a range of spacious and luxurious rooms and suites, with options featuring stunning views of Castle Harbour or Harrington Sound. Standard rooms start at 500 square feet and can accommodate rollaway beds for an additional fee. Ocean View Queen Rooms offer approximately 600 square feet and have two queen-size beds. Larger suites include the Harbour View Suite (1200 sq ft) and Royal Suite (1650 sq ft).

location: 27 Harbour Road, Paget Parish, PG 02 Mount Pleasant, Bermuda
resort_details:
Situated on the harbour, this resort in Paget features free shuttle service to the 18-hole golf course. It offers a full-service spa and on-site dining while each accommodation boasts a private balcony with Hamilton Harbour views.

The elegantly styled studios and suites at Newstead Belmont Hills Golf Resort & Spa include free Wi-Fi and a 26-inch flat-screen TV. Kitchenette facilities are available in the studios and suites.

A 24-hour fitness centre, outdoor pool and a hot tub are available at the Newstead Belmont Hills Resort.

The city of Hamilton is a 5-minute boat ride from the resort. The Botanical Gardens is a 7-minute drive away. Just a 5-minute shuttle away are the South Shore Beaches.

Blu at Belmont Hills restaurant offers views of the golf course and Hamilton Harbour. Open for dinner, the restaurant offers continental cuisine.

room_details.room_Description: Newstead Belmont Hills Golf Resort & Spa in Paget, Bermuda offers a variety of rooms, including Deluxe Rooms and Suites, with options for waterfront views and amenities like private balconies, flatscreen TVs, and coffee/tea makers. Deluxe Rooms feature two queen beds, while suites offer more space with features like a full kitchen, living room, and dining area.

resort_details: Originally founded by conservationist Laurance Rockefeller over half a century ago in 1964, and long regarded as one of the world’s greatest getaways, this iconic resort has been completely revived and redesigned while staying true to its identity as a leading example of ecotourism. Set across 500 acres of pristine private beachfront and breathtaking flora and fauna, the re-imagined resort provides an unparalleled island escape with expertly appointed accommodations, inspired amenities, dynamic dining outlets and bespoke services and programming.

room_details.room_Description: Rosewood Little Dix Bay offers various room and suite types, all designed with a focus on privacy and ocean views. Rooms range from standard king rooms to luxurious villas, some with private pools, and all offer amenities like air conditioning, sea views, attached bathrooms, and free WiFi.

resort_details: Escape to Scrub Island Resort, a luxurious retreat in the British Virgin Islands, where azure waters meet lush landscapes. This haven offers a blend of relaxation and adventure amidst breathtaking natural beauty. Immerse yourself in the turquoise waters of secluded beaches or lounge by the infinity pool overlooking the ocean. Indulge in culinary delights at multiple dining venues, from beachside grills to fine dining restaurants. Pamper yourself at Ixora Spa with rejuvenating treatments inspired by the island's flora. For the adventurous spirit, explore vibrant coral reefs while snorkeling or set sail on a catamaran adventure. Luxurious accommodations, from spacious villas to chic suites, provide comfort and serenity with breathtaking views. With impeccable service and attention to detail, Scrub Island Resort invites guests to create cherished memories and offers a stunning backdrop for weddings in the British Virgin Islands.

location: Long Bay Beach Resort West End, VG1130 Tortola Island, British Virgin Islands
resort_details:

resort_details:

location: Jan Thiel z/n, Jan Thiel, 00000 Willemstad, Curaçao
resort_details:

The luxurious Papagayo villas feature air-conditioned bedrooms and a living room with flat-screen cable TV, while the open-plan kitchens include a microwave and dishwasher. Some villas have ocean views and all have porch which opens out from the lounge. Toasters are available upon request.

The Papagayo’s restaurant serves local and international cuisine, including an à la carte breakfast. The resort also features elegant lounge areas, sun terrace and a kid’s club.

Across the street you will find the Papagayo Beach Plaza, where guests enjoy free access to the beach club and gym. There is also a spa, a casino and several shops and restaurants.

The center of Willemstad is a 15-minute drive away, while Hato International Airport is a 30-minute drive away.

Ocean View rooms feature a king bed, sofa, coffee/tea facilities, and a furnished terrace or balcony. King Rooms offer options with garden, boulevard, or lobby views, and some have oceanfront access. Villas are detached, offering amenities like multiple bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchens, and living areas.

location: 60 Tanager Way, KY1-9008 West Bay, Cayman Islands
resort_details:

Offering a spa center and fitness center, Kimpton Seafire Resort and Spa is set in West Bay. The resort has a year-round outdoor pool and sun terrace, and guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant or a drink at the bar.

A flat-screen TV with cable channels, as well as an iPod docking station are available. Certain units have a seating area to relax in after a busy day. Each room includes a private bathroom fitted with a bath or shower. Extras include bath robes and free toiletries.

You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property and three diverse on-property restaurants, including a beachside bar and grill

This resort has a private beach area and free use of bicycles is available. The nearest airport is Owen Roberts Airport, 4.3 mi from Kimpton Seafire Resort and Spa.

room_details.room_Description: Kimpton Seafire Resort offers a variety of room types, many with ocean views, including King and Queen rooms, suites, and even beach houses and bungalows. location: 747 West Bay Road, Seven Mile Beach KY1-1110 Grand Cayman
resort_details: A revel of the glory days of Caribbean understated glamour, Palm Heights is a generational reboot celebrating regional culture, cuisine, wellness, thinking and design. Nestled on Seven Mile Beach, one of the Caribbean’s most coveted stretches of white sand, at Palm Heights, guests can enjoy restaurants, stylish design, and breathtaking ocean views from every suite.

room_details.room_Description: Palm Heights in Grand Cayman offers a variety of suite types, all with ocean views, varying in size and amenities. All suites feature luxurious amenities like marble bathrooms, minibars, and free WiFi.

location: Seven Mile Beach, Grand Cayman, KY1-1209 George Town, Cayman Islands
resort_details:

This beachfront resort is just 1.9 mi from George Town.  It has guest rooms with WiFi, an outdoor pool, a tennis court, a spa and wellness center and on-site shops for guests to enjoy.

Among the amenities this AAA Five Diamond Award winner offers are a restaurant, a bar and a snack bar, a hot tub and concierge services.

Rooms at The Ritz-Carlton are air-conditioned and feature terraces, a work desk, a seating area and a private bathroom with free toiletries.

Owen Roberts International Airport is just 10 minutes’ drive away.

location: Seven Mile Beach, 30620, KYL-1203 George Town, Cayman Islands
resort_details:
Standing on the beautiful Seven Mile Beach, this Grand Caiman resort features the Hibiscus Spa and a variety of water sports. Exotic outdoor pool and cabanas are also provided.

A private patio or balcony provides tropical views from most of the bright rooms of The Westin Grand Caiman Seven Mile Beach Resort & Spa. A marble bath, flat-screen TV and mini fridge are also included.

Guests of the Westin Grand Caiman can dine by the ocean at Beach House or enjoy the island flavors of Ferdinands. Five other restaurants and lounges are available.

Diving lessons are offered in the resort’s diving center, and snorkeling and wave runners are also available.

Owen Roberts International Airport is 13 minutes away.

location: Auto. 5. Carretera Carretera, Rio San Juan 33300 Dominican Republic
resort_details: Perched above the gold sands of legendary Playa Grande Beach, Amanera is a sleek, secluded sanctuary providing unparalleled access to the area's incredible outdoors, where guests can enjoy endorphin-boosting water sports and back-to-nature experiences. Relaxation is provided by immersive spa journeys, all subtly infused with the spice and flavour of Dominican life and a holistic approach to wellness inspired by shamanic healing traditions of the Taíno Indians is used.

room_details.room_Description: Amanera offers various luxurious casitas, Hill Casitas, and larger two-bedroom villas, all featuring private pools, expansive terraces, and stunning ocean views. They are designed with high ceilings, warm wood finishes, and floor-to-ceiling glass doors, creating a seamless connection to nature.

location: Carretera La Romana - Higuey, 22000 La Romana, Dominican Republic
resort_details:
Experience World-class Service at Casa de Campo Resort & Villas
This 7,000-acre resort on the shores of the Caribbean contains a full-size replica of a 16th Century Mediterranean village and amphitheater.  La Romana International Airport is just across Highway 3.

Hotel rooms at Casa de Campo feature rich mahogany furnishings and a private balcony or terrace. Each is equipped with free Wi-Fi and a 42-inch flat-screen TV. A large walk-in closet and a private dressing area with black marble vanity are included.

On-site restaurants include the Beach Club by Le Cirque, serving seafood and grilled meats, La Cana by Il Circo, serving international food, and La Casita at the Marina, featuring fine Spanish cuisine, La Piazzetta located in Altos de Chavon and Lago Restaurant for breakfast.

Guests of the Casa have access to their own 4-passenger cart for touring the resort. A vast selection of activities is available, including the top-rated Teeth of the Dog golf course, water sports, and horseback riding. A health spa and nightly shows are also offered. Amenities include a private beach, expansive marina, tennis and polo facilities, and 3 championship golf courses—including Pete Dye’s masterpiece.

The Casa de Campo resort is 2.5 mi from downtown La Romana and just over 1 mi from the baseball stadium at Puerto La Romana. Casa de Campo Restor and Villas is 45 minutes' drive from Punta Cana International Airport on the Autovia Coral highway.

location: Isla Cayo Levantado, 32000 Santa Bárbara de Samaná, Dominican Republic
resort_details:
Experience World-class Service at Cayo Levantado Resort - All Inclusive
Cayo Levantado Resort, the first luxury wellness All-Inclusive resort in the Dominican Republic, is nestled on an exclusive island within the breathtaking Samaná Bay, this exclusive island resort offers a unique luxury experience that transcends the ordinary. With 218 suites and villas designed for ultimate relaxation and boasting stunning views, Cayo Levantado Resort offers 5 world-class restaurants, 5 Bars and a Coffee Shop, 24 hours In-suite service, 2 pools, a private beach, a state-of-the-art Spa, a Personal Training Studio with an Outdoor Box and boat transportation from Simi Baez private pier to island.

All Suites and Villas feature personalized assistance by an Ambassador, High-speed WIFI, a Full mini bar, Smart TV, and premium amenities.

The resort also features a dedicated wellness & Holistic haven, Yubarta, where guests can choose from a variety of activities and treatments designed to revitalize their body, mind, and spirit.

Cayo Levantado Resort is just 31 mi away from El Catey International Airport (AZS) and 93 mi from Las Americas International Airport (SDQ) in Santo Domingo.

room_details.room_Description: Cayo Levantado Resort (Adults Only) Samana, Dominican RepublicThe Cayo Levantado Resort offers a range of all-inclusive room options, including suites and villas, catering to various needs and preferences. These rooms generally feature amenities like balconies or terraces, air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, in-room safes, and minibars. Specific room types include Junior Suites, Sea View Junior Suites, and various villas with plunge pools and bay or beachfront views.

location: Cap Cana, Cap Cana, 23000 Punta Cana, Dominican Republic
resort_details:
Experience World-class Service at Eden Roc Cap Cana
Eden Roc Cap Cana is a five-star Relais & Châteaux resort nestled in Cap Cana, a gated beachfront community of the Dominican Republic.

The 30,000-acre community is home to beaches, cliffs, tropical forests, a marina and the No. 1 golf course in the Caribbean, a Jack Nicklaus signature course.

Blending the standards of the French and Italian Rivieras with the warmth and charms of the Caribbean, Eden Roc Cap Cana presents 60 all-suite accommodations – Boutique Suites and two multi-bedroom villas, all with private pools and 26 two-bedroom beachfront suites revealed in Spring 2017.

The resort recently enhanced its beach club with Blue Flag certified private beach to add an infinity pool and Nikkei-themed BLUE Grill + Bar. Culinary experiences also include Mediterraneo Restaurant with Executive Chef Gianluca Re Fraschini at the helm; oceanfront La Palapa, featuring international cuisine with traditional local influence; and a visiting celebrity chef series.  Eden Roc Cap Cana comes with spa and fitness facilities, a kids club for children ages 4-12 and function space for corporate retreats and events.

room_details.room_Description: Eden Roc Cap Cana offers a variety of spacious suites and villas, ranging from one to four bedrooms, with options for beachfront, pool-view, and garden-view accommodations. All suites feature luxurious amenities, including private pools, covered gazebo lounge areas, and fast Wi-Fi. Some suites also offer butler service and private chef services.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo
JW Marriott Santo Domingo is an elegant venue fully equipped with a concierge desk, gift shop, currency exchange services, an indoor pool and a restaurant. This smoke-free hotel has free Wi-Fi.

All the rooms and suites have an elegant décor and feature spacious bathrooms, some of them include a bath. Cable and satellite TV is available, along with air conditioning and a sofa.

The hotel also has a fitness center, fully equipped meeting facilities, luggage storage and ticket services. Grocery shopping services can also be provided, and coffee and tea are available in-room.

Some rooms also offer additional features like coffee/tea makers and views of the city.

location: Punta Cana Motorway - Higuey, 23302 Punta Cana, Dominican Republic
resort_details:
Experience World-class Service at Tortuga Bay
Featuring a private beach area in Punta Cana, a swimming pool and rooms with hot tub, this luxury and exclusive resort is half a mile from the beach and just 3 miles from Punta Cana International Airport.

The rooms at this AAA Five Diamond Award winner have minimalist style and include a fan, sitting area, flat-screen TV and balcony. The kitchens have a coffee maker and microwave, and the bathrooms are private and include a bathtub, shower and bathrobes.

The Tortuga Bay features the Bamboo restaurant with decor from an international designer and serves a fusion of Caribbean and Asian cuisine. The breakfast is free.

Activities such as fishing, horseback riding, kite sailing and eco-paddle surfing can be arranged at this hotel. The use of bikes and kayaks is for free.

location: El Cortecito, Bavaro, 23000 Punta Cana, Dominican Republic

This luxurious adults-only resort is located within the Grand Palladium Complex of 4 hotels with full access to all of them including their facilities and features a full-service spa, numerous on-site dining options and endless recreational and entertainment options.

Ladera is completely sustainable and handcrafted by local artisans using local hardwoods, stones and clay. Each suite at Ladera is unique and features a heated private plunge pool and breathtaking views of the Pitons thanks to our stunning open-walled design.

Here, our head chef Nigel Mitchell conjures up imaginative, St Lucia-inspired dishes using produce from the gardens right here on the property. Our greatest treasure at Ladera is our staff, whose genuine warmth and excellent service will make you feel like family. With them, you can discover a wealth of experiences on the property, including the Hideaway Rum Bar, the Piton Hiking Trail, mineral spring hot tubs, our four-story tree house, our weekly Sunset Fish Fry and much more. Other exciting adventures nearby include mud baths and waterfalls, world-class sailing, scuba diving and much more.

resort_details:
Experience World-class Service at Belizean Dreams Resort
Nestled in the charming coastal village of Hopkins, Belizean Dreams Resort offers a unique blend of relaxation and adventure. Our boutique-style resort is located in the heart of a traditional Garifuna community, providing an authentic cultural experience along with world-class hospitality.
Each room is equipped with modern amenities, including a flat-screen cable TV, a refrigerator, and complimentary toiletries.

Savor the flavors of Belize and beyond at our on-site restaurant, which combines international and local cuisine with a tropical twist. Dine al fresco by the beach or enjoy a handcrafted cocktail from our selection of wines, beers, and mixed drinks.

For the adventure enthusiast, Belizean Dreams Resort is your gateway to excitement. Discover coral reefs while snorkeling or diving, embark on thrilling fishing trips, or explore the wonders of Belize with guided tours to Mayan ruins, waterfalls, and jungle trails. Guests also enjoy complimentary use of our kayaks and paddleboards for some seaside fun.

Located approximately 3 hours from the Belize International Airport, we also provide shuttle services to and from the airport (additional fee applies). Alternatively, we can arrange for a scenic local flight to nearby Dangriga, followed by a short drive to Hopkins (additional fee applies).
Make your dream Belize vacation a reality at Belizean Dreams Resort, where casual elegance meets cultural authenticity.

Here, you’re not just a guest, you’re treated like family by a team dedicated to creating unforgettable moments. The Angkor National Museum is a 2-minute tuk-tuk (rickshaw) ride away. It takes 15 minutes by car to reach the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Angkor Wat and Siem Reap International Airport.

Offering views of downtown Siem Reap or the hotel’s courtyard, each air-conditioned room features Khmer-inspired contemporary art, custom furniture and summery decor. The hotel's dining options focuses on responsible resourcing of local ingredients. A buffet breakfast is served at The Dining Room, which specializes in French-Indochina cuisine set in an elegant setting. The hotel is a 10-minute drive from the Angkor UNESCO World Heritage Site and a 50-minute drive from Siem Reap International Airport.

Grand Hotel d'Angkor features an award-winning swimming pool, fitness center, spa, tennis courts and a one-of-a-kind cultural resort program. Set in over 15 acres of beautifully landscaped French gardens, the accommodations blends old-world charm with Cambodian influences and contemporary details. Rooms, suites and villas are characterized by beautifully refined interiors, hardwood floors, traditional ceiling fans, brass rotary telephones, high-speed wi-fi, 24-hour Raffles butler service and stunning views of either the iconic swimming pool or the expansive gardens. As a celebrated culinary destination that combines the best of local culture and cuisine with dishes from around the world, our restaurants and bars feature their own unique setting and atmosphere. Our curated cultural journeys ensure that Grand Hotel d'Angkor retains its position as the original and most inspiring address from which to discover Angkor Wat and its historic environs.

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Ritz-Carlton Kyoto
Opened in February 2014, this luxury 5-star hotel features high-standard services and guestrooms that are among the most spacious in Kyoto. Guests may enjoy complimentary use of the indoor swimming pool and the fitness center during their stay. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property.

The Ritz-Carlton Kyoto is located right along the Kamogawa River, offering iconic Kyoto views. Kyoto Shiyakushomae Subway Station is just a 3-minute walk away, while JR Kyoto Station can be reached within a 10-minute subway ride. Nijo-jo Castle, one of the World Heritage Sites, is a 3-minute subway ride from the hotel.

Featuring traditional Kyoto esthetics and sophisticated elegance, each room is fitted with a large flat-screen TV, a Blu-ray player and a Nespresso coffee maker. The private bathroom comes with a rain shower, a bath tub and a mini LED TV.

While staying at the hotel, guests can feel rejuvenated with massage treatments at the spa or enjoy workouts at the 24-hour gym. A 24-hour front desk and concierge services are offered. The business center is also available 24 hours.

La Locanda restaurant serves colorful Italian dishes featuring select ingredients from all over the world. Delicately prepared Japanese kaiseki multi-course meals and sushi can be savored at Mizuki restaurant. Pierre Hermé Paris offers delicious French sweets including macaroons.

room_details.room_Description: The Ritz-Carlton, Kyoto offers a variety of guest rooms and suites, including Deluxe Rooms, Grand Rooms, and Suites with river or courtyard views. Rooms feature spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and personal terrace decks, along with luxurious amenities like 600-count linens, complimentary internet, and Diptyque bath products according to the Ritz-Carlton website.

location: Kyoto, Kyoto, Kita-ku Kinugasa Kagamiishi 44-1 , Japan
resort_details:
Experience World-class Service at ROKU KYOTO, LXR Hotels & Resorts
Elegant Accommodations: ROKU KYOTO, LXR Hotels & Resorts in Kyoto offers a 5-star resort experience with a hot spring bath, spa facilities, sauna, fitness center, and a year-round outdoor swimming pool. Guests enjoy free WiFi, a terrace, and a beautifully maintained garden.

Dining and Leisure: The modern restaurant serves French cuisine with vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and dairy-free options. Additional amenities include a bar, yoga and fitness classes, and a coffee shop. Free on-site private parking and a 24-hour front desk ensure convenience.

Prime Location: Located 31 mi from Itami Airport, the resort is a 17-minute walk from Kinkaku-ji Temple. Nearby attractions include Kitano Tenmangu Shrine (1.2 mi), Nijo Castle (2.5 mi), and Kyoto Imperial Palace (3.1 mi). Highly rated by guests for its excellent service and facilities.

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Sowaka
Open from November 2018, located near Gion district and featuring a Japanese garden, SOWAKA offers rooms in Kyoto. The renovated main building features traditional Kyoto-style decoration for guests to enjoy. Free WiFi is provided throughout the building.

At the hotel, all air conditioned rooms come with an electric kettle, mini-bar, fridge and wardrobe. Rooms are fitted with a private bathroom with extras including a hairdryer, bathrobe and nightwear.

Staff at the 24-hour front desk can help with information about the area.

Kiyomizu-dera Temple is 0.6 mi away and Heian Shrine is 1 mi from the hotel. Itami Airport is 24 mi from the property.

room_details.room_Description: SOWAKA, a luxury hotel in Kyoto, features 23 individually designed rooms, blending heritage and modern comforts. The hotel's main building, originally a Japanese-style restaurant, has a unique Sukiya architectural style. Rooms offer a variety of experiences, including private gardens, maisonette-type rooms, and views of the courtyard or city.

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Suiran, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Kyoto
Located right along the gentle streams of Katsura River and boasting a beautiful Japanese garden, Suiran, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Kyoto offers the perfect getaway for travelers seeking peace and quiet. This upscale accommodations is located just a 15-minute stroll from JR Saga Arashiyama Station and a 3-minute stroll from Tenryuji Temple, which is registered as a UNESCO world heritage site.

Each room is furnished with a flat-screen TV, an electric kettle, a refrigerator and a seating area with a sofa. All rooms include a private bathroom equipped with a bath, a shower and free toiletries. Slippers and bathrobes are also available for your comfort.

Guests can relax at the spa, purchase souvenirs at the gift shop, or soak in the private open-air bath with an advance reservation.  Room service, 24-hour front desk and a concierge service are also available on site.

A fusion of Japanese kaiseki (traditional multi-course) meal and French cuisine are served for breakfast, lunch and dinner at the on-site restaurant, Kyo Suiran. Tea and coffee can be enjoyed at Cafe Hassui, between 11:00 and 17:00.

The symbolic Togetsukyo Bridge is located a 5-minute walk away, while the renowned Arashiyama Bamboo Grove can be found within a 10-minute walking distance. With a reservation, guests can take a rickshaw ride through the surrounding areas.
