location: Okinawa, Nanjo, Tamagusuku Aza Hyakunayamashitabaru 1299-1, Japan
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Hyakunagaran
Located right on the beach and on a cape surrounded by mountains, Hyakunagaran features spacious modern accommodations with wired internet access and ocean views. The adult-only hotel features long outdoor hallways with traditional wooden decor, a garden with tropical plants and an open-air cave with a 7-yard stone Buddha statue. Guests can reserve one of the free-use 6 Houjo-an private cottages, which feature an outdoor bath facing the beach. Naha Airport is a 35-minute drive away.

The air-conditioned rooms feature a living room with a flat-screen TV, a mini-bar and a seating area with sofa. Guests can lounge on the private terrace with tables and chairs, and unique casual robes are provided for use on the beach and around the hotel. The private bathroom comes with a hairdryer and slippers.

Massages and spa services can be requested at the private cottage and guests can sunbathe on its terrace. You can enjoy reading at the library or gaze at artworks at the gallery as well. Concierge service, photocopying and luggage storage are provided at the front desk. Guests have a 220 degree view of the ocean where Kudaka Island and Ojima Island can be seen, along with a beautiful sunset and sunrise.

Guests can enjoy Japanese and Okinawan seasonal course meals prepared with local ingredients.

Hyakunagaran Inn is a 3-minute walk from Mebaru Beach and a 10-minute drive from Ryukyu Golf Course. The Tamagusuku Castle Ruins are a 10-minute drive away.

room_details.room_Description: Hyakuna Garan offers 13 rooms and 2 suites, all with ocean views. The rooms are spacious and well-appointed, with a mix of Western and Japanese styles. Guests can expect luxurious amenities, including premium bedding, minibars, and in-room safes. The hotel also features a rooftop terrace, open-air bathhouses, and a variety of other amenities.

resort_details:
Experience World-class Service at The Ritz-Carlton Okinawa
Located right in front of Kise Country Club, the Ritz-Carlton, Okinawa features luxurious rooms with picturesque views of the surrounding forests and nearby beaches. Guests can enjoy soothing facial treatments and massages at The Ritz-Carlton Spa Okinawa or relax by the indoor/outdoor swimming pools. Free Wi-Fi is available at the entire property.

The spacious rooms feature a private balcony and an indoor bathtub overlooking the beach. Each room is equipped with a flat-screen TV, a Nespresso machine and a Tivoli Audio system. Guests can enjoy drinks from the mini-bar and wear the hotel’s original bathrobes. The private bathroom comes with rain showers and double sinks.

Local artworks and potteries can be purchased at the boutique and the fitness center is open 24/7. The concierge offers personal assistance and the 24-hour front desk provides currency exchange, dry cleaning and laundry services. Room service is available.

Chura Nuhji serves Italian dishes featuring local ingredients, while grilled Teppanyaki meals are offered at Kise restaurant. Light meals and refreshments are served at the poolside Library and the hotel’s bar.

The Ritz-Carlton, Okinawa is a 5-minute drive from Kise Beach and a 50-minute drive from Churaumi Aquarium. The Airport Liner shuttle bus is available from Naha Airport, which is a 1-hour drive away.

Genius discounts at this property are subject to booking dates, stay dates, and other available deals.

Located on the beautiful Yakushima Island, Sankara Hotel & Spa Yakushima offers luxurious accommodations with modern warm-colored interior and free WiFi. Guests can also relax with massages at the Spa.

The air-conditioned villas and suites feature a balcony or a terrace. A refrigerator, a CD player, and a flat-screen TV with DVD player are included in each. The private bathroom features slippers and free organic amenities. A hairdryer and a bathrobe are provided.

Guests can work out at the fitness center or enjoy reading books at the library lounge. The outdoor pool is open during the summer season. Car rental, laundry services and washing machines are also available.

The ayana restaurant serves casual French dishes using local ingredients. An authentic French dinner is available at the okas restaurant.

The Anboko Port is a 15-minute drive, and the Yakushima Airport is a 30-minute drive away. Free pick-up service is available from both locations with an advance reservation. Yakushima Hotel and Spa Sankara is 14 mi from Yakusugi Land, and 17 mi from the Ookawa no Taki Falls. The Shiratani Unsuikyo Ravine is 24 mi away.

If you’re looking for a luxury resort in Nago, look no further than The Terrace Club at Busena.

Guest rooms offer amenities such as a minibar, a refrigerator, and air conditioning, and guests can go online with free wifi offered by the resort.

The Terrace Club at Busena features room service and a concierge, to help make your stay more enjoyable. The property also boasts a pool and free breakfast. If you are driving to The Terrace Club at Busena, free parking is available.

While in Nago, you may want to check out some of the restaurants that are a short walk away from The Terrace Club at Busena, including Chura-Hana (0.8 mi), Colombin (0.8 mi), and Kise (0.7 mi).

There is no shortage of things to do in the area: explore popular historic sites such as Nantoirei no To.

The staff at The Terrace Club at Busena looks forward to serving you during your upcoming visit.

room_details.room_Description:
The Terrace Club at Busena offers spacious, studio-style rooms with a variety of amenities. Rooms typically feature a balcony or terrace, a spa tub, and access to a club lounge. Expect amenities like free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a refrigerator, and potentially a Nespresso coffee maker. Some rooms offer sea views and are equipped with two double or twin beds. 
Key Features:
Space: Rooms are generally large, with a minimum size of 54 square meters (581 square feet). 
Amenities: In-room amenities include a refrigerator, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and potentially a Nespresso coffee maker. 
Bathroom: Rooms often feature a separate shower and bathtub, with a moveable wall that allows for open or closed views. 
Lounge Access: All guests of The Terrace Club at Busena enjoy access to the club-floor service, including complimentary teatime and aperitifs in the ocean-side lounge. 
Views: Some rooms offer ocean views and sunset views. 
Comfort: Rooms often come equipped with robes, slippers, and pajamas. 
Accessibility: The resort has amenities such as a concierge service, luggage storage, and dry cleaning services, according to Trivago.

Featuring various spa and wellness facilities on site, the hotel offers a 24-hour front desk and concierge service. Guests enjoy free access to a 24-hour fitness center and indoor heated pool is available throughout the year.

Atmos Dining serves a wide range of European and Asian fusion cuisine, while Japanese food can be enjoyed at KURA - Teppanyaki & Sushi. C:Grill provides freshly grilled seafood and guests can enjoy a variety of cocktails at the stylish 40 Sky Bar and Lounge.

Billboard Live Osaka is a 10-minute walk from Conrad Osaka, while Osaka Castle is a 20-minute car ride away.

Located right in front of Osaka Castle, Hotel New Otani offers spacious rooms and 13 dining options. The property is a 5-minute walk from shopping complex JO-TERRACE OSAKA. Free WiFi connection is available throughout the property.

Rooms feature large windows with city or Osaka Castle views. They have an LCD TV and comfortable beds.

With an additional charge, guests can relax in the hot tub, sauna and enjoy massage treatment. Several shops and a beauty salon are available as well. The hotel offers concierge services, where entrance tickets to Osaka Castle can be purchased.

New Otani Osaka’s restaurants cater a variety of French, Japanese and International cuisine. Offering spectacular views of the city skyline and Osaka Castle, Keyaki restaurant serves grilled teppanyaki dishes, while Sky Lounge offers refreshing cocktails. A breakfast buffet featuring various cuisines are available at an extra charge.

Osaka Station is a 10-minute train ride from Hotel New Otani, while Kyoto and Nara can also be reached within 1-hour by train. The hotel is about a 75-minute train ride from Kansai International Airport and a 1-hour train ride from Itami Airport.

resort_details:

Located along the Okawa River renowned for beautiful cherry blossoms, Imperial Hotel Osaka is a prestigious 5-star hotel with elegant guest rooms, a fitness center and various fine dining options. It is a 5-minute walk from JR Sakuranomiya Station and a 15-minute free shuttle ride from JR Osaka Station. Free WiFi is available throughout the property.

Featuring chic décor and a relaxing ambiance, each spacious room comes with a satellite LCD TV, a fridge and a mini-bar. A wide work desk and a safety box are also included. The private bathroom is fitted with a bathtub and free toiletries.

While staying at Imperial Hotel Osaka, guests can work out at the fitness club and swimming pool at an additional charge, or receive rejuvenating massage treatments in the room or at the on-site salon. The business center comes with work desks and chargeable internet PCs. A hair salon and a flower shop are also available.

Both Osaka Tenmangu and Ougimachi subway stations are within a 10-minute walk, while iconic Osaka Castle is a 10-minute drive away. Japan Mint, which is a favorite spot for cherry blossom viewing in spring, is just a 10-minute stroll away.

Les Saison restaurant offers panoramic city views and sophisticated French cuisine. Kamon serves fresh seafood and steaks in teppanyaki-style, while lavish Chinese dishes can be enjoyed at Jasmine Garden.

room_details.room_Description: The Imperial Hotel, Osaka offers a variety of room types, including suites, superior rooms, and standard rooms. The hotel boasts spacious rooms with comfortable beds, beautiful river views, and an elegant, luxurious design. Rooms include amenities like a hair dryer, refrigerator, and mini-bar.

Offering views of Osaka city from the 20th floor, Pierre restaurant serves exquisite contemporary French dishes. All Day Dining serves a buffet with various international dishes, drinks are available at Adee Bar and Lounge.

Osaka InterContinental Hotel is a 10-minute drive from Osaka Castle and a 20-minute drive from Universal Studios Japan. Shin Osaka Station and Namba Station are both a 15-minute train ride away. Kansai International Airport is a 60-minute express train ride from JR Osaka Station.

room_details.room_Description: The InterContinental Osaka offers a variety of rooms and suites, many with city views, premium bedding, and minibar amenities. Some rooms include Club InterContinental lounge access, providing breakfast, afternoon tea, and cocktails. The hotel also features suites with separate living areas, luxurious bathrooms with bathtubs and showers, and even residences with multiple bedrooms.

Iconic design represents the perfect balance of urban dynamism and cultural sensibility and is the epitome of Japanese minimalism - nonetheless, a dramatic lobby framed by a gigantic washi paper lantern and anchored by a zen garden of water, gravel and rocks will welcome the guests.

room_details.room_Description: Aman Tokyo offers a variety of luxurious rooms and suites, each with a unique blend of Japanese design and modern amenities. resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Capitol Hotel Tokyu
Designed by Kengo Kuma, Capitol Hotel Tokyu features 3 restaurants, a 14th-floor indoor pool and direct access to 4 subway lines. Rooms are spacious for Tokyo and have city views. Free WiFi is available in the entire building and paid private parking is available on site.

Rooms at Tokyu Capitol Hotel offer a softly lit blend of the old and new, with paper screens and a large flat-screen TV. A mini-bar and a large private bathroom with a bathtub are included. Free toiletries, slippers and a hairdryer are provided.

Guests can look out over Tokyo as they work out at the fitness center or relax in the hot tub. Carju Rajah TIADO Spa offers massages and the hotel includes a beauty salon, photo studio and other shops. The business center on the 3rd floor features a computer and photocopying services for guests' convenience.

Star Hill Chinese Restaurant serves lunch and dinner in stylish modern settings. Suiren offers various Japanese dishes including teppanyaki, sushi and kaiseki multi-courses. Asian and Western cuisines are available all day at Origami. The Capitol Bar offers mood lighting, natural wood and elegantly served cocktails.

The hotel has direct access to the Tameike-sanno and Kokkai-gijido-mae subway stations, which offer direct links to the Shinjuku, Shibuya and Ginza areas. The Imperial Palace is a 5-minute drive, while Roppongi Hills is a 10-minute drive away.

room_details.room_Description: The Capitol Hotel Tokyu offers a variety of spacious and luxurious guest rooms, including suites and Club Floor rooms, all incorporating traditional Japanese design elements. Rooms feature panoramic views of Tokyo and are known for their elegant atmosphere and attentive service.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Conrad Tokyo
Located in the heart of Tokyo, just a few steps away from Ginza, the world-famous shopping and entertainment district. Conrad Tokyo features rooms furnished with modern decor, award winning restaurants and a 29th-floor spa with beautiful city views. It ranked 1st as the most popular Japanese hotel for international travelers by TripAdvisor 2015.

Shiodome Subway Station and JR Shimbashi Train Station are both located within a 5-minute walk from the hotel. Tokyo Big Sight Exhibition Center can be reached with a 25-minute monorail ride while the Imperial Palace is a 15-minute drive away.

Rooms at the Conrad are among the largest in Tokyo, and feature panoramic views of Hamarikyu Gardens or Tokyo Bay through floor-to-ceiling windows. Rooms come with a mini-bar, a flat-screen TV with a VOD system and a DVD player. Also offers a bathroom with rain shower. Wired and wireless internet access is available at an extra charge.

Guests can swim laps in the picturesque free-use indoor pool or work out to views of Tokyo in the spacious fitness center. Mizuki Spa offers private treatment rooms and a variety of relaxing massages.

Conrad Tokyo houses 5 dining options with city skyline views, including China Blue.

room_details.room_Description: The Conrad Tokyo offers luxurious and spacious rooms and suites with Japanese-inspired decor and modern amenities, many with panoramic city views. Executive rooms, deluxe suites, and the Royal Suite offer access to the Executive Lounge with complimentary amenities like breakfast, afternoon tea, and evening cocktails. Room details include features like balconies/terraces, separate showers and bathtubs, and Executive Lounge access.

The Mandarin Bar serves up refreshing cocktails, while Tapas Molecular Bar offers a one-of-a-kind, story-telling experience.

It is directly connected to Otemachi Subway Station and an 8-minute walk from JR Tokyo Station. Free WiFi is provided in the entire area.

Offering elegant and chic ambiance, each spacious room comes with a large LCD TV, a blu-ray/DVD player and a safety box. A fridge and an electric kettle are also provided. The private bathroom includes a small TV, a bath tub and toiletries.

While staying at Tokyo Palace Hotel, guests can enjoy a workout at the fitness gym, or receive rejuvenating treatments at the on-site Evian Spa Tokyo. The concierge desk can arrange various services for guests. Tablet rentals, copy and fax services are available for an extra charge upon request at the front desk or club lounge.

Located right next to the Imperial Palace, the hotel is a 10-minute walk from Ginza shopping area, and a 5-minute train ride from Akihabara electric town. Popular Tsukiji Fish Market can be reached within a 10-minute taxi ride. Airport limousine busses are available to/from Narita and Haneda airports at an extra charge.

place_name: The Prince Gallery Tokyo Kioicho, A Luxury Collection Hotel
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Prince Gallery Tokyo Kioicho, a Luxury Collection Hotel
Located a minutes’ walk away from Akasaka-Mitsuke Station of the Tokyo Metro Ginza and Marunouchi Line, The Prince Gallery Tokyo Kioicho features free WiFi throughout the entire property. There is a sake bar, a sushi restaurant and a teppanyaki restaurant on site, as well as a fitness center and a 24-hour front desk.

The hotel is directly linked to Nagatacho Station of the Nanboku Line. It is a 10-minute drive from Tokyo Station, and a 30-minute drive from Haneda Airport. Narita International Airport is a 100-minute drive away.

The Prince Gallery Tokyo Kioicho features a spa and wellness center and a sauna facility, and the front desk offers currency exchange. Laundry services are offered at an extra cost.

All rooms are air-conditioned/heated and feature a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Rooms come with a desk, mini-bar, electric kettle, a coffee machine, personal locker and a refrigerator. The private bathroom comes equipped with a bathtub and shower. Hairdryers, free toiletries, slippers and bathrobes provided.

Guests can enjoy a variety of Japanese cuisine on site, and there are several restaurants within a 3-minute walk from Akasaka Mitsuke Station.

place_name: Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club (Nanyuki, Kenya)
resort_details:
Experience World-class Service at Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club
Located in Nanyuki, Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club provides an outdoor swimming pool and tennis court. Featuring a 24-hour front desk, this property also provides guests with a restaurant. The property is set 15 mi from Mount Kenya National Park.

The units in the hotel are equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Rooms are complete with a private bathroom fitted with a hair dryer, while some rooms at Fairmont Mount Kenya also feature a seating area.

A buffet breakfast is served every morning at the property.

The accommodations offers a children's playground. You can play table tennis and darts at this 5-star hotel, and the area is popular for cycling.

Mt. Kenya Wildlife Conservancy is 1312 feet from Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club, while Nanyuki Sports Club is 5 mi from the property.

location: Harry Thuku Road, Nairobi CBD, 00200 Nairobi, Kenya
resort_details:
Set among tropical gardens, Fairmont The Norfolk offers luxury accommodations in an early 19th-century colonial building. It includes a fitness center with sauna, 6 restaurants and a heated outdoor pool.

Elegantly decorated rooms include a flat-screen TV, marble bathroom and views of the surrounding garden. More spacious suites feature a separate seating area and some have a large, furnished terrace.

The Norfolk features a modern-style American steak house, a classically furnished wine bar serving hors d'oeuvres and a poolside restaurant. Historical Lord Delamere Terrace restaurant and bar provides an international à la carte menu and drink selection. Free WiFi is available on site.

Shopping and cultural tours of Nairobi can be organized at the 24-hour front desk. The gym has personal trainers and daily classes as well as a steam room and massage facilities. Business guests are also offered a complimentary return shuttle to their office with free WiFi on board.

A collection of Kenyan history and culture can be seen at the National Museums of Kenya, a 15-minute walk. A shuttle is available at a fee for Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, 11 mi away.

room_details.room_Description: Fairmont The Norfolk in Nairobi offers a range of luxurious rooms and suites, many with unique features and historical details. Room types include Deluxe King Rooms, Fairmont Queen Rooms, Signature King Suites, and various suites like the Superior Suite and Deluxe Suite. The hotel also features rooms with 1937-era decor, honoring the hotel's rich history.

resort_details: Giraffe Manor is an iconic boutique hotel set in a leafy suburb of Nairobi. Owned and operated by The Safari Collection, there are twelve individually decorated rooms, offering first-class comfort and the feeling of staying in an elegant family home. The charming herd of resident Rothchild’s giraffes roam the surrounding sanctuary and give guests unique, once-in-a-lifetime encounters over breakfast and afternoon tea when they can be fed by hand. The Retreat at Giraffe Manor, found on the same property, gives guests access to a stunning pool and wellness facilities.

room_details.room_Description: Giraffe Manor in Nairobi offers 12 uniquely designed rooms, each with en-suite bathrooms and modern amenities. Some rooms are in the main manor house, while others are in the adjacent Garden Manor. Room features include mosquito nets, hairdryers, torches, safes, phones, and Wi-Fi.

location: Al Soor Street, Al Merqab, Kuwait City District, Kuwait, Kuwait
place_name: Four Seasons Hotel Kuwait at Burj Alshaya (Al Mirqab, Kuwait)
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Four Seasons Hotel Kuwait at Burj Alshaya
With five restaurants and lounges, Four Seasons Hotel Kuwait at Burj Alshaya offers a complete experience where guests can sleep, dine and enjoy all the facilities on offer. There is an indoor and an outdoor pool, and guests can enjoy the free WiFi throughout the hotel.

All rooms and suites feature oak hardwood floors, a curved sofa, a wall-mounted TV and a personal pantry with an espresso maker, tea maker and small refrigerator. Bedside control of lighting and drapery helps achieve a dark, restful room. Power outlets and data ports are within easy reach, and all rooms include a tablet to access Hotel services. The bathrooms include a free-standing oval tub, separate rain shower, twin vanity sinks, and a TV and lighting integrated within the mirror.

The Dai Forni offers rooftop views and matched Italian cuisine. For breakfast and lunch options, Elements restaurant showcases international cuisine with live cooking stations for Asian, Indian, Arabic and Italian specialties. Set on the fourth-floor terrace beside the outdoor pool is Al Bandar restaurant and lounge, offering shisha late into the night.

With an array of massages and facials, as well as noninvasive beauty treatments and medical cosmetics, the two-level spa facility features 10 treatment rooms, including two suites with bath tubs, a Psammotherapy suite and a Hammam.

Souk Al-Mubarakiya is 0.9 mi from Four Seasons Hotel Kuwait at Burj A, while Souq Al Kuwait is 1 mi away. Kuwait International Airport is 8.7 mi from the property.

location: Al Ta’awun Street, Kuwait, 13036 Kuwait, Kuwait
resort_details:
Experience World-class Service at Jumeirah Messilah Beach Kuwait
Located in the Messilah beach district, this 5-star hotel offers modern accommodations with free Wi-Fi in the heart of Kuwait. It features 5 dining outlets along with an outdoor pool, gym, and spa.

With contemporary décor and electric curtains, all air-conditioned units come with a flat-screen TV, mini-bar, tea/coffee making facilities, in-room safe, and private bathroom. The apartments have a fully equipped kitchen and a living room.

An international breakfast buffet is served at Garden Café, and Italian cuisine is offered at Olio Trattoria Italiana. You may also invite your family and friends to celebrate the victory of your favorite athlete or cheer on your team in our Mint Sports Lounge, savor a juicy steak at Pepper or enjoy your Afternoon Tea at the Lobby Lounge.

After a game of tennis or an energizing workout at Talise Fitness Club, you can unwind at Talise Spa where a range of treatments is available. You can take a dip in the swimming pool or soak up the sun at our sandy Beach. Sinbad’s Kids Club entertains children under 6 years old.

Jumeirah Messilah Beach Kuwait features state-of-the-art conference and banqueting facilities for business travelers.

location: 1873 Sheikh Zayed Bin Sultan Al Nahyan Rd, 92000, Farwaniya, 92000 Kuwait, Kuwait
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Waldorf Astoria Kuwait
Elegant Accommodations: Waldorf Astoria Kuwait in Al Andalous offers luxurious rooms with air-conditioning, free WiFi, and modern amenities. Each room includes a bathrobe, mini-bar, and work desk, ensuring a comfortable stay.

Exceptional Facilities: Guests can enjoy spa facilities, a sauna, fitness center, sun terrace, and a year-round outdoor swimming pool. Additional amenities include a hot tub, steam room, and yoga classes, catering to all fitness needs.

Dining Experience: The family-friendly restaurant serves Japanese, Mediterranean, and international cuisines in a modern and romantic ambiance. Breakfast options include continental, American, buffet, full English/Irish, vegetarian, vegan, halal, and gluten-free.

Prime Location: Located 8.1 mi from Kuwait International Airport, the hotel is near attractions such as Jaber Al Ahmad International Stadium (5 mi) and Liberation Tower (6.8 mi). Guests appreciate the attentive staff and nearby shops.

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Banyan Tree Kuala Lumpur
Located just a 3-minute walk from Pavilion Shopping Mall, Banyan Tree Kuala Lumpur offers accommodations within the hustle and bustle of Kuala Lumpur. It features an outdoor swimming pool and guests can enjoy meals at the in-house restaurant or have a drink at the bar. Free WiFi is available throughout the property.

It is 1312 feet from Aquaria KLCC, a 5-minute walk from Fahrenheit 88 and 2625 feet from The Weld. The property is close to popular attractions like Petronas Twin Towers, Berjaya Times Square and Suria KLCC. Suria KLCC is 0.6 mi from Banyan Tree Kuala Lumpur, while Dinner in the Sky KL is a 15-minute walk away. Kuala Lumpur International Airport is 34 mi from the property.

All rooms in the hotel are equipped with a coffee machine. With a private bathroom, rooms at Banyan Tree Kuala Lumpur also have free WiFi, while certain rooms will provide you with Petronas Twin Towers view. At the accommodations, each room comes with air conditioning and a flat-screen TV.

Speaking Chinese, English and Malay at the reception, staff will be happy to provide guests with practical information on the area.

room_details.room_Description: Banyan Tree Kuala Lumpur offers 55 elegant rooms and suites, ranging from Banyan Retreat King and Twin to the luxurious Banyan Tree Suite. All rooms feature modern interiors, city skyline views, and comfortable amenities.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Resorts World Genting - Crockfords
Elegant Accommodation: Resorts World Genting - Crockfords in Genting Highlands offers a 5-star experience with luxurious rooms featuring private bathrooms, bathrobes, and free WiFi.

Exceptional Facilities: Guests can enjoy a restaurant, bar, and lounge, complemented by a 24-hour front desk, concierge service, and full-day security.

Comfortable Amenities: Rooms include tea and coffee makers, minibars, and free toiletries, ensuring a comfortable and relaxing stay.

Prime Location: Located 70 km from Sultan Abdul Aziz Shah Airport, the hotel is near First World Plaza (4 km) and the Royal Selangor Pewter Factory and Visitor Centre (44 km).

room_details.room_Description: Crockfords at Resorts World Genting offers luxurious rooms and suites, all featuring private steam baths and marble restroom fixtures. The hotel also includes one-touch technology for controlling blinds, temperature, and lighting. Room types include Superior Rooms, Junior Suites, and Signature Suites, each with unique themes like a high-end gym, Zen tea ceremony space, or an automatic mahjong table. Executive Suites are the most luxurious, spanning over 2,900 square feet.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur
Located just 280 metres from KLCC Park, Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur offers accommodations within Kuala Lumpur's city centre. It features an outdoor swimming pool and guests can enjoy meals from 6 of the in-house dining options. Free WiFi is available in all rooms.
It is 280 metres to Petronas Twin Towers and Suria KLCC, while Avenue K is 500 metres from the property. Lot 10 and Sungai Wang Plaza are 2 km away. The nearest airport is Sultan Abdul Aziz Shah Airport, 30 km from Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur.
Air-conditioned rooms are fitted with a flat-screen TV. Some units open up to views of the park. En suite bathrooms include shower facilities.
Guests can approach the 24-hour front desk for concierge services. A fitness centre and a sauna room is available. Alternatively, guests can indulge in spa treatments at the in-house spa.
Elevated Cantonese cuisine is served at Yun House, while guests are treated to live cooking of international dishes featured at Curate's show kitchen. TThe Lounge offers delightful afternoon tea and a la carte dining. Cocktails can be enjoyed at award-winning Bar Trigona, voted #1 in Malaysia and part of Asia and the World's Best Bar List.

place_name: Genting Grand at Resorts World Genting
resort_details: Signature luxury hotel at the peak Crowned with the trademark Genting logo, Genting Grand is easily the most recognisable hotel at the peak. Enjoy a 5-star stay where elegance and class have stood the test of time, and indulge in the luxury that comes only from staying at the best.

place_name: Highlands Hotel at Resorts World Genting
resort_details:
Nestled in the cool climate of Genting Highlands Hotel features a casino, a spa, fitness centre and modern guestrooms. It operates a 24-hour front desk and provides daily housekeeping service.

Elegantly furnished, rooms come with carpet flooring, a work desk, in-room safe, a fan and seating area. A flat-screen satellite TV, telephone and electric kettle are also included. The attached bathroom has shower facility and hairdryer.

At Highlands Hotel, guests can relax in a pampering massage or enjoy rides and arcade games at the theme park. The friendly staff can assist with luggage storage, laundry and concierge services.

Housing a range of restaurants, guests can indulge in various selections of local and international cuisines. Room service options are also available. Parking is available at an additional charge.

The hotel is within a 10-minute walk from Genting Skyway Cable Car, Genting Indoor Theme Park and Genting International Convention Centre. Awana Golf Course and Chin Swee Caves Temple are about 15 minutes' drive away.

location: Kuala Lumpur City Centre, 50088 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Mandarin Oriental, Kuala Lumpur
Mandarin Oriental, Kuala Lumpur is a luxurious urban resort located in the heart of Kuala Lumpur and enjoys an unrivalled location next to the iconic Petronas Twin Towers, KL Convention Centre, and prestigious Suria KLCC mall. 

The hotel’s stylishly appointed rooms, suites and executive apartments overlook the city’s magnificent skyline and KLCC Park. Club rooms and suites offer access to MO Club Lounge, a sophisticated venue that combines prestige, convenience, and impeccable service.

Guests at MO Club will experience exclusive dining and added privileges including all day refreshments and priority check-in and check-out.

The hotel’s accommodation is also complemented by several award-winning restaurants and bars as well as state-of-the-art meeting and event facilities. Guests can also enjoy spectacular leisure and recreation facilities including tennis courts, an award-winning spa, kids club, and an outdoor infinity edge pool that overlooks the lush 50-acre KLCC park.

room_details.room_Description: The Mandarin Oriental, Kuala Lumpur offers a variety of elegant rooms and suites, many with views of the KLCC Park and the Petronas Twin Towers. Room types include Deluxe City View, Deluxe Park View, and Twin Towers View options. Deluxe rooms feature spacious marble bathrooms with walk-in showers and bathtub, while Park View rooms offer plush carpets and king or twin beds. Executive and Club rooms offer additional amenities and views, and the hotel also offers apartments and suites.

location: Jalan Teluk Datai, 07000 Teluk Datai, Malaysia
resort_details:
Experience world-class service at The Datai Langkawi
Located on the island of Langkawi, along a private beach, The Datai offers luxurious accommodation with free Wi-Fi. It boasts a golf course, well-appointed spa and swimming pool.

The rooms at The Datai Langkawi overlook a tropical landscape and feature a living area with a private balcony. En suite bathrooms are fitted with a dressing area and bathtub.

The hotel’s spa offers a menu of massage and body treatments. Mountain bikes are also available for usage, at no charge. Guests have access to a fitness centre and two tennis courts at Els Club Teluk Datai, which is a 5-minute drive from the resort.

Situated away from the hotel in a rainforest, The Gulai House is an open-air restaurant serving Malay and Indian dishes. The Dining Room serves western and local favourites, while The Pavilion offers Thai food in an outdoor setting.

The Datai is a 40-minute drive from Langkawi International Airport. The Els Club Teluk Datai is a 5-minute drive from the hotel.

room_details.room_Description: The Datai Langkawi offers a variety of luxurious rooms and suites, including the Datai Suite, Canopy Deluxe, Canopy Garden, Canopy Premium, and Canopy Suite. The Datai Suite is the largest, at 378 square metres, while the Canopy Deluxe and Canopy Garden are 63 square metres, and the Canopy Suite ranges from 109 to 125 square metres.

location: Jalan Pantai Kok, 07000 Pantai Kok, Malaysia
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Ritz-Carlton, Langkawi
Featuring a private beach area, tennis court and free WiFi, The Ritz-Carlton, Langkawi is located in Pantai Kok, 2.9 km from Oriental Village. It features a fitness centre. Guests can enjoy meals at the in-house restaurant or have a drink at the bar.

Langkawi Cable Car is 2.9 km from The Ritz-Carlton, Langkawi, while Seven Wells is 3.6 km away. The nearest airport is Langkawi Airport, 5 km from the property.

At the hotel, rooms come with a wardrobe. Rooms are fitted with a private bathroom with a bath. At The Ritz-Carlton, Langkawi, all rooms include a seating area.

The Ritz-Carlton, Langkawi offers a children's playground. Guests at the hotel will be able to enjoy activities in and around Pantai Kok, like cycling.

The in-house restaurant, Langkawi Kitchen serves up Asian cuisine, while guests can enjoy drinks and Thai dishes at Horizon Bar.

room_details.room_Description: The Ritz-Carlton, Langkawi, offers a variety of luxurious rooms and villas, many with private pools and views of the rainforest or ocean. The resort features Rainforest Deluxe Rooms, rainforest villas, and a range of larger villas, including those with private pools. Rooms typically include amenities like air conditioning, ensuite bathrooms, balconies, and free Wi-Fi.

resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Amilla Maldives
Amilla Fushi Resort Villas & Residences is a island resort located in Baa Atoll offering you a choice of island homes that hover over clear waters, nestled amongst lush tree tops or the shores of pristine white sand. An outdoor pool and a spa and wellness centre is available. Free WiFi access is available in this resort.

The air-conditioned accommodation will provide you with a terrace, minibar and a seating area. Featuring a shower, private bathroom also comes with a bath or shower. You can enjoy sea view from the room.

At Amilla Fushi Resort Villas & Residences you will find a restaurant, a private beach area and a tennis court Other facilities offered at the property include a ticket service, a tour desk and luggage storage. An array of activities can be enjoyed on site or in the surroundings, including fishing, diving and snorkelling.

This contemporary gastronomic paradise offers seven enticing restaurants, including signature Japanese izakaya with a spicy Latin touch, as well as three bars serving craft cocktails, immunity-boosting tinctures and fine wines to delight your taste buds.

The property is a 30-minute seaplane ride from Malé International Airport and a 15-minute flight to Dharavandhoo Domestic Airport in Baa Atoll.

room_details.room_Description: Amilla Maldives offers a variety of spacious and luxurious villas, including Sunset Water Pool Villas, Lagoon Water Pool Villas, Reef Water Pool Villas, Beach Pool Villas, and two-bedroom options. These villas feature private pools, air conditioning, private bathrooms, satellite channels, and tea/coffee makers.

location: Kihavah Huravalhi Island, 99999 Baa Atoll, Maldives
resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Anantara Kihavah Maldives Villas
Featuring luxurious villas with private infinity pools, Anantara Kihavah Villas is located on beautiful Kihavah Huravalhi Island in Baa Atoll. Surrounded by coral reefs and blue lagoon, it has free WiFi access and an over-water spa. Anantara Kihavah Villas is a scenic 35-minute seaplane ride from Male International Airport. Airport transfers are provided by the hotel at an extra charge.

Choose from several spacious Pool Villas and Residences either sitting above the crystal-clear waters or along a pristine stretch of virgin sand. Fitted with fine wood furnishings and premium cotton bedding, the air-conditioned villas feature an over-sized bathtub, outdoor dining pavilion and an entertainment system with a flat-screen TV, iPod dock and DVD player. Wine chiller, espresso machine and fully-stocked minibar are also included.  Each villa offers absolute privacy, beach and ocean access, personalised iPad concierge services, and a dedicated Villa Host on call 24 hours a day to help tailor-create your dream escape to the finest detail.

A range of water sports, including wake-boarding, windsurfing, canoeing, catamaran sailing and snorkeling, is available. For those looking to exercise, there is a tennis court and fitness centre on site. Swim with majestic manta rays or snorkel at one of the world’s most treasured house-reefs, just steps away from your villa. Stargaze into the night at the world’s only over water observatory.

Young VIPS are treated to an unforgettable holiday experience with mini-master chef classes, a giant trampoline park at the Kid’s Club, children’s amenities, and pampering sessions curated especially for young travelers at the over water spa.

The resort offers unique dining experiences in the Maldives ranging from a gourmet breakfast of live cooking stations on the beach to theatrical Teppanyaki cuisine. Integrating itself with the surrounding beauty of the vibrant coral reefs, a once-in-a-lifetime gastronomic experience awaits at our multi-awarded winning underwater restaurant, SEA.

location: Male City, North Male Atoll, 08110 Male, 08110 Male City, Maldives
resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru
Experience the Original Maldives in barefoot eco-luxury at Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru. Nestled within the idyllic North Malé Atoll, this lush tropical haven is conveniently reachable in just a 25-minute speedboat ride from Velana International Airport. The resort features 48 newly refurbished all-pool villas, blending timeless Maldivian heritage with sustainable design and adorned with distinctive local arts and crafts. Guests are welcomed with a serene barefoot ritual, grounding them in the island’s tranquil spirit.

Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru embodies its ethos of embracing the environment and empowering people through its expanded Marine Lab, a symbol of over 20 years of ocean stewardship. Guests can participate in inspired conservation efforts, including coral restoration and biodiversity programs, and enjoy mesmerising underwater experiences such as guided snorkelling tours, marine life safaris, Kahan’bu catamaran cruise and visits to the 26-year-old Rannamaari shipwreck, a vibrant habitat for marine creatures, and more.

Embark on an enchanting culinary journey at three exceptional dining venues: Sangu Garden for Maldivian grills, the signature Thai restaurant Saffron, and the award-winning Madi Hiyaa offering authentic Japanese Yakitori. With the new Dine-Around concept and the exclusive Twin-Island experience at its sister property Dhawa Ihuru, this inviting sanctuary offers unrivalled moments. Recognised as the 'Most Sustainable Resort' at the TTM Awards, Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru also features the award-winning Banyan Tree Spa, renowned for its holistic and rejuvenating wellness rituals.

Cheval Blanc Randheli is a luxurious, intimate Maldivian resort with 45 villas, including over-water, island, and beach garden villas, each with a private pool. It's located on Noonu Atoll, a 40-minute seaplane ride north of Malé. The resort offers fine dining, a Guerlain spa, and personalized services for exclusive experiences.

room_details.room_Description: Cheval Blanc Randheli offers various villas, including Island Villas (one or two-bedroom) and Water Villas. Island Villas range from 240 to 355 sqm (2,580 – 3,820 sqft) and feature private beaches, terraces, and ensuite bathrooms. Water Villas, on stilts, offer ocean views, private pools, and outdoor lounges.

resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Conrad Maldives Rangali Island
Set on 2 separate islands connected by a bridge, the luxurious Conrad Maldives Rangali Island offers spacious private villas. It boasts the all-glass underwater Ithaa Restaurant and 2 award-winning spas.

Stretching up to 500 metres into the Indian Ocean, Conrad Rangali Island's villas are packed full of creature comforts, including free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and DVD players. Beautiful sea or beach views are framed through wooden floor-to-ceiling windows.

Total relaxation can be enjoyed at the lagoon Spa Retreat and Over-Water Spa. Guests may make their stays extra rewarding by visiting the on-site Italian boutique, or learning about local culture on a day trip to one of the surrounding islands.

Conrad Maldives' 12 world-class restaurants and bars serve an assortment of international, Mediterranean and grilled dishes. Over 600 bottles of premium wine can be enjoyed at The Wine Cellar.

We are a twin-island experience resort. Our family island, Rangali-Finolhu welcomes children of all ages. Our secluded adults' island, Rangali island does not permit children below the age of 16 to stay in water villas and the Quiet Zone pool located on this island. With the exception of the 2 Bedroom Rangali Ocean Pavilion with Pool that accommodates up to a family of six including children.

Conrad Maldives Rangali Island is reachable via a 30-minute scenic seaplane transfer from Male International Airport.

room_details.room_Description: Conrad Maldives Rangali Island offers a range of accommodations, including beach villas, water villas, and suites, many with private pools. Room sizes vary, with options ranging from the smaller Sunrise Water Villas to the expansive Three-Bedroom Beach Suite. Many rooms also feature ocean views, private balconies or terraces, and luxurious amenities like bathtubs and spa tubs.

resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Constance Halaveli
Offering guests a luxurious island holiday, Constance Halaveli Resort features spacious villas with private plunge pools. Providing comprehensive spa and diving facilities, it has 3 dining options and tennis courts.

Featuring hardwood flooring and well-crafted furnishings, open-concept villas feature views of surrounding greenery or the lagoon. Each well-equipped villa has amenities like a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi.

To relax, guests can indulge in a massage at the spa, or go on fishing and diving trips. Regular workouts can be maintained at the well-equipped fitness centre.

JAHAZ Restaurant serves international dishes and is available for breakfast and dinner. Other dining options include fresh seafood at MEERU and Asian food at JING.

Experience world-class service at Cora Cora Maldives - Premium All-Inclusive Resort
Prime Beachfront Location: Cora Cora Maldives in Raa Maamigili offers a private beach area and beachfront access. Guests enjoy an infinity swimming pool, sun terrace, and free WiFi throughout the resort.

Comfortable Accommodations: Rooms feature sea views, air-conditioning, and private bathrooms. Additional amenities include balconies, terraces, and modern furnishings, ensuring a relaxing stay.

Dining Experience: The family-friendly restaurant serves Indian, Italian, Japanese, and other cuisines in a modern ambience. Breakfast options include continental, American, and vegetarian.

Leisure and Activities: Guests can participate in yoga, fitness classes, snorkelling, and film nights. The resort also provides a kids' club, indoor and outdoor play areas, and evening entertainment.

room_details.room_Description: Cora Cora Maldives offers a variety of room options, including beach villas, lagoon villas, and family villas with private pools. Rooms typically feature amenities like air conditioning, private balconies or terraces, flat-screen TVs, and minibars. Some villas also include walk-in showers, bathrobes, and additional bathrooms.

location: North Male Atoll, 09 230 North Male Atoll, Maldives
place_name: Four Seasons Resort Maldives at Kuda Huraa
resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Four Seasons Resort Maldives at Kuda Huraa
Vibrant with tropical flowers, Four Seasons Resort Maldives at Kuda Huraa is a garden-style resort arranged as a traditional Maldivian village on its own coral island. Just a 30-minute speedboat transfer from Malé international airport, it offers for year-round sun, surfing and diving.

The rooms are surrounded by tropical blooms or offer mesmerizing ocean views. A flat-screen TV and DVD player are available. En-suite spacious bathrooms integrate an indoor bath tub and shower area with a Maldivian open-air shower set in the exotic confines of a walled garden.

Guests can engage in exhilarating activities from surfing to shark safaris, dolphin-watching to diving. There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. You can play tennis and billiards at this resort. Snorkel the coral gardens or sail to The Island Spa for marine-inspired treatments.

Four restaurants and two bars are complemented by private dining options including sandbank barbecues and private over water gazebos.

Male City is 20 km from Four Seasons Kuda Huraa.

Please note that the property is only accessible by the following mode of transfer: Speedboat transfer takes 25 minutes from Male International Airport. The return rates are: Adult: USD 480.48, round trip, inclusive of all taxes Child (6 to 12 years): USD 241.47, round trip, inclusive of all taxes Infant (0 to 5 years): Complimentary CHILD POLICY: Children under 5 years will eat for free based on the rules and meal-plan accompanied by an adult, excluding alcoholic beverages. Maximum 2 free kids per unit paid. Mandatory green tax of USD 6 per child per night will be charged. Christmas and New Year supplement Compulsory Christmas Eve dinner at USD 369.30 per adult and USD 110.88 per child (children between 6 – 12 years). Compulsory New Year’s Eve dinner at USD 462 per adult and USD 110.88 per child (children between 6 – 12 years). GENERAL POLICIES: Please present the same credit card used to guarantee your booking when checking in / making the payment at the hotel. Please note that property may contact the cardholder for verification purposes. Due to safety and privacy concerns the operation of unmanned aerial systems or drones by any of guests including model aircraft by recreational users and hobbyists is prohibited. Our one-bedroom accommodation is only inclusive of daily breakfast for 2 persons, while the family accommodation is inclusive of up to four persons. A mandatory breakfast supplement will be charged for the additional guest as follows: - Adult Breakfast at USD 45 per adult per day - Child Breakfast at USD 23 per child per day (from 06 - 12 years old) - Rates are subject to 23.2% service charge and taxes.

location: Hurawalhi Island Resort Lhaviyani Atoll, 20187 Kuredu, Maldives
resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Hurawalhi Island Resort
Hurawalhi Island Resort offers accommodation in Hurawalhi. The resort has an outdoor pool and spa centre.

Every room at this resort is air conditioned and is equipped with a flat-screen TV. Some rooms include a seating area to relax in after a busy day. You will find a kettle in the room. Every room is equipped with a private bathroom. For your comfort, you will find bathrobes and slippers.

You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property.

Hurawalhi has the world's largest all glass under water restaurant "5.8 Undersea Restaurant". The area is popular for snorkelling and windsurfing.

room_details.room_Description: Hurawalhi Island Resort offers a variety of villas, including Ocean Pool Villas, Beach Sunset Pool Villas, Beach Pool Villas, Romantic Ocean Villas, and Ocean Villas. These villas are designed for comfort and privacy, featuring amenities like private pools, balconies, and luxurious bathrooms.

resort_details:
Experience world-class service at JA Manafaru, Maldives
Experience World-class Service and Award-winning Dine Around All Inclusive at JA Manafaru, Maldives Located on an all-natural private island in the north of the Maldives, JA Manafaru, Maldives provides luxurious beautifully appointed beach and overwater villas with private outdoor pools. An on-site PADI dove centre, 3 additional outdoor pools and pampering spa treatments are available. The property is spread over 35 acres of peaceful white sandy beach, accessible by either domestic flight, followed by speedboat ride or choice is a seaplane transfer from Male' to JA Manafaru, Maldives.

Spacious and air-conditioned, all accommodations are equipped with a private pool, flat-screen TV, Nespresso coffeemaker and complimentary Wi-Fi. With a choice of either Beach or Overwater Villas with either sunrise or sunset views and your very own pool and each has private bathrooms, some also with a relaxing spa bathtub and some with outdoor rain shower. For something really special we have three bespoke Residences for families or friends traveling together.

Indulge with the award-winning Dine Around package, offering a variety of culinary experiences – a generous sized menu, themed nights, in-villa dining, unlimited ice cream & over 150 wines and cocktails. Savour fresh seafood at Ocean Grill, delight in international buffets at Kakuni, or unwind with refreshing drinks by the Infinity Pool & Bar. Explore the world of Italian flavours at Andiamo Bistro, Teppanyaki grill and savour Japanese specialties at White Orchid, or sip handcrafted cocktails and live music at Veli Bar. For an unforgettable evening, descend to The Cellar, the Maldives' first subterranean wine cave, for an exclusive dining experience. All 7 venues cater to all diets and cravings.

Guests can relax on the stunning beach or around 3 outdoor pools, include 1 children's pool. JA Manafaru, Maldives offers snorkelling activities on-site, over 55 complimentary activities, and things to do. Complimentary snorkelling gear is available and there are also other water sports, such as diving, sailing, jet-skiing and stand-up paddle boarding. Additional facilities include a floodlit tennis court, a pool table, a games area, and a photography studio. Cool Zone is our Children’s playground/space. Calm Spa Sanctuary nestles between the ancient banyan trees where guests can unwind with Eminence treatments and Maldivian massages. There are also wellness classes, yoga sessions, and a gym with fantastic sea views

room_details.room_Description: JA Manafaru offers various room types, including Water Villas, Beach Pool Residences, and Ocean Pool Residences, with varying sizes and layouts. Some rooms feature private pools, open-air bathrooms, and indoor/outdoor rain showers. Guests can choose between different bed types, such as King beds and super king beds.

location: North Male Atoll, Fari Islands, 20013 North Male Atoll, Maldives
resort_details:
Experience world-class service at The Ritz-Carlton Maldives, Fari Islands
Prime Beachfront Location: The Ritz-Carlton Maldives, Fari Islands in Male offers a private beach area and beachfront access. Guests enjoy sea views, a sun terrace, and a lush garden.

Exceptional Facilities: The resort features spa facilities, a sauna, fitness centre, tennis court, and free WiFi. Additional amenities include a hot tub, steam room, and yoga classes.

Comfortable Accommodations: Rooms offer air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and sea views. Family rooms and ground-floor units cater to all guests.

Dining Experience: A family-friendly restaurant serves Indian, Italian, Japanese, and Mediterranean cuisines. Dining options include brunch, lunch, dinner, and high tea.

Experience world-class service at Six Senses Laamu
Six Senses Laamu is a luxury resort surrounded by clear turquoise water and white sandy beaches. Its villas come with a 37-inch flat-screen TV and Bose entertainment system. Rooms offer free WiFi.
 Beautifully designed, air-conditioned villas feature an outdoor bathroom with rainshower where guests can shower under the stars. Private day beds and sunloungers lets guests enjoy the Maldivian sun from the comfort of the villas. Rooms offer electric kettle, slippers and dental kit. Newspaper can be acquired on request.
 Six Senses Laamu is the only five-star resort in the Laamu Atoll, in the south of Maldives. It is located on Olhuveli Island which is a 65 minute Seaplane flight away from Male International Airport.
Six Senses Spa features stylish private treatment rooms, Ayurvedic therapies and relaxing body massage. The resort also provides a modern gym, yoga pavilion and an on-site diving centre.
 LEAF serves modern Mediterranean dishes prepared with fresh organic ingredients, while premium wine and cheese can be enjoyed at Altitude Wine Cellar. Breakfast options are available.
 Other dining options include international cuisine at Longitude, pizza at Sip Sip, ice cream at Ice and drinks at the Chill Bar.

room_details.room_Description: Six Senses Laamu offers various luxurious villas, including Lagoon Beach Villas, Ocean Beach Villas, and Laamu Water Villas, all featuring private pools and direct access to the lagoon or ocean. These villas range from 1162 to 2562 square feet and accommodate 3-4 guests. Each villa is equipped with amenities like Egyptian cotton sheets, pillowtop beds, minibars, and flat-screen TVs.

resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Soneva Fushi
Spacious luxury villas at Soneva Fushi are hidden among dense foliage on a private island, located within the Baa Atoll, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. It is a 30-minute seaplane transfer from Male International Airport.

At this eco friendly resort, all the villas and rooms are extraordinarily spacious and enjoy direct private access to the beach. Signature bathrooms are built within a large private garden setting with outdoor showers and separate bathtubs.

You can explore the island with complimentary bicycles. Intuitive service is provided by Barefoot Butler. Highlights include the open-air Cinema Paradiso, counting Saturn’s rings in the high-tech Observatory, the home-made chocolate and ice cream rooms, five hundred wines to choose from and six different restaurants.

Learn the art of glass blowing at the Maldives’ only glass studio, discover the waters with complimentary non-motorised water sports, and sail aboard Soneva’s luxury two-bedroom yacht, Soneva in Aqua.

Guests can spend an evening overnight at the Sandbank, completely private and remote for a truly intimate experience under the stars.

room_details.room_Description: Soneva Fushi offers a variety of luxurious villas, from one-bedroom options to multi-bedroom residences, all designed with barefoot luxury and a focus on privacy. Villas are situated on the island or over the water, with many featuring private pools and direct beach access.

resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Soneva Jani
Located on the island of Medhufaru in a 5.6 km lagoon in the Noonu Atoll, Soneva Jani features both overwater and island villas.
Each water villa opens to its very own stretch of lagoon and is complete with a private pool and a retractable roof to stargaze from the master bedroom. Some of the villas have slides from the top floor directly into the lagoon below. All villas are equipped with a spacious master bedroom with an adjoining kids sleeping area. All villas have an open-air bathroom with bathtub, shower and lagoon access. They also have a walk-in mini-bar with espresso machine and private wine cellar selection. An outdoor deck and seating area with sun loungers and direct access to the lagoon are also available.
The main facilities of Soneva Jani are located at The Gathering, which is a three-storey structure that hosts the main dining outlets as well as an Observatory, a Spa, gift-shop and a water sports and dive centre. There is also an overwater silent cinema, a tennis court, a labyrinth gardens, and a Children's Den on the main island.
Soneva Jani offers a number of dining options and cuisines, as well as the complimentary cheese room, chocolate room and ice-cream room for all guests.
The property is a 40-minute seaplane ride from Male International Airport and 1-hour by speedboat from Soneva Fushi, Soneva Jani's sister resort.

room_details.room_Description: Soneva Jani offers a variety of spacious villas, including overwater and island options, with features like private pools, water slides, and retractable roofs. Each villa boasts a unique design with bright, beachy interiors and offers amenities like minibar, in-room safe, and luxury bedding.

place_name: The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort
resort_details:
Experience world-class service at The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort
Experience World-Class Service at The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort.

The first St. Regis located on a private island, The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort is set on nine hectares of lush tropical gardens, powdery white sand and surrounded by a turquoise lagoon. The resort can be reached by seaplane in 45-minute from Velana International Airport (MLE).

Personalized St. Regis Butler Service is available for all the rooms. The 77 spacious villas and suites each come with a private pool, iPad room controls and floor-to-ceiling windows. The rooms also include a walk-in closet, private terrace and Bang & Olufsen BeoVision TV offering International channels. The marble bathrooms come with freestanding bathtub, rainforest shower and signature amenities. A nonalcoholic stocked mini-bar is available in each villa category. Free Wi-Fi access is also available.

Delight over Italian, Chinese, Japanese Kaiseki style, Middle Eastern and other international cuisines in an unforgettable setting: The St. Regis Maldives offers six distinct dining venues including a pop-up restaurant, an overwater tapas bar and exceptional wine dinners at Decanter cellar. Guests can also delight in an island picnic, floating rituals and more. Halal food is available.

Perched over water, guests can indulge in a holistic approach to relaxation and rejuvenation at Iridium Spa. There are six overwater treatment rooms, including two that are dedicated to healing Ayurveda treatments. Each visit offers a customized spa experience such as authentic rituals or luxury caviar treatments. The Blue Hole is one of the most expansive hydrotherapy pool in the Indian Ocean.

The property also offers services and entertainment such as acupuncture, meditation, anti-gravity yoga, Children's club, indoor games at Socialite Club, outdoor main pool, outdoor tennis court and a library.

In addition to diving, snorkeling and windsurfing, the resort offers jet skiing, sea bobbing, glass bottom kayaking, parasailing and a luxury yacht called Norma available for charter.

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at AX The Palace
Just 500 metres from Sliema's bus terminus and Valletta Ferry, The Palace is a 5-star hotel with a rooftop spa with infinity pool overlooking the Mediterranean Sea. Most rooms have a balcony with views of Valletta and the harbour.

The Palace has spacious, air-conditioned rooms with a smart TV with over 70 HD international channels, a minibar, and a tea-and-coffee maker. Free Wi-Fi is available in public areas and in all rooms.

There is a choice of 2 restaurants at The Palace, the top-floor restaurant specialising in Asian cuisine, and the second one in Mediterranean classics.

The hotel is 8 km from Malta Airport, while the capital Valletta is only a 20-minute drive away.

room_details.room_Description: AX The Palace in Sliema, Malta offers a variety of room types, including Deluxe Double or Twin Rooms, Superior Double or Twin Rooms with City View, Comfort Double or Twin Rooms (non-balcony), Executive Double Rooms, Suites, Junior Suites with Balconies, Family Rooms, and Suites with Hot Tubs. All rooms feature amenities like air conditioning, attached bathrooms, balconies (except Comfort rooms), and tea/coffee makers.

resort_details:

Featuring free WiFi and views of the city's rooftops, The Saint John - AX Hotels offers modern accommodation in Malta's capital Valletta. The property is 5 minutes' walk from St. John's Co-Cathedral.

Fully air conditioned, each elegant room has a contemporary style and features a flat-screen smart TV, a work desk, and a coffee machine. The en suite bathroom includes a hairdryer, a bathrobe, slippers and free toiletries.

You can start the day with a breakfast, which provides a selection of sweet and savoury products,  as well as fresh fruit, hot drinks, and fruit juice. Guests can enjoy a beer or cocktail at the hotel's bar.

You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property.

The National War Museum is 300 metres away, while the Upper Barrakka Gardens are just a 10-minute walk away. Malta International Airport is a 15-minute drive from the property.

location: De Paule Avenue, BZN 9023 Attard, Malta
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Corinthia Palace Malta
Located in the heart of the island of Malta,  Corinthia Palace Malta features an outdoor swimming pool, a wellness centre, gym and much more.

This boutique hotel was built around an elegant, converted villa from the 19th century. It faces the Presidential Palace and is next to the beautiful San Anton Botanical Gardens. Surrounded by its beautifully landscaped gardens, the  Corinthia Palace Malta is a peaceful setting for a relaxing break and one of the island's leading 5-star hotels.

Corinthia Palace Malta features spacious guest rooms, all complete with a private balcony and all modern comforts.

The professional team of staff are always on hand and will be delighted to be of service to you.

Property features an indoor pool and children between 0 to 16 years old can access the indoor pool from 9am to 12pm.

The Vitality Suite is an adult only experience, aged 16 years of age and up. Complimentary use for hotel guests throughout their stay, reservations are required to avoid disappointment.

Please contact the Athenaeum spa team for further information.

You are well located for exploring Malta. The walled city of Medina is just 4 km from the hotel, while the popular resort of St Julians is 7 km away.

location: St. George`s Bay, STJ 3301 St Julian's, Malta
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Corinthia St George's Bay
Right on the waterfront of St. George's Bay, the Corinthia is a 5-star hotel with an on-site spa and 5 swimming pools set on luxurious sea-view terraces. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout.

Corinthia St George's Bay features spacious, air-conditioned rooms with a large balcony, most overlooking the sea.

Fine dining at the Corinthia includes a generous daily breakfast, plus 11 restaurants serving a variety of cuisines, all with views. Restaurants have both indoor and outdoor options, offering a wide selection of fine wines and cocktails.

Corinthia’s Apollo by Dee Spas is available for a variety of treatments including beauty treatments, Ayurvedic and reflexology massages. It also has an indoor heated pool, a sauna, a jacuzzi and a gym. Self-hire boat rental may be rented at the hotel's water-sport and diving centre.

Bus stop and hop on hop off stops are located right outside the hotel to take you to Malta's main localities and attractions in Valletta and Sliema. Hotel is also located at a walking distance to restaurants and bars.

Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Domus Zamittello offers luxury accommodation in a restored 17th century palazzo in Valletta. The property is just as one enters Valletta, overlooking Republic Street and Freedom Square. Domus Zamittello offers an à la carte breakfast with food cooked fresh to order.

It is around a 3-minute walk from Upper Barrakka Gardens and 500 metres from Manoel Theatre. Casa Rocca Piccola is 400 metres from the property.

The 24-hour front desk can offer helpful tips for getting around the area.

National Museum of Archaeology is 300 metres from Domus Zamittello. Malta International Airport is 6 km from the property.

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Hilton Malta
Set on the seafront in Saint Julian's, the Hilton Malta is a luxury 5-star hotel offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and a modern décor. On site you will find a spa with indoor swimming pool, 2 adults only seasonal outdoor pools, 2 seasonal outdoor pools also available for kids and 1 paddling pool for children.

The spacious rooms at Hotel Hilton Malta feature a large balcony overlooking the sea or Portomaso marina. All rooms are air-conditioned and feature Wi-Fi access, a tea/coffee maker, and a satellite LCD TV. Some rooms offer access to the Executive lounges.

The hotel's Oceana Restaurant serves dinner by the pool, while the Blue Elephant specialises in Thai cuisine. Breakfast is buffet style.

Facilities include a tennis court and a fully equipped fitness centre.

Malta International Airport can be reached in 20 minutes by car.

location: 11 St. Barbara Bastion, VLT 1961 Valletta, Malta
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Iniala Harbour House
Elegant Accommodation: Iniala Harbour House in Valletta offers a 5-star experience with spa facilities, a wellness centre, sauna, fitness centre, terrace, restaurant, massage services, bar, indoor swimming pool, and free WiFi.

Comfortable Amenities: Guests enjoy air-conditioning, private bathrooms, bathrobes, tea and coffee makers, minibars, and soundproofed rooms. Additional features include sea views, balconies, and modern amenities.

Prime Location: Located 7 km from Malta International Airport, the hotel is a short walk from Valletta Waterfront and near attractions such as Upper Barrakka Gardens and Manoel Theatre. Scuba diving is available in the surroundings.

Exceptional Service: Highly rated for its attentive staff and excellent service, the hotel provides a convenient location, delicious French cuisine, and a variety of activities including yoga and cycling.

location: Triq ir-Rokon, San Lawrenz SLZ 1040, SLZ 1040 San Lawrenz, Malta
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Kempinski Hotel San Lawrenz
Surrounded by 30.000-m² gardens, Kempinski Hotel San Lawrenz features free parking and non smoking-only, air-conditioned rooms on Gozo Island. This hotel on the westermost area of Gozo in the small village of San Lawrenz has an on-site spa offering luxury treatments.

Each of the rooms and suites at Kempinski has a private balcony overlooking the surrounding countryside or the resort's gardens and swimming pools.

Guests can sample Mediterranean cuisine at the award-winning L'Ortolan restaurant and genuine Italian recipes at the L'istoria Restaurant. Il-Baldakkin Gastrobar has a terrace and serves light meals and cocktails while the poolside grill and fish restaurant open in summer offers alfresco dining space.

At the Kempinski spa you will find 2 heated indoor pools, an indoor hot tub, hammam and steam bath as well as a gym and the Mediterranean's largest Ayurveda health centre. 2 floodlit tennis courts and 3 outdoor pools of which 1 for children are available.

Built to architecturally fit into the limestone surroundings, the hotel is a 15-minute drive from Gozo Ferry Terminal for departures to Malta.

Comfortable Accommodations: The Londoner Hotel Sliema in Sliema offers adults-only rooms with balconies, private bathrooms, and modern amenities. Each room includes air-conditioning, a work desk, and free WiFi.

Dining and Leisure: Guests can enjoy British cuisine at the family-friendly restaurant, offering lunch and dinner with cocktails. The hotel provides a bar, lounge, and terrace for relaxation.

Prime Location: Located less than 1 km from Qui-Si-Sana Beach and 8 km from Malta International Airport, the hotel is close to attractions such as The Point Shopping Mall and Portomaso Marina. Activities include cycling and water sports.

Guest Services: The hotel offers private check-in and check-out, a 24-hour front desk, concierge service, and free WiFi. Additional amenities include a hot tub, terrace, and outdoor dining area.

location: 138 Saint George's Road, STJ 3022 St Julian's, Malta
resort_details:
Comfortable Accommodations: The Londoner Hotel St. Julian's in St. Julians offers adults-only rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and modern amenities. Each room includes a work desk, minibar, and free WiFi.

Exceptional Facilities: Guests can enjoy a rooftop swimming pool, terrace, and restaurant serving Mediterranean cuisine in a modern ambience. Additional facilities include a pool bar, outdoor seating area, and free WiFi throughout the property.

Prime Location: Located 9 km from Malta International Airport, the hotel is a short walk from St George's Bay Beach and Portomaso Marina. Nearby attractions include Love Monument and Bay Street Shopping Complex.

Guest Services: The hotel provides private check-in and check-out, a 24-hour front desk, concierge service, and a tour desk. Additional services include bike and car hire, electric vehicle charging, and paid private parking.

room_details.room_Description: The Londoner Hotel St. Julian's offers various room types, including Standard Internal Rooms (21-29 sqm), Comfort Rooms (25 sqm), and more. Standard Internal Rooms are ideal for short stays or business trips and feature comfortable beds, a mini fridge, and a bathroom with a walk-in shower. Comfort Rooms offer a furnished balcony and blend modern amenities with design. The hotel also has Deluxe Rooms (29 sqm) with a balcony and city views, as well as Junior Suites with a terrace and city view.

location: 39 Main Street, Balluta Bay - Taxi entrance: Triq Dun Anton Tabone, STJ 1017 St Julian's, Malta
resort_details: 39 Main Street, Balluta Bay - Taxi entrance: Triq Dun Anton Tabone, STJ 1017 St Julian's, Malta

room_details.room_Description:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Malta Marriott Resort & Spa
The Malta Marriott Resort & Spa is located in St Julian's, 100 metres from Balluta Bay beach. The Resort combines luxurious charm and the relaxed feel of a Mediterranean spa, with well-appointed premium category rooms and luxury suites.

The rooms are air-conditioned and feature free WiFi, separate walk-in shower, 55” TV, minibar, tea & coffee making facilities and a safety box.

Guests can enjoy a a roof top outdoor pool with a splash pool offering  views of Balluta Bay, including a fully equipped Spa with 9 treatment rooms, heated indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, steam room, fitness center and squash court.

With four diverse restaurants and three bars the Malta Marriott Resort & Spa is easily accessible by car, taxi and public transport. - The hotel is within walking distance to St Julian’s nightlife area and the main shopping district of Sliema.

location: Palazzo Bifora, Number 1 Aragon Lane, MDN 1260 Mdina, Malta
resort_details:
Elegant Accommodation: Palazzo Bifora in Mdina offers a rooftop swimming pool, sun terrace, restaurant, bar, and free WiFi. Guests enjoy air-conditioned rooms with private bathrooms, modern amenities, and city views.

Dining Experience: The family-friendly restaurant serves Mediterranean, local, and European cuisines with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. Breakfast includes continental, American, Italian, and full English/Irish selections.

Convenient Location: Located 8 km from Malta International Airport, the hotel is near attractions such as Hagar Qim (9 km) and Valletta Waterfront (11 km). Free parking and a paid airport shuttle are available.

Exceptional Service: Highly rated for its attentive staff and excellent service, Palazzo Bifora provides a convenient base for city trips.

room_details.room_Description: Palazzo Bifora Boutique Hotel in Mdina, Malta, offers 6 unique suites, each with individually designed decor and modern amenities. These suites feature air-conditioning, heating, Smart TVs, pillow menus, pillowtop beds, minibars, and soundproofing. Some suites offer balconies, inner courtyard views, or city views. All suites have ensuite bathrooms with soaking tubs, rainfall showerheads, and designer toiletries.
