Situated in Valletta, a 3-minute walk from University of Malta - Valletta Campus, Palazzo Consiglia - IK Collection features an outdoor swimming pool and a terrace. The property is around a 9-minute walk from Upper Barrakka Gardens and 700 metres from Manoel Theatre.

All rooms have a wardrobe, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom. Some rooms will provide you with a seating area.

A continental breakfast is served every morning at the property.

Spa and wellness facilities including a hot tub and a hammam are at guests' disposal during their stay at the accommodation. The property also provides a 24-hour front desk.

Popular points of interest near Palazzo Consiglia - IK Collection include Auberge de Castille, Museum in Valletta Malta and The Malta Experience. Malta International Airport is 8 km from the property.

Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Built on the sides of one of the valleys in Mellieha, the hotel offers exquisite views of the church, the bay, the islands of Gozo and Comino, and the village.

The picturesque village of Mellieha, with its many shops, bars and restaurants, is only 200 metres from the hotel.  You can easily access the main attractions before returning to the hotel where you can relax in the spa or enjoy a drink in the numerous bars.

Pergola Hotel & Spa features a children's play area, a games room and an indoor and outdoor pool.

At the Pergola you can choose between guest rooms and self-catering apartments, all with balconies. Free WiFi access is available throughout.

For lunch and dinner you have a wide choice of restaurants, all serving a delicious choice of Mediterranean dishes. End your day in style with live music in the lounge bar.

The d'Angleterre Legacy Established in 1755, the 5-star hotel d’Angleterre is an icon and a historic landmark in Copenhagen and Denmark. Celebrated for its elegance, luxury and style, hotel d’Angleterre embodies the perfect balance between the stately Victorian architecture of the historic building and the graceful simplicity of contemporary Nordic design. The end result is a uniquely elegant combination of rich materials, surfaces, shapes and tones. Inspired by its rich heritage the hotel has recently undergone a complete refurbishment and has reopened as a revitalized grand palace. Balancing legacy and style with intuitive and tailored services, the d’Angleterre will complement the desires of today’s refined travelers. At d’Angleterre, the guest can dine at our Michelin-starred restaurant Marchal, enjoy cocktails and champagne at Balthazar Champagne Bar, relax in the Amazing Space Spa and swimming pool, shop at d’Angleterre CREATIONS and experience our delicious pastries and specialties at MAISON d’Angleterre.

room_details.room_Description: Hotel d'Angleterre in Copenhagen offers a range of room types, including Superior Guest Rooms, Deluxe Guest Rooms, and various suite options, all with unique features and amenities. Superior Guest Rooms, around 25 m2 (269 ft2), are perfect for couples or solo travelers and offer king-size beds or single beds on request, marble bathrooms, and a working desk. Deluxe Guest Rooms, approximately 35 m2 (376 ft2), also feature king-size beds and other amenities. The hotel also boasts Junior Suites and One Bedroom Suites, offering more space and living areas.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Hotel Sanders
This elegant boutique hotel is centrally located in Copenhagen, just 200 metres from Nyhavn. Hotel Sanders features a rooftop conservatory garden and a modern restaurant. WiFi access is free.

Sander's stylish rooms feature a complimentary minibar with soft drinks and snacks, a flat-screen TV and air conditioning. Slippers and kimonos are included for extra comfort. The bathroom comes with a shower, hairdryer and luxury toiletries.

The restaurant Sanders Kitchen offers a menu inspired by the Mediterranean cuisine and focuses on fresh and healthy food. The menu is based on seasonal and local produce, and changes weekly.

Classic cocktails and carefully selected wines are served at bar Tata, which offers a relaxed atmosphere in a vintage setting. The inner courtyard is a perfect place to enjoy a drink, a good book or breakfast during sunny days.

Staff can arrange laundry and concierge services, as well a car and bike rental. Tivoli Garden and Copenhagen Central Station are found within 20 minutes' walk. Copenhagen Kastrup Airport is 9 km away.

room_details.room_Description: Hotel Sanders in Copenhagen offers a variety of rooms and suites, each designed with unique features and amenities. The hotel features classic rooms with king or queen beds, spacious bathrooms, and either street or courtyard views. They also offer one-bedroom suites with separate lounges, kitchenettes, and fireplaces, as well as luxurious suites with more space and amenities. Additionally, there are single rooms and smaller rooms that embrace the hotel's unique design and comfort.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Nimb Hotel
Located in Copenhagen’s famous Tivoli Gardens, this stylish boutique hotel is housed in an impressive Moorish-style building. It offers on-site dining and designer rooms with flat-screen TVs and park views.

Elegant rooms with antique furniture and four-poster beds are featured in all Nimb Hotel rooms. Each bathroom has a double sink and shower. Luxury toiletries and guest bathrobes are also included. Selected rooms feature a fireplace and a free-standing bathtub.

The restaurant Nimb Brasserie offer Tivoli Gardens views. Guests can enjoy seasonal Scandinavian dishes and French cuisine. Grilled delicacies with an Asian touch are available at Bar'n'Grill.

Featuring décor by Hans J Wegner, the bar serves afternoon tea and great coffee in the daylight hours. When the clock strikes 17, the talented bartenders mix splendid cocktails in the historic ballroom complete with chandeliers and a log fire.

Nimb Hotel can help arrange private limousine service to and from Copenhagen Airport, which is 8 km away.

location: 399 El Geish Road , San Stefano, 21599 Alexandria, Egypt
place_name: Four Seasons Hotel Alexandria at San Stefano
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Four Seasons Hotel Alexandria At San Stefano
Set in an architectural landmark, Hotel San Stefano features a fashionable resort setting with a private sandy beach and overlooking the Mediterranean Sea. It boasts a full-service spa, outdoor pool and restaurants with terraces. Guests can enjoy free WiFi throughout the property and in the guest rooms.

All rooms at the Four Seasons Hotel Alexandria At San Stefano have a balcony, some of them including Mediterranean Sea views. A minibar, TV and air conditioning are all standard facilities.

The hotel has a 2 story Spa and fitness centre that offers 14 treatment rooms, sauna, steam room, whirlpool and a squash court. For leisure, the hotel provides a number of recreation activities year round based on seasonality: an outdoor infinity pool, an indoor heated pool, a private beach, Kids For all Seasons program and sightseeing.

The hotel offers nine distinctive restaurants and lounges serving a diverse selection of local seafood and international specialties. Options range from Lebanese and Italian fine-dining to contemporary Mediterranean favourites – café snacks, cocktails and gelati. A Shisha corner is also available.

The Alexandria Four Seasons Hotel is 60 km from Alexandria Borg El Arab Airport. A hotel limousine is available upon request.

Offering rooms with views of the Mediterranean Sea and El Montazah Royal Gardens, AIFU Hotel El Montazah Alexandria is situated in Alexandria. The resort has 2 restaurants and an outdoor pool.

The air-conditioned accommodations at Aifu are decorated in a contemporary style. Each room has a modern, private bathroom. Most rooms come with a swimming pool view and montazah royal Gardens view

After a refreshing swim, guests can enjoy a work-out in the health club’s fitness centre. There is also a sauna and hot tub for a relaxing afternoon.

Guests can enjoy drinks at the Pool Bar, which is situated adjacent to the pool. For dinner, The Jasmine Restaurant offers exotic international dishes.

The Alexandria Library is a 10-minute drive from the hotel. Borg El Arab Airport is a 1-hour drive away. Free parking is available on-site.

resort_details: the location in Nabq Bay overlooking Tiran Island makes this hotel the perfect option for seeing the very best of Sharm El Sheikh. Chime Lounge and Bar features a charismatic lounge-style setting with a spacious dance floor and daily live entertainment. The buffet breakfast includes Chinese options.

Transfers by hotel taxi are available to and from Nadi International Airport for FJD 45 per 1 way for up to 4 people, on request, prior to arrival. There are Chinese-speaking staff at the property, and airport transfers with Chinese-speaking staff can be arranged upon request.

Sheraton Fiji Golf & Beach Resort is 7 km from Nadi Town and a 20-minute drive from Nadi International Airport. It is 25 km from Garden of the Sleeping Giant.

room_details.room_Description: The Sheraton Fiji Golf & Beach Resort offers spacious rooms with private balconies or patios, many with ocean views. Rooms typically include amenities such as a 32-inch LCD TV, private bathrooms with rainforest showerheads, coffee makers, free Wi-Fi, and a refrigerator. The resort also offers various room types, including oceanfront rooms and presidential suites.

resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Sheraton Resort & Spa, Tokoriki Island, Fiji
Adult only access rooms and family friendly rooms
Featuring a sandy private beach, Sheraton Resort & Spa, Tokoriki Island, Fiji boasts an outdoor pool and fitness centre. The on-site day spa, Tokoriki Retreat Spa, offers 4 serene treatment rooms. Free WiFi is available on property
Curcuma Restaurant: Indian-fusion flavors
Tokoriki Coco Palms: delightful Fijian lovo feast - an exquisite display of earth oven-style cooking with traditional music and dance
Side by Side: Our in-house kids club offers a variety of different activities changing daily
 Helicopter transfers available

The air-conditioned rooms all come with an iPod dock and flat-screen TV with cable channels including Chinese language channels. Each has a patio fitted with sun loungers and some have a private plunge pool. Chinese tea, slippers and a dental kit are available upon request.

Waitui House restaurant offers seafood and International cuisine. The resort’s waterfront dining option offers an exquisite menu bursting with flavour and fresh produce. With its oceanfront location, boasting breathtaking views from each and every table, Waitui House is the perfect venue for an indulgent dining experience. The pool bar offers small snacks and the Pantry Café serves sandwiches and pastries.

Guests can enjoy a variety of activities on site, like snorkelling and kayaking. The resort also has a gift shop and a 24-hour front desk.

Sheraton Resort & Spa is located on Tokoriki Island, 35 km off the west coast of Nadi. The resort is around a 1-hour ferry transfer from Port Denarau. Guests transfers via the daily ferry boat at 12:00pm or a private water taxi to the property are available.

room_details.room_Description: The Sheraton Resort & Spa Tokoriki Island Fiji offers a range of accommodation options, including rooms with island views, oceanfront rooms, and family rooms with connecting rooms. Many rooms feature a furnished patio, separate sitting area, and amenities like a refrigerator, flat-screen TV, and premium bedding. Some rooms also offer private plunge pools.

location: Castaway Island, Mamanuca Islands, . Castaway Island, Fiji
resort_details:
This Fiji island resort offers an award-winning private island retreat, surrounded by white sand beaches, coral reefs and crystal clear waters. The resort offers 4 restaurants, free non-motorised water sports and a free kids club.

Each of the spacious and traditionally thatched Fijian-style bungalows at Castaway Island has a refurbished private bathroom. Guests can choose to stay in a bungalow located directly on the beach.

Free resort facilities include a tennis court, beach volleyball, canoeing, windsurfing, snorkelling and hobie catamarans. You can relax on the beach or in a hammock, or indulge yourself with a massage or body treatment.

Overlooking the beach and ocean, the award-winning Restaurant 108 serves Asian, Fijian and Indian fusion cuisine. Water’s Edge Restaurant serves Fijian cuisine and sweeping ocean views. Sundowner Pizza Bar serves wood-fired pizzas and is located on the beach front. Nuku Marau Pool Bar & Grill is situated by the pool.

Castaway Island is situated 27 km from Denarau Island. It can be reached in 15 minutes by helicopter or seaplane from Nadi Airport.

room_details.room_Description: Castaway Island Fiji offers 65 air-conditioned bures, traditionally styled bungalows, each individually decorated. These bures feature vaulted ceilings lined with hand-painted Tapa cloth, separate sitting areas, and modern amenities. Rooms include private patios, safes, refrigerators, coffee/tea makers, and bathrooms with showers.

place_name: Hilton Fiji Beach Resort and Spa
resort_details:
Experience world-class service at Hilton Fiji Beach Resort and Spa
Boasting 2.5 kilometres of private beach, the luxurious Hilton Fiji Beach Resort offers spacious rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows. It features a day spa and 9 swimming pools, including 2 adults only pools in the Koro complex. Free WiFi is available in public areas around the property.

Hilton Fiji Beach Resort & Spa is located 12 minutes’ drive from Nadi Town and 3 minutes' drive from the Denarau Golf and Racquet Club. Nadi International Airport is a 20-minute drive away.

Opened on June 26, 2017 at Hilton Fiji Beach Resort and Spa, KORO is an adult only zone that includes beachfront restaurants with all day dining, a bar, expansive outdoor pools and a deck. There is live entertainment offered every night and there is a day spa and fitness centre, located alongside the KORO complex.

All the rooms at the Hilton Fiji Resort are luxuriously appointed, with flat-screen cable TV and DVD players. Each room is air-conditioned, and most also feature gorgeous ocean views.

Guests can work out in the fully equipped fitness centre. Nearby activities include fishing, jet skiing and diving. Children receive free access to the kids club. Union Pay credit cards are accepted and there are Chinese speaking staff at the property.

Nuku offers Fijian specialities and international cuisine, while Maravu features Pan-Asian cuisine and stunning water views. The Deli serves a range of espresso coffees, pastries and gelato. The adults only Koro offers breakfast, lunch and dinner.

A secluded boutique island retreat with luxurious touches befitting an exclusive island resort. Intimate, with only 16 spacious, incredibly private pool villas makes this resort unique. But it is the intangible aspects of this barefoot luxury retreat that sets it aside and offers an indulgent escape for true romantics.

location: 21 rue de l'ocean, 85320 Les Pineaux, France
resort_details:
About this property
Elegant Accommodation: Le Logis in Les Pineaux offers family rooms with private bathrooms, parquet floors, and wardrobes. Each room features a shower and garden or pool views.

Outdoor Amenities: Guests can relax in the seasonal outdoor swimming pool or enjoy the lush garden. Free WiFi is available throughout the property.

Convenient Location: Located 68 km from La Rochelle - Ile de Re Airport, the bed and breakfast is near attractions such as Domangère Golf Course (31 km), Vendespace (32 km), and Vendée History Museum (50 km).

Guest Favorites: Guests appreciate the delicious breakfast provided by the property, the friendly host, and the family-friendly atmosphere.

room_details.room_Description: Le Logis rooms are known for their individual decor and original architectural features, often found in historic buildings. They may include features like high ceilings or rooms under the rafters with vineyard views. Bathrooms typically offer soaking tubs or walk-in showers. Le Logis rooms are often part of larger estates or chateaux, offering a luxurious and unique stay.

location: 65 rue de Bellevue, Quartier de l'Echassier, Chateaubernard, 16100 Châteaubernard, France
resort_details:
Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

The Château de L'Yeuse is located 2.5 km from Cognac, near the banks of the River Charente. It offers classic accommodation and a sauna, spa, Turkish bath and outdoor swimming pool. Breakfast includes homemade and organic produce.

All guest rooms offer views of the countryside and have satellite TV and Wi-Fi access.

The hotel has a large terrace with panoramic views of the Charente countryside, where guests can eat and relax with a drink from the bar. The Yeuse’s restaurant serves gourmet cuisine and offers a variety of wines, served in one of the Château’s large dining rooms or on the terrace.

The hotel’s spa has a hot tub, sauna and offers massage therapy. Guests of the Yeuse can enjoy hiking and cycling nearby and travel the 7 km to Cognac Golf Club.

room_details.room_Description: Hôtel L'Yeuse Chateaux offers a variety of room types, including Superior Double Rooms, Deluxe Rooms, Suites, and Double King Suites. All rooms feature amenities like air conditioning, a minibar, free Wi-Fi, and a flat-screen TV. Some rooms offer river views, garden views, or balconies, while others have bathtubs or showers.

location: 15 rue du General Bruncher, 17450 Fouras, France
resort_details: This former coaching inn is located 50 meters from the beach overlooking Fort Boyard. It offers air-conditioned accommodation with a private bathroom, free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV, and free, unlimited access to the spa. A sweet and savory buffet breakfast is served every morning in the breakfast room or on the terrace. Guests can also relax with a drink or an aperitif at the Grand Hôtel des Bains SPA bar. The spa features a free indoor pool with hydromassage jets, as well as a hammam, sauna, and solarium. Activities in the surrounding area, including cycling, are available for an additional fee. La Rochelle is a 20-minute drive away, and Fort Boyard is close.

room_details.room_Description: The Grand Hotel Des Bains offers various room types with spa access, including standard, comfort, privilege, and junior suite categories. Rooms feature amenities like flat-screen TVs, free WiFi, and in some cases, balconies or terraces. The hotel also boasts a spa with a sauna, hammam, and swimming pool.

resort_details:
Enjoy VIP treatment with the exclusive service of HOTEL Domaine des Etangs, Auberge Resorts Collection
HOTEL Domaine des Etangs, Auberge Resorts Collection is located in Massignac, 30 km from Rochechouart - Nature Park. It offers free bikes, a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, a fitness centre and free private parking. A range of facilities are available on site, including a garden, a terrace and a restaurant. The property offers a 24-hour front desk, airport transfers, a shared lounge and free WiFi throughout the property. A minibar is also available. HOTEL Domaine des Etangs, Auberge Resorts Collection features a hammam. You can play billiards, table tennis and tennis at this 5-star hotel, and the area is popular for cycling. Guests staying at the hotel have access to an indoor pool and a business centre. Château de Montbrun is 35 km away. The nearest airport (Limoges-Bellegarde Airport) is 53 km away.

room_details.room_Description: Domaine Des Etangs offers a variety of rooms and suites, each named after a planet and designed to be unique and comfortable. The property also features cottages and villas, some with kitchens. Rooms are generally large, updated, and decorated with an eclectic mix of old and new styles, often with art and artful lighting.

location: ROUTE DE LA PETITE CHAMPAGNE MARGONNET, 16200 Bourg-Charente, France
resort_details:
About this property
Reliable info:Guests say the description and photos for this property are very accurate.
Comfortable Accommodation: Les Pilotis Du Cognac in Bourg-Charente offers a 3-star chalet with family rooms, a shared kitchen, and a games room. Free WiFi is available throughout the property.

Relaxing Facilities: Guests can enjoy spa facilities, a sun terrace, and a seasonal outdoor swimming pool. Additional amenities include a steam room, wellness packages, and a solarium.

Outdoor Activities: The chalet provides free on-site private parking, bike hire, and barbecue facilities. Activities such as fishing, walking tours, hiking, and cycling are nearby.

Local Attractions: Cognac Golf Course is a 19-minute walk away, and La Rochelle - Ile de Re Airport is 118 km from the property. Saintes Train Station is 38 km distant.

room_details.room_Description: Les Pilotis du Cognac offers four unique, wood-framed chalets on stilts, each with its own theme and private terrace. The chalets are equipped with a double bed, a sofa bed, a well-equipped kitchenette, and a bathroom with a shower. Common areas include a heated swimming pool (June 1st to September 30th), a spa and sauna, and a playground with barbecue facilities.

place_name: La Grande Terrasse Hotel & Spa La Rochelle - MGallery
resort_details:
Overlooking the ocean and the islands just off La Rochelle, this hotel with a heated indoor swimming pool is surrounded by 3 hectares of parkland. Guests benefit from a Nuxe spa, a hammam and a sauna on site.

Entirely renovated in 2017, La Grande Terrasse Hotel&Spa La Rochelle MGallery Hotel Collection offers well-equipped rooms with satellite TV and free Wi-Fi access.

The hotel restaurant "Gaya Cuisine de Bords de Mer – Pierre Gagnaire" overlooks the ocean and serves inventive variations of traditional French cuisine made using fresh local produce.

A concierge service, as well as a luggage porter service and valet parking are available at the property. Free private parking is offered on site.

location: Rue De La Combe, 84220 Gordes, France
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Airelles Gordes, La Bastide
Located in the hilltop village of Gordes, Airelles Gordes, La Bastide features 18th century décor and offers panoramic views over the Luberon valley from its many terraces and hanging gardens. Free WiFi is available anywhere in this Palace.

Most of the spacious rooms and suites feature private bathrooms with a bathtub, and some also include a separate shower. A flat-screen TV with satellite channels is provided.

Buffet breakfast is available every morning. The hotel's restaurants, La Table de La Bastide and Le Clover, both feature Provençal cuisine made with Mediterranean products served with regional wines. More  traditional meals can also be enjoyed in the vaulted dining room or on the shaded terrace with its view of the valley. Clover Gordes, the restaurant by Chef Jean-François Piège also offer a unique grill experience.

Le Airelles Spa by Guerlain offers an indoor swimming pool, 4 treatment rooms and a fitness center. The outdoor pool in the garden is surrounded by a sun deck and offer unrestricted views of the valley. Guests may enjoy a refreshment by the pool. A Citroën 2CV car and electric bicycles are available.

Secured parking is possible on site and car cleaning can be arranged free of charge. The property is a 50-minutes drive from Avignon TGV Train Station.

Airelles Saint-Tropez, officially known as Château de la Messardière, is a luxury hotel and resort located in Saint-Tropez, France. It's known for its fairytale castle architecture, lush grounds, and panoramic views of the Gulf of Saint-Tropez. The property features multiple dining options, including a Japanese restaurant by Nobu, and a spa offering a variety of treatments.

room_details.room_Description: Airelles Château de la Messardière in Saint-Tropez offers a variety of rooms, including Superior, Deluxe, and Suite categories, with options for sea views, garden views, pool access, and private pools. Rooms generally feature premium bedding, free minibar, in-room safes, and individually decorated spaces.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Château de Berne
Elegant Accommodation: Château de Berne in Lorgues offers a 5-star hotel experience with spa facilities, a swimming pool with a view, sauna, fitness centre, sun terrace, and free bicycles. Guests enjoy a garden, restaurant, bar, tennis court, indoor pool, and free WiFi.

Comfortable Amenities: Rooms feature bathrobes, private bathrooms, tea and coffee makers, garden views, hairdryers, free toiletries, showers, slippers, TVs, and wardrobes. Additional amenities include air-conditioning, terraces, heated pools, balconies, washing machines, and outdoor dining areas.

Dining and Leisure: The traditional restaurant serves French and Mediterranean cuisine for lunch and dinner. Guests can also enjoy yoga classes, walking tours, hiking, and cycling. The property is 78 km from Toulon-Hyeres Airport and near attractions such as Le Pont des Fées and Château de Grimaud.

room_details.room_Description: Château de Berne offers various room and suite options, all equipped with amenities like air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, minibars, and coffee machines. Some rooms feature garden views and balconies, and all rooms include premium bedding, including hypoallergenic pillows and Frette Italian sheets. The hotel also offers family rooms, suites, and even a villa with a private pool.

resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Airelles Château de la Messardière
Elegant Accommodation: Airelles Château de la Messardière in Saint-Tropez offers a 5-star experience with a private beach area, spa and wellness centre, swimming pool with a view, sauna, sun terrace, and free WiFi.

Comfortable Amenities: Guests enjoy private check-in and check-out, shuttle service, beauty services, steam room, wellness packages, fitness room, hot tub, 24-hour front desk, concierge service, kids' club, indoor and outdoor play areas, electric vehicle charging station, and free on-site parking.

Dining Options: The modern restaurant serves French, Italian, Mediterranean, and Asian cuisines for lunch, dinner, and high tea. Additional amenities include air-conditioning, balcony, private bathroom, bath, minibar, and interconnected rooms.

Prime Location: Located 53 km from Toulon - Hyeres Airport, the hotel is near Tahiti Beach (2 km), Chateau de Grimaud and Le Pont des Fées (14 km), and Port Grimaud (9 km). Scuba diving is available in the surroundings. Highly rated by guests.

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Château Saint-Martin & Spa - an Oetker Collection Hotel
Located in Vence, 24 km from Nice, Château Saint-Martin & Spa - an Oetker Collection Hotel is a 12th-century Knight Templar Castle with panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea. It offers a heated swimming pool, a restaurant and well-being centre.

All rooms and suites are air-conditioned. They feature views of the garden, countryside or sea, a TV with cable channels and a safety deposit box. The en suite bathrooms include a hairdryer, free toiletries and slippers. Some rooms feature a balcony.

There are several restaurants on site including the gourmet Saint Martin, which features a terrace with panoramic views of the Mediterranean coast and an open kitchen. There is also a bar, Le Rossini. Room service is available throughout the day.

Additional features include body treatments, yoga lessons, wine tasting, a boules and a 24-hour reception. The beach is 13 km away and free private parking is possible on site.

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Coquillade Provence
Located close to the Luberon Park, Coquillade Provence welcomes you in a typical 13th-century wine-making village.  Offering contemporary rooms, the hotel boasts indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a spa and three restaurants. Bike rental and charging stations for electric cars are available at this property.

Coquillade Provence features charming rooms, junior suites and suites. The spacious and bright rooms open onto the gardens or a private terrace with a stunning view of Luberon. They offer a private bathroom.

Spend a lazy afternoon by the outdoor swimming pool before having dinner in the hotel restaurant. It serves gourmet cuisine,  traditional specialties prepared with local seasonal produce and italian cuisine.

The property is 6 km from Roussillon and 50 km from Avignon.

location: 71, Boulevard du Général de Gaulle, 06230 Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat, France
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Grand-Hôtel du Cap-Ferrat, A Four Seasons Hotel
Set on 7 hectares of Mediterranean gardens, at the tip of captivating Cap-Ferrat, Grand-Hôtel du Cap-Ferrat is awarded the status of a luxury Palace hotel and offers a 33 metres-long sea-water heated pool and panoramic sea views. Located 12 km from Nice, it features three restaurants, including the La Véranda, and an award-winning 750 m² spa centre.

Since 1908 Grand-Hôtel du Cap-Ferrat has welcomed rich and famous guests to its elegant rooms. With a refined décor, the spacious rooms include a docking station featuring USB and bluetooth connections, minibar and an LCD TV. Each air-conditioned room offers pinewood or sea views, and some suites also have a private pool. Free WiFi access is included.

Gourmet cuisine is served in the restaurant Le Cap which has 1 Michelin star. You can enjoy Mediterranean dishes at the Club Dauphin grill restaurant next to the outdoor infinity pool, or in the chic La Véranda bistrot.

The hotel's award-winning spa features five lavish treatment rooms, including a luxury VIP suite for couples, as well as two outdoor treatment pavilions with mesmerising Mediterranean views and a 1,200 m² Spa Garden with sea-view sun terraces. Le Spa also includes indoor and outdoor fitness options.

Monaco is located 15 km from the hotel and the Italian Border is 40 km away. Nice Côte d'Azur Airport is located 19 km away. Grand-Hôtel du Cap-Ferrat, A Four Seasons Hotel can provide a private transfer service with advance reservation.

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Hotel Byblos Saint-Tropez
Hotel Byblos Saint-Tropez is a palace hotel situated in the heart of the village of Saint-Tropez, in between the Provence and the French Riviera Region. It boasts two restaurants, the "B by the pool" and the "Cucina by Alain Ducasse", and a Spa featuring Sisley cosmetics. The hotel also offers an outdoor heated pool and a fitness centre.

Each room and suite is uniquely decorated in a Provençal theme. They are fully equipped with air conditioning, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV, and free WiFi access. They also feature either a view on the garden, pool or village.

Guests benefit from a wide range of services including the Concierge's “Clefs D’Or” desk, a front desk, 24-hour room service, housekeeping and laundry facilities.

Nice Côte d’Azur Airport is 92 km away and Toulon-Hyères Airport is 52 km from the property. A free shuttle service is available from the hotel to Pampelonne Beach.

room_details.room_Description: Hôtel Byblos Saint-Tropez offers a range of room types, including Classic Rooms, Deluxe Rooms, and Suites, each with unique features and amenities. The Classic Rooms, spanning from 28 to 38 square meters, are decorated in a Mediterranean style and offer king-size beds or twin beds with garden, village, or pool views. Deluxe Rooms, larger at 32 to 43 square meters, include a sitting area and private balconies or terraces. Suites offer even more space and luxury, with options like the Missoni Suite, designed by Laura Gonzalez.

location: 50 La Croisette, Cannes City-Centre, 06400 Cannes, France
resort_details:
The JW Marriott Cannes welcomes you to Cannes, on the Boulevard de la Croisette, just 50 meters from the beach. This 5-star hotel offers a rooftop pool, a private partner beach, a casino and a shopping mall.

Accommodations at the JW Marriott Cannes combine shades of cream and chocolate with the theme of the Film Festival. Each room has an LCD satellite TV, and some have balconies with views of the bay and the Lerins Islands.

An American breakfast buffet is served every morning. Guests can enjoy traditional, upscale Italian cuisine at the famous Scalini restaurant. In the evening, the Sunset Terrace, offers a glass of champagne or a cocktail overlooking the sunset. Room service is also available daily, with a limited menu during the night.

The JW Marriott Cannes features a 24-hour front desk with currency exchange services and a business center with Wi-Fi access. The hotel underwent a renovation in 2021.

The JW Marriott Cannes is 30 km from Nice-Côte d'Azur Airport and a 15-minute boat ride from Sainte-Marguerite Island. Private underground parking is available on site.

This is the preferred neighborhood for travelers visiting Cannes, according to independent customer reviews.

Couples particularly appreciate the location of this property. They give it a 9.5 rating for a two-person stay.

room_details.room_Description: The JW Marriott Cannes offers a variety of rooms and suites, including Deluxe Guest Rooms with city, garden, and partial sea views, as well as One Bedroom Suites and Prestige Suites. Many rooms feature a cinema theme with portraits of movie stars and contemporary designs.

location: 12 Rue de l'Indépendance Américaine, 78000, Versailles France
resort_details: Airelles Château de Versailles, also known as Le Grand Contrôle, is a luxury hotel located on the grounds of the Château de Versailles, offering unparalleled access to the palace and gardens. The hotel is housed in a building originally designed by Jules Hardouin-Mansart in 1681 and has been meticulously restored to its former glory. It offers a unique blend of historical grandeur and modern amenities, with 13 rooms and suites, each decorated with period furnishings and art.

room_details.room_Description: Airelles Château de Versailles offers 14 rooms and suites, including a 2-bedroom suite, named after historical figures and decorated with 17th and 18th-century furnishings and art. Each room has unique details like fireplaces, herringbone parquet floors, and textiles recreated from Versailles' archives. Bathrooms are also period-appropriate, featuring marble checkerboard floors. Some rooms have views of the gardens or the Lake of the Swiss Guards.

location: 30 Avenue George V, 8th arr., 75008 Paris, France
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Bvlgari Hotel Paris
Elegant Accommodation: Bvlgari Hotel Paris in Paris offers a 5-star experience with spa facilities, a wellness centre, sauna, fitness centre, indoor swimming pool, terrace, restaurant, bar, and free WiFi.

Comfortable Amenities: Guests enjoy private check-in and check-out, beauty services, wellness packages, fitness room, hot tub, 24-hour front desk, concierge service, family rooms, and full-day security.

Dining Options: The restaurant serves Italian cuisine with American, Italian, and Asian breakfasts. Dining ambiances include traditional, modern, and romantic. Lunch and dinner are available with vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and dairy-free options.

Prime Location: Located less than 1 km from the Arc de Triomphe and an 18-minute walk to the Eiffel Tower, the hotel is 17 km from Paris Orly Airport. Nearby attractions include Musée de l'Orangerie and Palais des Congrès de Paris.

room_details.room_Description: The Bvlgari Hotel Paris offers various room types, including Executive Rooms, Deluxe Suites, and the Bvlgari Penthouse. Executive Rooms offer 42-square-meter spaces with private loggias, while Deluxe Suites feature 65-square-meter spaces with marble bathrooms and dressing rooms. The Bvlgari Penthouse is a 400-square-meter suite on two levels with a 360° view of Paris.

location: 31, Avenue George V, 8th arr., 75008 Paris, France
place_name: Four Seasons Hotel George V Paris
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Four Seasons Hotel George V Paris
Just steps from the Champs-Elysées, on Avenue George V, Four Seasons Hotel George V features private terraces with commanding Paris city views, signature lavish flower displays imagined by Jeff Leatham, top-of-the-line spa treatments and Michelin-awarded dining.

The somptuous rooms and suites, many with private terraces overlooking the city of Paris, are fitted with an interactive TV, CD/DVD player and library and WiFi access. Espresso coffee machine with complimentary coffee pods, safe, mini bar, and in-room bread toasting service are standard.

Four Seasons Hotel George V, Paris provides three restaurants recognized by the coveted Michelin Guide for a total of 6 stars. Classic French cuisine and lighter menus have earned Le Cinq three Michelin stars. The chic La Galerie is a favorite spot among fashionable Parisians for a drink or light bites. Le George, awarded one Michelin star, offers Mediterranean cuisine designed for sharing. The 7-meter-high conservatory offers views of the marble courtyard and houses two-Michelin starred L’Orangerie, where guests will be able to discover light, gourmet dishes centered around vegetables, dairy and seafood, deliberately eschewing meat. Finally, Le Bar proposes cocktails and its large windows open on to the famous Avenue George V.

The spa, spread over 720 square meters, includes a 17-meters swimming pool, vitality pool with hydro-massage water experience circuit heated to 34°C, a 90 m² cutting-edge fitness room, and a stylish hair salon. Moreover, other facilities include valet and concierge service, as well as meeting and banquet facilities with dedicated staff.


Just 1.6 km from Eiffel Tower and 3.5 km from Musée d'Orsay, Four Seasons Hotel George V, Paris is set in an ideal location in the Golden Triangle, famous for high-fashion boutiques. It is also 3.5 km from the trendy shops and cafes of St. Germain-des-Prés. The hotel offers parking at an extra cost.

Located on the iconic Place Vendôme, the Ritz Paris is one of the most legendary hotels in the City of Lights. Refinement of French art de vivre meets elegance of Belle Époque décor. Exquisitely appointed 71 rooms and 71 suites bear the name of F. Scott Fitzgerald or Marcel Proust. Ritz Paris is a place where dreams come to life. The famous Bar Vendôme welcomes guests to savor dishes at any hour of the day while the Ritz Bar is the perfect place to enjoy zodiac-themed cocktails. Ritz Paris Le Comptoir celebrates modern conviviality and French gourmandise, with exceptional pastries by Chef François Perret. At the École Ritz Escoffier, enthusiasts, from novice to professional, can perfect their approach to French cuisine and pastry-making. The Ritz Club & Spa and its sumptuous pool elevates well-being to an art form. Last but not least, Salon Proust is the place to enjoy a delightful teatime à la française and no visit to the Ritz Paris would be complete without stopping by the iconic Bar Hemingway.

room_details.room_Description: The Ritz Paris offers a diverse range of rooms and suites, each with its own unique character and ambiance. Rooms range from Superior to Grand Deluxe, featuring elegant French-style decor, modern amenities, and luxurious marble bathrooms. Many rooms offer views of the Eiffel Tower, Opéra Garnier, Place Vendôme, or the hotel's Grand Jardin. The Ritz Paris also boasts Prestige Suites, including the Suite Chopin and Suite Impériale, with historical significance and unique features like the painted ceiling of the Suite Chopin.

location: 4 Rue De Valois, 1st arr., 75001 Paris, France
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Grand Hôtel Du Palais Royal
Set within an 18th-century building, the Grand Hotel is located in the heart of Paris, 200 metres from the Louvre museum and Tuileries Gardens. It features fine works of art, a spa by Holidermie, à la carte restaurant and 24-hour reception.

The designer rooms at Grand Hotel Palais Royal include a minibar, free Wi-Fi, en suite facilities and a HD flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Some rooms have a balcony with views Paris' monuments.

Grand Hôtel Du Palais Royal serves a daily American-style buffet breakfast, which can be taken in the guest room upon request. Guests can also enjoy fine dining in the restaurant or relax with a drink in the hotel's bar.

The Palais Royal-Musée du Louvre Metro station (line 1) is only 150 metres from the hotel and provides direct access to the Champs-Elysées, Place de la Concorde and Arc de Triomphe. Charles-de-Gaulle Airport is 23 km away.

location: Hameau de Bellevue 9 rue de la Republique, 51160 Champillon, France
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Royal Champagne Hotel & Spa
Elegant Accommodations: Royal Champagne Hotel & Spa in Champillon offers luxurious rooms with garden views, private balconies, and modern amenities. Each room includes air-conditioning, a private bathroom, and free WiFi.

Exceptional Facilities: Guests can enjoy an infinity swimming pool, spa and wellness centre, sauna, fitness centre, sun terrace, and indoor pool. Additional facilities include a hot tub, steam room, and beauty services.

Gourmet Dining: The modern restaurant serves French cuisine with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. Breakfast includes champagne, warm dishes, fresh pastries, and a variety of fruits.

location: 10 Place de la Concorde, 8th arr., 75008 Paris, France
place_name: Hôtel de Crillon, A Rosewood Hote
resort_details:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Hotel de Crillon
Hotel de Crillon is set in Paris, 300 metres from both the Tuileries Garden and the Champs-Elysées and 1.5 km from the Louvre Museum. Some rooms have a balcony. The hotel features an indoor swimming pool and a spa.

Each room at Hotel de Crillon provides Rivolta Carmignani Italian linen and French Drouault pillows and duvets. The spacious marble bathrooms feature underfloor heating as well as bespoke toiletries and a bathroom mirror with an inset television. A walk-in rain shower and a bath are also provided. In-room check-in and a Bluetooth sound system are available.

In our gastronomic restaurant L’Écrin*, we invite you to an exceptional culinary experience characterized by the subtlety of our dishes and remarkable pairings.

Nonos by Paul Pairet is a delicatessen counter and the deliciously moreish recreation of the Hôtel de Crillon offering the very best seafood, charcuterie, smoked fish and cheeses.

Butterfly Pâtisserie, the new gourmet space in the hotel located in the heart of Paris, showcases delicacies, artful cakes, seasonal desserts and signature chocolates in a gleaming high jewellery atelier setting.

Jardin d’Hiver is the perfect cocoon in which to share a glamorous family moment or tête-à-tête. Travelers and Parisians can enjoy all-day dining or indulge their sweet tooth with splendid desserts by our Head Pastry Chef Matthieu Carlin.

Located on Place de la Concorde, the bar Les Ambassadeurs at Hôtel de Crillon, A Rosewood Hotel, epitomises the quintessential spirit of Paris. The most iconic cocktail bar in the capital.

An indoor swimming pool with atypical decoration and a fireplace area is featured. Guests can also relax in the spa or enjoy massage and beauty treatments at an extra cost. A hairdresser and fitness centre are available on site.

High-speed internet access is provided throughout. Extras include valet parking and a concierge service. The surrounding area is convenient for shopping and provides direct access to several touristic sites.

An airport shuttle is available. Orsay Museum is 1 km from Hotel de Crillon, while the Grands Magasins Department Stores can be found 1.1 km away. The nearest airport is Paris - Orly Airport, 24 km from Hotel de Crillon.

location: Chocó Cloud Forest, Pichincha Province, Ecuador (100km northwest of Quito)
resort_details: Mashpi Lodge is an award-winning luxury eco-lodge nestled in the pristine Chocoan cloud forest, just 3.5 hours from Quito. This architectural marvel features contemporary design with floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows, seamlessly integrating guests with the surrounding rainforest. Set within a 3,200-acre private reserve, the lodge offers unparalleled access to one of the world's most biodiverse hotspots, home to over 400 bird species, including 35 endemic species. The property features innovative exploration options including the Dragonfly Gondola aerial tram, Sky Bike canopy experience, and extensive trail systems leading to pristine waterfalls. As a National Geographic Unique Lodge of the World and member of Relais & Châteaux, Mashpi combines sustainable luxury with cutting-edge conservation efforts, including an on-site research laboratory that has discovered new species. The lodge operates on hydroelectric power and was built using sustainable construction techniques to minimize environmental impact.

room_details.room_Description: Mashpi Lodge offers 22 rooms and 3 suites accommodating up to 48 guests across three floors. All accommodations feature floor-to-ceiling and wall-to-wall panoramic windows providing intimate forest views. First-floor rooms span 495 sq ft with king beds and spacious bathrooms featuring Philippe Starck-designed bathtubs positioned at windows for forest views while soaking. Rooms feature subtle LED lighting, wooden accents, modern minimalist décor mixing warm earth tones with steel, stone and glass, blackout curtains, premium linens, air conditioning, and en-suite bathrooms with double sinks. The contemporary design creates a luxury cocoon where guests can observe the cloud forest from the comfort of their beds. All rooms are equipped with modern amenities while maintaining an intimate connection to nature, with the sounds and sights of the rainforest just beyond the glass.

resort_details: Hacienda Zuleta is a historic 4,000-acre working farm and luxury hacienda in Ecuador's northern Andean highlands, formerly owned by two Ecuadorian presidents. With panoramic mountain views, colonial architecture, and gracious service, Hacienda Zuleta provides an unforgettable glimpse into Ecuador's rural heritage.

resort_details: Napo Wildlife Center is a premier eco-lodge deep in Ecuador's Amazon rainforest, offering unparalleled wildlife viewing within Yasuní National Park, one of Earth's most biodiverse regions. This community-owned and operated lodge is located on pristine Añangucocha Lake, accessible only by motorized canoe along blackwater creeks. The property features a 135-foot canopy observation tower providing incredible bird-watching opportunities, proximity to one of the Amazon's most productive parrot clay licks, and extensive trail systems through primary rainforest. Expert indigenous guides lead excursions showcasing incredible biodiversity including pink river dolphins, caimans, monkeys, and over 560 bird species. The lodge combines authentic Amazon immersion with comfortable accommodations, delicious cuisine, and professional naturalist guiding. As a community tourism initiative, guests' stays directly support indigenous conservation efforts.

room_details.room_Description: Napo Wildlife Center offers 16 spacious cabins with private balconies overlooking Añangucocha Lake, providing premium comfort in the heart of the Amazon. Accommodations feature comfortable beds with mosquito netting and quality linens, private bathrooms with hot water showers and flush toilets (rare in remote Amazon lodges), ceiling fans, solar-powered lighting, hammocks on private decks, and floor-to-ceiling screened windows maximizing lake views and natural ventilation. The design uses natural materials including bamboo and palm thatch, creating authentic jungle atmosphere while maintaining high comfort standards. Cabins are elevated and connected by covered boardwalks, protecting the forest floor. With 24-hour electricity from solar panels, hot showers, and spacious layouts, Napo Wildlife Center provides exceptional Amazon comfort.

Guests enjoy a spectacular rooftop pool and bar offering 360-degree panoramic views of Old Havana's colonial architecture and surrounding cityscape, the refined Spa Albear by Resense, two gourmet restaurants including San Cristobal with breathtaking city vistas, an elegant Cigar Bar, sophisticated Lobby Bar, fully equipped fitness center, and multiple event spaces. Operated by Europe's oldest luxury hotel group Kempinski, this landmark property combines rich Cuban heritage with European luxury standards and impeccable personalized service.
